action.name: Snapcast Reflex
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder is attacked while a spell is ready, it can loose that spell at once with no wind-up.
This can happen once every few seconds and costs a little extra mana.
This is a spell and haste effect.
action.tag: This is a spell and haste effect.

adept.name: Practised Incantation
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Each time the holder casts the same spell again in a fight, that spell's effect grows slightly, up to a limit that scales with rank.
Casting a different spell resets the build-up.
This is a spell and mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a spell and mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Distilled Casting
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder drinks a potion, its next spell carries the potion's nature: a healing draught mends allies the spell touches, a harmful brew afflicts enemies it strikes.
This applies only to the first spell cast within a short time of drinking.
This is a spell and alchemy effect.
alchemy.tag: This is a spell and alchemy effect.

ambush.name: Lurking Sigil
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Spells the holder casts at an enemy that has not noticed it strike with greater effect and briefly silence the target.
Once a fight is underway, this applies only to the first spell aimed at each new enemy.
This is a spell and stealth effect.
ambush.tag: This is a spell and stealth effect.

animate.name: Living Spellwork
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, when the holder casts a lasting spell, the spell takes a small animate shape that follows the holder and repeats a weaker echo of the effect.
The shape fades after a short time or when struck hard.
This is a spell and animation effect.
animate.tag: This is a spell and animation effect.

anzu.name: Stormwing Cant
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder takes lightning damage, it stores a charge, and its next spell releases the charge as a bolt that leaps to a nearby enemy.
Charges build only from lightning taken, are capped by rank, and fade after a short time.
This is a spell and lightning effect.
anzu.tag: This is a spell and lightning effect.

ape.name: Bellowing Hex
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder lands a spell on an enemy at close range, the spell knocks the enemy back and draws its attention to the holder.
This can happen once every few seconds and costs stamina as well as mana.
This is a spell and command effect.
ape.tag: This is a spell and command effect.

armour.name: Plated Wards
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Protective spells the holder casts also give their target a thin layer of physical resistance while the spell lasts.
The layer is lost the moment the protective spell breaks.
This is a spell and protection effect.
armour.tag: This is a spell and protection effect.

arsenal.name: Weaponform Spells
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder switches weapons, its next spell takes that weapon's form: a blade makes a cutting arc, a bow a piercing bolt, a hammer a crushing blast.
This has a short cooldown and applies to damaging spells only.
This is a spell and conjuration effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a spell and conjuration effect.

aspect.name: Mantled Element
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder is struck by an enemy spell, it takes on an aspect of that spell's element, and its own spells deal that element as well for a short time.
A new aspect replaces the old, and this has a cooldown.
This is a spell and transformation effect.
aspect.tag: This is a spell and transformation effect.

avatar.name: Embodied Invocation
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, when the holder casts its strongest spell, it becomes an avatar of that spell for a short time, radiating the spell's effect to enemies in melee range.
While the avatar lasts, the holder's mana does not regenerate.
This is a spell and transformation effect.
avatar.tag: This is a spell and transformation effect.

axe.name: Cleaving Incant
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Spells the holder casts at a single target cleave, spilling a portion of their effect onto enemies beside it.
The spillover costs extra mana and never applies to healing spells.
This is a spell and area effect.
axe.tag: This is a spell and area effect.

balance.name: Even Casting
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
While the holder's health and mana sit close to level with each other, its spells gain extra effect.
When they fall far apart, the holder's spells cost slightly more until they even out.
This is a spell and mastery effect.
balance.tag: This is a spell and mastery effect.

bat.name: Echolocant
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells give off a faint ringing that reveals hidden and invisible enemies they pass near.
Revealed enemies stay visible to the party for a short time, and the reveal has a cooldown.
This is a spell and sound and detection effect.
bat.tag: This is a spell and sound and detection effect.

battlefield.name: Warfield Sorcery
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
While a fight involves many combatants, the holder's area spells spread wider and linger slightly longer.
The bonus shrinks as enemies fall and ends with the fight.
This is a spell and area effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a spell and area effect.

bear.name: Mauling Word
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder is badly hurt, its spells hit harder and knock enemies off their feet for a short time.
This fury can trigger once per fight.
This is a spell and might effect.
bear.tag: This is a spell and might effect.

bee.name: Hive Spellwork
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Damaging spells the holder casts leave a buzzing mark; allies who strike a marked enemy deal slightly more damage to it.
Marks fade after a short time and do not stack.
This is a spell and swarm and support effect.
bee.tag: This is a spell and swarm and support effect.

behemoth.name: Colossal Incant
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder gathers mana through a long cast and releases a spell at vast scale, its effect and area swelling greatly.
The holder cannot move while gathering, and being staggered wastes the mana.
This is a spell and annihilation effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a spell and annihilation effect.

bird.name: Skylark Verse
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Spells the holder casts while moving travel faster and reach further.
After each such spell the holder gains a brief burst of speed, on a short cooldown.
This is a spell and movement effect.
bird.tag: This is a spell and movement effect.

blight.name: Withering Rite
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Damaging spells the holder casts leave a blight that slowly saps the enemy's health and weakens healing it receives.
The blight does not stack; recasting only refreshes it.
This is a spell and affliction effect.
blight.tag: This is a spell and affliction effect.

blood.name: Blood Liturgy
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder runs short of mana, it pays for spells with its own health instead.
Spells paid in blood gain extra effect and make enemies they strike bleed, but the holder will not spend health it cannot spare.
This is a spell and affliction effect.
blood.tag: This is a spell and affliction effect.

bone.name: Ossuary Hymn
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When an enemy dies to the holder's spell, splinters of its bones burst outward and strike enemies close by.
The burst has a cooldown and scales with rank.
This is a spell and death effect.
bone.tag: This is a spell and death effect.

boundary.name: Bounded Casting
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's area spells raise a faint wall along their edge that slows enemies crossing it.
The wall lasts only as long as the spell that made it.
This is a spell and barrier effect.
boundary.tag: This is a spell and barrier effect.

bounty.name: Spoils of Sorcery
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder defeats an enemy with a spell, it recovers a portion of that spell's mana cost, more for powerful enemies.
This can never return more mana than the spell cost.
This is a spell and harvest effect.
bounty.tag: This is a spell and harvest effect.

bow.name: Arrowed Cant
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's projectile spells fly further and strike harder the further they travel.
Projectile spells cast at very close range lose a portion of their effect.
This is a spell and hunting effect.
bow.tag: This is a spell and hunting effect.

brush.name: Painted Glyphs
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Each spell the holder casts paints a glowing glyph beneath it; allies standing on a glyph gain a small boon matching the spell's element.
Glyphs fade after a short time, and only a handful can exist at once.
This is a spell and support effect.
brush.tag: This is a spell and support effect.

cage.name: Spellcage
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder wraps a dangerous enemy in a cage of spell-light that holds it in place and blocks its spells.
The cage breaks after a short time or when the enemy takes heavy damage.
This is a spell and restraint effect.
cage.tag: This is a spell and restraint effect.

cat.name: Feline Cast
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder dodges an attack, its next spell is cast instantly and gains extra effect.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a spell and evasion effect.
cat.tag: This is a spell and evasion effect.

cataclysm.name: Ruinous Invocation
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder's spell strikes an enemy still suffering from another of its spells, the effects compound into a destructive burst.
The burst has a long cooldown and harms the holder slightly if it stands within it.
This is a spell and annihilation effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is a spell and annihilation effect.

cattle.name: Herding Hex
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Enemies struck by the holder's spells are nudged toward each other, bunching together for the party's area attacks.
An enemy can be nudged only once every few seconds.
This is a spell and command effect.
cattle.tag: This is a spell and command effect.

chain.name: Linked Incantation
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Damaging spells the holder casts chain from their target to a nearby enemy, carrying a portion of their effect.
Each link is weaker than the last, and the chain cannot return to an enemy it has already struck.
This is a spell and binding effect.
chain.tag: This is a spell and binding effect.

chaotic.name: Wayward Surge
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Each spell the holder casts has a chance to surge, gaining a random extra effect: a burst of fire, a slowing frost, a jolt of lightning or a brief stun.
A surge can also misfire and cost the holder extra mana.
This is a spell and chaos effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a spell and chaos effect.

charlatan.name: Feigned Formula
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells look like something else to enemies, so they react late or dodge the wrong way.
Enemies who have seen through the trick once in a fight are not fooled again by the same spell.
This is a spell and illusion effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a spell and illusion effect.

chicken.name: Flustered Hex
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder is cornered or badly hurt, its spells send enemies scattering in a brief panic.
This can trigger once per fight, and panicked enemies recover quickly if struck.
This is a spell and fear effect.
chicken.tag: This is a spell and fear effect.

chimera.name: Patchwork Casting
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder casts spells of different elements in quick succession, the last spell fuses the elements together and carries all of their effects.
The fusion costs extra mana and has a cooldown.
This is a spell and transmutation effect.
chimera.tag: This is a spell and transmutation effect.

claw.name: Rending Spell
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Damaging spells the holder casts tear at their target, leaving wounds that bleed for a short time.
Bleeding from this source does not stack on the same enemy.
This is a spell and affliction effect.
claw.tag: This is a spell and affliction effect.

cloth.name: Silken Mantle
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Spells the holder casts on allies wrap them in a light mantle that softens the next blow they take.
The mantle lasts a short time and does not stack.
This is a spell and protection effect.
cloth.tag: This is a spell and protection effect.

cloud.name: Overcast Working
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Area spells the holder casts leave a drifting haze that blurs enemy aim within it.
The haze thins after a short time, and a new patch replaces the old.
This is a spell and storm effect.
cloud.tag: This is a spell and storm effect.

cold.name: Rime Invocation
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells chill their targets, slowing their movement and attacks for a short time.
An enemy chilled repeatedly grows briefly resistant to the chill.
This is a spell and cold effect.
cold.tag: This is a spell and cold effect.

coral.name: Reefbound Ward
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Protective spells the holder casts grow a crust of living coral that cuts enemies who strike the protected ally.
The crust breaks when the protective spell ends.
This is a spell and protection effect.
coral.tag: This is a spell and protection effect.

corrupt.name: Tainted Formula
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Damaging spells the holder casts corrupt the enemy's own magic, making its spells cost more and fizzle more often for a short time.
Corruption from this source can be cleansed, and has a cooldown on each enemy.
This is a spell and curse effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a spell and curse effect.

crocodile.name: Deathroll Hex
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder hits the same enemy with spells several times in a row, the last spell grips and drags it to the ground.
The grip has a cooldown and lasts only a moment.
This is a spell and restraint effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a spell and restraint effect.

crystal.name: Faceted Casting
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder stores a sliver of each spell it casts in a floating crystal, and the crystal releases a faint copy of that spell when the holder is struck.
A new spell replaces the stored sliver, and the crystal recharges slowly.
This is a spell and resonance effect.
crystal.tag: This is a spell and resonance effect.

cycle.name: Wheeling Litany
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder has cast each of its spells in turn without repeating, the cycle closes and its next spell costs no mana.
Casting a spell out of turn breaks the cycle.
This is a spell and mastery effect.
cycle.tag: This is a spell and mastery effect.

dance.name: Spellstep Cadence
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder can cast while moving freely, and each spell cast mid-stride grants it a moment of extra evasion.
The evasion fades quickly and has a short cooldown.
This is a spell and movement and evasion effect.
dance.tag: This is a spell and movement and evasion effect.

dark.name: Umbral Cant
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Spells the holder casts from shadow or darkness gain extra effect and blind their target for a moment.
The blinding has a cooldown on each enemy.
This is a spell and darkness effect.
dark.tag: This is a spell and darkness effect.

dawn.name: First Light Verse
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The first spell the holder casts in each fight blazes with dawn-light, healing allies it passes and burning undead and shadow creatures.
This happens once per fight.
This is a spell and light and healing effect.
dawn.tag: This is a spell and light and healing effect.

death.name: Funeral Incant
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's damaging spells strike harder against enemies near death.
When such a spell finishes an enemy, the holder regains a little mana, on a short cooldown.
This is a spell and death effect.
death.tag: This is a spell and death effect.

deep.name: Abyssal Pressure Spell
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Spells the holder casts press down on their target with crushing weight, slowing it and grinding its defences for a short time.
The weight does not stack, and lasts only while the target stays near where it was struck.
This is a spell and water effect.
deep.tag: This is a spell and water effect.

deer.name: Fleetfoot Cant
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When an enemy closes on the holder, its next spell is cast as it bounds away, putting distance between them.
This can happen once every few seconds and costs stamina.
This is a spell and movement and evasion effect.
deer.tag: This is a spell and movement and evasion effect.

desolate.name: Barren Working
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Area spells the holder casts leave the ground barren, stopping enemy healing and regeneration within it.
The barren ground fades after a short time and affects allies' regeneration too.
This is a spell and affliction and area effect.
desolate.tag: This is a spell and affliction and area effect.

dimension.name: Folded Range
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells can fold space to reach a target beyond their normal range or around an obstacle.
A folded spell costs extra mana and has a cooldown.
This is a spell and dimension effect.
dimension.tag: This is a spell and dimension effect.

discord.name: Jarring Verse
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Enemies struck by the holder's spells are briefly thrown into disorder and may strike at each other.
An enemy can be thrown into disorder only once every so often, and powerful enemies shake it off quickly.
This is a spell and sound effect.
discord.tag: This is a spell and sound effect.

discordant.name: Dissonant Chord
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder's spell lands on an enemy that is casting, it shatters the casting with a clash of dissonance and stuns the caster for a moment.
This has a cooldown.
This is a spell and sound and resonance effect.
discordant.tag: This is a spell and sound and resonance effect.

dog.name: Faithful Cant
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When an ally near the holder is attacked, the holder's next spell turns on the attacker and gains extra effect against it.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a spell and protection effect.
dog.tag: This is a spell and protection effect.

doom.name: Knell of Ending
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder can mark an enemy with a doom that gathers each time the holder's spells strike it, then breaks in a heavy blow when it fills.
Marking a new enemy lifts the doom from the old, and the mark fades if left untouched.
This is a spell and curse effect.
doom.tag: This is a spell and curse effect.

doppelganger.name: Mirrored Caster
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder conjures a mirror-image that copies the next few spells it casts at a portion of their effect.
The mirror-image vanishes after a short time or when struck.
This is a spell and conjuration effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a spell and conjuration effect.

dragon.name: Wyrmfire Word
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder's next spell erupts as a cone of dragonfire that burns everything before it.
The holder cannot cast again for a short time after.
This is a spell and fire and area effect.
dragon.tag: This is a spell and fire and area effect.

duck.name: Slick Casting
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Harmful spells cast at the holder have a chance to slide off it, losing a portion of their effect.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a spell and water and defensive effect.
duck.tag: This is a spell and water and defensive effect.

dust.name: Grit Incant
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Spells the holder casts kick up a cloud of grit that blinds and slows enemies caught in it.
The cloud settles after a short time, and a new cloud replaces the old.
This is a spell and wind effect.
dust.tag: This is a spell and wind effect.

earth.name: Bedrock Spell
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
While the holder stands still, its spells gain extra effect and it cannot be knocked back.
The bonus ends the moment the holder moves.
This is a spell and earth and defensive effect.
earth.tag: This is a spell and earth and defensive effect.

echo.name: Resounding Cast
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
A short time after the holder casts a spell, a faint echo of it repeats at the same place.
The echo carries a portion of the spell's effect, and a spell can echo only once.
This is a spell and sound and resonance effect.
echo.tag: This is a spell and sound and resonance effect.

eclipse.name: Umbra Corona
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells carry light and shadow together, healing allies they touch and harming enemies they strike.
The healing is slight and has a cooldown on each ally.
This is a spell and light and darkness effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a spell and light and darkness effect.

edifice.name: Raised Sanctum
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder's spell raises a small structure of magic around it that strengthens spells cast from within.
The structure lasts a short time and crumbles if the holder leaves it.
This is a spell and conjuration and warding effect.
edifice.tag: This is a spell and conjuration and warding effect.

effigy.name: Proxy Figure

master.tag: This is a spell and mastery effect.

might.name: Brawny Incant
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells draw on its physical strength as well as its magic, gaining a portion of its power as extra damage.
Spells boosted this way cost stamina as well as mana.
This is a spell and might effect.
might.tag: This is a spell and might effect.

ministration.name: Tending Litany
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When an ally near the holder is badly hurt, the holder's next spell turns to tending them, healing them in addition to its normal effect.
This has a cooldown on each ally.
This is a spell and healing and support effect.
ministration.tag: This is a spell and healing and support effect.

minotaur.name: Labyrinth Hex
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Enemies struck by the holder's spells lose their bearings and wander aimlessly for a moment before they find their target again.
An enemy can lose its bearings only once every so often.
This is a spell and confusion effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a spell and confusion effect.

mirage.name: Heat-Haze Casting
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Spells the holder casts appear to come from somewhere nearby rather than from the holder, drawing enemy attention away from it.
The illusion has a short cooldown.
This is a spell and illusion effect.
mirage.tag: This is a spell and illusion effect.

mirror.name: Reflecting Ward
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When an enemy spell strikes the holder, a portion of it is reflected back at the caster.
Reflection has a cooldown and cannot reflect more than a portion of the spell.
This is a spell and warding effect.
mirror.tag: This is a spell and warding effect.

monkey.name: Mimic's Trick
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder sees an ally cast a spell, it can copy a weaker version of that spell on its own next turn.
A copied spell costs extra mana, and a new copy replaces the old.
This is a spell and mimicry effect.
monkey.tag: This is a spell and mimicry effect.

monolith.name: Standing Stone Rite
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder's spell raises a standing stone that repeats the holder's spells in a weaker form while the holder stays near it.
The stone crumbles after a short time or when the holder strays far.
This is a spell and earth and conjuration effect.
monolith.tag: This is a spell and earth and conjuration effect.

moon.name: Tidewane Verse
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells wax and wane in a slow cycle through each fight, swinging between greater effect and lower mana cost.
The cycle cannot be hurried, and the holder favours spells that suit its current phase.
This is a spell and time effect.
moon.tag: This is a spell and time effect.

mouse.name: Quiet Squeak
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Small, cheap spells the holder casts draw no attention from enemies.
Larger spells still draw attention as normal.
This is a spell and stealth effect.
mouse.tag: This is a spell and stealth effect.

myriad.name: Scattered Spell Sparks
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's damaging spells burst into many small sparks that scatter among enemies close to the target.
Each spark carries only a sliver of the spell's effect, and the burst has a short cooldown.
This is a spell and swarm and area effect.
myriad.tag: This is a spell and swarm and area effect.

mystic.name: Arcane Insight
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder senses the magic of enemies around it, and its spells strike harder against those preparing a spell of their own.
The holder also warns the party of an enemy's large spell a moment before it lands, on a cooldown.
This is a spell and perception and precognition effect.
mystic.tag: This is a spell and perception and precognition effect.

nebula.name: Starcloud Bloom
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Area spells the holder casts leave a shimmering cloud of starstuff that slowly harms enemies and lightly restores mana to allies.
The cloud fades after a short time, and a new cloud replaces the old.
This is a spell and stellar and area effect.
nebula.tag: This is a spell and stellar and area effect.

needle.name: Piercing Thread
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's projectile spells narrow to a needle point, passing through armour and wards.
Narrowed spells lose a portion of their area.
This is a spell and precision effect.
needle.tag: This is a spell and precision effect.

nemesis.name: Sworn Enmity
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The enemy that last hurt the holder most becomes its nemesis, and the holder's spells strike it harder.
The holder's spells against other enemies lose a little effect while a nemesis lives.
This is a spell and hunting effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a spell and hunting effect.

net.name: Snaring Mesh
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Area spells the holder casts settle as a mesh of magic that slows enemies within it.
Enemies that struggle free are briefly immune to the mesh.
This is a spell and binding and restraint effect.
net.tag: This is a spell and binding and restraint effect.

network.name: Rippling Rapport
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Spells the holder casts on an ally ripple along a link to other allies nearby at a portion of their effect.
The ripple has a short cooldown and weakens with each ally it reaches.
This is a spell and support effect.
network.tag: This is a spell and support effect.

oasis.name: Wellspring Refuge
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder's spell opens a small pool of calm where allies recover health and mana while they stand in it.
The pool dries up after a short time.
This is a spell and water and restoration effect.
oasis.tag: This is a spell and water and restoration effect.

ocean.name: Rolling Breakers
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells build like a rising tide: each spell cast without a break gains slightly more effect than the last.
The tide breaks when the holder stops casting or is interrupted.
This is a spell and water and momentum effect.
ocean.tag: This is a spell and water and momentum effect.

octopus.name: Many-Armed Casting
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder can keep a lesser spell running while it casts another.
Holding spells together drains mana steadily.
This is a spell and mastery effect.
octopus.tag: This is a spell and mastery effect.

omen.name: Portent Reading
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder reads an omen in each fight and, a moment before an enemy's heavy attack, casts a warning spell that lets nearby allies brace.
Braced allies take slightly less damage from that attack, and this has a cooldown.
This is a spell and precognition effect.
omen.tag: This is a spell and precognition effect.

onslaught.name: Unrelenting Barrage
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
While the holder keeps striking with spells, each comes slightly faster than the last.
The pace resets if the holder pauses or is struck hard.
This is a spell and momentum and haste effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a spell and momentum and haste effect.

pangolin.name: Scaled Recoil
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder is badly hurt, it curls behind a spell of overlapping scales that blocks attacks while it recovers mana.
The holder cannot cast or move while curled, and this can happen once per fight.
This is a spell and defensive and shield effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a spell and defensive and shield effect.

paper.name: Folded Spellscript
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Before a fight, the holder folds a spell into a paper charm, and it can release that spell instantly at no mana cost during the fight.
The charm is spent when used and cannot be refolded mid-fight.
This is a spell and preparation effect.
paper.tag: This is a spell and preparation effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Dreamfever Visions
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Enemies struck by the holder's spells see shifting phantoms, attacking illusions instead of real foes for a moment.
An enemy can be fooled only once every so often.
This is a spell and illusion effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is a spell and illusion effect.

phoenix.name: Pyre Resurgence
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, when an ally near the holder falls, the holder's next spell burns with phoenix fire that lifts that ally back up with a sliver of health.
The holder spends all of its remaining mana to do it.
This is a spell and fire and rebirth effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a spell and fire and rebirth effect.

plant.name: Thorned Verse
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells sprout thorny vines at their target that tangle and scratch enemies nearby.
The vines wither after a short time.
This is a spell and nature and growth effect.
plant.tag: This is a spell and nature and growth effect.

potent.name: Concentrated Dose
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder can pour extra mana into any spell, sharply increasing its effect.
A concentrated spell costs much more mana and has a cooldown.
This is a spell and potency effect.
potent.tag: This is a spell and potency effect.

predatory.name: Stalker's Hex
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells strike harder against enemies that are fleeing, alone or badly hurt.
Spells against such prey also slow them for a moment, on a short cooldown.
This is a spell and hunting effect.
predatory.tag: This is a spell and hunting effect.

prison.name: Gaoler's Seal
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder seals an enemy inside a spell prison that it cannot leave and cannot attack out of.
Allies cannot harm the sealed enemy either, and the seal breaks after a short time.
This is a spell and binding and restraint effect.
prison.tag: This is a spell and binding and restraint effect.

prosperity.name: Bountiful Casting
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
While the party is healthy and well supplied with mana, the holder's spells gain extra effect.
The bonus fades as allies are hurt.
This is a spell and support effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a spell and support effect.

pure.name: Unsullied Word
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells cannot be weakened by enemy curses or afflictions.
Spells cast on allies also cleanse a minor affliction, on a cooldown.
This is a spell and purification effect.
pure.tag: This is a spell and purification effect.

rabbit.name: Skittering Cant
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
After the holder casts a spell, it darts a short distance away from the nearest enemy.
The dart costs stamina and has a short cooldown.
This is a spell and evasion and movement effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a spell and evasion and movement effect.

rake.name: Raking Spell
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's line spells drag across the ground, pulling enemies they cross a short way along with them.
The drag has a cooldown and does not move large enemies.
This is a spell and binding effect.
rake.tag: This is a spell and binding effect.

rat.name: Scavenger's Hex
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells spread a creeping sickness among enemies standing close together.
The sickness weakens as it spreads and fades after a short time.
This is a spell and poison and affliction effect.
rat.tag: This is a spell and poison and affliction effect.

reagent.name: Catalysing Spell
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder's spell strikes an enemy already affected by an ally's ability, it catalyses that effect, strengthening it for a short time.
This has a cooldown on each enemy.
This is a spell and alchemy and support effect.
reagent.tag: This is a spell and alchemy and support effect.

refracting.name: Splitting Prism
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells bend as they pass through other spells or wards, splitting into several beams that strike separate enemies.
Each beam carries only a portion of the spell, and this has a cooldown.
This is a spell and light effect.
refracting.tag: This is a spell and light effect.

renewal.name: Restoring Verse
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When a spell the holder cast ends, a little of its mana returns to the holder.
The return is small and does not apply to spells that were broken early.
This is a spell and restoration effect.
renewal.tag: This is a spell and restoration effect.

resolute.name: Unbroken Will
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells cannot be interrupted by fear, stun or silence while it is channelling them.
Effects that fail to interrupt still apply once the spell ends.
This is a spell and resolve effect.
resolute.tag: This is a spell and resolve effect.

resonating.name: Sympathetic Peal
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder casts a spell of the same element as an ally's recent spell, the spells ring together and gain extra effect.
The peal has a short cooldown.
This is a spell and resonance and sound effect.
resonating.tag: This is a spell and resonance and sound effect.

roc.name: Thunderwing Strike
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder's spell drops from above as a great beating of wings that flattens enemies in a wide area.
The holder is left winded for a short time after.
This is a spell and wind and area effect.
roc.tag: This is a spell and wind and area effect.

rune.name: Inscribed Litany
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder inscribes a rune of its favoured spell into the ground, and the rune fires that spell at enemies who step near it.
A new rune replaces the old, and it fades after a short time.
This is a spell and warding and trap effect.
rune.tag: This is a spell and warding and trap effect.

sacrifice.name: Bloodprice Empowerment
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder can give up a portion of its own health to make its next spell on an ally far stronger.
The health spent cannot be healed back for a short time, and the holder will not spend health it cannot spare.
This is a spell and sacrifice and support effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a spell and sacrifice and support effect.

sand.name: Duneshift Working
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Area spells the holder casts turn the ground to loose sand that slows enemies and scours them for slight damage.
The sand settles after a short time.
This is a spell and earth and area effect.
sand.tag: This is a spell and earth and area effect.

sceptre.name: Regal Focus
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
While the holder wields a focus, staff or sceptre, its spells gain extra effect and cost slightly less mana.
The bonus is lost while the holder fights with any other weapon.
This is a spell and command effect.
sceptre.tag: This is a spell and command effect.

scribe.name: Scrivened Spell
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder writes its most recent spell into a floating script, and can recast it from the script once at reduced mana cost.
Writing a new spell erases the old script, and it fades after a short time.
This is a spell and preparation effect.
scribe.tag: This is a spell and preparation effect.

serene.name: Stillwater Cant
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
While the holder is calm and unhurt, its spells cost less mana.
The calm breaks when the holder is struck and returns after a short time without harm.
This is a spell and tranquility effect.
serene.tag: This is a spell and tranquility effect.

serpent.name: Constrictor Hex
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells coil around their target, poisoning it and slowing it for a short time.
The coil does not stack, and has a cooldown on each enemy.
This is a spell and poison and binding effect.
serpent.tag: This is a spell and poison and binding effect.

shark.name: Bloodscent Hex
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells strike harder against bleeding enemies and find them even when they hide.
The bonus lasts only while the enemy bleeds.
This is a spell and hunting and tracking effect.
shark.tag: This is a spell and hunting and tracking effect.

shield.name: Aegis Formula
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Shield spells the holder casts are larger and cover allies standing close to their target.
Shared shields are thinner, and this has a cooldown.
This is a spell and shield and protection effect.
shield.tag: This is a spell and shield and protection effect.

shimmer.name: Glimmer Veil
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
After the holder casts a spell, it shimmers out of focus, making it harder for enemies to hit for a moment.
The shimmer has a short cooldown.
This is a spell and evasion effect.
shimmer.tag: This is a spell and evasion effect.

ship.name: Crewmate's Charm
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Spells the holder casts on allies carry them along with the holder's own momentum, giving them a burst of speed toward the holder's side.
This has a cooldown on each ally.
This is a spell and travel and support effect.
ship.tag: This is a spell and travel and support effect.

shovel.name: Undermining Spell
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells dig under their target, tipping it off balance and opening it to allies' attacks.
An enemy can be tipped only once every few seconds.
This is a spell and earth effect.
shovel.tag: This is a spell and earth effect.

sickle.name: Crescent Sweep Cant
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells sweep in a crescent, striking all enemies in an arc before it.
Sweeping costs extra mana and has a short cooldown.
This is a spell and harvest and area effect.
sickle.tag: This is a spell and harvest and area effect.

simulacrum.name: Spellwright Effigy
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder shapes a hollow likeness of itself that casts its weakest spell on its own for a short time.
The likeness breaks when struck hard.
This is a spell and conjuration and animation effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a spell and conjuration and animation effect.

sin.name: Avarice Hex
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells weigh enemies down with their own misdeeds, striking harder against enemies that have recently harmed an ally.
The bonus fades after a short time.
This is a spell and curse effect.
sin.tag: This is a spell and curse effect.

skirmish.name: Hit-and-Fade Cant
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder casts a spell and then moves, its next spell gains extra effect.
The bonus is lost if the holder stands still too long, and has a short cooldown.
This is a spell and movement effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a spell and movement effect.

skunk.name: Reeking Cloud
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When an enemy closes on the holder, the holder's next spell bursts into a foul cloud that drives enemies back and makes them cough.
This has a cooldown.
This is a spell and poison effect.
skunk.tag: This is a spell and poison effect.

sky.name: Broadsky Invocation
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Under an open sky, the holder's spells reach further and strike harder.
Indoors or underground the bonus is lost.
This is a spell and wind and storm effect.
sky.tag: This is a spell and wind and storm effect.

sloth.name: Languid Hex
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Enemies struck by the holder's spells move and attack more slowly for a short time.
The holder's own spells cast slightly slower as well.
This is a spell and time effect.
sloth.tag: This is a spell and time effect.

smoke.name: Smokescreen Spell
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells trail smoke that hides allies within it from enemy sight.
The smoke clears after a short time, and a new cloud replaces the old.
This is a spell and stealth effect.
smoke.tag: This is a spell and stealth effect.

snake.name: Fanged Whisper
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells strike swiftly and poison their target.
The poison does not stack, and has a cooldown on each enemy.
This is a spell and poison effect.
snake.tag: This is a spell and poison effect.

soaring.name: Uplifting Gust
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells lift allies' spirits, giving them a brief surge of speed and lighter footing.
This has a cooldown on each ally.
This is a spell and wind and haste effect.
soaring.tag: This is a spell and wind and haste effect.

song.name: Spellsong Refrain
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
While the holder keeps casting, it sings a refrain that strengthens allies' spells nearby.
The refrain ends when the holder is interrupted.
This is a spell and sound and support effect.
song.tag: This is a spell and sound and support effect.

sovereign.name: Crowned Decree
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder speaks a decree that makes every ally's next spell gain extra effect.
The holder cannot cast for a short time after.
This is a spell and command and support effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a spell and command and support effect.

spear.name: Lancing Cant
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].

This is a spell and might effect.
bear.tag: This is a spell and might effect.

bee.name: Hive Spellwork
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bee essence.

Damaging spells the holder casts leave a buzzing mark; allies who strike a marked enemy deal slightly more damage to it.
Marks fade after a short time and do not stack.
This is a spell and swarm and support effect.
bee.tag: This is a spell and swarm and support effect.

behemoth.name: Colossal Incant
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder gathers mana through a long cast and releases a spell at vast scale, its effect and area swelling greatly.
The holder cannot move while gathering, and being staggered wastes the mana.
This is a spell and annihilation effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a spell and annihilation effect.

bird.name: Skylark Verse
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Spells the holder casts while moving travel faster and reach further.

This is a spell and movement effect.
bird.tag: This is a spell and movement effect.

blight.name: Withering Rite
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Damaging spells the holder casts leave a blight that slowly saps the enemy's health and weakens healing it receives.
The blight does not stack; recasting only refreshes it.
This is a spell and affliction effect.
blight.tag: This is a spell and affliction effect.

blood.name: Blood Liturgy
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder runs short of mana, it pays for spells with its own health instead.
Spells paid in blood gain extra effect and make enemies they strike bleed, but the holder will not spend health it cannot spare.
This is a spell and affliction effect.
blood.tag: This is a spell and affliction effect.

bone.name: Ossuary Hymn
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When an enemy dies to the holder's spell, splinters of its bones burst outward and strike enemies close by.
The burst has a cooldown and scales with rank.
This is a spell and death effect.
bone.tag: This is a spell and death effect.

boundary.name: Bounded Casting
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.

The holder's area spells raise a faint wall along their edge that slows enemies crossing it.
The wall lasts only as long as the spell that made it.
This is a spell and barrier effect.
boundary.tag: This is a spell and barrier effect.

bounty.name: Spoils of Sorcery
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.

When the holder defeats an enemy with a spell, it recovers a portion of that spell's mana cost, more for powerful enemies.

This is a spell and harvest effect.
bounty.tag: This is a spell and harvest effect.

bow.name: Arrowed Cant

lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's projectile spells fly further and strike harder the further they travel.
Projectile spells cast at very close range lose a portion of their effect.
This is a spell and hunting effect.
bow.tag: This is a spell and hunting effect.

brush.name: Painted Glyphs
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Each spell the holder casts paints a glowing glyph beneath it; allies standing on a glyph gain a small boon matching the spell's element.
Glyphs fade after a short time, and only a handful can exist at once.
This is a spell and support effect.
brush.tag: This is a spell and support effect.

cage.name: Spellcage
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder wraps a dangerous enemy in a cage of spell-light that holds it in place and blocks its spells.
The cage breaks after a short time or when the enemy takes heavy damage.
This is a spell and restraint effect.
cage.tag: This is a spell and restraint effect.

When the holder dodges an attack, its next spell is cast instantly and gains extra effect.

This is a spell and evasion effect.

cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.

When the holder's spell strikes an enemy still suffering from another of its spells, the effects compound into a destructive burst.

This is a spell and annihilation effect.

chaotic.tag: This is a spell and chaos effect.

charlatan.tag: This is a spell and illusion effect.

chicken.name: Flustered Hex
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder is cornered or badly hurt, its spells send enemies scattering in a brief panic.

This is a spell and fear effect.
chicken.tag: This is a spell and fear effect.

chimera.name: Patchwork Casting

When the holder casts spells of different elements in quick succession, the last spell fuses the elements together and carries all of their effects.

lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].

effigy.tag: This is a spell and warding effect.

lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].

elemental.tag: This is a spell and elemental effect.

elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].

elixir.tag: This is a spell and healing and restoration effect.

lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].

lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].

time.tag: This is a spell and time effect.

tranquil.name: Becalmed Mind
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells calm allies they touch, easing fear and quickening their mana recovery for a short time.
This has a cooldown on each ally.
This is a spell and restoration effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a spell and restoration effect.

transfiguration.name: Transmuted Charm
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder can change the element of any spell it casts to suit the fight.
Changing a spell's element costs extra mana.
This is a spell and transmutation effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a spell and transmutation effect.

transgression.name: Forbidden Working
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder can break the limits of its spells, casting them at far greater effect.
Each forbidden casting hurts the holder and has a long cooldown.
This is a spell and curse effect.
transgression.tag: This is a spell and curse effect.

trap.name: Snare Glyph
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder can lay a spell on the ground as a hidden trap that triggers when an enemy steps on it.
Only a few traps can be laid at once.
This is a spell and trap effect.
trap.tag: This is a spell and trap effect.

tree.name: Rooted Grove
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
While the holder stands rooted, its spells grow branches that shelter nearby allies from projectiles.
The branches wither when the holder moves.
This is a spell and nature and protection effect.
tree.tag: This is a spell and nature and protection effect.

troll.name: Trollblood Cant
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Each spell the holder casts heals it a little over time.
The healing stops while the holder burns.
This is a spell and healing and regeneration effect.
troll.tag: This is a spell and healing and regeneration effect.

trowel.name: Mortared Ward
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells patch damaged wards and barriers, restoring part of their strength.
The patch has a short cooldown on each barrier.
This is a spell and barrier effect.
trowel.tag: This is a spell and barrier effect.

turtle.name: Shellback Ward
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When the holder is badly hurt, it casts a shell around itself that absorbs damage while it recovers.
The holder cannot move while in the shell, and this has a long cooldown.
This is a spell and shield effect.
turtle.tag: This is a spell and shield effect.

twilight.name: Twilight Spellshift
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells shift between light and darkness as the fight wears on, gaining the strength of whichever the enemy is weaker to.
Shifting takes a short time.
This is a spell and light and darkness effect.
twilight.tag: This is a spell and light and darkness effect.

undeath.name: Grave Spellwork
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When an enemy falls to the holder's spell, it can rise briefly as a shade that fights for the party.
A new shade replaces the old, and it fades after a short time.
This is a spell and necromantic effect.
undeath.tag: This is a spell and necromantic effect.

unity.name: Concord Weave
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells gain extra effect for each ally close by.
The bonus caps at a level that scales with rank.
This is a spell and support effect.
unity.tag: This is a spell and support effect.

vast.name: Boundless Reach
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's area spells cover a much wider area.
Widened spells lose a portion of their strength.
This is a spell and area effect.
vast.tag: This is a spell and area effect.

vehicle.name: Carrying Spell
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells can sweep an ally up and carry them a short distance to safety.
This has a cooldown.
This is a spell and travel and movement effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a spell and travel and movement effect.

venom.name: Envenomed Cant
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's damaging spells carry venom that deals damage over time and slows healing.
Venom from this source does not stack.
This is a spell and poison effect.
venom.tag: This is a spell and poison effect.

verdant.name: Greenwood Chant
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells leave patches of growth that heal allies standing in them.
Patches wither after a short time, and only a few can exist at once.
This is a spell and nature and healing effect.
verdant.tag: This is a spell and nature and healing effect.

vessel.name: Reservoir Spellwork
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder stores the mana of spells it chooses not to cast, filling a reserve it can draw on later in the fight.
The reserve holds a limited amount that scales with rank.
This is a spell and storage effect.
vessel.tag: This is a spell and storage effect.

visage.name: Masked Casting
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells wear a false face, so enemies cannot tell which spell is coming until it lands.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a spell and illusion effect.
visage.tag: This is a spell and illusion effect.

vision.name: Farseer Cant
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder sees where an enemy will be a moment ahead, and its spells strike there.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a spell and precognition effect.
vision.tag: This is a spell and precognition effect.

void.name: Riftmaw Cant
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells open small rifts that pull enemies toward them and drain their mana.
Rifts close after a short time, and a new rift replaces the old.
This is a spell and void effect.
void.tag: This is a spell and void effect.

volcano.name: Magma Burst
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder's spell erupts from the ground beneath enemies in a burst of molten rock.
The ground burns for a short time after.
This is a spell and fire and earth effect.
volcano.tag: This is a spell and fire and earth effect.

vortex.name: Vortex Spell Pull
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's area spells spin into a vortex that pulls enemies toward the centre.
Large enemies resist the pull, and this has a cooldown.
This is a spell and wind and area effect.
vortex.tag: This is a spell and wind and area effect.

wasp.name: Stinging Volley
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells strike as quick stings that each deal a little poison.
Stings stack only a few times on the same enemy.
This is a spell and poison effect.
wasp.tag: This is a spell and poison effect.

water.name: Flowing Cant
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells flow around obstacles to reach their target.
Flowing spells lose a little strength.
This is a spell and water effect.
water.tag: This is a spell and water effect.

weave.name: Interwoven Spells
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder can weave its spells together with an ally's, combining their effects.
Weaving costs extra mana and has a cooldown.
This is a spell and mastery effect.
weave.tag: This is a spell and mastery effect.

wendigo.name: Wendigo Spell Hunger
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells freeze and starve their target, slowing it and draining its stamina.
The drain has a cooldown on each enemy.
This is a spell and cold and hunger effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a spell and cold and hunger effect.

whale.name: Fathom Hum
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells carry a deep song that calms allies and steadies them against knockback.
The song fades after a short time.
This is a spell and sound effect.
whale.tag: This is a spell and sound effect.

wheel.name: Turning Spell
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Each time the holder casts its spells in a full rotation, the next spell costs no mana.
Repeating a spell before the rotation closes breaks it.
This is a spell and cycle effect.
wheel.tag: This is a spell and cycle effect.

whip.name: Lashing Word
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells lash at enemies at a distance, pulling them toward the holder.
The lash has a cooldown.
This is a spell and binding effect.
whip.tag: This is a spell and binding effect.

wind.name: Gusting Cant
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells ride the wind, flying faster and further.
Wind-carried spells lose a little strength.
This is a spell and wind effect.
wind.tag: This is a spell and wind effect.

wing.name: Feathered Verse
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells lift lightly, arcing over obstacles to reach their target.
Arcing spells take slightly longer to land.
This is a spell and wind effect.
wing.tag: This is a spell and wind effect.

wolf.name: Packcall Hex
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells strike harder against enemies its allies are also attacking.
The bonus has a short cooldown on each enemy.
This is a spell and hunting effect.
wolf.tag: This is a spell and hunting effect.

wood.name: Heartwood Ward
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's protective spells grow a layer of heartwood that soaks up a portion of damage.
The heartwood burns away quickly under fire.
This is a spell and nature and protection effect.
wood.tag: This is a spell and nature and protection effect.

wrath.name: Wrathful Incant
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
When an ally near the holder falls, the holder's spells strike much harder for a short time.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a spell and fury effect.
wrath.tag: This is a spell and fury effect.

zeal.name: Fervent Litany
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
The holder's spells grow stronger the longer it fights without pause.
The fervour fades if the holder stops casting for a short time.
This is a spell and momentum effect.
zeal.tag: This is a spell and momentum effect.

ziz.name: Skyshaker Cry
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spell Aptitude]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spell Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder's spell carries a great cry that shakes the ground and staggers all enemies close by.
The holder is left winded for a short time after.
This is a spell and sound and area effect.
ziz.tag: This is a spell and sound and area effect.

action.name: Snap Blessing
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you give an ally a buff, they gain a brief burst of haste as it takes hold.
This can trigger for each ally only once every few seconds.
This is a support and haste effect.
action.tag: This is a support and haste effect.

adept.name: Practised Hand
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each time you give the same buff again during a fight, it lands slightly deeper, up to a cap that scales with rank.
The built-up practice fades when the fight ends.
This is a support and mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a support and mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Tincture Grace
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Potions and elixirs drunk by you or allies near you have their beneficial effects strengthened as if they were buffs you gave.
When a potion cures an affliction near you, the drinker resists that affliction for a short time afterward.
This is a support and alchemy effect.
alchemy.tag: This is a support and alchemy effect.

ambush.name: Hidden Benediction
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give in the opening moments of a fight the party started last longer.
The first affliction to land on you after the party strikes from hiding is shrugged off entirely, once per fight.
This is a stealth and warding effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and warding effect.

animate.name: Kindled Constructs
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Summoned and animated allies near you receive your buffs at full strength and resist afflictions the way you do.
This sharing works only while they stay within a short distance of you.
This is an animation and support effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and support effect.

anzu.name: Stolen Fortune
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When your dispel strips a buff from an enemy, a crackling, weaker copy of it passes to you for a short time.
This theft has a cooldown, and the stolen copy cannot be passed on.
This is a storm and transmutation effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and transmutation effect.

ape.name: Brawler's Blood
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs that raise your strength or attack hit harder on you than other buffs do.
When you resist a stun or slow, you gain a brief surge of might, once every so often.
This is a momentum and defensive effect.
ape.tag: This is a momentum and defensive effect.

armour.name: Plated Spirit
