armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you hold a defensive buff, afflictions that strike you are weakened further.
Once per fight, an affliction that would land on you instead wears away your defensive buff.
This is a protection and warding effect.
armour.tag: This is a protection and warding effect.

arsenal.name: Armoury Rite
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give that empower attacks carry an extra edge suited to the ally's weapon: heavier for blades and hafts, quicker for bows and staves.
The edge lasts only as long as the buff and costs a little extra mana.
This is a support and mastery effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a support and mastery effect.

aspect.name: Aspected Grace
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give take on the colour of your own essences, carrying a minor extra boon drawn from your strongest power.
Only your most recent buff carries the aspect at any time.
This is a support and transformation effect.
aspect.tag: This is a support and transformation effect.

avatar.name: Vessel of Grace
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you receive a buff while below half health, it spills over to allies near you at reduced strength.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a radiant and support effect.
avatar.tag: This is a radiant and support effect.

axe.name: Sundering Dispel
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When your dispel strips a buff from an enemy, it also hacks at that enemy's armour, weakening it for a short time.
The armour break has a cooldown and does not stack.
This is a purification and annihilation effect.
axe.tag: This is a purification and annihilation effect.

balance.name: Tipping Scales
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you carry more afflictions than buffs, afflictions on you weaken further; while you carry more buffs than afflictions, your buffs on allies last longer.
The scales can tip only once every few seconds.
This is a support and warding effect.
balance.tag: This is a support and warding effect.

bat.name: Night Hearing
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions cast at you by enemies you cannot see are resisted as well as those you can.
The first affliction from an unseen source each fight is heard coming and turned aside.
This is a darkness and perception effect.
bat.tag: This is a darkness and perception effect.

battlefield.name: Rallying Ground
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies fighting near you share a portion of your resistance to afflictions.
The shared resistance fades a short time after an ally steps away from you.
This is an area and support effect.
battlefield.tag: This is an area and support effect.

bear.name: Thick Hide
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions that cause bleeding or open wounds are resisted strongly.
When such an affliction does land, you gain brief toughness, once every so often.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
bear.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

bee.name: Hive Blessing
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give spread a faint share to allies standing beside the target.
The share is weaker and lasts only a short time.
This is a swarm and support effect.
bee.tag: This is a swarm and support effect.

behemoth.name: Unbending Bulk
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While your health is high, afflictions that slow, stun or knock you aside are resisted far more often.
Each such affliction resisted costs you stamina.
This is a defensive and momentum effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a defensive and momentum effect.

bird.name: Wingborne Grace
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Movement buffs you give or receive last longer and grant a moment of evasion when they land.
The evasion triggers only as the buff is applied.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
bird.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

blight.name: Festering Rebound
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction outright, a withered version of it festers on the enemy that cast it.
Each enemy can suffer this only once per fight.
This is an affliction and poison effect.
blight.tag: This is an affliction and poison effect.

blood.name: Blood Rite
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You may spend a portion of your health to deepen a buff you give an ally.
Afflictions that drain your health are weaker still. The rite has a cooldown.
This is a restoration and affliction effect.
blood.tag: This is a restoration and affliction effect.

bone.name: Marrow Bulwark
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions that shred armour or break the body are shortened further.
When such an affliction ends on you, you gain brief armour, once every so often.
This is a defensive and necromantic effect.
bone.tag: This is a defensive and necromantic effect.

boundary.name: Threshold Circle
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
After you stand still for a moment, a faint circle forms around you; allies inside it resist afflictions as you do.
The circle fades as soon as you move.
This is a warding and barrier effect.
boundary.tag: This is a warding and barrier effect.

bounty.name: Plentiful Gift
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an ally holding your buff lands a killing blow, that buff is refreshed.
Each buff can be refreshed this way only once.
This is a harvest and support effect.
bounty.tag: This is a harvest and support effect.

bow.name: Arrow Blessing
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You can send a buff to a distant ally along a line of light, as if they stood beside you.
Buffs sent this way cost extra mana.
This is a support and travel effect.
bow.tag: This is a support and travel effect.

brush.name: Smudged Sigil
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give leave a painted mark on the ally; when an affliction lands on them, the mark smudges away to weaken it.
Each mark is spent the first time it works.
This is a warding and transmutation effect.
brush.tag: This is a warding and transmutation effect.

cage.name: Caged Malice
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction, it is caught and held around you instead of fading.
Your next dispel against an enemy hurls the caged affliction onto it. The cage holds only a short time.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
cage.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

cat.name: Cat's Twist
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction would stun, root or disable you, you twist free of it entirely.
This works once per fight.
This is an evasion and warding effect.
cat.tag: This is an evasion and warding effect.

cataclysm.name: Ruinous Purge
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs your dispel strips from an enemy burst outward, harming enemies close by.
The burst has a cooldown and scales with rank.
This is an annihilation and area effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an annihilation and area effect.

cattle.name: Herd Steadiness
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies bunched close around you resist afflictions slightly better for every ally in the group, up to a cap.
The steadiness breaks the moment the group scatters.
This is a support and protection effect.
cattle.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

chain.name: Linked Blessing
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your most recent buff binds its holder to you with a faint chain; while linked, an affliction striking either of you is split between you and weakened.
The link snaps if you move far apart.
This is a binding and support effect.
chain.tag: This is a binding and support effect.

chaotic.name: Wild Surge
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give sometimes carry a random minor boon on top.
Afflictions you resist sometimes leap at random to a nearby enemy. Either surge has a cooldown.
This is a transmutation and affliction effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a transmutation and affliction effect.

charlatan.name: Easy Mark
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You seem the easiest mark to enemy casters, who prefer to aim their afflictions at you instead of your allies.
The lure lasts only while you are above half health.
This is a protection and warding effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a protection and warding effect.

chicken.name: Flustered Dispel
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction lands on you, you reflexively dispel yourself at reduced mana cost, removing the newest affliction only.
This reflex has a cooldown.
This is a purification and haste effect.
chicken.tag: This is a purification and haste effect.

chimera.name: Fused Boons
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you give an ally a buff of a kind they already hold from another source, the buffs fuse into a stronger whole.
A fused buff lasts only as long as the shorter of its parts.
This is a transformation and support effect.
chimera.tag: This is a transformation and support effect.

claw.name: Rending Dispel
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel tears a buff away from an enemy and leaves a brief bleeding wound where it was.
The wound does not stack and has a cooldown.
This is an affliction and annihilation effect.
claw.tag: This is an affliction and annihilation effect.

cloth.name: Woven Mantle
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give wrap the ally in a light mantle that weakens the first affliction they suffer while the buff lasts.
The mantle frays once it has done its work.
This is a protection and warding effect.
cloth.tag: This is a protection and warding effect.

cloud.name: Drifting Veil
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Area buffs you place linger like mist for a short time after you leave them.
While you are moving, afflictions aimed at you drift aside slightly more often.
This is a wind and evasion effect.
cloud.tag: This is a wind and evasion effect.

cold.name: Rimefrost Boon
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Frost afflictions are resisted strongly. Buffs you give chill the ally's attacks, slowing enemies they strike.
The slow is brief and cannot stack on the same enemy.
This is a cold and support effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and support effect.

coral.name: Coral Reef Layers
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies who stay near you slowly build layers of resistance to afflictions.
Each affliction that lands strips away a layer, and the layers rebuild only slowly.
This is a water and protection effect.
coral.tag: This is a water and protection effect.

corrupt.name: Tainted Purge
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
A buff your dispel strips from an enemy rots into a weak affliction on that same enemy.
The rot costs extra mana and has a cooldown.
This is an affliction and transmutation effect.
corrupt.tag: This is an affliction and transmutation effect.

crocodile.name: Still-Water Lurk
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you hold still, your resistance to afflictions deepens moment by moment.
When you break stillness, your next dispel snaps shut with extra force. The build-up resets after it is spent.
This is a hunting and defensive effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a hunting and defensive effect.

crystal.name: Crystal Lattice
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
For a short time after you give a buff, it is locked in a crystal lattice and enemy dispels cannot remove it.
The lattice forms on only your most recent buff.
This is a protection and warding effect.
crystal.tag: This is a protection and warding effect.

cycle.name: Charged Cycle
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each affliction you resist charges your next buff, and each buff you give strengthens your next resistance.
Each charge is spent as soon as it is used and fades after a short time.
This is a time and support effect.
cycle.tag: This is a time and support effect.

dance.name: Graceful Rhythm
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you keep moving in a fight, buffs you give last longer and afflictions slide off you more often.
Standing still for a moment breaks the rhythm.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
dance.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

dark.name: Shrouded Ward
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give are hidden in shadow from enemy dispels for a short time after they land.
Darkness afflictions are weaker on you still.
This is a shadow and protection effect.
dark.tag: This is a shadow and protection effect.

dawn.name: Daybreak Grace
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
The first buff you give each fight shines brighter and also lifts a minor affliction from its target.
This works once per fight.
This is a light and purification effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and purification effect.

death.name: Grave Ward
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an ally near you is about to fall while afflicted, the afflictions on them end at once.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a death and protection effect.
death.tag: This is a death and protection effect.

deep.name: Fathom Calm
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Lasting afflictions on you weaken the longer they hold, as if crushed under deep water.
The weakening resets each time a fresh affliction lands.
This is a water and warding effect.
deep.tag: This is a water and warding effect.

deer.name: Woodland Watch
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You sense enemy casters preparing afflictions; allies near you resist the first such affliction from each caster.
This works once per caster per fight.
This is a perception and nature effect.
deer.tag: This is a perception and nature effect.

desolate.name: Withering Field
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Healing and regeneration buffs on enemies near you are stifled and weaken.
The stifling reaches only a short distance and drains mana while enemies stand in it.
This is an affliction and area effect.
desolate.tag: This is an affliction and area effect.

dimension.name: Elsewhere Fold
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, an affliction about to land on you is folded away into elsewhere and never arrives.
Buffs you give can reach an ally out of sight, at extra mana cost.
This is a travel and warding effect.
dimension.tag: This is a travel and warding effect.

discord.name: Discord Sting
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction, a jarring note disrupts its caster, delaying their next spell.
Each caster can be jarred only once every so often.
This is a sound and affliction effect.
discord.tag: This is a sound and affliction effect.

discordant.name: Clashing Chorus
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Enemies near you that hold several buffs find those buffs clashing, each weakened by the others.
The clash reaches only a short distance and costs mana while it holds.
This is a sound and area effect.
discordant.tag: This is a sound and area effect.

dog.name: Loyal Guard
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When the ally you most recently buffed is afflicted, you rush toward them and your next dispel on them costs no mana.
This has a cooldown.
This is a support and protection effect.
dog.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

doom.name: Fated Mark
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
An enemy whose affliction you resist is marked by fate; your next attack on it strikes harder.
Only the latest mark holds, and it fades after a short time.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
doom.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

doppelganger.name: Mirrored Boon
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an ally near you gains a buff from another source, you gain a weaker copy of it.
Each kind of buff can be copied only once every so often.
This is a transformation and support effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a transformation and support effect.

dragon.name: Draconic Majesty
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Fear and charm afflictions are resisted strongly by you and by allies near you.
Once per fight, when an ally near you is overcome by fear, your presence breaks it at once.
This is a fire and command effect.
dragon.tag: This is a fire and command effect.

duck.name: Water Off Feathers
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions that soak, chill or slow you slide off more easily.
The first slowing affliction aimed at you each fight misses entirely.
This is a water and evasion effect.
duck.tag: This is a water and evasion effect.

dust.name: Crumbling Hex
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction ends on you, its lingering after-effects crumble away with it.
Buffs on enemies near you crumble slightly faster. This reaches only a short distance.
This is a purification and area effect.
dust.tag: This is a purification and area effect.

earth.name: Rooted Ward
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you stand still, knockback and stun afflictions are resisted strongly.
Moving breaks the rooting, and it takes a moment to settle again.
This is a defensive and nature effect.
earth.tag: This is a defensive and nature effect.

echo.name: Echoed Resolve
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction, an echo of that resistance rings out to allies near you for a short time.
The echo has a cooldown.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
echo.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

eclipse.name: Shadowed Sun
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, a blinding or darkness affliction on you is swallowed whole.
Your next buff after that carries a veil of shadow that hides its holder from enemy afflictions for a short time.
This is a shadow and light effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a shadow and light effect.

edifice.name: Cornerstone Blessing
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you hold your ground, buffs you have given to allies are anchored and enemy dispels cannot remove them.
The anchoring lasts only a short time after you move.
This is a barrier and protection effect.
edifice.tag: This is a barrier and protection effect.

effigy.name: Proxy Doll
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, a strong affliction on you is passed into a small effigy that stands beside you until the affliction runs out.
Enemies can destroy the effigy, which returns the affliction to you.
This is a curse and binding effect.
effigy.tag: This is a curse and binding effect.

elemental.name: Elemental Accord
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Fire, frost, lightning and stone buffs you give or receive are stronger still.
Afflictions of those elements are resisted further, but only the element that struck you most recently.
This is a fire, frost and lightning effect.
elemental.tag: This is a fire, frost and lightning effect.

elixir.name: Distilled Grace
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Restorative and healing-over-time buffs you give last longer.
When such a buff ends, it leaves a brief resistance to afflictions. This has a cooldown for each ally.
This is a healing and alchemy effect.
elixir.tag: This is a healing and alchemy effect.

empower.name: Amplifying Presence
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies near you receive buffs from any source at greater strength.
The amplifying holds only while they stay within a short distance of you.
This is a support and mastery effect.
empower.tag: This is a support and mastery effect.

eye.name: Seeing Ward
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You see the buffs on enemies, and your dispel strips their strongest buff first.
This works only on enemies you can see clearly.
This is a perception and revelation effect.
eye.tag: This is a perception and revelation effect.

feast.name: Shared Table
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each buff your dispel strips from an enemy feeds allies near you a small heal.
The heal shrinks for each buff stripped in quick succession.
This is a harvest and healing effect.
feast.tag: This is a harvest and healing effect.

feeble.name: Borrowed Boon
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you are weakened by an affliction, buffs you give burn brighter, as if your strength had gone into them.
This lasts only while the weakness lasts.
This is an affliction and support effect.
feeble.tag: This is an affliction and support effect.

fertile.name: Seedfall Blessing
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When a buff you gave expires, it drops a seed that sprouts a smaller buff of a random kind on its holder.
A seeded buff cannot seed again.
This is a growth and nature effect.
fertile.tag: This is a growth and nature effect.

fey.name: Changeling Swap
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Charm and illusion afflictions are resisted strongly.
Once per fight, you trade an affliction on an ally near you for a harmless glamour that fades in a short time.
This is a nature and transformation effect.
fey.tag: This is a nature and transformation effect.

fire.name: Purifying Flame
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction on you is burned away early by your resistance, it flares and scorches enemies close by.
The flare has a cooldown.
This is a fire and purification effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire and purification effect.

firebird.name: Ember Blessing
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give make the ally's attacks smoulder, burning enemies they strike.
When the buff ends, it flares into a small heal on its holder. The burn does not stack.
This is a fire and healing effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire and healing effect.

fish.name: Finned Slip
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Roots, grabs and snares slip off you more easily and end sooner.
When you slip such an affliction, you gain a brief burst of speed, once every so often.
This is a water and evasion effect.
fish.tag: This is a water and evasion effect.

flea.name: Leaping Hex
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
A minor affliction you resist hops onto an enemy near you instead.
Only minor afflictions can hop, and the hop has a cooldown.
This is an affliction and movement effect.
flea.tag: This is an affliction and movement effect.

flesh.name: Living Ward
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you are afflicted, your body knits itself, restoring a little health over time.
The knitting is slight and stops when the last affliction ends.
This is a restoration and healing effect.
flesh.tag: This is a restoration and healing effect.

foot.name: Sure-Footed Ward
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Movement buffs on you cannot be stripped by enemy dispels.
Slows and roots on you are shortened further, but only while you keep walking.
This is a movement and defensive effect.
foot.tag: This is a movement and defensive effect.

force.name: Forceful Dispel
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel shoves its target back a little and breaks any spell it was channelling.
The shove has a cooldown.
This is a momentum and annihilation effect.
force.tag: This is a momentum and annihilation effect.

forge.name: Forge-Tempered Boons
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give harden as they last: the longer a buff has held, the harder it is for enemies to dispel.
The tempering resets if the buff is refreshed.
This is a fire and protection effect.
forge.tag: This is a fire and protection effect.

fork.name: Forked Boon
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give fork, and a weaker branch lands on another ally near the target.
The branch lasts only a short time and cannot fork again.
This is a support and area effect.
fork.tag: This is a support and area effect.

fortress.name: Inner Keep
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you are below half health, afflictions are resisted strongly and buffs you receive last longer.
The keep holds only while your health stays low.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
fortress.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

fox.name: Cunning Cover
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Enemies cannot pick out your buffs; their dispels against you strike at random among everything you carry, afflictions included.
This cover slips for a short time after you are dispelled.
This is a stealth and evasion effect.
fox.tag: This is a stealth and evasion effect.

frog.name: Leaping Cleanse
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you dodge or leap, you shed a minor affliction.
Poison afflictions are resisted strongly. The shedding has a cooldown.
This is a movement and purification effect.
frog.tag: This is a movement and purification effect.

fungus.name: Spore Communion
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give release spores; allies standing near the buffed ally share a sliver of its resistance to afflictions.
The spores drift away after a short time.
This is a growth and support effect.
fungus.tag: This is a growth and support effect.

garuda.name: Serpent's Bane
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Poison and venom afflictions are resisted strongly by you.
Once per fight, a great gust from you tears poisons off every ally near you.
This is a wind and purification effect.
garuda.tag: This is a wind and purification effect.

gate.name: Gatekeeper's Pause
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
The first affliction to reach you in a short span is held at a gate for a moment, giving you a further chance to resist it.
The gate opens again only after a cooldown.
This is a warding and barrier effect.
gate.tag: This is a warding and barrier effect.

gathering.name: Gathered Grace
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each buff you give in a fight adds to a gathering store.
When the store fills, your next buff touches every ally near you. The store empties when spent.
This is a harvest and support effect.
gathering.tag: This is a harvest and support effect.

glass.name: Brittle Hex
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions on you turn brittle; when you are hit hard, an affliction on you may shatter.
Shattering has a cooldown and cannot break curses.
This is a defensive and purification effect.
glass.tag: This is a defensive and purification effect.

glimeron.name: Split Beam Ward
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction cast as a projectile, its light is split and scattered across enemies near its caster, dazzling them briefly.
The scatter has a cooldown.
This is a light and warding effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a light and warding effect.

goat.name: Stubborn Hoof
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction, you dig in and briefly resist every affliction of the same kind.
This stubbornness lasts only a short time and has a cooldown.
This is a defensive and warding effect.
goat.tag: This is a defensive and warding effect.

gorgon.name: Gorgon's Stiffening
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an enemy tries to afflict you and fails, it stiffens as if turning to stone, slowed for a moment.
Each enemy can be stiffened only once every so often.
This is a restraint and curse effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a restraint and curse effect.

griffin.name: Griffin's Watch
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give to allies below half health are stronger still.
While such an ally is near you, afflictions aimed at them are weakened. This guarding costs stamina.
This is a protection and support effect.
griffin.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

growth.name: Rising Boon
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give grow slowly stronger while their holder keeps fighting.
The growth stops at a cap that scales with rank, and ends if the holder leaves combat.
This is a growth and support effect.
growth.tag: This is a growth and support effect.

guardian.name: Warden's Oath
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
A portion of each affliction aimed at an ally near you is drawn to you instead, where your resistance meets it.
Each affliction drawn costs you stamina.
This is a protection and support effect.
guardian.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

hair.name: Bristling Sense
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Fine strands bristle when an affliction is cast at you from behind, and you resist it as if you saw it coming.
This works only once every so often.
This is a perception and warding effect.
hair.tag: This is a perception and warding effect.

hammer.name: Anvil Dispel
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When your dispel strips a buff, the blow leaves the enemy briefly dazed.
The daze has a cooldown and is shorter on stronger enemies.
This is a restraint and annihilation effect.
hammer.tag: This is a restraint and annihilation effect.

hand.name: Healing Hand Touch
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give to an ally standing beside you land stronger.
You can lift an affliction from an ally beside you by touch, once every so often.
This is a healing and support effect.
hand.tag: This is a healing and support effect.

harmonic.name: Tuned Blessing
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give are tuned to their holder; each time the holder resists an affliction, the buff hums and lasts slightly longer.
The extension is capped for each buff.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

harpy.name: Shrieking Rebuke
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction lands on you, you let out a shriek that shortens the buffs on enemies near you.
The shriek has a cooldown.
This is a sound and affliction effect.
harpy.tag: This is a sound and affliction effect.

harvest.name: Reaped Boons
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an enemy you have dispelled dies, you reap a sliver of each buff it held and pass it to allies near you.
Reaped buffs are weak and last only a short time.
This is a harvest and support effect.
harvest.tag: This is a harvest and support effect.

heidel.name: Steed's Blessing
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give to allies who are charging or running across the field last longer.
When an ally holding your buff is slowed, the slow is shortened. This works for each ally once every so often.
This is a movement and travel effect.
heidel.tag: This is a movement and travel effect.

hook.name: Hooked Dispel
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel can catch a distant enemy, stripping a buff and dragging it a little closer.
The drag has a cooldown and cannot move large enemies.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
hook.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

horse.name: Galloping Grace
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Haste buffs you give or receive last longer.
While you are moving at speed, slows on you are shortened further. This ends when you stop.
This is a movement and haste effect.
horse.tag: This is a movement and haste effect.

hunger.name: Ravenous Purge
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel devours the buffs it strips, restoring a little of your mana for each.
The restoration is capped for each dispel.
This is a harvest and annihilation effect.
hunger.tag: This is a harvest and annihilation effect.

hunt.name: Quarry's Brand
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
The enemy that most recently afflicted you is branded as quarry; buffs you give hit harder against it.
Only the latest quarry is branded, and the brand fades after a while.
This is a hunting and tracking effect.
hunt.tag: This is a hunting and tracking effect.

hydra.name: Regrowing Blessing
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an enemy dispels a buff you gave, the buff regrows on its holder a short time later at lesser strength.
Buffs can regrow only a limited number of times per fight.
This is a rebirth and support effect.
hydra.tag: This is a rebirth and support effect.

ice.name: Frozen Hex
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You can freeze an affliction on you in place, pausing it so it has no effect for a short time.
Freezing has a cooldown, and the affliction resumes when it thaws.
This is an ice and time effect.
ice.tag: This is an ice and time effect.

immortal.name: Undying Grace
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions that drain your health cannot bring you below a sliver of health while you hold a buff.
This protection breaks once per fight and then is gone until the next.
This is a protection and rebirth effect.
immortal.tag: This is a protection and rebirth effect.

iron.name: Iron Mind Ward
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Mental afflictions such as fear, charm and confusion are resisted strongly.
Each mental affliction resisted costs you a little stamina.
This is a defensive and warding effect.
iron.tag: This is a defensive and warding effect.

juggernaut.name: Juggernaut Advance
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you are moving toward an enemy, slows and roots fail to take hold on you.
The effect ends the moment you turn away or stop.
This is a momentum and defensive effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a momentum and defensive effect.

karmic.name: Karmic Return
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions you resist return a portion of their force to their caster.
Buffs you give return a faint sliver to you. Each return has a cooldown.
This is an affliction and support effect.
karmic.tag: This is an affliction and support effect.

knife.name: Precise Excision
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispels on allies always cut out the most harmful affliction first.
Each precise cut costs a little extra mana.
This is a purification and mastery effect.
knife.tag: This is a purification and mastery effect.

knowledge.name: Studied Defiance
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each enemy affliction you witness is studied; afflictions you have already seen this fight are resisted more strongly.
The study is forgotten when the fight ends.
This is a revelation and warding effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a revelation and warding effect.

kraken.name: Kraken's Hold
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When your dispel strips an enemy's buff, a tendril of water holds that enemy in place for a moment.
The hold has a cooldown and breaks early if the enemy is struck.
This is a water and restraint effect.
kraken.tag: This is a water and restraint effect.

leviathan.name: Abyssal Calm
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies across a wide area around you resist afflictions slightly better.
The calm weakens with distance and costs mana while it holds.
This is a water and area effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water and area effect.

life.name: Vital Grace
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Healing buffs you give also lift a minor affliction from their holder when they first land.
The lifting has a cooldown for each ally.
This is a healing and purification effect.
life.tag: This is a healing and purification effect.

light.name: Radiant Shelter
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Blinding and darkness afflictions are resisted strongly.
Buffs you give shed light that weakens darkness afflictions on their holder for a short time.
This is a light and radiant effect.
light.tag: This is a light and radiant effect.

lightning.name: Arc Blessing
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your buffs are cast quicker.
When you resist an affliction, a spark leaps back to its caster. The spark has a cooldown.
This is a lightning and haste effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and haste effect.

lizard.name: Sloughed Hex
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once every so often, you shed an affliction like old skin and gain brief regeneration.
Curses cannot be shed this way.
This is a restoration and transformation effect.
lizard.tag: This is a restoration and transformation effect.

locust.name: Locust Purge
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel releases a cloud of locusts that strips minor buffs from enemies near the target over a short time.
The cloud has a cooldown.
This is a swarm and area effect.
locust.tag: This is a swarm and area effect.

lotus.name: Lotus Withering Purge
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions of the same kind cannot stack on you; a repeat only refreshes what is there.
Once per fight, when you are carrying several afflictions, the weakest of them withers away.
This is a purification and healing effect.
lotus.tag: This is a purification and healing effect.

lurker.name: Unseen Readiness
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you are hidden or unseen, your resistance quietly builds.
The first affliction to strike you after you are revealed fails. The build-up is lost if you are revealed without being struck.
This is a stealth and warding effect.
lurker.tag: This is a stealth and warding effect.

magic.name: Arcane Saturation
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Magical buffs you give and receive are stronger still.
Your buffs cost slightly more mana.
This is a mastery and support effect.
magic.tag: This is a mastery and support effect.

malign.name: Malign Lash
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction is dispelled from you, it lashes back at its caster in a weakened form.
The lash has a cooldown.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

manatee.name: Sea-Cow Solace
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions on allies near you wane slightly faster.
This works only while you have not attacked for a short time.
This is a water and healing effect.
manatee.tag: This is a water and healing effect.

manticore.name: Manticore's Barb
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an enemy afflicts you, your next attack on it carries a venom that weakens its buffs.
The venom has a cooldown and does not stack.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
manticore.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

master.name: Master's Benediction
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give carry an extra minor benefit chosen to suit the ally's role: guard, striker or healer.
Only a few allies can carry this benefit at a time.
This is a mastery and support effect.
master.tag: This is a mastery and support effect.

might.name: Mighty Footing
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Strength buffs on you also grant resistance to being knocked down.
Each knockdown resisted costs stamina.
This is a momentum and defensive effect.
might.tag: This is a momentum and defensive effect.

ministration.name: Tender Care
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispels on allies also heal them a little for each affliction removed.
The healing is capped for each dispel.
This is a healing and purification effect.
ministration.tag: This is a healing and purification effect.

minotaur.name: Mazewise Calm
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Confusion and disorientation afflictions fail on you, and allies near you resist them more strongly.
Your own protection holds once every so often; the allies' share lasts only while they stay close.
This is a defensive and perception effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a defensive and perception effect.

mirage.name: Mirage Decoy
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction lands on you, you leave a mirage behind that draws the next affliction aimed at you.
The mirage fades after a short time or once it is struck.
This is an evasion and light effect.
mirage.tag: This is an evasion and light effect.

mirror.name: Mirrored Hex
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once every so often, an affliction aimed at you is reflected back at its caster.
Reflected afflictions are weaker and shorter.
This is a warding and resonance effect.
mirror.tag: This is a warding and resonance effect.

monkey.name: Mischief Swap
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, you swap an affliction on you for a buff on an enemy near you: it takes your affliction and you take its buff.
The stolen buff lasts only a short time.
This is a transmutation and binding effect.
monkey.tag: This is a transmutation and binding effect.

monolith.name: Monolith Calm
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you stand still, you become a standing stone; allies near you resist afflictions as steadily as you do.
The aura ends when you move and takes a moment to rise again.
This is a barrier and area effect.
monolith.tag: This is a barrier and area effect.

moon.name: Waning Hex
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions on you wane like the moon, weakening steadily toward their end.
Buffs you give in shadow or dim places last longer. Neither works against curses.
This is a light and shadow effect.
moon.tag: This is a light and shadow effect.

mouse.name: Small Target
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Area afflictions that catch you are weaker still, and you often slip out of them early.
Slipping out has a cooldown.
This is an evasion and area effect.
mouse.tag: This is an evasion and area effect.

myriad.name: Myriad Blessing
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each distinct buff you carry slightly strengthens all the others.
The strengthening is capped and counts only buffs from you or your allies.
This is a support and mastery effect.
myriad.tag: This is a support and mastery effect.

mystic.name: Mystic Sense
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You feel when any ally in the fight is afflicted, and your next dispel on that ally reaches farther.
The farther reach costs extra mana.
This is a perception and support effect.
mystic.tag: This is a perception and support effect.

nebula.name: Starcloud Spread
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Area afflictions that land near you are dispersed into a thin cloud, weaker on every ally caught in it.
The dispersal has a cooldown.
This is an area and warding effect.
nebula.tag: This is an area and warding effect.

needle.name: Pinpoint Dispel
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel pierces enemy shields and barriers to strip the buffs beneath.
Piercing has a cooldown.
This is an annihilation and purification effect.
needle.tag: This is an annihilation and purification effect.

nemesis.name: Nemesis Ward
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
The strongest enemy in a fight becomes your nemesis; its afflictions are resisted strongly by you and by allies near you.
Every other enemy's afflictions are met as usual.
This is a warding and hunting effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a warding and hunting effect.

net.name: Snaring Ward
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction, it leaves a net of threads that briefly slows enemies close by.
The net has a cooldown.
This is a restraint and binding effect.
net.tag: This is a restraint and binding effect.

network.name: Networked Resistance
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies holding your buffs are linked; when a linked ally resists an affliction, the others gain brief resistance to it.
The shared resistance has a cooldown.
This is a support and resonance effect.
network.tag: This is a support and resonance effect.

oasis.name: Oasis Refuge
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies resting near you recover from afflictions faster.
The refuge works only while they have not been hit for a short time.
This is a water and restoration effect.
oasis.tag: This is a water and restoration effect.

ocean.name: Tidal Cleanse
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Every so often a tide washes out from you, rinsing a minor affliction from each ally near you.
The tide costs mana and has a long cooldown.
This is a water and purification effect.
ocean.tag: This is a water and purification effect.

octopus.name: Many Arms
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel on an ally also reaches out to other allies near them, removing a minor affliction from each.
When heavily afflicted yourself, you release a cloud of ink that hides you from enemy afflictions briefly, once per fight.
This is a darkness and purification effect.
octopus.tag: This is a darkness and purification effect.

omen.name: Omen's Warning
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You sense a strong affliction a moment before it is cast, warning allies near you, who resist it more strongly.
This works once per fight for each enemy.
This is a precognition and warding effect.
omen.tag: This is a precognition and warding effect.

onslaught.name: Relentless Blessing
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While allies keep attacking, your buffs on them are refreshed slightly with each hit.
The refreshing has a cap and stops if they pause.
This is a momentum and support effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a momentum and support effect.

pangolin.name: Pangolin Shrug
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When afflicted, you can curl up briefly and shrug the affliction off.
You cannot act while curled, and curling has a cooldown.
This is a defensive and shield effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a defensive and shield effect.

paper.name: Inscribed Slip
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each buff you give comes with a paper slip; an enemy dispel must burn the slip first and leaves the buff alone.
Each slip burns away after it is used.
This is a warding and protection effect.
paper.tag: This is a warding and protection effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Dream Haunting
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Enemies that afflict you are haunted by phantasms, weakening the next affliction they cast.
The haunting has a cooldown for each enemy.
This is an affliction and curse effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is an affliction and curse effect.

phoenix.name: Ashen Rising
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, when you would fall, every affliction on you burns away and you rise with a brief protective buff.
After rising you resist afflictions less for a short time.
This is a fire and rebirth effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a fire and rebirth effect.

plant.name: Taproot Boon
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give take root in the ground beneath their holder, leaving a patch that grants a faint version to anyone standing in it.
The patch withers after a short time.
This is a growth and area effect.
plant.tag: This is a growth and area effect.

potent.name: Potent Infusion
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give are deeper and more concentrated.
Each buff costs more mana, and you can hold your buffs on fewer allies at once.
This is a mastery and support effect.
potent.tag: This is a mastery and support effect.

predatory.name: Predator's Purge
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel strikes hardest on wounded enemies: stripping a buff from an enemy below half health strips another as well.
This has a cooldown.
This is a hunting and annihilation effect.
predatory.tag: This is a hunting and annihilation effect.

prison.name: Warden's Seal
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
An enemy you dispel cannot receive new buffs for a short time.
The seal has a cooldown and holds only the latest enemy dispelled.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
prison.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

prosperity.name: Prosperous Overflow
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you carry several buffs, a faint share of your surplus flows to the ally nearest you.
The share is weaker and stops when your buffs thin out.
This is a support and harvest effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a support and harvest effect.

pure.name: Pure Vessel
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Curses and corruption fail on you more often.
Your dispels always purge curses first, at extra mana cost.
This is a purification and holy effect.
pure.tag: This is a purification and holy effect.

rabbit.name: Bolting Start
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction lands on you, you gain a quick burst of speed to get clear of its source.
The burst has a cooldown.
This is a haste and evasion effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a haste and evasion effect.

rake.name: Raking Purge
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel sweeps in a short arc in front of you, stripping a minor buff from each enemy it passes.
The sweep costs extra mana.
This is an area and purification effect.
rake.tag: This is an area and purification effect.

rat.name: Scavenger's Mend
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Disease afflictions are resisted strongly.
When any affliction runs out on you, you scavenge a small heal from its remains. This has a cooldown.
This is a salvage and healing effect.
rat.tag: This is a salvage and healing effect.

reagent.name: Catalytic Grace
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
An affliction that lands on you can be broken down and turned into a minor buff of a related kind.
This transmutation has a cooldown.
This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.
reagent.tag: This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.

refracting.name: Refracted Boon
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give pass through every ally standing in a line between you and the target, leaving each a faint share.
The shares last only a short time.
This is a light and support effect.
refracting.tag: This is a light and support effect.

renewal.name: Renewing Grace
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When a buff you gave ends while its holder is still fighting, it renews itself at reduced strength.
Each buff renews only once.
This is a restoration and support effect.
renewal.tag: This is a restoration and support effect.

resolute.name: Unbroken Resolve
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, when an affliction would stop you acting, you act straight through it.
Stuns and sleeps that do hold are shortened further.
This is a defensive and warding effect.
resolute.tag: This is a defensive and warding effect.

resonating.name: Resonant Bond
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies near you who hold the same buff resonate, each strengthening the others slightly.
The resonance is capped and holds only while they stay close.
This is a resonance and support effect.
resonating.tag: This is a resonance and support effect.

roc.name: Roc Wingshade
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies sheltering in your shadow are shielded from area afflictions, which reach them weakened.
The shelter covers only allies close to you and costs stamina while it holds.
This is a protection and area effect.
roc.tag: This is a protection and area effect.

rune.name: Runic Circle
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, you inscribe a rune on the ground where you stand; allies on it resist afflictions strongly.
The rune fades after a short time.
This is a warding and binding effect.
rune.tag: This is a warding and binding effect.

sacrifice.name: Sacrificial Shield
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an ally near you is struck by a strong affliction, you take it onto yourself, where your resistance weakens it.
Taking it costs a portion of your health, and this has a cooldown.
This is a protection and support effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

sand.name: Hourglass Ward
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions on you run out faster, like sand slipping away, while you keep moving.
The faster running stops the moment you stand still.
This is a time and movement effect.
sand.tag: This is a time and movement effect.

sceptre.name: Sceptred Edict
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, you raise your hand and decree an end to the minor afflictions on every ally near you.
Allies freed this way resist command and fear afflictions for a short time.
This is a command and purification effect.
sceptre.tag: This is a command and purification effect.

scribe.name: Recorded Blessing
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Every buff you give in a fight is recorded.
Once per fight, you rewrite the buff you have given most often onto every ally near you.
This is a support and mastery effect.
scribe.tag: This is a support and mastery effect.

serene.name: Serene Mind
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you are not attacking, afflictions on you fade quickly.
The serenity breaks as soon as you strike, and settles again after a short time.
This is a healing and warding effect.
serene.tag: This is a healing and warding effect.

serpent.name: Coiling Dispel
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel can coil around an enemy, squeezing out its buffs over a short time and slowing it while the coil holds.
The coil has a cooldown.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
serpent.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

shark.name: Bloodscent Dispel
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel against a bleeding enemy strips an extra buff.
You sense bleeding enemies near you. The extra strip has a cooldown.
This is a hunting and annihilation effect.
shark.tag: This is a hunting and annihilation effect.

shield.name: Bulwark Blessing
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Shield and barrier buffs you give or receive are stronger and last longer.
Each such buff costs slightly more mana.
This is a shield and barrier effect.
shield.tag: This is a shield and barrier effect.

shimmer.name: Shimmering Haze
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies holding your buffs shimmer, and enemy afflictions aimed at them miss more often.
The shimmer lasts only a short time after each buff lands.
This is a light and evasion effect.
shimmer.tag: This is a light and evasion effect.

ship.name: Steady Hull
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When several allies near you are afflicted at once, the afflictions on all of them are shortened slightly.
This works only while the crew stays close to you.
This is a support and protection effect.
ship.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

shovel.name: Dig Out
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispels on allies dig out the longest-lasting affliction first.
Each dispel used this way costs a little stamina.
This is a salvage and purification effect.
shovel.tag: This is a salvage and purification effect.

sickle.name: Gleaning Dispel
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each affliction your dispel cuts away from an ally restores a little of your stamina.
The restoration is capped for each dispel.
This is a harvesting and restoration effect.
sickle.tag: This is a harvesting and restoration effect.

simulacrum.name: Hollow Echo
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you give your strongest buff, a hollow copy of it settles on you at reduced strength.
The copy cannot be passed on and fades after a short time.
This is a transformation and support effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a transformation and support effect.

sin.name: Sinner's Burden
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each affliction on an ally near you weighs on the enemy that cast it, giving that enemy a creeping weakness.
The burden ends when the affliction does, and costs you a little health while it holds.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
sin.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

skirmish.name: Skirmisher's Grace
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you move between enemies, you can cast buffs without slowing.
Buffs cast on the move are slightly shorter.
This is a movement and support effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a movement and support effect.

skunk.name: Noxious Rebuke
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction lands on you, you release a stench that weakens the buffs on enemies near you.
The stench has a cooldown.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
skunk.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

sky.name: Weathered Sky
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Storm and wind afflictions are resisted strongly by you and by allies near you.
The allies' share lasts only while they stay close.
This is a storm and wind effect.
sky.tag: This is a storm and wind effect.

sloth.name: Lingering Blessing
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give last much longer.
They take noticeably longer to cast.
This is a time and support effect.
sloth.tag: This is a time and support effect.

smoke.name: Smoke Screen
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction, smoke rises around you, hiding allies near you from enemy afflictions for a moment.
The smoke has a cooldown.
This is a stealth and protection effect.
smoke.tag: This is a stealth and protection effect.

snake.name: Venom-Proof Scales
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Venom afflictions on you are shortened sharply.
When a venom ends on you, your next attack carries a trace of it. This has a cooldown.
This is a poison and defensive effect.
snake.tag: This is a poison and defensive effect.

soaring.name: Uplifting Boon
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give lift their holder's spirits, briefly shaking off slows and roots as they land.
The lift works only as each buff is applied.
This is a wind and movement effect.
soaring.tag: This is a wind and movement effect.

song.name: Warding Hymn
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you are giving buffs, you hum a hymn; allies who hear it resist afflictions slightly better.
The hymn carries only a short distance and stops when you take a heavy hit.
This is a sound and support effect.
song.tag: This is a sound and support effect.

sovereign.name: Sovereign Will
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Command and domination afflictions fail on you.
Allies near you share this protection, but only while you stand above half health.
This is a command and warding effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a command and warding effect.

spear.name: Piercing Dispel
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel flies in a straight line, stripping a buff from the first enemy and continuing to the next behind it.
The line costs extra mana and reaches only a short distance.
This is an annihilation and area effect.
spear.tag: This is an annihilation and area effect.

spider.name: Web of Wards
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give spin a thread back to you; when any threaded ally is afflicted, you feel it and resist that affliction yourself for a short time.
Only a few threads can hold at once.
This is a binding and perception effect.
spider.tag: This is a binding and perception effect.

spike.name: Thorned Ward
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction lands on you, spikes jut from your skin and wound enemies close by.
The spikes have a cooldown.
This is a defensive and affliction effect.
spike.tag: This is a defensive and affliction effect.

staff.name: Channelled Grace
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give through a staff reach farther and land steadier.
While you hold your staff ready, afflictions are resisted slightly better. Staff buffs cost a little more mana.
This is a mastery and support effect.
staff.tag: This is a mastery and support effect.

star.name: Lodestar Boon
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your most recent buff shines like a star over its holder, guiding your dispels to them first when they are afflicted.
The star fades when the buff ends.
This is a light and support effect.
star.tag: This is a light and support effect.

stellar.name: Starfall Purge
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, your dispel falls as a shower of starlight, stripping a buff from every enemy in a wide area.
The shower takes a moment to fall.
This is an area and radiant effect.
stellar.tag: This is an area and radiant effect.

storm.name: Stormcaller's Mantle
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Lightning and wind buffs you give crackle, striking enemies that afflict their holder.
The strike has a cooldown for each ally.
This is a storm and lightning effect.
