storm.tag: This is a storm and lightning effect.

succubus.name: Siren Refusal
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Charm afflictions are resisted strongly.
When you resist a charm, its caster is drawn toward you and its buffs weaken for a short time. This has a cooldown.
This is a curse and binding effect.
succubus.tag: This is a curse and binding effect.

sun.name: Noonday Blessing
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give warm their holder, burning away darkness and cold afflictions faster.
The warmth lasts only a short time after each buff.
This is a light and fire effect.
sun.tag: This is a light and fire effect.

swarm.name: Swarming Grace
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Small, short buffs you give scatter among all allies near you instead of landing on just the target.
Each scattered buff is faint and brief.
This is a swarm and support effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and support effect.

swift.name: Swift Casting
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your buffs and dispels are cast quickly.
Quick-cast buffs are slightly shorter.
This is a haste and support effect.
swift.tag: This is a haste and support effect.

sword.name: Blade Blessing
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give to an ally wielding a blade also sharpen their parries, weakening afflictions delivered by weapon strikes.
This lasts only while the buff holds.
This is a defensive and mastery effect.
sword.tag: This is a defensive and mastery effect.

talisman.name: Hung Talisman Ward
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
At the start of each fight you hang a charm about you; the first affliction to strike you breaks the charm and fails.
The charm returns only in the next fight.
This is a warding and protection effect.
talisman.tag: This is a warding and protection effect.

tentacle.name: Grasping Cleanse
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel can reach out with a tendril to an ally out of easy range and pull an affliction off them.
The reach has a cooldown.
This is a purification and support effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a purification and support effect.

thread.name: Mending Thread
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your buffs are stitched into their holder; a dispel that tears a buff away leaves a thread that restores a faint version shortly after.
Each buff carries only the latest thread.
This is a binding and restoration effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and restoration effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderclap Ward
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction, a clap of thunder briefly stuns its caster.
The thunderclap has a long cooldown.
This is a storm and lightning effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a storm and lightning effect.

time.name: Borrowed Moments
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions on you run their course faster, while buffs on you hold their time a little longer.
Once per fight, you wind back the clock on a buff about to expire on an ally near you.
This is a time and support effect.
time.tag: This is a time and support effect.

tranquil.name: Tranquil Waters
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies near you who have not been hit for a short time shed minor afflictions on their own.
The calm breaks for an ally the moment they are struck.
This is a water and restoration effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a water and restoration effect.

transfiguration.name: Shifting Blessing
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an ally holding your buff is afflicted, the buff can reshape itself into a resistance against that affliction.
The reshaped buff lasts only a short time, and each buff can reshape only once.
This is a transformation and warding effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a transformation and warding effect.

transgression.name: Trespasser's Rebuke
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Enemy buffs that break the rules of a fight, such as invulnerability or unstoppable states, are torn by your dispel before any other.
Tearing them costs extra mana and has a cooldown.
This is an annihilation and purification effect.
transgression.tag: This is an annihilation and purification effect.

trap.name: Spring-Loaded Ward
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you stand still, you set a hidden ward at your feet; the next affliction to reach you springs it and is caught.
The ward takes a moment to set and is lost if you move.
This is a warding and restraint effect.
trap.tag: This is a warding and restraint effect.

tree.name: Heartwood Hold
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you receive draw on your roots and last longer while you stay put.
Knockdowns and pulls are resisted strongly, but only while you are standing still.
This is a nature and defensive effect.
tree.tag: This is a nature and defensive effect.

troll.name: Troll's Mending
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions that stop healing or regeneration fail on you more often.
While you regenerate, afflictions on you are shortened further. Fire afflictions still burn as usual.
This is a restoration and healing effect.
troll.tag: This is a restoration and healing effect.

trowel.name: Patched Ward
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an enemy dispels a buff from an ally near you, you smooth over the gap and their resistance to afflictions holds for a short time.
The patching has a cooldown.
This is a protection and salvage effect.
trowel.tag: This is a protection and salvage effect.

turtle.name: Turtle's Withdrawal
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you are carrying several afflictions, you draw in and shorten them all sharply.
While drawn in you move slowly, and this has a long cooldown.
This is a defensive and shield effect.
turtle.tag: This is a defensive and shield effect.

twilight.name: Dusk Veil
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Light and darkness afflictions alike are blunted against you.
Once per fight, when you fall below half health, a dusk veil falls that hides you from afflictions briefly.
This is a shadow and light effect.
twilight.tag: This is a shadow and light effect.

undeath.name: Deathless Ward
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Necromantic and draining afflictions are resisted strongly.
Your buffs work on undead and animated allies as they do on the living. Buffs given this way cost extra mana.
This is a necromantic and protection effect.
undeath.tag: This is a necromantic and protection effect.

unity.name: Unified Party Ward
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When every ally in the party holds a buff from you, all of them resist afflictions slightly better.
The unity breaks as soon as any of those buffs ends.
This is a support and resonance effect.
unity.tag: This is a support and resonance effect.

vast.name: Vast Boon Reach
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your buffs and dispels reach allies across a wide area.
Casting at the far end of that reach costs extra mana.
This is an area and support effect.
vast.tag: This is an area and support effect.

vehicle.name: Carried Blessing
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies travelling close behind you carry your buffs for longer.
Slows and roots on such allies are shortened, but only while they keep pace with you.
This is a travel and movement effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a travel and movement effect.

venom.name: Venom Turned
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Poisons that land on you are weakened further, and your body learns from them.
When a poison ends on you, your next dispel against an enemy leaves a weak poison behind. This has a cooldown.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

verdant.name: Verdant Canopy
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give sprout a light canopy over their holder that shades them from area afflictions.
The canopy withers after a short time.
This is a nature and protection effect.
verdant.tag: This is a nature and protection effect.

vessel.name: Overflow Reserve
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Mana you would recover while full is held in reserve.
You spend that reserve first when giving buffs or dispelling, up to a limit that scales with rank.
This is a support and mastery effect.
vessel.tag: This is a support and mastery effect.

visage.name: Stern Visage
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Enemies that meet your gaze hesitate to afflict you, casting at allies or not at all.
The stare lasts only a short time and has a cooldown.
This is a warding and command effect.
visage.tag: This is a warding and command effect.

vision.name: Far Sight
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You see which ally an enemy is about to afflict, and you can buff that ally against it in time.
This foresight has a cooldown.
This is a precognition and support effect.
vision.tag: This is a precognition and support effect.

void.name: Null Ward
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once every so often, an affliction aimed at you is swallowed by the void around you and erased.
While the void is open, buffs you receive are also slightly muted.
This is a darkness and warding effect.
void.tag: This is a darkness and warding effect.

volcano.name: Eruptive Purge
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you carry several afflictions, pressure builds; your next dispel erupts, scorching enemies close by as it clears you.
The eruption has a cooldown.
This is a fire and purification effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and purification effect.

vortex.name: Vortex Siphon
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, you draw minor afflictions off every ally near you into a whirl that spins them out harmlessly.
The whirl leaves you slowed for a moment.
This is a wind and purification effect.
vortex.tag: This is a wind and purification effect.

wasp.name: Stinging Retort
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each affliction you resist lets you sting back, weakening the caster's armour briefly.
The stings do not stack and have a cooldown.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
wasp.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

water.name: Runnel Blessing
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give flow from ally to ally: when a holder is struck, the buff can run on to an ally beside them.
The flow happens only once for each buff.
This is a water and support effect.
water.tag: This is a water and support effect.

weave.name: Woven Wards
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give to an ally weave together with the ones they already hold, becoming harder for enemies to dispel.
The weave unravels if you leave the fight.
This is a binding and protection effect.
weave.tag: This is a binding and protection effect.

wendigo.name: Hungering Frost
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each buff your dispel strips from an enemy leaves it starving and chilled, slowed for a short time.
The chill has a cooldown.
This is a cold and hunting effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and hunting effect.

whale.name: Whale Song
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, a deep song rolls out from you, lengthening every buff on allies across a wide area.
The song takes a moment to sing, and you cannot attack while singing.
This is a sound and water effect.
whale.tag: This is a sound and water effect.

wheel.name: Wheelturn Haste
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each time an affliction ends on you, your next buff is cast faster.
The momentum is lost if you do not use it soon.
This is a momentum and haste effect.
wheel.tag: This is a momentum and haste effect.

whip.name: Lashing Dispel
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel lashes out at a distant enemy, stripping a buff and stinging it.
The lash has a cooldown and does not reach across obstacles.
This is a restraint and annihilation effect.
whip.tag: This is a restraint and annihilation effect.

wind.name: Windswept Ward
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Clouds, gases and lingering area afflictions near you are blown thinner.
The wind holds only while you keep moving.
This is a wind and area effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and area effect.

wing.name: Wingspread Aegis
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an ally beside you is targeted by an affliction, you can spread your wings over them and take the brunt yourself.
This has a cooldown and costs stamina.
This is a protection and support effect.
wing.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

wolf.name: Pack Bond
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies fighting the same enemy as you share a portion of your resistance.
The bond holds only while the pack is attacking the same target.
This is a hunting and support effect.
wolf.tag: This is a hunting and support effect.

wood.name: Grained Ward
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give soak into their holder like oil into wood, lasting longer while they hold still.
The soaking ends when the holder moves.
This is a nature and protection effect.
wood.tag: This is a nature and protection effect.

wrath.name: Wrathful Resistance
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction, you gain a brief fury that sharpens your attacks.
The fury has a cooldown and does not stack.
This is a momentum and affliction effect.
wrath.tag: This is a momentum and affliction effect.

zeal.name: Zealous Devotion
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Fear and despair afflictions fail on you while you are fighting toward a sworn foe.
Buffs you give to allies attacking that same foe last longer. Only the latest foe can be sworn.
This is a holy and support effect.
zeal.tag: This is a holy and support effect.

ziz.name: Skyshadow Dread
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, a vast shadow spreads from you, and enemies beneath it lose the strength of their buffs for a short time.
The shadow drains your mana while it holds.
This is a shadow and area effect.
ziz.tag: This is a shadow and area effect.

action.name: Snap Blessing
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you give an ally a buff, they gain a brief burst of haste as it takes hold.
This can trigger for each ally only once every few seconds.
This is a support and haste effect.
action.tag: This is a support and haste effect.

adept.name: Practised Hand
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each time you give the same buff again during a fight, it lands slightly deeper, up to a cap that scales with rank.
The built-up practice fades when the fight ends.
This is a support and mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a support and mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Tincture Grace
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Potions and elixirs drunk by you or allies near you have their beneficial effects strengthened as if they were buffs you gave.
When a potion cures an affliction near you, the drinker resists that affliction for a short time afterward.
This is a support and alchemy effect.
alchemy.tag: This is a support and alchemy effect.

ambush.name: Hidden Benediction
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give in the opening moments of a fight the party started last longer.
The first affliction to land on you after the party strikes from hiding is shrugged off entirely, once per fight.
This is a stealth and warding effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and warding effect.

animate.name: Kindled Constructs
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Summoned and animated allies near you receive your buffs at full strength and resist afflictions the way you do.
This sharing works only while they stay within a short distance of you.
This is an animation and support effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and support effect.

anzu.name: Stolen Fortune
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When your dispel strips a buff from an enemy, a crackling, weaker copy of it passes to you for a short time.
This theft has a cooldown, and the stolen copy cannot be passed on.
This is a storm and transmutation effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and transmutation effect.

ape.name: Brawler's Blood
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs that raise your strength or attack hit harder on you than other buffs do.
When you resist a stun or slow, you gain a brief surge of might, once every so often.
This is a momentum and defensive effect.
ape.tag: This is a momentum and defensive effect.

armour.name: Plated Spirit
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you hold a defensive buff, afflictions that strike you are weakened further.
Once per fight, an affliction that would land on you instead wears away your defensive buff.
This is a protection and warding effect.
armour.tag: This is a protection and warding effect.

arsenal.name: Armoury Rite
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give that empower attacks carry an extra edge suited to the ally's weapon: heavier for blades and hafts, quicker for bows and staves.
The edge lasts only as long as the buff and costs a little extra mana.
This is a support and mastery effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a support and mastery effect.

aspect.name: Aspected Grace
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give take on the colour of your own essences, carrying a minor extra boon drawn from your strongest power.
Only your most recent buff carries the aspect at any time.
This is a support and transformation effect.
aspect.tag: This is a support and transformation effect.

avatar.name: Vessel of Grace
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you receive a buff while below half health, it spills over to allies near you at reduced strength.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a radiant and support effect.
avatar.tag: This is a radiant and support effect.

axe.name: Sundering Dispel
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When your dispel strips a buff from an enemy, it also hacks at that enemy's armour, weakening it for a short time.
The armour break has a cooldown and does not stack.
This is a purification and annihilation effect.
axe.tag: This is a purification and annihilation effect.

balance.name: Tipping Scales
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you carry more afflictions than buffs, afflictions on you weaken further; while you carry more buffs than afflictions, your buffs on allies last longer.
The scales can tip only once every few seconds.
This is a support and warding effect.
balance.tag: This is a support and warding effect.

bat.name: Night Hearing
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions cast at you by enemies you cannot see are resisted as well as those you can.
The first affliction from an unseen source each fight is heard coming and turned aside.
This is a darkness and perception effect.
bat.tag: This is a darkness and perception effect.

battlefield.name: Rallying Ground
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies fighting near you share a portion of your resistance to afflictions.
The shared resistance fades a short time after an ally steps away from you.
This is an area and support effect.
battlefield.tag: This is an area and support effect.

bear.name: Thick Hide
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions that cause bleeding or open wounds are resisted strongly.
When such an affliction does land, you gain brief toughness, once every so often.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
bear.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

bee.name: Hive Blessing
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give spread a faint share to allies standing beside the target.
The share is weaker and lasts only a short time.
This is a swarm and support effect.
bee.tag: This is a swarm and support effect.

behemoth.name: Unbending Bulk
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While your health is high, afflictions that slow, stun or knock you aside are resisted far more often.
Each such affliction resisted costs you stamina.
This is a defensive and momentum effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a defensive and momentum effect.

bird.name: Wingborne Grace
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Movement buffs you give or receive last longer and grant a moment of evasion when they land.
The evasion triggers only as the buff is applied.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
bird.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

blight.name: Festering Rebound
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction outright, a withered version of it festers on the enemy that cast it.
Each enemy can suffer this only once per fight.
This is an affliction and poison effect.
blight.tag: This is an affliction and poison effect.

blood.name: Blood Rite
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You may spend a portion of your health to deepen a buff you give an ally.
Afflictions that drain your health are weaker still. The rite has a cooldown.
This is a restoration and affliction effect.
blood.tag: This is a restoration and affliction effect.

bone.name: Marrow Bulwark
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions that shred armour or break the body are shortened further.
When such an affliction ends on you, you gain brief armour, once every so often.
This is a defensive and necromantic effect.
bone.tag: This is a defensive and necromantic effect.

boundary.name: Threshold Circle
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
After you stand still for a moment, a faint circle forms around you; allies inside it resist afflictions as you do.
The circle fades as soon as you move.
This is a warding and barrier effect.
boundary.tag: This is a warding and barrier effect.

bounty.name: Plentiful Gift
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an ally holding your buff lands a killing blow, that buff is refreshed.
Each buff can be refreshed this way only once.
This is a harvest and support effect.
bounty.tag: This is a harvest and support effect.

bow.name: Arrow Blessing
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You can send a buff to a distant ally along a line of light, as if they stood beside you.
Buffs sent this way cost extra mana.
This is a support and travel effect.
bow.tag: This is a support and travel effect.

brush.name: Smudged Sigil
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give leave a painted mark on the ally; when an affliction lands on them, the mark smudges away to weaken it.
Each mark is spent the first time it works.
This is a warding and transmutation effect.
brush.tag: This is a warding and transmutation effect.

cage.name: Caged Malice
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction, it is caught and held around you instead of fading.
Your next dispel against an enemy hurls the caged affliction onto it. The cage holds only a short time.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
cage.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

cat.name: Cat's Twist
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction would stun, root or disable you, you twist free of it entirely.
This works once per fight.
This is an evasion and warding effect.
cat.tag: This is an evasion and warding effect.

cataclysm.name: Ruinous Purge
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs your dispel strips from an enemy burst outward, harming enemies close by.
The burst has a cooldown and scales with rank.
This is an annihilation and area effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an annihilation and area effect.

cattle.name: Herd Steadiness
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies bunched close around you resist afflictions slightly better for every ally in the group, up to a cap.
The steadiness breaks the moment the group scatters.
This is a support and protection effect.
cattle.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

chain.name: Linked Blessing
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your most recent buff binds its holder to you with a faint chain; while linked, an affliction striking either of you is split between you and weakened.
The link snaps if you move far apart.
This is a binding and support effect.
chain.tag: This is a binding and support effect.

chaotic.name: Wild Surge
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give sometimes carry a random minor boon on top.
Afflictions you resist sometimes leap at random to a nearby enemy. Either surge has a cooldown.
This is a transmutation and affliction effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a transmutation and affliction effect.

charlatan.name: Easy Mark
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You seem the easiest mark to enemy casters, who prefer to aim their afflictions at you instead of your allies.
The lure lasts only while you are above half health.
This is a protection and warding effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a protection and warding effect.

chicken.name: Flustered Dispel
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction lands on you, you reflexively dispel yourself at reduced mana cost, removing the newest affliction only.
This reflex has a cooldown.
This is a purification and haste effect.
chicken.tag: This is a purification and haste effect.

chimera.name: Fused Boons
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you give an ally a buff of a kind they already hold from another source, the buffs fuse into a stronger whole.
A fused buff lasts only as long as the shorter of its parts.
This is a transformation and support effect.
chimera.tag: This is a transformation and support effect.

claw.name: Rending Dispel
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel tears a buff away from an enemy and leaves a brief bleeding wound where it was.
The wound does not stack and has a cooldown.
This is an affliction and annihilation effect.
claw.tag: This is an affliction and annihilation effect.

cloth.name: Woven Mantle
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give wrap the ally in a light mantle that weakens the first affliction they suffer while the buff lasts.
The mantle frays once it has done its work.
This is a protection and warding effect.
cloth.tag: This is a protection and warding effect.

cloud.name: Drifting Veil
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Area buffs you place linger like mist for a short time after you leave them.
While you are moving, afflictions aimed at you drift aside slightly more often.
This is a wind and evasion effect.
cloud.tag: This is a wind and evasion effect.

cold.name: Rimefrost Boon
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Frost afflictions are resisted strongly. Buffs you give chill the ally's attacks, slowing enemies they strike.
The slow is brief and cannot stack on the same enemy.
This is a cold and support effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and support effect.

coral.name: Coral Reef Layers
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies who stay near you slowly build layers of resistance to afflictions.
Each affliction that lands strips away a layer, and the layers rebuild only slowly.
This is a water and protection effect.
coral.tag: This is a water and protection effect.

corrupt.name: Tainted Purge
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
A buff your dispel strips from an enemy rots into a weak affliction on that same enemy.
The rot costs extra mana and has a cooldown.
This is an affliction and transmutation effect.
corrupt.tag: This is an affliction and transmutation effect.

crocodile.name: Still-Water Lurk
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you hold still, your resistance to afflictions deepens moment by moment.
When you break stillness, your next dispel snaps shut with extra force. The build-up resets after it is spent.
This is a hunting and defensive effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a hunting and defensive effect.

crystal.name: Crystal Lattice
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
For a short time after you give a buff, it is locked in a crystal lattice and enemy dispels cannot remove it.
The lattice forms on only your most recent buff.
This is a protection and warding effect.
crystal.tag: This is a protection and warding effect.

cycle.name: Charged Cycle
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each affliction you resist charges your next buff, and each buff you give strengthens your next resistance.
Each charge is spent as soon as it is used and fades after a short time.
This is a time and support effect.
cycle.tag: This is a time and support effect.

dance.name: Graceful Rhythm
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you keep moving in a fight, buffs you give last longer and afflictions slide off you more often.
Standing still for a moment breaks the rhythm.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
dance.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

dark.name: Shrouded Ward
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give are hidden in shadow from enemy dispels for a short time after they land.
Darkness afflictions are weaker on you still.
This is a shadow and protection effect.
dark.tag: This is a shadow and protection effect.

dawn.name: Daybreak Grace
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
The first buff you give each fight shines brighter and also lifts a minor affliction from its target.
This works once per fight.
This is a light and purification effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and purification effect.

death.name: Grave Ward
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an ally near you is about to fall while afflicted, the afflictions on them end at once.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a death and protection effect.
death.tag: This is a death and protection effect.

deep.name: Fathom Calm
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Lasting afflictions on you weaken the longer they hold, as if crushed under deep water.
The weakening resets each time a fresh affliction lands.
This is a water and warding effect.
deep.tag: This is a water and warding effect.

deer.name: Woodland Watch
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You sense enemy casters preparing afflictions; allies near you resist the first such affliction from each caster.
This works once per caster per fight.
This is a perception and nature effect.
deer.tag: This is a perception and nature effect.

desolate.name: Withering Field
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Healing and regeneration buffs on enemies near you are stifled and weaken.
The stifling reaches only a short distance and drains mana while enemies stand in it.
This is an affliction and area effect.
desolate.tag: This is an affliction and area effect.

dimension.name: Elsewhere Fold
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, an affliction about to land on you is folded away into elsewhere and never arrives.
Buffs you give can reach an ally out of sight, at extra mana cost.
This is a travel and warding effect.
dimension.tag: This is a travel and warding effect.

discord.name: Discord Sting
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction, a jarring note disrupts its caster, delaying their next spell.
Each caster can be jarred only once every so often.
This is a sound and affliction effect.
discord.tag: This is a sound and affliction effect.

discordant.name: Clashing Chorus
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Enemies near you that hold several buffs find those buffs clashing, each weakened by the others.
The clash reaches only a short distance and costs mana while it holds.
This is a sound and area effect.
discordant.tag: This is a sound and area effect.

dog.name: Loyal Guard
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When the ally you most recently buffed is afflicted, you rush toward them and your next dispel on them costs no mana.
This has a cooldown.
This is a support and protection effect.
dog.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

doom.name: Fated Mark
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
An enemy whose affliction you resist is marked by fate; your next attack on it strikes harder.
Only the latest mark holds, and it fades after a short time.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
doom.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

doppelganger.name: Mirrored Boon
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an ally near you gains a buff from another source, you gain a weaker copy of it.
Each kind of buff can be copied only once every so often.
This is a transformation and support effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a transformation and support effect.

dragon.name: Draconic Majesty
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Fear and charm afflictions are resisted strongly by you and by allies near you.
Once per fight, when an ally near you is overcome by fear, your presence breaks it at once.
This is a fire and command effect.
dragon.tag: This is a fire and command effect.

duck.name: Water Off Feathers
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions that soak, chill or slow you slide off more easily.
The first slowing affliction aimed at you each fight misses entirely.
This is a water and evasion effect.
duck.tag: This is a water and evasion effect.

dust.name: Crumbling Hex
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction ends on you, its lingering after-effects crumble away with it.
Buffs on enemies near you crumble slightly faster. This reaches only a short distance.
This is a purification and area effect.
dust.tag: This is a purification and area effect.

earth.name: Rooted Ward
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you stand still, knockback and stun afflictions are resisted strongly.
Moving breaks the rooting, and it takes a moment to settle again.
This is a defensive and nature effect.
earth.tag: This is a defensive and nature effect.

echo.name: Echoed Resolve
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction, an echo of that resistance rings out to allies near you for a short time.
The echo has a cooldown.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
echo.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

eclipse.name: Shadowed Sun
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, a blinding or darkness affliction on you is swallowed whole.
Your next buff after that carries a veil of shadow that hides its holder from enemy afflictions for a short time.
This is a shadow and light effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a shadow and light effect.

edifice.name: Cornerstone Blessing
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you hold your ground, buffs you have given to allies are anchored and enemy dispels cannot remove them.
The anchoring lasts only a short time after you move.
This is a barrier and protection effect.
edifice.tag: This is a barrier and protection effect.

effigy.name: Proxy Doll
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, a strong affliction on you is passed into a small effigy that stands beside you until the affliction runs out.
Enemies can destroy the effigy, which returns the affliction to you.
This is a curse and binding effect.
effigy.tag: This is a curse and binding effect.

elemental.name: Elemental Accord
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Fire, frost, lightning and stone buffs you give or receive are stronger still.
Afflictions of those elements are resisted further, but only the element that struck you most recently.
This is a fire, frost and lightning effect.
elemental.tag: This is a fire, frost and lightning effect.

elixir.name: Distilled Grace
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Restorative and healing-over-time buffs you give last longer.
When such a buff ends, it leaves a brief resistance to afflictions. This has a cooldown for each ally.
This is a healing and alchemy effect.
elixir.tag: This is a healing and alchemy effect.

empower.name: Amplifying Presence
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies near you receive buffs from any source at greater strength.
The amplifying holds only while they stay within a short distance of you.
This is a support and mastery effect.
empower.tag: This is a support and mastery effect.

eye.name: Seeing Ward
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You see the buffs on enemies, and your dispel strips their strongest buff first.
This works only on enemies you can see clearly.
This is a perception and revelation effect.
eye.tag: This is a perception and revelation effect.

feast.name: Shared Table
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each buff your dispel strips from an enemy feeds allies near you a small heal.
The heal shrinks for each buff stripped in quick succession.
This is a harvest and healing effect.
feast.tag: This is a harvest and healing effect.

feeble.name: Borrowed Boon
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you are weakened by an affliction, buffs you give burn brighter, as if your strength had gone into them.
This lasts only while the weakness lasts.
This is an affliction and support effect.
feeble.tag: This is an affliction and support effect.

fertile.name: Seedfall Blessing
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When a buff you gave expires, it drops a seed that sprouts a smaller buff of a random kind on its holder.
A seeded buff cannot seed again.
This is a growth and nature effect.
fertile.tag: This is a growth and nature effect.

fey.name: Changeling Swap
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Charm and illusion afflictions are resisted strongly.
Once per fight, you trade an affliction on an ally near you for a harmless glamour that fades in a short time.
This is a nature and transformation effect.
fey.tag: This is a nature and transformation effect.

fire.name: Purifying Flame
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction on you is burned away early by your resistance, it flares and scorches enemies close by.
The flare has a cooldown.
This is a fire and purification effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire and purification effect.

firebird.name: Ember Blessing
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give make the ally's attacks smoulder, burning enemies they strike.
When the buff ends, it flares into a small heal on its holder. The burn does not stack.
This is a fire and healing effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire and healing effect.

fish.name: Finned Slip
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Roots, grabs and snares slip off you more easily and end sooner.
When you slip such an affliction, you gain a brief burst of speed, once every so often.
This is a water and evasion effect.
fish.tag: This is a water and evasion effect.

flea.name: Leaping Hex
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
A minor affliction you resist hops onto an enemy near you instead.
Only minor afflictions can hop, and the hop has a cooldown.
This is an affliction and movement effect.
flea.tag: This is an affliction and movement effect.

flesh.name: Living Ward
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you are afflicted, your body knits itself, restoring a little health over time.
The knitting is slight and stops when the last affliction ends.
This is a restoration and healing effect.
flesh.tag: This is a restoration and healing effect.

foot.name: Sure-Footed Ward
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Movement buffs on you cannot be stripped by enemy dispels.
Slows and roots on you are shortened further, but only while you keep walking.
This is a movement and defensive effect.
foot.tag: This is a movement and defensive effect.

force.name: Forceful Dispel
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel shoves its target back a little and breaks any spell it was channelling.
The shove has a cooldown.
This is a momentum and annihilation effect.
force.tag: This is a momentum and annihilation effect.

forge.name: Forge-Tempered Boons
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give harden as they last: the longer a buff has held, the harder it is for enemies to dispel.
The tempering resets if the buff is refreshed.
This is a fire and protection effect.
forge.tag: This is a fire and protection effect.

fork.name: Forked Boon
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give fork, and a weaker branch lands on another ally near the target.
The branch lasts only a short time and cannot fork again.
This is a support and area effect.
fork.tag: This is a support and area effect.

fortress.name: Inner Keep
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you are below half health, afflictions are resisted strongly and buffs you receive last longer.
The keep holds only while your health stays low.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
fortress.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

fox.name: Cunning Cover
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Enemies cannot pick out your buffs; their dispels against you strike at random among everything you carry, afflictions included.
This cover slips for a short time after you are dispelled.
This is a stealth and evasion effect.
fox.tag: This is a stealth and evasion effect.

frog.name: Leaping Cleanse
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you dodge or leap, you shed a minor affliction.
Poison afflictions are resisted strongly. The shedding has a cooldown.
This is a movement and purification effect.
frog.tag: This is a movement and purification effect.

fungus.name: Spore Communion
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give release spores; allies standing near the buffed ally share a sliver of its resistance to afflictions.
The spores drift away after a short time.
This is a growth and support effect.
fungus.tag: This is a growth and support effect.

garuda.name: Serpent's Bane
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Poison and venom afflictions are resisted strongly by you.
Once per fight, a great gust from you tears poisons off every ally near you.
This is a wind and purification effect.
garuda.tag: This is a wind and purification effect.

gate.name: Gatekeeper's Pause
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
The first affliction to reach you in a short span is held at a gate for a moment, giving you a further chance to resist it.
The gate opens again only after a cooldown.
This is a warding and barrier effect.
gate.tag: This is a warding and barrier effect.

gathering.name: Gathered Grace
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each buff you give in a fight adds to a gathering store.
When the store fills, your next buff touches every ally near you. The store empties when spent.
This is a harvest and support effect.
gathering.tag: This is a harvest and support effect.

glass.name: Brittle Hex
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions on you turn brittle; when you are hit hard, an affliction on you may shatter.
Shattering has a cooldown and cannot break curses.
This is a defensive and purification effect.
glass.tag: This is a defensive and purification effect.

glimeron.name: Split Beam Ward
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction cast as a projectile, its light is split and scattered across enemies near its caster, dazzling them briefly.
The scatter has a cooldown.
This is a light and warding effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a light and warding effect.

goat.name: Stubborn Hoof
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction, you dig in and briefly resist every affliction of the same kind.
This stubbornness lasts only a short time and has a cooldown.
This is a defensive and warding effect.
goat.tag: This is a defensive and warding effect.

gorgon.name: Gorgon's Stiffening
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an enemy tries to afflict you and fails, it stiffens as if turning to stone, slowed for a moment.
Each enemy can be stiffened only once every so often.
This is a restraint and curse effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a restraint and curse effect.

griffin.name: Griffin's Watch
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give to allies below half health are stronger still.
While such an ally is near you, afflictions aimed at them are weakened. This guarding costs stamina.
This is a protection and support effect.
griffin.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

growth.name: Rising Boon
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give grow slowly stronger while their holder keeps fighting.
The growth stops at a cap that scales with rank, and ends if the holder leaves combat.
This is a growth and support effect.
growth.tag: This is a growth and support effect.

guardian.name: Warden's Oath
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
A portion of each affliction aimed at an ally near you is drawn to you instead, where your resistance meets it.
Each affliction drawn costs you stamina.
This is a protection and support effect.
guardian.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

hair.name: Bristling Sense
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Fine strands bristle when an affliction is cast at you from behind, and you resist it as if you saw it coming.
This works only once every so often.
This is a perception and warding effect.
hair.tag: This is a perception and warding effect.

hammer.name: Anvil Dispel
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When your dispel strips a buff, the blow leaves the enemy briefly dazed.
The daze has a cooldown and is shorter on stronger enemies.
This is a restraint and annihilation effect.
hammer.tag: This is a restraint and annihilation effect.

hand.name: Healing Hand Touch
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give to an ally standing beside you land stronger.
You can lift an affliction from an ally beside you by touch, once every so often.
This is a healing and support effect.
hand.tag: This is a healing and support effect.

harmonic.name: Tuned Blessing
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give are tuned to their holder; each time the holder resists an affliction, the buff hums and lasts slightly longer.
The extension is capped for each buff.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

harpy.name: Shrieking Rebuke
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction lands on you, you let out a shriek that shortens the buffs on enemies near you.
The shriek has a cooldown.
This is a sound and affliction effect.
harpy.tag: This is a sound and affliction effect.

harvest.name: Reaped Boons
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an enemy you have dispelled dies, you reap a sliver of each buff it held and pass it to allies near you.
Reaped buffs are weak and last only a short time.
This is a harvest and support effect.
harvest.tag: This is a harvest and support effect.

heidel.name: Steed's Blessing
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give to allies who are charging or running across the field last longer.
When an ally holding your buff is slowed, the slow is shortened. This works for each ally once every so often.
This is a movement and travel effect.
heidel.tag: This is a movement and travel effect.

hook.name: Hooked Dispel
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel can catch a distant enemy, stripping a buff and dragging it a little closer.
The drag has a cooldown and cannot move large enemies.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
hook.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

horse.name: Galloping Grace
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Haste buffs you give or receive last longer.
While you are moving at speed, slows on you are shortened further. This ends when you stop.
This is a movement and haste effect.
horse.tag: This is a movement and haste effect.

hunger.name: Ravenous Purge
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel devours the buffs it strips, restoring a little of your mana for each.
The restoration is capped for each dispel.
This is a harvest and annihilation effect.
hunger.tag: This is a harvest and annihilation effect.

hunt.name: Quarry's Brand
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
The enemy that most recently afflicted you is branded as quarry; buffs you give hit harder against it.
Only the latest quarry is branded, and the brand fades after a while.
This is a hunting and tracking effect.
hunt.tag: This is a hunting and tracking effect.

hydra.name: Regrowing Blessing
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an enemy dispels a buff you gave, the buff regrows on its holder a short time later at lesser strength.
Buffs can regrow only a limited number of times per fight.
This is a rebirth and support effect.
hydra.tag: This is a rebirth and support effect.

ice.name: Frozen Hex
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You can freeze an affliction on you in place, pausing it so it has no effect for a short time.
Freezing has a cooldown, and the affliction resumes when it thaws.
This is an ice and time effect.
ice.tag: This is an ice and time effect.

immortal.name: Undying Grace
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions that drain your health cannot bring you below a sliver of health while you hold a buff.
This protection breaks once per fight and then is gone until the next.
This is a protection and rebirth effect.
immortal.tag: This is a protection and rebirth effect.

iron.name: Iron Mind Ward
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Mental afflictions such as fear, charm and confusion are resisted strongly.
Each mental affliction resisted costs you a little stamina.
This is a defensive and warding effect.
iron.tag: This is a defensive and warding effect.

juggernaut.name: Juggernaut Advance
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you are moving toward an enemy, slows and roots fail to take hold on you.
The effect ends the moment you turn away or stop.
This is a momentum and defensive effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a momentum and defensive effect.

karmic.name: Karmic Return
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions you resist return a portion of their force to their caster.
Buffs you give return a faint sliver to you. Each return has a cooldown.
This is an affliction and support effect.
karmic.tag: This is an affliction and support effect.

knife.name: Precise Excision
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispels on allies always cut out the most harmful affliction first.
Each precise cut costs a little extra mana.
This is a purification and mastery effect.
knife.tag: This is a purification and mastery effect.

knowledge.name: Studied Defiance
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each enemy affliction you witness is studied; afflictions you have already seen this fight are resisted more strongly.
The study is forgotten when the fight ends.
This is a revelation and warding effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a revelation and warding effect.

kraken.name: Kraken's Hold
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When your dispel strips an enemy's buff, a tendril of water holds that enemy in place for a moment.
The hold has a cooldown and breaks early if the enemy is struck.
This is a water and restraint effect.
kraken.tag: This is a water and restraint effect.

leviathan.name: Abyssal Calm
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies across a wide area around you resist afflictions slightly better.
The calm weakens with distance and costs mana while it holds.
This is a water and area effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water and area effect.

life.name: Vital Grace
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Healing buffs you give also lift a minor affliction from their holder when they first land.
The lifting has a cooldown for each ally.
This is a healing and purification effect.
life.tag: This is a healing and purification effect.

light.name: Radiant Shelter
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Blinding and darkness afflictions are resisted strongly.
Buffs you give shed light that weakens darkness afflictions on their holder for a short time.
This is a light and radiant effect.
light.tag: This is a light and radiant effect.

lightning.name: Arc Blessing
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your buffs are cast quicker.
When you resist an affliction, a spark leaps back to its caster. The spark has a cooldown.
This is a lightning and haste effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and haste effect.

lizard.name: Sloughed Hex
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once every so often, you shed an affliction like old skin and gain brief regeneration.
Curses cannot be shed this way.
This is a restoration and transformation effect.
lizard.tag: This is a restoration and transformation effect.

locust.name: Locust Purge
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel releases a cloud of locusts that strips minor buffs from enemies near the target over a short time.
The cloud has a cooldown.
This is a swarm and area effect.
locust.tag: This is a swarm and area effect.

lotus.name: Lotus Withering Purge
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions of the same kind cannot stack on you; a repeat only refreshes what is there.
Once per fight, when you are carrying several afflictions, the weakest of them withers away.
This is a purification and healing effect.
lotus.tag: This is a purification and healing effect.

lurker.name: Unseen Readiness
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you are hidden or unseen, your resistance quietly builds.
The first affliction to strike you after you are revealed fails. The build-up is lost if you are revealed without being struck.
This is a stealth and warding effect.
lurker.tag: This is a stealth and warding effect.

magic.name: Arcane Saturation
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Magical buffs you give and receive are stronger still.
Your buffs cost slightly more mana.
This is a mastery and support effect.
magic.tag: This is a mastery and support effect.

malign.name: Malign Lash
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction is dispelled from you, it lashes back at its caster in a weakened form.
The lash has a cooldown.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

manatee.name: Sea-Cow Solace
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions on allies near you wane slightly faster.
This works only while you have not attacked for a short time.
This is a water and healing effect.
manatee.tag: This is a water and healing effect.

manticore.name: Manticore's Barb
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an enemy afflicts you, your next attack on it carries a venom that weakens its buffs.
The venom has a cooldown and does not stack.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
manticore.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

master.name: Master's Benediction
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give carry an extra minor benefit chosen to suit the ally's role: guard, striker or healer.
Only a few allies can carry this benefit at a time.
This is a mastery and support effect.
master.tag: This is a mastery and support effect.

might.name: Mighty Footing
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Strength buffs on you also grant resistance to being knocked down.
Each knockdown resisted costs stamina.
This is a momentum and defensive effect.
might.tag: This is a momentum and defensive effect.

ministration.name: Tender Care
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispels on allies also heal them a little for each affliction removed.
The healing is capped for each dispel.
This is a healing and purification effect.
ministration.tag: This is a healing and purification effect.

minotaur.name: Mazewise Calm
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Confusion and disorientation afflictions fail on you, and allies near you resist them more strongly.
Your own protection holds once every so often; the allies' share lasts only while they stay close.
This is a defensive and perception effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a defensive and perception effect.

mirage.name: Mirage Decoy
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction lands on you, you leave a mirage behind that draws the next affliction aimed at you.
The mirage fades after a short time or once it is struck.
This is an evasion and light effect.
mirage.tag: This is an evasion and light effect.
