This works only while you have not attacked for a short time.
This is a water and healing effect.
manatee.tag: This is a water and healing effect.

manticore.name: Manticore's Barb
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an enemy afflicts you, your next attack on it carries a venom that weakens its buffs.
The venom has a cooldown and does not stack.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
manticore.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

master.name: Master's Benediction
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give carry an extra minor benefit chosen to suit the ally's role: guard, striker or healer.
Only a few allies can carry this benefit at a time.
This is a mastery and support effect.
master.tag: This is a mastery and support effect.

might.name: Mighty Footing
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Strength buffs on you also grant resistance to being knocked down.
Each knockdown resisted costs stamina.
This is a momentum and defensive effect.
might.tag: This is a momentum and defensive effect.

ministration.name: Tender Care
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispels on allies also heal them a little for each affliction removed.
The healing is capped for each dispel.
This is a healing and purification effect.
ministration.tag: This is a healing and purification effect.

minotaur.name: Mazewise Calm
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Confusion and disorientation afflictions fail on you, and allies near you resist them more strongly.
Your own protection holds once every so often; the allies' share lasts only while they stay close.
This is a defensive and perception effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a defensive and perception effect.

mirage.name: Mirage Decoy
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction lands on you, you leave a mirage behind that draws the next affliction aimed at you.
The mirage fades after a short time or once it is struck.
This is an evasion and light effect.
mirage.tag: This is an evasion and light effect.

mirror.name: Mirrored Hex
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once every so often, an affliction aimed at you is reflected back at its caster.
Reflected afflictions are weaker and shorter.
This is a warding and resonance effect.
mirror.tag: This is a warding and resonance effect.

monkey.name: Mischief Swap
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, you swap an affliction on you for a buff on an enemy near you: it takes your affliction and you take its buff.
The stolen buff lasts only a short time.
This is a transmutation and binding effect.
monkey.tag: This is a transmutation and binding effect.

monolith.name: Monolith Calm
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you stand still, you become a standing stone; allies near you resist afflictions as steadily as you do.
The aura ends when you move and takes a moment to rise again.
This is a barrier and area effect.
monolith.tag: This is a barrier and area effect.

moon.name: Waning Hex
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Afflictions on you wane like the moon, weakening steadily toward their end.
Buffs you give in shadow or dim places last longer. Neither works against curses.
This is a light and shadow effect.
moon.tag: This is a light and shadow effect.

mouse.name: Small Target
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Area afflictions that catch you are weaker still, and you often slip out of them early.
Slipping out has a cooldown.
This is an evasion and area effect.
mouse.tag: This is an evasion and area effect.

myriad.name: Myriad Blessing
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each distinct buff you carry slightly strengthens all the others.
The strengthening is capped and counts only buffs from you or your allies.
This is a support and mastery effect.
myriad.tag: This is a support and mastery effect.

mystic.name: Mystic Sense
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You feel when any ally in the fight is afflicted, and your next dispel on that ally reaches farther.
The farther reach costs extra mana.
This is a perception and support effect.
mystic.tag: This is a perception and support effect.

nebula.name: Starcloud Spread
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Area afflictions that land near you are dispersed into a thin cloud, weaker on every ally caught in it.
The dispersal has a cooldown.
This is an area and warding effect.
nebula.tag: This is an area and warding effect.

needle.name: Pinpoint Dispel
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel pierces enemy shields and barriers to strip the buffs beneath.
Piercing has a cooldown.
This is an annihilation and purification effect.
needle.tag: This is an annihilation and purification effect.

nemesis.name: Nemesis Ward
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
The strongest enemy in a fight becomes your nemesis; its afflictions are resisted strongly by you and by allies near you.
Every other enemy's afflictions are met as usual.
This is a warding and hunting effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a warding and hunting effect.

net.name: Snaring Ward
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction, it leaves a net of threads that briefly slows enemies close by.
The net has a cooldown.
This is a restraint and binding effect.
net.tag: This is a restraint and binding effect.

network.name: Networked Resistance
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies holding your buffs are linked; when a linked ally resists an affliction, the others gain brief resistance to it.
The shared resistance has a cooldown.
This is a support and resonance effect.
network.tag: This is a support and resonance effect.

oasis.name: Oasis Refuge
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies resting near you recover from afflictions faster.
The refuge works only while they have not been hit for a short time.
This is a water and restoration effect.
oasis.tag: This is a water and restoration effect.

ocean.name: Tidal Cleanse
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Every so often a tide washes out from you, rinsing a minor affliction from each ally near you.
The tide costs mana and has a long cooldown.
This is a water and purification effect.
ocean.tag: This is a water and purification effect.

octopus.name: Many Arms
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel on an ally also reaches out to other allies near them, removing a minor affliction from each.
When heavily afflicted yourself, you release a cloud of ink that hides you from enemy afflictions briefly, once per fight.
This is a darkness and purification effect.
octopus.tag: This is a darkness and purification effect.

omen.name: Omen's Warning
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
You sense a strong affliction a moment before it is cast, warning allies near you, who resist it more strongly.
This works once per fight for each enemy.
This is a precognition and warding effect.
omen.tag: This is a precognition and warding effect.

onslaught.name: Relentless Blessing
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While allies keep attacking, your buffs on them are refreshed slightly with each hit.
The refreshing has a cap and stops if they pause.
This is a momentum and support effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a momentum and support effect.

pangolin.name: Pangolin Shrug
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When afflicted, you can curl up briefly and shrug the affliction off.
You cannot act while curled, and curling has a cooldown.
This is a defensive and shield effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a defensive and shield effect.

paper.name: Inscribed Slip
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each buff you give comes with a paper slip; an enemy dispel must burn the slip first and leaves the buff alone.
Each slip burns away after it is used.
This is a warding and protection effect.
paper.tag: This is a warding and protection effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Dream Haunting
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Enemies that afflict you are haunted by phantasms, weakening the next affliction they cast.
The haunting has a cooldown for each enemy.
This is an affliction and curse effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is an affliction and curse effect.

phoenix.name: Ashen Rising
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, when you would fall, every affliction on you burns away and you rise with a brief protective buff.
After rising you resist afflictions less for a short time.
This is a fire and rebirth effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a fire and rebirth effect.

plant.name: Taproot Boon
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give take root in the ground beneath their holder, leaving a patch that grants a faint version to anyone standing in it.
The patch withers after a short time.
This is a growth and area effect.
plant.tag: This is a growth and area effect.

potent.name: Potent Infusion
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give are deeper and more concentrated.
Each buff costs more mana, and you can hold your buffs on fewer allies at once.
This is a mastery and support effect.
potent.tag: This is a mastery and support effect.

predatory.name: Predator's Purge
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel strikes hardest on wounded enemies: stripping a buff from an enemy below half health strips another as well.
This has a cooldown.
This is a hunting and annihilation effect.
predatory.tag: This is a hunting and annihilation effect.

prison.name: Warden's Seal
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
An enemy you dispel cannot receive new buffs for a short time.
The seal has a cooldown and holds only the latest enemy dispelled.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
prison.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

prosperity.name: Prosperous Overflow
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you carry several buffs, a faint share of your surplus flows to the ally nearest you.
The share is weaker and stops when your buffs thin out.
This is a support and harvest effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a support and harvest effect.

pure.name: Pure Vessel
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Curses and corruption fail on you more often.
Your dispels always purge curses first, at extra mana cost.
This is a purification and holy effect.
pure.tag: This is a purification and holy effect.

rabbit.name: Bolting Start
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an affliction lands on you, you gain a quick burst of speed to get clear of its source.
The burst has a cooldown.
This is a haste and evasion effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a haste and evasion effect.

rake.name: Raking Purge
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel sweeps in a short arc in front of you, stripping a minor buff from each enemy it passes.
The sweep costs extra mana.
This is an area and purification effect.
rake.tag: This is an area and purification effect.

rat.name: Scavenger's Mend
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Disease afflictions are resisted strongly.
When any affliction runs out on you, you scavenge a small heal from its remains. This has a cooldown.
This is a salvage and healing effect.
rat.tag: This is a salvage and healing effect.

reagent.name: Catalytic Grace
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
An affliction that lands on you can be broken down and turned into a minor buff of a related kind.
This transmutation has a cooldown.
This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.
reagent.tag: This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.

resolute.name: Unbroken Resolve
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Resolute essence.

roc.tag: This is a protection and area effect.

rune.name: Runic Circle

rune.tag: This is a warding and binding effect.

When an ally near you is struck by a strong affliction, you take it onto yourself, where your resistance weakens it.

sacrifice.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

sand.name: Hourglass Ward
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Sand essence.

sand.tag: This is a time and movement effect.

sceptre.name: Sceptred Edict
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.

sceptre.tag: This is a command and purification effect.

scribe.name: Recorded Blessing
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.

scribe.tag: This is a support and mastery effect.

serene.name: Serene Mind
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
While you are not attacking, afflictions on you fade quickly.
The serenity breaks as soon as you strike, and settles again after a short time.
This is a healing and warding effect.
serene.tag: This is a healing and warding effect.

serpent.name: Coiling Dispel
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.

The coil has a cooldown.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
serpent.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

shark.name: Bloodscent Dispel
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Shark essence.

shark.tag: This is a hunting and annihilation effect.

shield.name: Bulwark Blessing
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Shield essence.

Shield and barrier buffs you give or receive are stronger and last longer.

This is a shield and barrier effect.
shield.tag: This is a shield and barrier effect.

shimmer.name: Shimmering Haze
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].

The shimmer lasts only a short time after each buff lands.
This is a light and evasion effect.
shimmer.tag: This is a light and evasion effect.

ship.name: Steady Hull
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When several allies near you are afflicted at once, the afflictions on all of them are shortened slightly.

shovel.name: Dig Out

shovel.tag: This is a salvage and purification effect.

sickle.name: Gleaning Dispel
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Sickle essence.

simulacrum.name: Hollow Echo

simulacrum.tag: This is a transformation and support effect.

sin.name: Sinner's Burden

skirmish.name: Skirmisher's Grace
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].

skirmish.tag: This is a movement and support effect.

skunk.name: Noxious Rebuke

When an affliction lands on you, you release a stench that weakens the buffs on enemies near you.

skunk.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

smoke.tag: This is a stealth and protection effect.

snake.name: Venom-Proof Scales
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Snake essence.

twilight.tag: This is a shadow and light effect.

venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Venom essence.

venom.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.

weave.name: Woven Wards
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give to an ally weave together with the ones they already hold, becoming harder for enemies to dispel.
The weave unravels if you leave the fight.
This is a binding and protection effect.
weave.tag: This is a binding and protection effect.

wendigo.name: Hungering Frost
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each buff your dispel strips from an enemy leaves it starving and chilled, slowed for a short time.
The chill has a cooldown.
This is a cold and hunting effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and hunting effect.

whale.name: Whale Song
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, a deep song rolls out from you, lengthening every buff on allies across a wide area.
The song takes a moment to sing, and you cannot attack while singing.
This is a sound and water effect.
whale.tag: This is a sound and water effect.

wheel.name: Wheelturn Haste
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Each time an affliction ends on you, your next buff is cast faster.
The momentum is lost if you do not use it soon.
This is a momentum and haste effect.
wheel.tag: This is a momentum and haste effect.

whip.name: Lashing Dispel
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Your dispel lashes out at a distant enemy, stripping a buff and stinging it.
The lash has a cooldown and does not reach across obstacles.
This is a restraint and annihilation effect.
whip.tag: This is a restraint and annihilation effect.

wind.name: Windswept Ward
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Clouds, gases and lingering area afflictions near you are blown thinner.
The wind holds only while you keep moving.
This is a wind and area effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and area effect.

wing.name: Wingspread Aegis
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When an ally beside you is targeted by an affliction, you can spread your wings over them and take the brunt yourself.
This has a cooldown and costs stamina.
This is a protection and support effect.
wing.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

wolf.name: Pack Bond
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Allies fighting the same enemy as you share a portion of your resistance.
The bond holds only while the pack is attacking the same target.
This is a hunting and support effect.
wolf.tag: This is a hunting and support effect.

wood.name: Grained Ward
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Buffs you give soak into their holder like oil into wood, lasting longer while they hold still.
The soaking ends when the holder moves.
This is a nature and protection effect.
wood.tag: This is a nature and protection effect.

wrath.name: Wrathful Resistance
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
When you resist an affliction, you gain a brief fury that sharpens your attacks.
The fury has a cooldown and does not stack.
This is a momentum and affliction effect.
wrath.tag: This is a momentum and affliction effect.

zeal.name: Zealous Devotion
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Fear and despair afflictions fail on you while you are fighting toward a sworn foe.
Buffs you give to allies attacking that same foe last longer. Only the latest foe can be sworn.
This is a holy and support effect.
zeal.tag: This is a holy and support effect.

ziz.name: Skyshadow Dread
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Magic Affinity]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Magic Affinity].
Once per fight, a vast shadow spreads from you, and enemies beneath it lose the strength of their buffs for a short time.
The shadow drains your mana while it holds.
This is a shadow and area effect.
ziz.tag: This is a shadow and area effect.

action.name: Quickening Sap
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder uses a nature ability straight after moving, the ability casts faster and its nature damage is slightly increased.
This can trigger once every few moments.
This is a nature and haste effect.
action.tag: This is a nature and haste effect.

adept.name: Rooted Discipline
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Each nature ability the holder lands during a fight adds a stacking bonus to its nature damage, up to a limit that scales with rank.
The stacks fade if the holder goes a short time without landing a nature ability.
This is a nature and mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a nature and mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Sapwright's Draught
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When an ally near the holder drinks a potion, the holder's affinity steeps into it and the drinker resists nature effects for a short time.
A healing potion drunk this way also draws out a portion of any poison on the drinker. Each ally can benefit only once every so often.
This is a nature and alchemy effect.
alchemy.tag: This is a nature and alchemy effect.

ambush.name: Thicket Strike
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
While the holder has not yet been noticed by an enemy, its opening nature attack against that enemy deals greatly increased nature damage and briefly roots it.
This can happen once per enemy each fight.
This is a nature, stealth and restraint effect.
ambush.tag: This is a nature, stealth and restraint effect.

animate.name: Wakened Bramble
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, when the holder lands a nature ability, a bramble guardian rises where it struck and fights for a short time, dealing nature damage that scales with the holder's affinity.
The guardian withers at once if the holder is knocked down.
This is a nature and animation effect.
animate.tag: This is a nature and animation effect.

anzu.name: Stormbloom Kin
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity reaches into the storm: it resists lightning effects, and its lightning abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
When the holder is struck by lightning, it stores a charge that makes its next nature or lightning ability arc to a nearby enemy. A charge can be stored only once every short while.
This is a lightning, storm and nature effect.
anzu.tag: This is a lightning, storm and nature effect.

ape.name: Canopy Strength
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's melee strikes carry a portion of its nature damage bonus.
While it fights near trees or heavy growth, its strikes briefly knock enemies back, at a small stamina cost per strike.
This is a nature and momentum effect.
ape.tag: This is a nature and momentum effect.

armour.name: Barkskin Mantle
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder takes a heavy hit, its skin hardens like bark, reducing damage it takes for a short time.
While the bark holds, nature effects on the holder end sooner. This can occur once every so often.
This is a nature and defensive effect.
armour.tag: This is a nature and defensive effect.

arsenal.name: Thornbound Arms
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Each time the holder alternates between a weapon attack and a nature ability, it gains a thorn charge, up to a limit that scales with rank.
At the limit, its next attack releases every charge as a burst of nature damage around the target. Charges fade after a short time.
This is a nature and mastery effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a nature and mastery effect.

aspect.name: Greenwood Aspect
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, when the holder falls below half health, it takes on the aspect of the forest for a short time: its nature resistance rises sharply and its nature abilities cost less mana.
When the aspect ends, the holder is briefly slowed.
This is a nature and transformation effect.
aspect.tag: This is a nature and transformation effect.

avatar.name: Wildwood Herald
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Allies near the holder share a portion of its nature resistance.

Once per fight, when the party is outnumbered, the holder becomes a herald of the wild for a short time and lends its nature damage bonus to the attacks of nearby allies, at a mana cost that scales with rank.
This is a nature, support and transformation effect.
avatar.tag: This is a nature, support and transformation effect.

axe.name: Heartwood Cleaver
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's wide swings spread a share of nature damage to every enemy they strike.
Enemies hit this way take increased nature damage from the holder for a short time. The mark cannot be reapplied to the same enemy until a cooldown passes.
This is a nature and area effect.
axe.tag: This is a nature and area effect.

balance.name: Equinox Poise
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder resists a nature effect, it gains a brief bonus to nature damage; when it deals nature damage, it gains brief extra nature resistance.
Neither bonus can trigger while the other is active.
This is a nature and mastery effect.
balance.tag: This is a nature and mastery effect.

bat.name: Duskleaf Echo
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder hears the rustle of growth around it: hidden enemies standing in grass, brush or nature clouds are revealed to the party for a short time.
Its next nature ability against a revealed enemy deals extra damage. This can trigger once every so often.
This is a nature, sound and detection effect.
bat.tag: This is a nature, sound and detection effect.

battlefield.name: Overgrown Field
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature abilities leave patches of growth on the ground for a short time. Allies in the growth resist nature effects; enemies in it are slowed.
Only a few patches can exist at once, and the oldest withers when another appears.
This is a nature, growth and area effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a nature, growth and area effect.

bear.name: Den Mother's Hide
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When an ally near the holder is struck by a nature or poison effect, the holder takes a portion of it instead and meets it with its own resistance.
It can shield each ally this way only once every short while.
This is a nature, protection and defensive effect.
bear.tag: This is a nature, protection and defensive effect.

bee.name: Pollen Burst
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature damage dusts enemies with pollen. When an ally strikes a dusted enemy, the pollen bursts and heals that ally slightly.
An enemy cannot be dusted again until a short time has passed.
This is a nature, healing and swarm effect.
bee.tag: This is a nature, healing and swarm effect.

behemoth.name: Ancient Bulk
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
While the holder's health is high, its nature resistance also protects it from knockback and stagger.
Its nature abilities strike a wider area but cast slightly slower.
This is a nature and area effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a nature and area effect.

bird.name: Windseed Song
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity leans toward the wind: its nature abilities carry on the breeze, reaching slightly further and pushing light enemies back.
Once per fight, when poison or spores gather around allies, a gust from the holder scatters them.
This is a nature, wind and purification effect.
bird.tag: This is a nature, wind and purification effect.

blight.name: Rotroot Affinity
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature damage leaves a lingering blight that reduces the healing its target receives.
The blight cannot stack and fades after a short time; its cost is a slight drain on the holder's mana while any blight is active.
This is a nature, poison and affliction effect.
blight.tag: This is a nature, poison and affliction effect.

blood.name: Sapblood Vein
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder resists bleeding as it resists nature effects.
Once per fight, when the holder is badly wounded, it spends a portion of its health to greatly empower its next nature ability.
This is a nature and affliction effect.
blood.tag: This is a nature and affliction effect.

bone.name: Ossified Root
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder is rooted, slowed or held, it shakes the effect off sooner and gains brief armour.
Its nature abilities can splinter into bone thorns that pierce armour, at an extra mana cost.
This is a nature and defensive effect.
bone.tag: This is a nature and defensive effect.

boundary.name: Living Hedgerow
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, when enemies close on a wounded ally, the holder raises a living hedge between them for a short time.
The hedge resists nature damage and harms enemies that break through it.
This is a nature, warding and barrier effect.
boundary.tag: This is a nature, warding and barrier effect.

bounty.name: Fruitful Fall
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder defeats an enemy with nature damage, the body sprouts a fruit that heals the nearest wounded ally.
Only a few fruits can exist at once, and they wither after a short time.
This is a nature, harvest and healing effect.
bounty.tag: This is a nature, harvest and healing effect.

bow.name: Thornshaft Volley
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's ranged attacks carry its nature damage bonus.
Shots that hit at long range sprout thorns that briefly slow the target. Each target can be slowed this way only once every short while.
This is a nature and hunting effect.
bow.tag: This is a nature and hunting effect.

brush.name: Verdant Stroke
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature abilities paint a trail of green along their path. Allies crossing the trail are cleansed of a minor poison.
Each trail fades after a short time, and only the newest trail remains.
This is a nature and purification effect.
brush.tag: This is a nature and purification effect.

cage.name: Briar Cage
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When an enemy strikes the holder in melee, roots can rise to cage it for a short time. Caged enemies take increased nature damage.
This can happen once every so often.
This is a nature, binding and restraint effect.
cage.tag: This is a nature, binding and restraint effect.

cat.name: Feline Greenstep
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder evades an attack, its next nature ability is quickened and deals slightly increased damage.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a nature and evasion effect.
cat.tag: This is a nature and evasion effect.

cataclysm.name: Wildfall Ruin
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, after the holder's nature abilities have struck many times, it tears up the ground around itself in a violent upheaval of roots, dealing heavy nature damage in an area.
The holder is drained of mana for a short time afterward.
This is a nature, area and annihilation effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is a nature, area and annihilation effect.

cattle.name: Pasture Endurance
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
While the holder stands its ground, its nature resistance builds over a short time, and allies sheltering behind it share a portion.
The built-up resistance is lost when the holder moves.
This is a nature and protection effect.
cattle.tag: This is a nature and protection effect.

chain.name: Vinelink Lash
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder's nature ability hits an enemy, a vine leaps to another enemy nearby and deals a portion of the damage again.
The vine can keep leaping while enemies stand close, losing strength with each leap. This can happen once every few moments.
This is a nature and binding effect.
chain.tag: This is a nature and binding effect.

chaotic.name: Wild Mutation
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Each nature ability the holder uses may bloom with a random extra effect: a brief root, a poison, a burst of spores or a minor heal for nearby allies.
The holder cannot choose the outcome, and the same extra effect cannot occur back to back.
This is a nature and transmutation effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a nature and transmutation effect.

charlatan.name: False Bloom
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, when the holder is targeted by a strong attack, it leaves behind a flowering decoy that draws enemy attention for a short time.
When the decoy is destroyed, it bursts and poisons the enemies around it.
This is a nature, stealth and poison effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a nature, stealth and poison effect.

chicken.name: Hearthyard Vigour
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder is struck by a nature effect, it scatters a little seed around itself that slowly heals allies standing nearby.
The seed lasts a short time and can scatter only once every so often.
This is a nature and healing effect.
chicken.tag: This is a nature and healing effect.

chimera.name: Grafted Kinship
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
At the start of each fight, the holder's affinity grafts onto whichever element it has met most recently, and it resists that element as it resists nature.
Its nature abilities carry a share of damage of that grafted element. The graft lasts for that fight only.
This is a nature and transformation effect.
chimera.tag: This is a nature and transformation effect.

claw.name: Thornclaw Rake
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's close strikes leave thorny wounds that deal nature damage over a short time.
Wounds on the same enemy do not stack; a fresh wound replaces the old.
This is a nature and affliction effect.
claw.tag: This is a nature and affliction effect.

cloth.name: Leafwoven Garb
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Living leaves weave through the holder's clothing, extending its nature resistance to a slight resistance against all elemental damage.
The leaves are stripped away for a short time whenever the holder takes heavy fire damage.
This is a nature and protection effect.
cloth.tag: This is a nature and protection effect.

cloud.name: Raincloud Canopy
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, when several allies are wounded, the holder calls a soft rain over the party that heals slightly over a short time and strengthens nature abilities used beneath it.
Enemies under the rain are not affected.
This is a nature, water and healing effect.
cloud.tag: This is a nature, water and healing effect.

cold.name: Frostbloom Affinity
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity turns toward the cold: it resists cold effects, and its cold abilities are strengthened as its nature abilities are.
Enemies struck by both its cold and nature damage within a short time are briefly frozen in place. Each enemy can be frozen this way once every so often.
This is a cold, frost and nature effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold, frost and nature effect.

coral.name: Reefgrowth Guard
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder is hit, hard coral growth spreads over the struck spot and reduces further damage there for a short time.
Enemies that strike the coral are scratched for minor nature damage. The growth can form once every short while.
This is a nature, growth and defensive effect.
coral.tag: This is a nature, growth and defensive effect.

corrupt.name: Tainted Grove
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature damage corrupts its targets, lowering their resistance to nature and poison for a short time.
Each time the holder corrupts an enemy, it suffers a slight loss of health.
This is a nature, poison and curse effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a nature, poison and curse effect.

crocodile.name: Riverbank Jaws
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When an enemy is rooted or slowed by the holder's nature abilities, the holder's next strike against it clamps down, dealing heavy nature damage and holding it a moment longer.
This can happen once per enemy every so often.
This is a nature, hunting and restraint effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a nature, hunting and restraint effect.

crystal.name: Geode Heart
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Nature damage the holder resists is stored in a crystal within it, up to a limit that scales with rank.
When the crystal is full, its next nature ability releases the stored power as a shower of crystal shards.
This is a nature and resonance effect.
crystal.tag: This is a nature and resonance effect.

cycle.name: Seasonwheel Turn
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Over the course of a fight, the holder's affinity turns through the seasons in order: spring adds healing to its nature abilities, summer adds damage, autumn adds poison, and winter adds slowing.
Each season lasts a short time and cannot be held or skipped.
This is a nature, time and growth effect.
cycle.tag: This is a nature, time and growth effect.

dance.name: Reedsway Step
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
While the holder keeps moving, it sways around incoming nature effects and has a chance to avoid them outright.
Each avoided effect strengthens its next nature ability slightly. The bonus is lost if the holder stops moving.
This is a nature, movement and evasion effect.
dance.tag: This is a nature, movement and evasion effect.

dark.name: Nightshade Affinity
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity grows toward shadow: it resists darkness effects, and its shadow abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
Its nature damage against enemies standing in darkness carries a lingering nightshade poison. The poison cannot stack.
This is a shadow, darkness and nature effect.
dark.tag: This is a shadow, darkness and nature effect.

dawn.name: Morningdew Gift
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
At the start of each fight, the holder and nearby allies are covered in dew that absorbs the opening nature or darkness effect to strike them.
Its nature abilities also deal a portion of radiant damage. The dew does not return until the next fight.
This is a light, radiant and nature effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light, radiant and nature effect.

death.name: Gravebloom Affinity
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When an enemy dies near the holder, flowers spring from the body and strengthen the holder's next nature ability.
Undead enemies take a portion of extra nature damage from the holder. The flowers wither after a short time.
This is a nature and death effect.
death.tag: This is a nature and death effect.

deep.name: Taproot Depths
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
While the holder stands still, roots reach deep beneath it and slowly restore its mana.
The roots also make it resistant to being moved. Moving tears the roots free, and they take a short time to regrow.
This is a nature and restoration effect.
deep.tag: This is a nature and restoration effect.

deer.name: Glade Runner
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder is struck by a nature effect, it bounds away a short distance and gains a brief burst of speed.
This can trigger once every so often, and it cannot trigger while the holder is rooted.
This is a nature, movement and evasion effect.
deer.tag: This is a nature, movement and evasion effect.

desolate.name: Barrenroot Endurance
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
In barren places with little growth, the holder draws on the memory of the wild, and its nature resistance and damage do not weaken.
Once per fight, it can scorch the ground around it barren, denying enemies any healing or growth there for a short time.
This is a nature and curse effect.
desolate.tag: This is a nature and curse effect.

dimension.name: Wayroot Passage
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder can step through growth it has created, vanishing into a patch of its own nature effect and emerging from another nearby.
This costs mana and can be done once every so often.
This is a nature and travel effect.
dimension.tag: This is a nature and travel effect.

discord.name: Jarring Bloom
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature damage sets enemies' nerves on edge, briefly making them more likely to strike at each other.
An enemy affected this way cannot be affected again for a short time.
This is a nature and curse effect.
discord.tag: This is a nature and curse effect.

discordant.name: Clashing Seasons
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder's nature ability strikes an enemy already suffering a different elemental effect, the clash deals bonus damage of both kinds.
The bonus can occur once per enemy every short while.
This is a nature and resonance effect.
discordant.tag: This is a nature and resonance effect.

dog.name: Pack Scent
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Enemies hit by the holder's nature damage carry its scent for a short time, and the party's attacks against them deal slightly increased damage.
Only a few enemies can carry the scent at once.
This is a nature, tracking and hunting effect.
dog.tag: This is a nature, tracking and hunting effect.

doom.name: Slow Witherfall
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature damage marks an enemy with slow decay. When the mark ends, the enemy takes a burst of nature damage based on the damage the holder dealt it meanwhile.
Only a few enemies can bear the mark at once, and each mark takes a short time to come due.
This is a nature, death and curse effect.
doom.tag: This is a nature, death and curse effect.

doppelganger.name: Thornwood Mimic
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, when the holder is surrounded, it grows a wooden copy of itself that repeats its nature abilities at reduced strength for a short time.
The copy has little health and burns easily.
This is a nature and conjuration effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a nature and conjuration effect.

dragon.name: Wyrmwood Breath
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder exhales a cone of caustic pollen and spores, dealing heavy nature damage to enemies before it.
Enemies caught in the cone are briefly frightened. The breath costs a large portion of the holder's mana.
This is a nature, poison and area effect.
dragon.tag: This is a nature, poison and area effect.

duck.name: Marshreed Calm
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Water and nature effects roll off the holder: it also resists water effects, and when it shrugs off a hostile effect it is cleansed of a minor ailment.
The cleansing can occur once every short while.
This is a nature and water effect.
duck.tag: This is a nature and water effect.

dust.name: Pollenhaze Veil
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder's health drops low, it releases a haze of pollen and dust around itself that hides it and nearby allies for a short time.
Enemies inside the haze have reduced accuracy. This can happen once per fight.
This is a nature, stealth and evasion effect.
dust.tag: This is a nature, stealth and evasion effect.

earth.name: Stonegrown Footing
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity sinks into the earth: it resists earth effects, and its earth abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
While it stands on soil or stone, it cannot be knocked down. Moving quickly breaks this footing for a short time.
This is a nature and defensive effect.
earth.tag: This is a nature and defensive effect.

echo.name: Rustling Return
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Shortly after the holder lands a nature ability, a faint echo of it strikes the same spot again for a portion of the damage.
The echo carries no extra effects and can occur once every few moments.
This is a nature and resonance effect.
echo.tag: This is a nature and resonance effect.

eclipse.name: Moonshade Bloom
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature abilities draw on both light and shadow: they deal a portion of radiant damage to enemies in darkness and a portion of shadow damage to enemies in light.
Switching between them takes a short time when the holder's surroundings change.
This is a light, shadow and nature effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a light, shadow and nature effect.

edifice.name: Rootwall Keep
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder grows a ring of thick root walls around itself and nearby allies, blocking attacks from outside for a short time.
The walls resist nature damage but can be cut down by heavy attacks.
This is a nature, barrier and protection effect.
edifice.tag: This is a nature, barrier and protection effect.

effigy.name: Strawman Ward
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder plants a woven effigy of grass and twigs that takes the next nature or poison effect aimed at a nearby ally.
The effigy lasts a short time, or until it absorbs an effect.
This is a nature and warding effect.
effigy.tag: This is a nature and warding effect.

elemental.name: Wildroot Convergence
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity spreads across the elements it wields: each of its elemental abilities gains a slight share of the bonus its nature abilities receive.
Its resistance to nature effects extends to a lesser resistance against other elements while it is above half mana.
This is a nature and mastery effect.
elemental.tag: This is a nature and mastery effect.

elixir.name: Sapling Tonic
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Healing the holder receives also cleanses a portion of any nature or poison effect on it.
Once per fight, when the holder is badly poisoned, its blood turns to green sap that heals it over a short time.
This is a nature, healing and purification effect.
elixir.tag: This is a nature, healing and purification effect.

empower.name: Kindling Grove
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When an ally near the holder uses an ability, the holder's affinity feeds it, adding a portion of nature damage to that ability.
Each ally can be empowered this way once every so often, and each empowerment costs the holder mana.
This is a nature and support effect.
empower.tag: This is a nature and support effect.

eye.name: Keen Greensight
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder sees the weak points where nature damage bites deepest, and its nature abilities have a chance to strike them for heavy damage.
After such a strike, the holder's sight takes a short time to refocus.
This is a nature and perception effect.
eye.tag: This is a nature and perception effect.

feast.name: Verdant Repast
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder's nature damage defeats an enemy, the holder draws in its remaining vitality and heals slightly.
Each meal grants a brief stacking bonus to nature damage, which fades after a short time.
This is a nature and harvest effect.
feast.tag: This is a nature and harvest effect.

feeble.name: Wilting Touch
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature damage saps strength from its targets, making them deal slightly less damage for a short time.
The effect cannot stack on the same enemy.
This is a nature and affliction effect.
feeble.tag: This is a nature and affliction effect.

fertile.name: Fallow Bloom
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Ground touched by the holder's nature abilities becomes fertile for a short time, and allies standing on it regain health and mana slightly faster.
Only a small patch of ground can be fertile at once.
This is a nature, growth and restoration effect.
fertile.tag: This is a nature, growth and restoration effect.

fey.name: Feywild Grace
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature abilities carry a touch of fey glamour, briefly confusing enemies they strike.
A confused enemy may wander or attack the wrong target. Each enemy can be confused this way once every so often.
This is a nature and curse effect.
fey.tag: This is a nature and curse effect.

fire.name: Emberroot Affinity
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity catches flame: it resists fire effects, and its fire abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
Enemies poisoned by the holder burst into flame when struck by its fire damage, ending the poison in a burst of burning damage. This can happen once per enemy every short while.
This is a fire, burn and nature effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire, burn and nature effect.

firebird.name: Ashbloom Rebirth
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, when the holder falls, it bursts into flame and is reborn from a sprouting seed with a portion of its health.
The flames burn nearby enemies, and the holder is weakened for a short time after rising.
This is a fire, rebirth and nature effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire, rebirth and nature effect.

fish.name: Streamscale Ease
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder resists water effects as it resists nature, and it moves freely through shallow water, marsh and mud.
While it stands in water, its nature abilities cost slightly less mana.
This is a nature, water and movement effect.
fish.tag: This is a nature, water and movement effect.

flea.name: Burrfleck Leap
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder is struck in melee, it springs a short distance away, leaving burrs on its attacker that slow it briefly.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a nature, movement and evasion effect.
flea.tag: This is a nature, movement and evasion effect.

flesh.name: Greenflesh Mending
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's wounds close with green fibres: while it is in combat, it slowly regenerates health, faster while standing among growth.
Regeneration pauses for a short time whenever the holder takes fire damage.
This is a nature and healing effect.
flesh.tag: This is a nature and healing effect.

foot.name: Mossfoot Tread
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Rough ground, brambles, mud and growth do not slow the holder.
Each step it takes through such ground slightly speeds its next nature ability. The bonus is used up when the ability is cast.
This is a nature and movement effect.
foot.tag: This is a nature and movement effect.

force.name: Rootforce Surge
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature abilities drive enemies back with surging roots and knock down light foes.
Knockdowns can occur on each enemy once every so often, at a slight extra stamina cost.
This is a nature and momentum effect.
force.tag: This is a nature and momentum effect.

forge.name: Charwood Temper
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity is tempered by heat: when it takes fire damage, a portion is converted into a brief bonus to nature damage.
It also resists fire effects slightly. The bonus cannot be refreshed until it fades.
This is a fire and nature effect.
forge.tag: This is a fire and nature effect.

fork.name: Branching Strike
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's targeted nature abilities can branch, striking another enemy nearby for a portion of the damage.
Branching costs extra mana and can occur once every few moments.
This is a nature and area effect.
fork.tag: This is a nature and area effect.

fortress.name: Ironbark Bastion
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
While the holder holds position near allies, ironbark armour grows over it, reducing damage it takes and pulling enemy attention toward it.
The armour falls away if the holder moves far, and regrows over a short time.
This is a nature, protection and defensive effect.
fortress.tag: This is a nature, protection and defensive effect.

fox.name: Foxglove Feint
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder evades an attack, it leaves a cloud of foxglove pollen that poisons the attacker.
The cloud can appear once every short while.
This is a nature, poison and evasion effect.
fox.tag: This is a nature, poison and evasion effect.

frog.name: Bogsong Affinity
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's skin secretes a mild toxin: enemies that strike it in melee are poisoned briefly.
While it stands in marsh or shallow water, its nature resistance is greater. The toxin cannot stack on the same enemy.
This is a nature, poison and water effect.
frog.tag: This is a nature, poison and water effect.

fungus.name: Mycelial Bond
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature damage seeds spores in its targets. When a seeded enemy dies, spores burst out and poison enemies nearby.
Only a few enemies can be seeded at once.
This is a nature, poison and growth effect.
fungus.tag: This is a nature, poison and growth effect.

garuda.name: Serpentbane Talon
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature damage is greater against serpents, reptiles and venomous creatures.
Once per fight, when an ally is poisoned, the holder's cry burns the venom away from allies around it.
This is a nature, hunting and purification effect.
garuda.tag: This is a nature, hunting and purification effect.

gate.name: Thornbriar Gate
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder raises a living archway of thorns. Allies who pass through it gain brief nature resistance; enemies who pass through it are scratched and slowed.
The archway lasts a short time.
This is a nature, warding and conjuration effect.
gate.tag: This is a nature, warding and conjuration effect.

gathering.name: Seedgatherer's Store
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Each nature effect the holder resists adds a seed to its store, up to a limit that scales with rank.
When an ally nearby is badly wounded, the holder spends its stored seeds to heal that ally. Spent seeds take a while to gather again.
This is a nature, harvest and healing effect.
gathering.tag: This is a nature, harvest and healing effect.

glass.name: Dewglass Lens
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
In sunlight, the holder focuses light through a lens of dew, and its nature abilities deal a portion of extra radiant damage.
The lens shatters when the holder takes a heavy hit and reforms after a short time.
This is a light and nature effect.
glass.tag: This is a light and nature effect.

glimeron.name: Glimmerleaf Shroud
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Leaves around the holder shimmer and shift, and enemies attacking it from a distance sometimes strike a glimmering afterimage instead.
The afterimage can form once every short while and is spent by the attack it takes.
This is a nature and evasion effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a nature and evasion effect.

goat.name: Crag Grazer
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder resists poisons from things it has eaten or breathed, and it cannot be slowed by steep or rocky ground.
When it charges an enemy, its butt carries nature damage and a brief stagger, at a stamina cost.
This is a nature and momentum effect.
goat.tag: This is a nature and momentum effect.

gorgon.name: Stonevine Gaze
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder's gaze turns an enemy's limbs to wood for a short time, rooting it in place and lowering its defences against nature damage.
Powerful foes resist and are only slowed.
This is a nature, transformation and restraint effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a nature, transformation and restraint effect.

griffin.name: Talonbriar Pounce
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When an enemy targets a wounded ally, the holder leaps on it with a pouncing strike that deals nature damage and roots it briefly.
The pounce costs stamina and can be used once every so often.
This is a nature, protection and restraint effect.
griffin.tag: This is a nature, protection and restraint effect.

growth.name: Wildgrowth Flourish
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Each nature ability the holder uses makes the next slightly larger in area, building over the fight up to a limit that scales with rank.
The growth resets if the holder is stunned or knocked down.
This is a nature and growth effect.
growth.tag: This is a nature and growth effect.

guardian.name: Elderwood Sentinel
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder watches over the most wounded ally nearby, and that ally shares its nature resistance.
Once per fight, when that ally would be struck by a heavy nature or poison effect, the holder takes the effect in their place.
This is a nature, protection and support effect.
guardian.tag: This is a nature, protection and support effect.

hair.name: Willowtress Snare
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's hair grows long and fibrous, and enemies that strike it in melee can be briefly tangled.
Tangled enemies take slightly increased nature damage. This can occur once every short while.
This is a nature and binding effect.
hair.tag: This is a nature and binding effect.

hammer.name: Stumpcrusher Blow
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's heavy strikes drive roots up from the ground around the target, dealing nature damage to enemies nearby.
This costs stamina and can happen once every few moments.
This is a nature and area effect.
hammer.tag: This is a nature and area effect.

hand.name: Greenhand Touch
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder stands next to a wounded ally, its touch coaxes their wounds to close, healing them slowly.
The holder can tend only a few allies at once, and each touch costs mana.
This is a nature and healing effect.
hand.tag: This is a nature and healing effect.

harmonic.name: Windchime Grove
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder and an ally hit the same enemy in quick succession, the blows resonate and deal a portion of extra nature damage.
The resonance can occur on each enemy once every short while.
This is a nature, sound and resonance effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a nature, sound and resonance effect.

harpy.name: Thistlewind Shriek
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, when enemies crowd the holder, it lets out a shriek that scatters thistle barbs around it, dealing nature damage and briefly frightening nearby enemies.
The shriek costs a portion of the holder's stamina.
This is a nature, wind and sound effect.
harpy.tag: This is a nature, wind and sound effect.

harvest.name: Reaper's Bounty
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Enemies hit repeatedly by the holder's nature damage ripen. When the holder strikes a ripe enemy, it harvests a burst of bonus damage and restores a little of its own mana.
An enemy takes a short time to ripen again after being harvested.
This is a nature, harvest and harvesting effect.
harvest.tag: This is a nature, harvest and harvesting effect.

heidel.name: Steadfast Steed
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder gains the endurance of a hardy beast of burden: nature effects that slow or drain stamina affect it only lightly.
After it runs for a while, its next nature ability lands with a trampling charge that knocks light enemies aside. The charge takes a short time to build again.
This is a nature, travel and momentum effect.
heidel.tag: This is a nature, travel and momentum effect.

hook.name: Hooked Bramble
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once every so often, the holder lashes a hooked bramble at a distant enemy and drags it closer, dealing nature damage.
Enemies dragged this way are briefly slowed. Large foes are not moved but are still slowed.
This is a nature, binding and restraint effect.
hook.tag: This is a nature, binding and restraint effect.

horse.name: Meadow Gallop
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
While the holder runs across open grass or growth, it gains speed and stamina regenerates slightly faster.
The first nature ability it uses after a sprint strikes harder. This bonus can be gained once every short while.
This is a nature, haste and movement effect.
horse.tag: This is a nature, haste and movement effect.

hunger.name: Ravenous Root
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature damage over time feeds it, restoring a small portion of health for each tick it deals.
While the holder's health is full, the roots grow restless and its nature damage is slightly reduced.
This is a nature and harvest effect.
hunger.tag: This is a nature and harvest effect.

hunt.name: Woodland Quarry
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
At the start of each fight, the holder marks the strongest enemy as its quarry. Its nature damage against the quarry is increased, and the quarry's resistance to nature is lowered.
If the quarry dies, the holder cannot mark another until the next fight.
This is a nature, hunting and tracking effect.
hunt.tag: This is a nature, hunting and tracking effect.

hydra.name: Manyheaded Thicket
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When something destroys a plant or growth the holder has summoned, it splits and regrows as smaller shoots that keep fighting for a short time.
Shoots that are destroyed do not split again, and fire stops the regrowth entirely.
This is a nature, growth and summoning effect.
hydra.tag: This is a nature, growth and summoning effect.

ice.name: Hoarfrost Affinity
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity turns to ice: it resists ice effects, and its ice abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
Its ice abilities leave frozen thorns in the ground that slow enemies crossing them. Only a few patches of thorns can exist at once.
This is a frost, ice and nature effect.
ice.tag: This is a frost, ice and nature effect.

immortal.name: Evergreen Vigil
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, when a hit would knock the holder down, it endures like an ancient tree and remains standing with a sliver of health.
For a short time afterward, it heals slowly and resists all nature effects completely. It is weakened when this ends.
This is a nature, rebirth and protection effect.
immortal.tag: This is a nature, rebirth and protection effect.

iron.name: Ironwood Hide
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature resistance extends to slight resistance against physical damage.
When it is struck by a heavy blow, its skin briefly hardens to ironwood and turns the next blow aside. This can happen once every so often.
This is a nature, defensive and protection effect.
iron.tag: This is a nature, defensive and protection effect.

juggernaut.name: Uprooting Charge
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder charges, roots tear up in its wake, and enemies it passes through take nature damage and are knocked aside.
Nature effects cannot stop or slow the holder during the charge. The charge costs stamina and has a cooldown.
This is a nature, momentum and movement effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a nature, momentum and movement effect.

karmic.name: Fruit of Deeds
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When an enemy afflicts the holder or an ally with a nature effect, part of it is returned to that enemy.
When the holder heals an ally, its next nature ability is slightly strengthened. Each return can happen once every short while.
This is a nature and curse effect.
karmic.tag: This is a nature and curse effect.

knife.name: Thornedge Blade
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's quick strikes leave thorns in the wound that deal a little nature damage over a short time.
Strikes against enemies already suffering a nature effect find gaps in their armour. The thorns cannot stack on the same enemy.
