This is a nature and affliction effect.
knife.tag: This is a nature and affliction effect.

knowledge.name: Druidic Lore
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder learns the natures of the creatures it fights: each time it faces a kind of enemy it has fought before, its nature damage against that kind is slightly increased.
Its knowledge also reveals which enemies are weak or resistant to nature to the party. The bonus builds slowly and scales with rank.
This is a nature, revelation and mastery effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a nature, revelation and mastery effect.

kraken.name: Strangling Kelp
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder calls thick tendrils of kelp and vine from the ground that seize several enemies around it, rooting them for a short time.
Seized enemies take nature damage while held. The holder cannot move while the tendrils are active.
This is a nature, binding and restraint effect.
kraken.tag: This is a nature, binding and restraint effect.

leviathan.name: Abyssal Tide
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity reaches toward the tide: it resists water effects, and its water abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
Once per fight, it sends a great wave of water and weed rolling forward, knocking enemies down and leaving them slowed for a short time.
This is a water, nature and area effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water, nature and area effect.

life.name: Lifebloom Wellspring
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's healing abilities are strengthened as its nature abilities are, and healing it gives also grants a brief resistance to nature effects.
When it heals an ally who is below half health, a flower blooms at their feet and heals them slightly more over a short time.
This is a nature, healing and restoration effect.
life.tag: This is a nature, healing and restoration effect.

light.name: Sunleaf Affinity
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity turns toward light: it resists light effects, and its light abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
Allies near it in bright places resist darkness effects slightly. The holder's light abilities cost slightly more mana while it stands in darkness.
This is a light, radiant and nature effect.
light.tag: This is a light, radiant and nature effect.

lightning.name: Thunderroot Affinity
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity grounds lightning: it resists lightning effects, and its lightning abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
When it strikes an enemy rooted by nature, its lightning damage courses through the roots to nearby enemies. This can happen once every few moments.
This is a lightning, storm and nature effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning, storm and nature effect.

lizard.name: Scaleshed Renewal
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder is badly poisoned or afflicted, it sheds its skin and is cleansed of nature effects.
Its shed skin lies on the ground for a short time and draws enemy attacks. This can happen once per fight.
This is a nature, purification and restoration effect.
lizard.tag: This is a nature, purification and restoration effect.

locust.name: Blightswarm Plague
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder's nature damage defeats an enemy, a small swarm of locusts bursts from the body and chews at nearby enemies.
The swarm lasts a short time, and only a few swarms can exist at once.
This is a nature, swarm and affliction effect.
locust.tag: This is a nature, swarm and affliction effect.

lotus.name: Opening Lotus Bed
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder stands still and uses no abilities for a moment, a lotus opens beneath it, cleansing it of nature effects and restoring mana.
The lotus closes when the holder acts and takes a short time to open again.
This is a nature, purification and restoration effect.
lotus.tag: This is a nature, purification and restoration effect.

lurker.name: Undergrowth Lurker
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
While the holder stands in heavy growth, it is harder for enemies to see.
Once per fight, the growth itself lunges from beneath an enemy near the holder, dealing heavy nature damage and dragging it down to root it briefly.
This is a nature, stealth and restraint effect.
lurker.tag: This is a nature, stealth and restraint effect.

magic.name: Wildweave Arcana
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature spells cost slightly less mana and gain a portion of arcane damage.
When it resists a hostile spell's nature effect, its next spell is quickened. This can happen once every short while.
This is a nature and mastery effect.
magic.tag: This is a nature and mastery effect.

malign.name: Baneful Thorn
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature damage carries a malign curse that makes its target take slightly more damage from all sources for a short time.
The holder suffers slight health loss each time it applies the curse. It cannot stack on the same enemy.
This is a nature, curse and affliction effect.
malign.tag: This is a nature, curse and affliction effect.

manatee.name: Seagrass Grazer
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's gentle presence soothes allies near it, slightly slowing the spread of nature and poison effects on them.
While the holder is out of combat, it heals allies near it slowly. In combat this heal is weaker and costs mana.
This is a nature, healing and support effect.
manatee.tag: This is a nature, healing and support effect.

manticore.name: Stingtail Thorn
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once every so often, the holder flings a volley of poisoned thorns at an enemy, dealing nature damage and leaving a strong poison.
Poisoned enemies that strike the holder take a portion of the damage back as thorns. The volley costs stamina.
This is a nature, poison and hunting effect.
manticore.tag: This is a nature, poison and hunting effect.

master.name: Grovewarden Command
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Plants, beasts and growth the holder summons or controls share its nature affinity, resisting nature effects and dealing increased nature damage.
Summoned creatures obey it more swiftly. Keeping them empowered costs a little mana over time.
This is a nature, command and summoning effect.
master.tag: This is a nature, command and summoning effect.

might.name: Oakstrength Might
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's heavy attacks carry its nature damage bonus and knock enemies back.
When it is struck by a nature effect, its next heavy attack gains extra force. The bonus can be gained once every short while.
This is a nature and momentum effect.
might.tag: This is a nature and momentum effect.

ministration.name: Wardgarden Tending
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's healing abilities also cleanse nature and poison effects from the allies they touch.
Each cleanse costs a little extra mana and can be applied to each ally once every short while.
This is a nature, healing and purification effect.
ministration.tag: This is a nature, healing and purification effect.

minotaur.name: Hedgemaze Bull
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder raises a ring of tall hedges around a group of enemies, trapping them for a short time while the party fights them from the gaps.
The holder can charge through its own hedges, knocking down enemies it hits.
This is a nature, barrier and restraint effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a nature, barrier and restraint effect.

mirage.name: Heatshimmer Grove
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, when the holder is targeted by a ranged attack, it vanishes into a shimmering illusion of a tree, and the attack strikes the illusion instead.
The holder reappears a short distance away with its next nature ability quickened.
This is a nature, stealth and evasion effect.
mirage.tag: This is a nature, stealth and evasion effect.

mirror.name: Mirrorleaf Reflection
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder resists a nature effect, a portion of it can be reflected back at its source.
Reflection can happen once every short while and does not work against nature effects from the holder's allies.
This is a nature and warding effect.
mirror.tag: This is a nature and warding effect.

monkey.name: Vineswing Scramble
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder is surrounded, it can swing away on a vine, landing a short distance off and leaving a tangle of creepers that slows enemies behind it.
This costs stamina and can happen once every so often.
This is a nature, movement and evasion effect.
monkey.tag: This is a nature, movement and evasion effect.

monolith.name: Standing Stone Grove
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder raises a moss-covered standing stone. Allies near it resist nature effects strongly, and enemies near it have their nature abilities weakened.
The stone lasts a short time, and the holder cannot move far from it without the effect ending.
This is a nature, warding and area effect.
monolith.tag: This is a nature, warding and area effect.

moon.name: Moonpetal Affinity
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
At night or in darkness, the holder's nature abilities glow with pale moonlight and slowly heal allies they pass near.
In bright daylight, the healing fades. Each ally can be healed this way once every short while.
This is a nature, light and healing effect.
moon.tag: This is a nature, light and healing effect.

mouse.name: Fieldmouse Scurry
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
While the holder moves through grass or undergrowth, enemies have trouble keeping track of it, and their attacks against it miss slightly more often.
This effect ends for a short time whenever the holder is hit.
This is a nature, stealth and evasion effect.
mouse.tag: This is a nature, stealth and evasion effect.

myriad.name: Myriad Seedfall
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature abilities scatter seeds that sprout into many tiny thorny shoots, each dealing minor nature damage to enemies nearby.
The shoots wither after a short time, and only a few clusters can exist at once.
This is a nature, swarm and growth effect.
myriad.tag: This is a nature, swarm and growth effect.

mystic.name: Druid's Insight
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder senses the flow of nature magic around it, and its nature abilities pierce a portion of enemy magical resistance.
Once per fight, when an enemy begins a powerful nature spell, the holder warns the party and gains brief resistance against it.
This is a nature, precognition and mastery effect.
mystic.tag: This is a nature, precognition and mastery effect.

nebula.name: Stardust Pollen
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder releases a drifting cloud of glittering pollen when it is badly hurt, hiding itself and nearby allies from ranged attacks while they stand within.
The cloud lasts a short time and can form once per fight.
This is a nature, stealth and protection effect.
nebula.tag: This is a nature, stealth and protection effect.

needle.name: Pine Needle Volley
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's ranged nature abilities fire a spray of needles that pierce through the first enemy and strike those behind it for a portion of the damage.
Needles cannot pierce shields or barriers, and the spray costs extra mana.
This is a nature and hunting effect.
needle.tag: This is a nature and hunting effect.

nemesis.name: Grudgethorn Oath
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When an enemy lands a heavy hit on an ally, the holder marks it as its nemesis for a short time, and its nature damage against that enemy is increased.
A fresh mark replaces any earlier nemesis.
This is a nature, hunting and curse effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a nature, hunting and curse effect.

net.name: Creeper Snare
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once every so often, the holder casts a net of creeping vines over an area, slowing enemies inside and making them easier to hit.
Enemies who stay inside too long are rooted briefly. The net withers after a short time.
This is a nature, binding and restraint effect.
net.tag: This is a nature, binding and restraint effect.

network.name: Rootweb Network
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder links nearby allies through a web of roots beneath the ground. When a linked ally is struck by a nature effect, the strain is shared among all linked allies.
The roots also carry a slight portion of the holder's healing to linked allies. The link breaks if allies stray far apart.
This is a nature, support and protection effect.
network.tag: This is a nature, support and protection effect.

oasis.name: Palmring Spring
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, when the party is worn down, the holder raises a small spring ringed by palms that heals allies standing near it and cleanses them of heat and nature effects.
The spring dries up after a short time.
This is a nature, water and healing effect.
oasis.tag: This is a nature, water and healing effect.

ocean.name: Tidewrack Surge
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity embraces the sea: it resists water effects, and its water abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
Its water abilities leave tangles of wrack that slow enemies. Only a few tangles can exist at once.
This is a water, nature and restraint effect.
ocean.tag: This is a water, nature and restraint effect.

octopus.name: Grasping Ivy
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When an enemy comes close to the holder, ivy tendrils reach out to grab and slow it.
The tendrils can hold several enemies at once but each grab lasts only a short time and costs a little mana.
This is a nature and binding effect.
octopus.tag: This is a nature and binding effect.

omen.name: Withering Portent
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder senses when a nature or poison attack is about to strike, and gains a brief resistance to it the moment before it lands.
This warning can occur once every short while.
This is a nature and precognition effect.
omen.tag: This is a nature and precognition effect.

onslaught.name: Rampant Overgrowth
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Each nature ability the holder uses in quick succession costs slightly less mana than the last.
The chain breaks if the holder pauses, and it is left briefly winded when the chain ends.
This is a nature and momentum effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a nature and momentum effect.

pangolin.name: Pinecone Curl
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder's health drops low, it curls behind overlapping bark scales for a short time, taking greatly reduced damage.
While curled, it cannot attack. This can happen once per fight.
This is a nature, defensive and protection effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a nature, defensive and protection effect.

paper.name: Pressed Leaf Charm
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
At the start of each fight, the holder folds a pressed leaf charm for a nearby ally. The charm absorbs the opening nature effect aimed at that ally.
A fresh charm is folded only at the start of the next fight.
This is a nature and warding effect.
paper.tag: This is a nature and warding effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Fever Garden
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder fills the air with hallucinogenic spores, and nearby enemies see a nightmare of grasping plants and attack random targets for a short time.
Enemies of higher rank resist. The spores cost a large portion of the holder's mana.
This is a nature, poison and curse effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is a nature, poison and curse effect.

phoenix.name: Phoenixroot Rising
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity is touched by fire: it resists fire effects, and its fire abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
Once per fight, when an ally near the holder falls, a burst of flame and seed raises them with a portion of their health. The holder is weakened for a short time afterward.
This is a fire, rebirth and nature effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a fire, rebirth and nature effect.

plant.name: Gardener's Bond
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Plants the holder summons or grows last a little longer and deal increased nature damage.
When a plant it summoned is destroyed, the holder regains a small portion of the mana it cost. This can happen once every short while.
This is a nature, growth and summoning effect.
plant.tag: This is a nature, growth and summoning effect.

potent.name: Concentrated Sap
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature effects over time are stronger but shorter, dealing the same damage in less time.
Its nature abilities cost slightly more mana while this is active.
This is a nature and potency effect.
potent.tag: This is a nature and potency effect.

predatory.name: Hunting Bloom
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder deals increased nature damage to enemies that are wounded, slowed or alone.
When it defeats such an enemy, its next nature ability is quickened. This can happen once every short while.
This is a nature and hunting effect.
predatory.tag: This is a nature and hunting effect.

prison.name: Thornbound Prison
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder seals an enemy within a cage of thorns for a short time. The enemy cannot act, and takes nature damage while it is held.
Allies cannot damage the trapped enemy until it is released.
This is a nature, binding and restraint effect.
prison.tag: This is a nature, binding and restraint effect.

prosperity.name: Plentiful Aftermath
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
After each fight in which the holder dealt nature damage, it and nearby allies recover health and mana slightly faster for a short time.
This bonus does not stack across fights.
This is a nature, restoration and harvest effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a nature, restoration and harvest effect.

pure.name: Purewater Root
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder resists curses and corruption as it resists nature effects.
When it is afflicted, it can purge the effect and gain a brief burst of nature damage. This can happen once every so often.
This is a nature and purification effect.
pure.tag: This is a nature and purification effect.

rabbit.name: Burrow Spring
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder is hit by a nature effect, it springs away in a quick hop and briefly gains speed.
This can trigger once every short while and costs a little stamina.
This is a nature, movement and haste effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a nature, movement and haste effect.

rake.name: Furrowing Tines
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's sweeping strikes leave furrows in the ground that sprout grasping weeds, slowing enemies who step in them.
The furrows fade after a short time, and only a few can exist at once.
This is a nature, growth and restraint effect.
rake.tag: This is a nature, growth and restraint effect.

rat.name: Plaguewhisker Cunning
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder shrugs off disease as it shrugs off nature effects.
Enemies it poisons spread a portion of that poison to nearby enemies after a short time. The spread can happen once per poison.
This is a nature, poison and affliction effect.
rat.tag: This is a nature, poison and affliction effect.

reagent.name: Herbal Catalyst
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When an ally drinks a potion near the holder, the holder's nature abilities are briefly strengthened.
When the holder drinks a potion, its effect also spreads to the nearest ally at reduced strength. Each potion can spread only once.
This is a nature, alchemy and support effect.
reagent.tag: This is a nature, alchemy and support effect.

refracting.name: Prismleaf Spectrum
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When a hostile spell strikes the holder, part of its energy is caught in the holder's leaves and split into a spray of green light that strikes several nearby enemies.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a nature, light and resonance effect.
refracting.tag: This is a nature, light and resonance effect.

renewal.name: Springtide Renewal
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When a nature effect on the holder ends, it recovers a small portion of health.
Once per fight, when it falls below half health, new growth covers it and it regenerates over a short time.
This is a nature, restoration and healing effect.
renewal.tag: This is a nature, restoration and healing effect.

resolute.name: Deeproot Resolve
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder cannot be feared, charmed or confused by nature effects while its health is above half.
When it is below half health, it instead gains a brief burst of resistance each time it is struck. This burst has a cooldown.
This is a nature and defensive effect.
resolute.tag: This is a nature and defensive effect.

resonating.name: Humming Grove
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder uses a nature ability, nearby plants hum in resonance and deal a portion of the damage again to enemies near them.
The resonance can occur once every few moments.
This is a nature, sound and resonance effect.
resonating.tag: This is a nature, sound and resonance effect.

roc.name: Treetop Roc
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder lets out a mighty cry that shakes leaves, branches and debris down from above onto enemies in an area, dealing nature damage and briefly stunning them.
The cry costs a large portion of stamina.
This is a nature, sound and area effect.
roc.tag: This is a nature, sound and area effect.

rune.name: Rootrune Inscription
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature abilities leave a glowing rune in the ground where they land. Enemies who step on the rune are rooted briefly.
Only a few runes can exist at once, and each fades after a short time.
This is a nature, warding and restraint effect.
rune.tag: This is a nature, warding and restraint effect.

sacrifice.name: Wilting Offering
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, when an ally near the holder is close to falling, the holder gives up a large portion of its own health to cover that ally in healing growth.
The holder's nature resistance is lowered for a short time afterward.
This is a nature, healing and protection effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a nature, healing and protection effect.

sand.name: Duneroot Affinity
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity reaches into dry places: it resists earth and sand effects, and its earth abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
Its nature abilities kick up stinging sand that briefly blinds enemies. Each enemy can be blinded this way once every short while.
This is a nature and earth effect.
sand.tag: This is a nature and earth effect.

sceptre.name: Bloomrod Authority
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Allies near the holder resist nature effects slightly and deal slightly increased nature damage.
Once per fight, the holder can command the growth around enemies to hold them still for a short time. This costs a large portion of mana.
This is a nature, command and support effect.
sceptre.tag: This is a nature, command and support effect.

scribe.name: Leafscript Glyph
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
At the start of each fight, the holder writes a glyph of leaves on a nearby ally, granting them its nature resistance for a short time.
The glyph can be written once per fight.
This is a nature and warding effect.
scribe.tag: This is a nature and warding effect.

serene.name: Still Pond Calm
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
While the holder is calm and unharmed for a short time, its nature resistance rises and its mana recovers faster.
Taking damage breaks the calm.
This is a nature and restoration effect.
serene.tag: This is a nature and restoration effect.

serpent.name: Coiling Venom
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's poisons coil tighter around their targets, lasting slightly longer and slowing the enemy while they last.
Each poisoned enemy can be slowed this way once every short while.
This is a nature, poison and restraint effect.
serpent.tag: This is a nature, poison and restraint effect.

shark.name: Bloodkelp Frenzy
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder deals increased nature damage to bleeding or wounded enemies.
When such an enemy is nearby, the holder is drawn to it and moves slightly faster for a short time. This can happen once every so often.
This is a nature and hunting effect.
shark.tag: This is a nature and hunting effect.

shield.name: Barkshield Ward
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder or a nearby ally is struck by a nature effect, a shield of bark can form to absorb part of it.
Each ally can be shielded this way once every short while.
This is a nature, shield and protection effect.
shield.tag: This is a nature, shield and protection effect.

shimmer.name: Glimmerdew Shimmer
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
While the holder stands among growth, dew shimmers over it and its outline blurs, making ranged attacks against it miss more often.
The shimmer fades for a short time when the holder casts a spell.
This is a nature and evasion effect.
shimmer.tag: This is a nature and evasion effect.

ship.name: Driftwood Keel
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder resists being pushed, pulled or knocked over by nature and water effects.
Allies sheltering close behind it share a portion of this steadiness. The shared steadiness ends if the holder is staggered.
This is a nature and protection effect.
ship.tag: This is a nature and protection effect.

shovel.name: Buried Thornseed
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's heavy strikes turn the earth, burying seeds that sprout into thorns after a short time and deal nature damage to enemies above them.
Only a few seeds can be buried at once.
This is a nature, growth and earth effect.
shovel.tag: This is a nature, growth and earth effect.

sickle.name: Reaping Crescent
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's sweeping strikes reap enemies suffering nature effects, dealing bonus nature damage.
Each reaped enemy restores a little of the holder's stamina. This can happen once every few moments.
This is a nature, harvest and harvesting effect.
sickle.tag: This is a nature, harvest and harvesting effect.

simulacrum.name: Woodcarved Likeness
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder grows a wooden likeness of a nearby ally that copies that ally's basic attack at reduced strength for a short time.
The likeness shares the holder's nature resistance but burns easily.
This is a nature and conjuration effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a nature and conjuration effect.

sin.name: Forbidden Fruit
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature damage tempts its targets, causing them to lower their guard and take slightly more damage for a short time.
Each enemy tempted this way drains a little of the holder's health.
This is a nature and curse effect.
sin.tag: This is a nature and curse effect.

skirmish.name: Briar Skirmisher
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder attacks while moving, it leaves trails of briars that scratch enemies who follow it.
The briars fade after a short time, and the holder cannot leave more while it stands still.
This is a nature and movement effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a nature and movement effect.

skunk.name: Musk Bloom
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When an enemy strikes the holder from behind, the holder releases a foul cloud that makes enemies in it flee briefly.
The cloud can form once every so often.
This is a nature, poison and area effect.
skunk.tag: This is a nature, poison and area effect.

sky.name: Skyward Canopy
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity reaches toward the open sky: it resists wind effects, and its wind abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
Its wind abilities carry seeds that sprout where they land. Only a few sprouts can exist at once.
This is a wind, nature and growth effect.
sky.tag: This is a wind, nature and growth effect.

sloth.name: Mossback Patience
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The longer the holder goes without moving, the more moss grows over it, slowly building nature resistance and healing it.
The moss falls away when it moves quickly.
This is a nature, healing and protection effect.
sloth.tag: This is a nature, healing and protection effect.

smoke.name: Smoulderleaf Haze
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder takes fire damage, its leaves smoulder into a haze that hides it from enemies for a short time.
The haze can form once every so often.
This is a nature, fire and stealth effect.
smoke.tag: This is a nature, fire and stealth effect.

snake.name: Adder's Affinity
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder resists venom as it resists nature effects.
Its quick strikes against poisoned enemies deal bonus nature damage. This bonus can occur once every short while.
This is a nature and poison effect.
snake.tag: This is a nature and poison effect.

soaring.name: Sporescatter Updraft
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder leaps or dodges, a gust of warm air carries it a little further and scatters any spores or poison clouds where it landed.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a nature, wind and movement effect.
soaring.tag: This is a nature, wind and movement effect.

song.name: Birdsong Grove
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
While the holder fights, it hums an old woodland song, and allies nearby resist nature effects slightly.
Once per fight, the song swells to cleanse allies of nature effects. Singing costs a little mana over time.
This is a nature, sound and support effect.
song.tag: This is a nature, sound and support effect.

sovereign.name: Crowned Oak
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Allies near the holder share a portion of its nature resistance and damage bonus.
Once per fight, when the party is pressed hard, the holder raises a crown of oak leaves that heals allies and makes them resist nature effects for a short time.
This is a nature, command and support effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a nature, command and support effect.

spear.name: Thornpike Thrust
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's thrusting attacks drive a thorny spike through the target, dealing nature damage to enemies behind it.
The spike can strike once every few moments.
This is a nature and hunting effect.
spear.tag: This is a nature and hunting effect.

spider.name: Silkweb Trap
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder spins webs of plant silk in places it fights, slowing enemies that pass through them.
Enemies caught in the silk take increased nature damage. Only a few webs can exist at once.
This is a nature, binding and restraint effect.
spider.tag: This is a nature, binding and restraint effect.

spike.name: Thornspike Burst
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder is struck in melee, sharp thorns burst from the ground around it and deal nature damage to nearby enemies.
This can happen once every so often.
This is a nature and area effect.
spike.tag: This is a nature and area effect.

staff.name: Leafing Greenstaff
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's staff sprouts living branches that channel its nature spells more smoothly, lowering their mana cost slightly.
Each spell cast through the staff adds a leaf to it; when the staff is full, the holder's next nature spell is quickened.
This is a nature and mastery effect.
staff.tag: This is a nature and mastery effect.

star.name: Starseed Bloom
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature abilities carry a glimmer of starlight, dealing a portion of radiant damage.
At night, this bonus is greater. The glimmer fades for a short time after the holder takes heavy damage.
This is a nature and light effect.
star.tag: This is a nature and light effect.

stellar.name: Cosmic Blossom
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder calls down a shower of glowing seeds that bloom into radiant flowers, dealing nature and radiant damage to enemies in an area.
The holder is left weakened for a short time afterward.
This is a nature, light and area effect.
stellar.tag: This is a nature, light and area effect.

storm.name: Stormgrove Affinity
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity grows with the storm: it resists lightning and wind effects, and its storm abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
While it stands in rain or storm, its nature abilities strike with lightning. This can happen once every few moments.
This is a storm, lightning and nature effect.
storm.tag: This is a storm, lightning and nature effect.

succubus.name: Honeyed Allure
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature abilities carry a sweet scent that charms enemies for a short time, making them unwilling to strike the holder.
Each enemy can be charmed this way once every so often. Powerful enemies are not affected.
This is a nature and curse effect.
succubus.tag: This is a nature and curse effect.

sun.name: Sunflower Affinity
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity turns toward the sun: it resists fire and light effects, and its light abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
In daylight, its nature abilities slowly heal it. At night the healing fades.
This is a light, fire and nature effect.
sun.tag: This is a light, fire and nature effect.

swarm.name: Hivegrove Swarm
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature abilities release a swarm of insects that harry enemies for a short time, dealing minor nature damage.
Only a few swarms can exist at once.
This is a nature and swarm effect.
swarm.tag: This is a nature and swarm effect.

swift.name: Quickleaf Haste
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature abilities cast slightly faster.
After resisting a nature effect, the holder briefly moves faster. This can happen once every short while.
This is a nature and haste effect.
swift.tag: This is a nature and haste effect.

sword.name: Bramble Blade
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's sword strikes carry a portion of its nature damage bonus.
Each successful parry leaves a thorny wound on the attacker. This can happen once every short while.
This is a nature and mastery effect.
sword.tag: This is a nature and mastery effect.

talisman.name: Acorn Talisman
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
At the start of each fight, the holder blesses a nearby ally with an acorn charm that shares its nature resistance.
The charm lasts until it absorbs a nature effect or until the fight ends.
This is a nature and warding effect.
talisman.tag: This is a nature and warding effect.

tentacle.name: Writhing Vines
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Vines sprout from the holder's back and lash nearby enemies, dealing minor nature damage.
The vines can lash once every few moments, and fire stops them for a short time.
This is a nature and binding effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a nature and binding effect.

thread.name: Gossamer Thread
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder links itself to a nearby ally with a fine thread of green silk. While linked, nature damage the ally takes is partly shared with the holder.
The link breaks if they move far apart and takes a short time to reform.
This is a nature, protection and binding effect.
thread.tag: This is a nature, protection and binding effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderbloom Herald
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity calls the thunder: it resists lightning effects, and its lightning abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
Once per fight, it calls a lightning strike down on an enemy, leaving a scorched patch where new growth sprouts and heals allies standing in it for a short time.
This is a lightning, storm and nature effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a lightning, storm and nature effect.

time.name: Ageless Bough
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Nature effects on the holder pass more quickly, and its own nature effects on enemies linger slightly longer.
Once per fight, it can turn back the growth of a nature effect on an ally, removing it entirely.
This is a nature and time effect.
time.tag: This is a nature and time effect.

tranquil.name: Quiet Glade
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Allies near the holder are calmed, resisting fear and confusion from nature effects.
When the holder has not attacked for a short time, the calm deepens and slowly heals allies nearby.
This is a nature, healing and support effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a nature, healing and support effect.

transfiguration.name: Seedchange Rite
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].

Once per fight, the holder can transfigure a hostile nature effect on itself or an ally into a beneficial effect of the same kind, turning poison into regeneration or entanglement into protective growth.
This costs a large portion of mana.
This is a nature, transformation and transmutation effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a nature, transformation and transmutation effect.

transgression.name: Strangler Fig
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature damage seeds a strangler fig in its target, which slowly saps its strength and feeds a little of it to the holder.
Only a few enemies can be seeded at once, and the holder is slightly slowed while any seed is active.
This is a nature, curse and harvest effect.
transgression.tag: This is a nature, curse and harvest effect.

trap.name: Snapjaw Trap
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder plants a snapping flower where it stands, which bites and roots the next enemy to step on it.
Only a few flowers can exist at once, and each takes a short time to grow.
This is a nature, trap and restraint effect.
trap.tag: This is a nature, trap and restraint effect.

tree.name: Ancient Elm
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
While the holder stands still, it takes root, gaining strong nature resistance and slowly healing.
Uprooting itself to move takes a moment, during which it is vulnerable.
This is a nature, healing and defensive effect.
tree.tag: This is a nature, healing and defensive effect.

troll.name: Mossgreen Regrowth
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder regenerates health steadily during combat.
Fire or acid damage stops the regeneration for a short time.
This is a nature and healing effect.
troll.tag: This is a nature and healing effect.

trowel.name: Gardener's Trowel
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder plants seeds as it fights that grow into small healing herbs, which heal the nearest wounded ally when they ripen.
Only a few herbs can grow at once, and each takes a short time to ripen.
This is a nature, healing and growth effect.
trowel.tag: This is a nature, healing and growth effect.

turtle.name: Shellbark Shelter
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder takes heavy damage, it can draw into a shell of hardened bark, taking greatly reduced damage for a short time.
It cannot act while sheltered. This can happen once per fight.
This is a nature, defensive and shield effect.
turtle.tag: This is a nature, defensive and shield effect.

twilight.name: Gloaming Petal
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
At dusk or in dim light, the holder's nature abilities are harder for enemies to see coming and are less likely to be dodged.
In full light or full darkness, this bonus fades.
This is a nature, shadow and light effect.
twilight.tag: This is a nature, shadow and light effect.

undeath.name: Deathcap Affinity
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity embraces rot: it resists necromantic effects, and its necromantic abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
Its nature damage on the living leaves a fungal rot that weakens their healing. The rot cannot stack.
This is a necromantic, death and nature effect.
undeath.tag: This is a necromantic, death and nature effect.

unity.name: Kindred Grove
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder and its allies stand close together, they all share a portion of the holder's nature resistance.
The shared resistance grows slightly with each ally nearby, up to a limit that scales with rank.
This is a nature, support and protection effect.
unity.tag: This is a nature, support and protection effect.

vast.name: Endless Forest
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature abilities spread across a wider area.
The wider spread costs slightly more mana.
This is a nature and area effect.
vast.tag: This is a nature and area effect.

vehicle.name: Rolling Bramble
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once every so often, the holder sends a ball of tangled bramble rolling ahead of it, knocking down and scratching enemies in its path.
The bramble gathers speed as it rolls and breaks apart after a short distance.
This is a nature, movement and momentum effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a nature, movement and momentum effect.

venom.name: Toxin Mastery
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's poisons are stronger and harder for enemies to cleanse.
Its poisons deal slightly less damage to enemies resistant to nature.
This is a nature and poison effect.
venom.tag: This is a nature and poison effect.

verdant.name: Greenheart Flourish
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's nature abilities leave lush growth wherever they land, and allies in that growth heal slowly.
Only a few patches of growth can exist at once.
This is a nature, growth and healing effect.
verdant.tag: This is a nature, growth and healing effect.

vessel.name: Seedpod Vessel
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder stores a portion of each nature effect it resists in a seedpod, up to a limit that scales with rank.
When an ally falls below half health, the holder breaks the pod to heal them. The pod takes a while to fill again.
This is a nature, healing and support effect.
vessel.tag: This is a nature, healing and support effect.

visage.name: Barkmask Visage
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's face takes on the look of weathered bark, and enemies hesitate to strike it.
Once per fight, when an enemy targets the holder, it flinches and wastes its attack.
This is a nature and defensive effect.
visage.tag: This is a nature and defensive effect.

vision.name: Overseer's Canopy
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder sees through the eyes of nearby plants, revealing hidden enemies near any growth to the party.
Seeing through plants costs a little mana over time.
This is a nature, perception and revelation effect.
vision.tag: This is a nature, perception and revelation effect.

void.name: Hollowed Root
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder resists a nature effect, the effect is drawn into a hollow within it and vanishes.
Once per fight, the holder can empty the hollow, dealing damage to nearby enemies based on what it held.
This is a nature and annihilation effect.
void.tag: This is a nature and annihilation effect.

volcano.name: Magmaroot Affinity
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity sinks into the burning earth: it resists fire and earth effects, and its fire abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
Once per fight, it splits the ground and sends burning roots up through enemies in an area.
This is a fire, burn and nature effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire, burn and nature effect.

vortex.name: Whirling Leafstorm
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once every so often, the holder whips up a whirl of razor leaves around itself that cuts nearby enemies and pulls them slightly closer.
The whirl lasts a short time and costs mana.
This is a nature, wind and area effect.
vortex.tag: This is a nature, wind and area effect.

wasp.name: Stinging Thicket
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's ranged attacks sting their targets with a mild poison that briefly slows them.
The sting cannot stack on the same enemy.
This is a nature and poison effect.
wasp.tag: This is a nature and poison effect.

water.name: Riverbloom Affinity
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity flows with the water: it resists water effects, and its water abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
Its water abilities leave puddles that feed nearby plants and growth, strengthening them for a short time.
This is a water and nature effect.
water.tag: This is a water and nature effect.

weave.name: Wickerweave Mesh
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder weaves the growth it summons into a tight mesh, making its walls and barriers of growth sturdier.
Weaving takes a moment and can be done once every so often.
This is a nature, barrier and conjuration effect.
weave.tag: This is a nature, barrier and conjuration effect.

wendigo.name: Hungering Frostwood
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity turns toward the hungry cold: it resists cold effects, and its cold abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
When it defeats an enemy with cold damage, it feeds on the remains and heals slightly. Feeding can happen once every short while.
This is a cold, frost and nature effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold, frost and nature effect.

whale.name: Great Kelp Song
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity carries a deep song that steadies allies nearby, slightly reducing nature damage they take.
Once per fight, the song swells into a wave of sound that stuns enemies close to the holder.
This is a nature, sound and support effect.
whale.tag: This is a nature, sound and support effect.

wheel.name: Wheel of Seasons
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Each nature ability the holder uses adds a turn to a wheel of seasons. When the wheel completes a full turn, the holder's next nature ability is greatly strengthened.
The wheel resets at the end of each fight.
This is a nature and time effect.
wheel.tag: This is a nature and time effect.

whip.name: Vinelash Whip
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's whip strikes carry a portion of its nature damage bonus and can briefly snare enemies.
Each enemy can be snared this way once every short while.
This is a nature and binding effect.
whip.tag: This is a nature and binding effect.

wind.name: Seedwind Affinity
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity rides the wind: it resists wind effects, and its wind abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
Its wind abilities carry thistledown that slows enemies they strike. The thistledown cannot stack.
This is a wind and nature effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and nature effect.

wing.name: Sheltering Boughs
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When an ally near the holder is struck by a heavy ranged attack, leafy boughs sweep up to shield them, absorbing part of the damage.
This can happen once every so often.
This is a nature, shield and protection effect.
wing.tag: This is a nature, shield and protection effect.

wolf.name: Wildpack Howl
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When the holder and an ally attack the same enemy, the holder's nature damage against it is increased.
Once per fight, the holder howls and nearby allies briefly gain its nature damage bonus.
This is a nature, hunting and support effect.
wolf.tag: This is a nature, hunting and support effect.

wood.name: Heartwood Affinity
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
The holder's affinity sinks into wood: its wooden weapons and staves carry its nature damage bonus, and its wood abilities are strengthened alongside its nature abilities.
Fire damage the holder takes is slightly increased.
This is a nature and growth effect.
wood.tag: This is a nature and growth effect.

wrath.name: Bramble Fury
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
When an ally near the holder falls, the holder's nature abilities are greatly strengthened for a short time.
When the fury ends, the holder is briefly exhausted.
This is a nature and momentum effect.
wrath.tag: This is a nature and momentum effect.

zeal.name: Fervent Bloom
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Each nature ability the holder lands in quick succession strengthens the next slightly.
The chain breaks if the holder pauses, and the holder's mana regenerates slower while the chain lasts.
This is a nature and momentum effect.
zeal.tag: This is a nature and momentum effect.

ziz.name: Skyshadow Canopy
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Nature Affinity]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Nature Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder spreads a vast shadow of branches and leaves overhead, slowing enemies beneath it and shielding allies from ranged attacks for a short time.
This costs a large portion of mana.
This is a nature, shadow and protection effect.
ziz.tag: This is a nature, shadow and protection effect.

action.name: Quickened Mending
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Healing you use takes hold faster: heal-over-time effects you cast deliver their restoration in a shorter span without losing any of the total.
When you heal an ally mid-attack, their next action comes a moment sooner. This can happen once every few seconds per ally.
This is a healing and haste effect.
action.tag: This is a healing and haste effect.

adept.name: Seasoned Healer
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Each healing ability you use in a fight costs slightly less mana for each different healing ability you have already used in that fight.
The discount resets when the fight ends and cannot reduce a cost below a small floor.
This is a healing and mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a healing and mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Living Tincture
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Healing potions you drink also restore a portion of their effect to allies standing close to you.
A potion's lingering regeneration lasts a little longer on you. Only healing potions are shared this way.
This is a healing and alchemy effect.
alchemy.tag: This is a healing and alchemy effect.

ambush.name: Hidden Bloom
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
You can lay a dormant healing ward on an ally. The first time that ally drops below half health, the ward bursts and restores a strong surge of health.
You can hold only a single dormant ward at a time, and laying a new one costs mana.
This is a healing and warding effect.
ambush.tag: This is a healing and warding effect.

animate.name: Wakened Sap
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Healing you cast on summoned and animated allies is greatly amplified and also repairs damaged constructs.
Once per fight, a summoned ally that would be destroyed is held together at a sliver of health for a short time.
This is a healing and animation effect.
animate.tag: This is a healing and animation effect.

anzu.name: Storm-Kindled Vigour
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When you heal an ally, a crackle of lightning leaps from them to strike a nearby enemy, dealing damage that scales with the healing done.
The arc can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a healing and lightning effect.
anzu.tag: This is a healing and lightning effect.

ape.name: Primal Recovery
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Healing you receive while you are in melee range of an enemy is amplified further.
While below half health, your natural regeneration quickens for a short time after you land a melee hit. This cannot stack.
This is a healing and might effect.
ape.tag: This is a healing and might effect.

armour.name: Barkskin Resilience
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Healing that would take you or an ally above full health becomes a thin protective layer that absorbs damage.
The layer fades after a short time and cannot exceed a portion of maximum health.
This is a healing and protection effect.
armour.tag: This is a healing and protection effect.

arsenal.name: Verdant Quiver
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your weapon attacks against enemies carry a sliver of life: each hit heals the most wounded ally nearby for a small amount.
This healing scales with rank and can trigger only once every short interval.
This is a healing and support effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a healing and support effect.

aspect.name: Lifewarden's Aspect
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
While an ally is under a healing or regeneration effect you applied, they take on a faint green aspect that slightly reduces incoming damage.
The aspect ends when the effect ends.
This is a healing and protection effect.
aspect.tag: This is a healing and protection effect.

avatar.name: Grove Incarnate
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Once per fight, when your health falls very low, you take on the form of a living grove for a short time.
In that form your healing radiates to every ally around you and your regeneration is greatly amplified, but you move slowly.
This is a healing and transformation effect.
avatar.tag: This is a healing and transformation effect.

axe.name: Woodcutter's Renewal
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Heavy blows you land restore a small amount of your own health, amplified by your affinity.
This can trigger once every few seconds and only on hits that deal heavy damage.
This is a healing and might effect.
axe.tag: This is a healing and might effect.

balance.name: Equitable Mending
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When you heal an ally whose health is lower than yours, a portion of the healing is also shared out evenly across the rest of the party.
This sharing has a short cooldown.
This is a healing and support effect.
balance.tag: This is a healing and support effect.

bat.name: Night-Wing Draught
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your damage against bleeding enemies drains a small amount of health back to you.
The drain is amplified by your affinity and works only in dim light or darkness.
This is a healing and darkness effect.
bat.tag: This is a healing and darkness effect.

battlefield.name: Field Surgeon
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Allies fighting within a short distance of you regenerate health slowly while they are in combat.
The regeneration stops for an ally who leaves your area, and resumes when they return.
This is a healing and area effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a healing and area effect.

bear.name: Bear's Slumber
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When you stand still and do not attack for a moment, your regeneration surges until you move or are struck.
The surge costs stamina while it lasts.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
bear.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

bee.name: Honeyed Balm
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your heals leave a sweet residue on allies that slowly restores health and cleanses minor poisons.
The residue lasts a short time and refreshes rather than stacking.
This is a healing and purification effect.
bee.tag: This is a healing and purification effect.

behemoth.name: Mountain's Heartbeat
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Healing you receive also raises your maximum health slightly for a short time.
The bonus does not stack beyond a limit that scales with rank.
This is a healing and defensive effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a healing and defensive effect.

bird.name: Songbird's Lift
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Allies you heal gain a brief burst of movement speed.
This can affect each ally once every few seconds.
This is a healing and movement effect.
bird.tag: This is a healing and movement effect.

blight.name: Rot-Turned Growth
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When you cleanse a disease or poison from an ally, the affliction is turned into a short burst of regeneration for them.
This works once per affliction cleansed and costs a little mana.
This is a healing and affliction effect.
blight.tag: This is a healing and affliction effect.

blood.name: Heartsblood Tide
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
You can spend a portion of your own health to heal an ally for a larger amount.
Your affinity amplifies the healing but not the cost. You will not use this while below half health.
This is a healing and blood effect.
blood.tag: This is a healing and blood effect.

bone.name: Knitted Bone
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Healing you apply also shortens slowing and crippling effects on the target.
An ally healed while crippled shrugs off the cripple entirely, once per fight per ally.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
bone.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

boundary.name: Sheltered Hollow
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Healing effects you place on an area cannot be entered by enemies for a short time after they appear.
The area's boundary fades after that, and it costs extra mana to raise.
This is a healing and barrier effect.
boundary.tag: This is a healing and barrier effect.

bounty.name: Plentiful Harvest
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When an enemy dies near you, the party receives a small burst of healing.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a healing and harvest effect.
bounty.tag: This is a healing and harvest effect.

bow.name: Greenwood Arrow
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
You can fire a healing arrow at a distant ally, restoring health on impact.
It shares a cooldown with your other ranged abilities and costs mana.
This is a healing and support effect.
bow.tag: This is a healing and support effect.

brush.name: Painted Vitality
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
You can trace a mark of life on the ground. Allies who cross it receive a small heal.
Each ally can draw on the mark a single time, and you can keep only a single mark at a time.
This is a healing and conjuration effect.
brush.tag: This is a healing and conjuration effect.

cage.name: Caged Pulse
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Enemies restrained by you cannot receive healing while they are held.
Each enemy you restrain gives a small heal to the ally nearest it.
This is a healing and restraint effect.
cage.tag: This is a healing and restraint effect.

cat.name: Last Green Breath
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Once per fight, when a blow would fell you, you are instead left at a sliver of health and receive a strong heal over a short time.
Your affinity amplifies that heal.
This is a healing and rebirth effect.
cat.tag: This is a healing and rebirth effect.

cataclysm.name: Life After Ruin
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When a powerful area attack strikes the party, a wave of restorative energy follows it, healing each ally hit for a portion of the damage taken.
This can trigger once per fight.
This is a healing and annihilation effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is a healing and annihilation effect.

cattle.name: Pasture's Patience
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Regeneration effects on you and allies near you last noticeably longer.
This does not apply to effects that heal in a sudden burst, and the extension cannot be refreshed.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
cattle.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

chain.name: Linked Lifeline
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your single-target heals leap on to a further nearby wounded ally, healing them for a reduced portion.
Each jump loses some strength, and the chain stops after a short reach.
This is a healing and binding effect.
chain.tag: This is a healing and binding effect.

chaotic.name: Wild Bloom
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your heals sometimes burst outward unpredictably, healing every ally in a small area for a portion of the amount.
The chance rises with rank, and a burst cannot follow another within a short time.
This is a healing and area effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a healing and area effect.

charlatan.name: Feigned Wound
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When you receive healing while enemies are targeting you, you appear more badly hurt than you are, drawing their attacks while allies recover.
The illusion lasts a short time and has a cooldown.
This is a healing and illusion effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a healing and illusion effect.

chicken.name: Hearth Vigour
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Food and rest effects that restore health between fights restore more and finish faster for you and allies near you.
This works only outside combat.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
chicken.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

chimera.name: Tangled Vitality
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When you heal an ally, they also gain a brief boost to whichever of health, mana or stamina is lowest.
The boost is small and can affect each ally once every few seconds.
This is a healing and transformation effect.
chimera.tag: This is a healing and transformation effect.

claw.name: Thorn-Mended Talons
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your rending attacks heal you for a small part of the damage dealt.
This is amplified by your affinity and has a short cooldown between triggers.
This is a healing and hunting effect.
claw.tag: This is a healing and hunting effect.

cloth.name: Living Bandage
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When an ally near you starts bleeding, a wrapping of living cloth closes the wound, ending the bleed and restoring a little health.
