This can trigger once every short interval.
This is a healing and binding effect.
cloth.tag: This is a healing and binding effect.

cloud.name: Mist of Mending
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your area heals leave behind a soft mist that keeps healing allies inside it for a short time.
The mist drifts with the wind and costs a little extra mana to leave behind.
This is a healing and water effect.
cloud.tag: This is a healing and water effect.

cold.name: Frostbound Pulse
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When an ally drops below half health, you can encase a wound in healing frost, stopping damage over time on them and restoring health as the frost melts.
The ally is slowed while the frost holds, and this has a cooldown.
This is a healing and frost effect.
cold.tag: This is a healing and frost effect.

coral.name: Reef Renewal
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Each heal you cast on an ally builds a layer of living coral on them. When the coral is broken by an attack, it heals them for a portion.
Coral layers stack up to a limit and fade after a short time.
This is a healing and growth effect.
coral.tag: This is a healing and growth effect.

corrupt.name: Bitter Sap
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Healing that enemies receive near you is partly spoiled, and a portion of the spoiled healing passes to your nearest ally.
This works only within a short distance of you.
This is a healing and curse effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a healing and curse effect.

crocodile.name: Riverbank Rest
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
While you are standing in water, your regeneration is greatly amplified.
Healing you receive while in water also cleanses a minor affliction. This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a healing and water effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a healing and water effect.

crystal.name: Prism Heart
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Healing you over-cast on an ally is stored in a crystal that floats near them and releases it when they are next damaged.
Each ally can hold a single crystal, and it shatters after a short time if unused.
This is a healing and crystal effect.
crystal.tag: This is a healing and crystal effect.

cycle.name: Turning Seasons
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Each time a regeneration effect you applied ends naturally, it renews itself at reduced strength.
Each renewal is weaker than the last, and the cycle ends after a short time.
This is a healing and time effect.
cycle.tag: This is a healing and time effect.

dance.name: Leafdancer's Grace
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Each time you evade an attack, you heal yourself and the nearest ally for a small amount.
This has a short cooldown and scales with rank.
This is a healing and evasion effect.
dance.tag: This is a healing and evasion effect.

dark.name: Moonless Mending
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Healing you cast while hidden or in darkness does not reveal you or the target to enemies.
Heals cast from concealment restore a little extra.
This is a healing and shadow effect.
dark.tag: This is a healing and shadow effect.

dawn.name: Dawnsong Vitality
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
At the start of each fight, the party receives a soft wave of healing light and brief regeneration.
This happens once per fight.
This is a healing and light effect.
dawn.tag: This is a healing and light effect.

death.name: Last Rites Reversed
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When an ally near you is reduced to very low health, your next heal on them is greatly amplified.
This works once per fight for each ally.
This is a healing and death effect.
death.tag: This is a healing and death effect.

deep.name: Wellspring Below
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When you have gone a short time without being damaged, you build a reservoir of life that flows into you the next time you are hurt.
The reservoir is capped by rank.
This is a healing and water effect.
deep.tag: This is a healing and water effect.

deer.name: Fawnlight Recovery
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
While you are moving away from enemies, your regeneration is amplified.
Healing you receive also gives a brief burst of speed, once every few seconds.
This is a healing and movement effect.
deer.tag: This is a healing and movement effect.

desolate.name: Stubborn Root
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When healing is scarce, such as when an enemy effect reduces healing received, your own healing ignores a portion of that reduction.
This applies to healing you use and healing you receive.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
desolate.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

dimension.name: Folded Lifeline
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
You can heal an ally out of normal reach, folding space to deliver a healing touch.
This costs extra mana and has a cooldown.
This is a healing and dimension effect.
dimension.tag: This is a healing and dimension effect.

discord.name: Discordant Pulse
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When an enemy near you heals, a jarring pulse of life energy interrupts it and heals your nearest ally instead for a portion.
This can trigger once every short interval.
This is a healing and sound effect.
discord.tag: This is a healing and sound effect.

discordant.name: Jarring Vitality
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Healing you use on an ally who is confused, stunned or charmed shakes them free of that effect.
Each ally can be freed this way once every few seconds.
This is a healing and purification effect.
discordant.tag: This is a healing and purification effect.

dog.name: Loyal Mending
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
You automatically heal an ally who is attacked while standing next to you.
This has a cooldown and favours the most wounded ally.
This is a healing and support effect.
dog.tag: This is a healing and support effect.

doom.name: Defiance of Doom
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When an ally is struck by a death mark or doom effect, your healing on them is amplified for as long as it lasts.
If the effect expires while you are healing them, they are restored for a portion of their health, once per fight.
This is a healing and death effect.
doom.tag: This is a healing and death effect.

doppelganger.name: Mirrored Mend
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When you heal yourself, a faint echo of the heal also reaches the ally with the lowest health nearby.
The echo is weaker than the original and has a short cooldown.
This is a healing and illusion effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a healing and illusion effect.

dragon.name: Wyrmheart Vigour
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your regeneration burns with draconic fire, healing you and dealing light fire damage to enemies who strike you in melee.
This lasts while the regeneration lasts and costs mana to trigger.
This is a healing and fire effect.
dragon.tag: This is a healing and fire effect.

duck.name: Placid Shallows
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Damage over time on allies near you is slightly reduced, and healing washes some of it away.
This works only while you are not taking damage yourself.
This is a healing and water effect.
duck.tag: This is a healing and water effect.

dust.name: Ash to Seed
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When an enemy near you dies, it leaves a small mote of life that heals the first ally to pass through it.
Motes fade after a short time.
This is a healing and harvest effect.
dust.tag: This is a healing and harvest effect.

earth.name: Rooted Vitality
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
While you stand still on natural ground, healing you cast and receive is amplified further.
The bonus ends the moment you move.
This is a healing and nature effect.
earth.tag: This is a healing and nature effect.

echo.name: Answering Pulse
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
A short time after you heal an ally, a softer echo of the heal repeats on them.
The echo does not trigger other effects and has a short cooldown.
This is a healing and resonance effect.
echo.tag: This is a healing and resonance effect.

eclipse.name: Shadowed Bloom

You carry a living charm that strengthens healing you receive while you are below half health.
The charm dims for a short time after it has restored a large amount.
This is a healing and warding effect.
talisman.tag: This is a healing and warding effect.

tentacle.name: Tendril Mend
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
You can reach a tendril of living sap to an ally a short distance away and heal them while it holds.
The tendril breaks if either of you moves too far, and it drains mana while held.
This is a healing and binding effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a healing and binding effect.

thread.name: Lifethread Weaving
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
You can bind a thread of life between yourself and an ally, so a portion of healing either of you receives passes to the other.
You can keep only a single thread, and it snaps if you move far apart.
This is a healing and binding effect.
thread.tag: This is a healing and binding effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderclap Bloom
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When you heal an ally in a storm or after a lightning strike, the heal arrives with a thunderclap that staggers nearby enemies.
This has a cooldown.
This is a healing and storm effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a healing and storm effect.

time.name: Rewound Wound
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Once per fight, you can turn back an ally's last heavy wound, restoring the health it took.
This works only on damage taken in the last short moment.
This is a healing and time effect.
time.tag: This is a healing and time effect.

tranquil.name: Tranquil Grove
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When the fight lulls and no enemy is attacking, you and nearby allies regenerate quickly.
The effect ends the moment combat resumes.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

transfiguration.name: Metamorphic Mend
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
You can turn a harmful effect on an ally into a brief beneficial one of the same kind.
This costs mana and has a cooldown.
This is a healing and transmutation effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a healing and transmutation effect.

transgression.name: Forbidden Vitality
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
You can force a heal past an enemy effect that blocks healing.
Doing so costs a portion of your own health and has a cooldown.
This is a healing and curse effect.
transgression.tag: This is a healing and curse effect.

trap.name: Snare of Life
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
You can set a hidden healing snare that triggers when an ally steps on it.
You can keep only a single snare at a time.
This is a healing and warding effect.
trap.tag: This is a healing and warding effect.

tree.name: Elder Tree's Shade
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
While you stand still, you cast a shade around you in which allies regenerate slowly.
The shade fades a short time after you move.
This is a healing and nature effect.
tree.tag: This is a healing and nature effect.

troll.name: Trollblood Vigour
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your regeneration is greatly amplified.
Fire and acid damage halt it for a short time.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
troll.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

trowel.name: Gardener's Care
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
You can plant a small healing seedling near an ally that grows and heals them steadily.
The seedling can be destroyed and fades after a short time.
This is a healing and growth effect.
trowel.tag: This is a healing and growth effect.

turtle.name: Shell of Patience
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When you withdraw into a defensive stance, your regeneration is greatly amplified.
You move slowly while in the stance, and it costs stamina.
This is a healing and defensive effect.
turtle.tag: This is a healing and defensive effect.

twilight.name: Dusk Blossom
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
At dusk and dawn, your heals restore more and grant brief protection against shadow damage.
The protection lasts a short time.
This is a healing and twilight effect.
twilight.tag: This is a healing and twilight effect.

undeath.name: Grave-Defying Mend
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your heals damage undead enemies near the target.
The damage is small and has a cooldown.
This is a healing and holy effect.
undeath.tag: This is a healing and holy effect.

unity.name: United Hearts
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Healing on any party member is slightly amplified for each ally standing close to them.
The bonus is capped and applies only in combat.
This is a healing and support effect.
unity.tag: This is a healing and support effect.

vast.name: Boundless Spring
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your area heals cover a wider area.
They cost slightly more mana.
This is a healing and area effect.
vast.tag: This is a healing and area effect.

vehicle.name: Carriage of Life
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
You can carry a fallen ally with you while moving, healing them slowly as you go.
You move slowly while carrying them and cannot attack.
This is a healing and travel effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a healing and travel effect.

venom.name: Antidote Bloom
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your heals counteract venom, reversing a portion of any poison damage the target has taken recently.
This has a short cooldown per ally.
This is a healing and poison effect.
venom.tag: This is a healing and poison effect.

verdant.name: Verdant Heart
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Living plants spring up where you heal, healing allies who stand among them.
The plants wither after a short time.
This is a healing and nature effect.
verdant.tag: This is a healing and nature effect.

vessel.name: Overflow Phial
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Excess healing you receive is stored, then released to heal you when you take damage.
The store is capped by rank and drains slowly.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
vessel.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

visage.name: Healthy Glow
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Allies you heal appear hale and strong, making enemies hesitate before attacking them.
This lasts a short time and has a cooldown per ally.
This is a healing and illusion effect.
visage.tag: This is a healing and illusion effect.

vision.name: Foreseen Mending
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
You see the wounds allies are about to suffer and shield them with a small pre-emptive heal.
This works once every few seconds and only for allies in sight.
This is a healing and precognition effect.
vision.tag: This is a healing and precognition effect.

void.name: Life from Nothing
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When an enemy's attack misses you, a sliver of life seeps back into you from the empty space.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a healing and void effect.
void.tag: This is a healing and void effect.

volcano.name: Ashen Bloom
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
After a fire or explosion strikes near you, the scorched ground sprouts healing growth for a short time.
This has a cooldown.
This is a healing and fire effect.
volcano.tag: This is a healing and fire effect.

vortex.name: Spiralling Remedy
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your area heals draw allies slightly toward the centre, gathering them for the next heal.
The pull is gentle and has a cooldown.
This is a healing and wind effect.
vortex.tag: This is a healing and wind effect.

wasp.name: Waspsting Salve
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your heals leave a stinging salve on allies that injects a mild poison into enemies that strike them.
The salve lasts a short time and has a cooldown per ally.
This is a healing and poison effect.
wasp.tag: This is a healing and poison effect.

water.name: Living Water
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your heals flow on through water, reaching allies standing in it nearby.
This costs a little more mana when it spreads.
This is a healing and water effect.
water.tag: This is a healing and water effect.

weave.name: Woven Vitality
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When you cast several heals in quick succession, they weave together into a lasting regeneration on the last target.
The regeneration lasts a short time and has a cooldown.
This is a healing and binding effect.
weave.tag: This is a healing and binding effect.

wendigo.name: Winter's Hunger
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
In cold places, your attacks drain a little life from enemies to heal you.
This works only in the cold and has a short cooldown.
This is a healing and cold effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a healing and cold effect.

whale.name: Deep Breath
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your maximum health is raised slightly, and your regeneration scales with it.
This bonus fades while you are exhausted.
This is a healing and defensive effect.
whale.tag: This is a healing and defensive effect.

wheel.name: Rotating Remedy
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Each heal you cast on a different ally in turn is slightly stronger than the last.
The bonus resets if you heal the same ally back to back.
This is a healing and momentum effect.
wheel.tag: This is a healing and momentum effect.

whip.name: Lashing Lifeline
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your whip strikes can heal an ally at range instead of harming an enemy.
This costs mana and has a cooldown.
This is a healing and support effect.
whip.tag: This is a healing and support effect.

wind.name: Wind-Carried Mend
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your heals travel on the wind, arriving faster and reaching slightly further.
This applies only outdoors.
This is a healing and wind effect.
wind.tag: This is a healing and wind effect.

wing.name: Wings of Mending
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When an ally next to you is struck, you can spread wings of light around them, healing them and blocking the next hit.
This has a cooldown.
This is a healing and protection effect.
wing.tag: This is a healing and protection effect.

wolf.name: Pack Mending
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your heals are amplified for each ally fighting the same enemy as the target.
The bonus is capped and applies only in combat.
This is a healing and support effect.
wolf.tag: This is a healing and support effect.

wood.name: Heartwood Vigour
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Healing you receive also grants a brief layer of bark that absorbs a small amount of damage.
The bark fades after a short time and does not stack.
This is a healing and protection effect.
wood.tag: This is a healing and protection effect.

wrath.name: Furious Recovery
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
When you are badly hurt, healing you receive also grants a brief surge of damage.
This has a cooldown.
This is a healing and might effect.
wrath.tag: This is a healing and might effect.

zeal.name: Zealous Spring
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Your heals restore more when cast in the heat of battle, while you are in melee.
This costs slightly more stamina.
This is a healing and holy effect.
zeal.tag: This is a healing and holy effect.

ziz.name: Skyborne Bloom
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Life Affinity]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Life Affinity].
Once per fight, you can call down a great gust that heals every ally in a wide area.
This costs a large amount of mana.
This is a healing and wind effect.
ziz.tag: This is a healing and wind effect.

action.name: Quickened Wellspring
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
Each time you use an ability, your mana returns faster for a brief moment afterward.
The quickening refreshes rather than stacks, and it lapses if you stand idle.
This is a haste and restoration effect.
action.tag: This is a haste and restoration effect.

adept.name: Practised Breath
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
While you repeat the same ability you used last, mana returns slightly faster, as the blood settles into a known rhythm.
Using a different ability resets the rhythm.
This is a mastery and restoration effect.
adept.tag: This is a mastery and restoration effect.

alchemy.name: Distilled Lineage
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
When you drink a mana potion, its effect lingers, and your mana keeps trickling back faster for a short time after the potion is spent.
The lingering effect cannot trigger again until the potion cooldown ends.
This is an alchemy and restoration effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and restoration effect.

ambush.name: Patient Ambusher
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
While you are unseen by enemies or have not yet acted in a fight, mana returns markedly faster.
The bonus ends the moment you attack or are struck.
This is a stealth and restoration effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and restoration effect.

animate.name: Wakeful Veins
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
While you sustain an animated or conjured ally, a portion of the mana it would drain from you is returned by your blood.
This only covers upkeep costs, not the cost of creating the ally.
This is an animation and restoration effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and restoration effect.

anzu.name: Stormcrest Blood
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
When you are struck by lightning or wind magic, the strike feeds your blood and returns a burst of mana.
This can happen only once every few seconds, and the hit still lands in full.
This is a storm and lightning effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and lightning effect.

ape.name: Grounded Vigour
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
Landing an unarmed or brawling strike pulls a small amount of mana back through your body.
This gain is limited by a short internal cooldown and spends a little stamina each time.
This is a momentum and restoration effect.
ape.tag: This is a momentum and restoration effect.

armour.name: Sheathed Current
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
While wearing armour, absorbed damage is partly converted into returning mana.
The conversion pauses for a short time after it triggers.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
armour.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

arsenal.name: Armed Inheritance
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
Switching between weapon styles in a fight returns a measure of mana as the blood adapts.
This can occur only once per stance change cooldown.
This is a mastery and momentum effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a mastery and momentum effect.

aspect.name: Shapeworn Wellspring
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
While a self-transformation or aspect ability is active, your mana returns faster.
When the aspect ends, its upkeep cost is partly refunded.
This is a transformation and restoration effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation and restoration effect.

avatar.name: Vessel of Elders
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
Once per fight, when your mana runs low, the ancestral magic surges forth and restores a large portion of it.
For a short time afterward, your spells cost a little more as the blood recovers.
This is a transformation and restoration effect.
avatar.tag: This is a transformation and restoration effect.

axe.name: Cleaver's Tithe
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
Heavy cleaving blows that hit multiple enemies each return a sliver of mana.
The return is capped per swing and has a short cooldown.
This is a momentum and harvest effect.
axe.tag: This is a momentum and harvest effect.

balance.name: Even Tide
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
When your mana is below your health as a share of its maximum, mana returns faster; when above, health returns slightly faster instead.
The effect pauses for a short time when you take a heavy blow.
This is a restoration and support effect.
balance.tag: This is a restoration and support effect.

bat.name: Night Sipper
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
In darkness or shadow, your mana returns faster.
In bright light, the effect is suppressed for a short time.
This is a shadow and darkness effect.
bat.tag: This is a shadow and darkness effect.

battlefield.name: Field Communion
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
While multiple allies fight within your aura, the flow of your mana accelerates, sharing a small portion with them.
The shared portion slows your own regeneration slightly.
This is an area and support effect.
battlefield.tag: This is an area and support effect.

bear.name: Hibernal Blood
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
When you remain out of combat for a short time, mana returns very quickly as you rest.
The effect ends the instant you enter battle.
This is a restoration and defensive effect.
bear.tag: This is a restoration and defensive effect.

bee.name: Hived Wellspring
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
Each ally healed by you gives back a tiny pulse of mana to your reserves.
The pulse can only trigger from each ally once in a short window.
This is a support and restoration effect.
bee.tag: This is a support and restoration effect.

behemoth.name: Colossal Reservoir
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
Your maximum mana grows larger, and your mana returns at a steady pace no matter how depleted.
This larger reserve takes longer to fill from empty.
This is a mastery and defensive effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a mastery and defensive effect.

bird.name: Soaring Pulse
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
While moving quickly, mana returns slightly faster.
Standing still for a short time halts the effect.
This is a movement and haste effect.
bird.tag: This is a movement and haste effect.

blight.name: Rotting Root
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
Each time an enemy suffers from your affliction or poison, it slowly leeches mana back to you.
Each afflicted enemy can feed you only once per cooldown.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
blight.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

blood.name: Bloodbound Spring
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
You can spend a portion of health to restore mana instantly.
This costs health and has a short cooldown.
This is a necromantic and restoration effect.
blood.tag: This is a necromantic and restoration effect.

bone.name: Ossified Flow
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
When you are struck hard, your bones resonate, returning a small burst of mana.
This can trigger only once in a short window.
This is a defensive and resonance effect.
bone.tag: This is a defensive and resonance effect.

boundary.name: Borderline Stream
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
While you stand inside a barrier or warded area, mana returns more swiftly.
Leaving the barrier removes the effect at once.
This is a warding and barrier effect.
boundary.tag: This is a warding and barrier effect.

bounty.name: Prize Blood
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
Each enemy defeated by you or allies near you releases a small burst of mana to you.
This gain can occur only once in a short window.
This is a harvest and restoration effect.
bounty.tag: This is a harvest and restoration effect.

bow.name: Taut Bowstring Tide
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
While you hold a bowshot at full draw, mana slowly returns.
The effect ends the moment you release the shot.
This is a hunting and mastery effect.
bow.tag: This is a hunting and mastery effect.

brush.name: Inked Lineage
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
Each glyph or rune you place returns a small portion of mana as the magic settles.
Each glyph can feed you only once.
This is a conjuration and resonance effect.
brush.tag: This is a conjuration and resonance effect.

cage.name: Locked Spring
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
When you restrain or bind an enemy, a trickle of mana returns to you for as long as the binding lasts.
The trickle ends if the target breaks free.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
cage.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

cat.name: Graceful Lineage
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
After you evade an attack, mana returns faster for a short time.
This effect cannot trigger again until it lapses.
This is an evasion and movement effect.
cat.tag: This is an evasion and movement effect.

cataclysm.name: Ruinous Upwelling
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
After you cast an area spell that strikes many enemies, a surge of mana floods back to you.
This surge can occur only once per fight.
This is an area and annihilation effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an area and annihilation effect.

cattle.name: Herd Patience
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
While allies stand close beside you, your mana returns at a steady, unhurried pace that ignores interruptions from damage.
The effect fades if you are left alone for a short time.
This is a support and defensive effect.
cattle.tag: This is a support and defensive effect.

chain.name: Linked Current
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Mystic Bloodline]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mystic Bloodline].
When a spell of yours jumps between targets, each jump returns a sliver of mana.
The return per cast is capped, and each target can feed you only once per cast.
This is a binding and lightning effect.
