transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
The holder's dodges cut across rules of motion, letting it pass through enemies in its path.
Each such pass costs a sliver of health and has a cooldown.
This is a curse and evasion effect.
transgression.tag: This is a curse and evasion effect.

trap.name: Snarefoot
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
When the holder dodges away from an enemy, it leaves a hidden snare behind that roots the next enemy to step on it.
The snare fades after a short time and has a cooldown.
This is a binding and trap effect.
trap.tag: This is a binding and trap effect.

tree.name: Rooted Sway
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
While the holder stands among trees or plants, its evasion rises slightly.
The bonus fades as it moves away from cover.
This is a nature and evasion effect.
tree.tag: This is a nature and evasion effect.

troll.name: Trollblood Stride
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
While the holder keeps moving, it heals slowly.
The healing stops for a short time if the holder is struck.
This is a regeneration and movement effect.
troll.tag: This is a regeneration and movement effect.

trowel.name: Groundwork Step
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
When the holder dodges, it smooths the ground beneath it, letting allies who follow move slightly faster.
The smoothed ground fades after a short time.
This is an earth and support effect.
trowel.tag: This is an earth and support effect.

turtle.name: Shell Stance
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
When the holder stops to brace, it tucks in and takes reduced damage from the next hit.
This costs stamina and has a cooldown.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
turtle.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

twilight.name: Dusk Shroud
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
In twilight or dim light, the holder's movements are hard to follow, and its evasion rises slightly.
This only works in dim light.
This is a shadow and evasion effect.
twilight.tag: This is a shadow and evasion effect.

undeath.name: Deathless Gait
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
Once per fight, when the holder would be felled while moving, it keeps moving for a moment with its wounds held at bay.
When the moment passes, it is left at low health.
This is a necromantic and evasion effect.
undeath.tag: This is a necromantic and evasion effect.

unity.name: Shared Stride
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
Allies near the holder share a portion of its movement speed.
The bonus ends if the holder falls behind or is struck.
This is a support and haste effect.
unity.tag: This is a support and haste effect.

vast.name: Vast Stride
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
The holder's dodges cover far more ground in open spaces.
This only works where there is room to move freely.
This is a movement and travel effect.
vast.tag: This is a movement and travel effect.

vehicle.name: Carriage Glide
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
The holder moves smoothly and slightly faster along roads and paved ground.
This does not work on rough terrain.
This is a movement and travel effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a movement and travel effect.

venom.name: Venomous Feint
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
When the holder evades an attack, its next strike carries a stronger poison.
This has a cooldown.
This is a poison and evasion effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and evasion effect.

verdant.name: Thicket Step
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
The holder moves through thick brush and undergrowth without slowing, and enemies following it are tangled.
This only works in overgrown places.
This is a nature and growth effect.
verdant.tag: This is a nature and growth effect.

vessel.name: Amphora of Steps
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
Each dodge fills the holder with a little stored energy, which heals it when it stops moving.
The store is capped and empties if the holder is struck.
This is a restoration and evasion effect.
vessel.tag: This is a restoration and evasion effect.

visage.name: Masked Grace
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
The holder's face blurs as it moves, and enemies find it slightly harder to track.
This only works while the holder is in motion.
This is a concealment and evasion effect.
visage.tag: This is a concealment and evasion effect.

vision.name: Clear Sight
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
The holder sees attacks coming a moment early and dodges them slightly more often.
This only works against enemies it can see.
This is a perception and evasion effect.
vision.tag: This is a perception and evasion effect.

void.name: Void Step
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
When the holder dodges, it blinks through emptiness and reappears a short distance away.
This costs mana and has a cooldown.
This is a dimensional and evasion effect.
void.tag: This is a dimensional and evasion effect.

volcano.name: Magma Step
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
The holder's dodges leave pools of molten rock that burn enemies who cross them.
The pools cool after a short time and appear once every few seconds.
This is a fire and evasion effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and evasion effect.

vortex.name: Whirling Dodge
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
When the holder dodges, it spins and pulls nearby enemies slightly toward the spot it left.
This has a cooldown.
This is a wind and evasion effect.
vortex.tag: This is a wind and evasion effect.

wasp.name: Wasp's Dart
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
After a dodge, the holder's next strike is a quick sting that lands before the enemy can react.
This has a cooldown.
This is a poison and haste effect.
wasp.tag: This is a poison and haste effect.

water.name: Flowing Grace
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
The holder moves through water and wet ground without slowing, and its dodges leave a splash that douses flames.
This only works on wet ground.
This is a water and movement effect.
water.tag: This is a water and movement effect.

weave.name: Woven Step
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
The holder's movements weave a faint pattern that lets allies near it dodge slightly more easily.
The pattern fades if the holder stops moving.
This is a support and evasion effect.
weave.tag: This is a support and evasion effect.

wendigo.name: Frost-Starved Lope
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
While the holder is cold or hungry, its movement speed rises slightly.
This only works while the holder is suffering from cold or low stamina.
This is a cold and haste effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and haste effect.

whale.name: Leviathan's Sway
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
When the holder dodges, a heavy wave of force follows it and briefly slows pursuers.
This has a cooldown.
This is a water and momentum effect.
whale.tag: This is a water and momentum effect.

wheel.name: Spoke Rhythm
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
When the holder dodges, its next dodge comes out faster.
The chain resets after a short time.
This is a momentum and evasion effect.
wheel.tag: This is a momentum and evasion effect.

whip.name: Lashing Retreat
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
When the holder dodges away from an enemy, it lashes back and keeps the enemy at a distance.
This has a cooldown.
This is an evasion and restraint effect.
whip.tag: This is an evasion and restraint effect.

wind.name: Windborne Step
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
The holder's dodges catch the wind and carry it farther, especially when moving with the breeze.
This only works where air moves freely.
This is a wind and movement effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and movement effect.

wing.name: Mantle Flare
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
When the holder dodges, a flare of spectral wings shields it from the next hit.
The shield breaks after a hit and has a cooldown.
This is a wind and protection effect.
wing.tag: This is a wind and protection effect.

wolf.name: Pack Runner
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
While the holder moves alongside allies, it gains slightly more speed and evasion.
The bonus ends if the holder strays from the group.
This is a support and hunting effect.
wolf.tag: This is a support and hunting effect.

wood.name: Heartwood Poise
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
The holder resists being knocked back while standing on wooden floors or among trees.
This only works on wooden ground or in forests.
This is a nature and defensive effect.
wood.tag: This is a nature and defensive effect.

wrath.name: Furious Dodge
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
When the holder is struck, its next dodge is faster and leads into a strike with extra force.
This has a cooldown.
This is a momentum and wrath effect.
wrath.tag: This is a momentum and wrath effect.

zeal.name: Zealous Step
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
The holder moves slightly faster toward its chosen target.
The bonus ends if the holder changes targets.
This is a haste and hunting effect.
zeal.tag: This is a haste and hunting effect.

ziz.name: Great-Wing Gust
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Elf] ability [Grace]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Grace].
Once per fight, when the holder dodges a heavy attack, a great gust bursts from it and pushes enemies back.
The gust leaves the holder briefly unsteady.
This is a wind and evasion effect.
ziz.tag: This is a wind and evasion effect.

action.name: Spoils in Motion
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy you helped defeat drops its additional loot, the loot spills into your path, and passing through it grants you a brief burst of attack speed.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a movement and haste effect.
action.tag: This is a movement and haste effect.

adept.name: Practised Plunder
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each different kind of enemy the party defeats in a fight adds to a tally. When the fight ends, its additional loot leans toward materials from the kind the party fought most.
The tally resets at the end of every fight.
This is a mastery and harvest effect.
adept.tag: This is a mastery and harvest effect.

alchemy.name: Distilled Spoils
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Crude monster parts among the additional loot are sometimes rendered into ready reagents before they reach the party's spoils.
When this happens, you breathe in the residue and recover a little health. The healing can happen once per fight.
This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.

ambush.name: Ambusher's Tithe
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
An enemy defeated before it has noticed the party yields a richer share of additional loot, and you gain a brief boon of increased damage.
Only the first enemy defeated in each fight can pay this tithe.
This is a stealth and harvest effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and harvest effect.

animate.name: Fetching Spoils
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot dropped by defeated enemies stirs and crawls toward the nearest wounded ally, healing that ally slightly when it arrives.
Each piece that moves this way costs you a little mana, and only a portion of each fight's loot can be woken.
This is an animation and healing effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and healing effect.

anzu.name: Stormwrack Bounty
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies slain by lightning or storm damage cast off additional loot crackling with static. The first ally to reach it gains bonus lightning damage on their attacks for a short time.
This can happen once per fight for each ally.
This is a storm and lightning effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and lightning effect.

ape.name: Grabbing Hands
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When you defeat an enemy in melee, you snatch an extra piece of loot from it before it falls and gain a brief surge of strength.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a harvest and might effect.
ape.tag: This is a harvest and might effect.

armour.name: Salvaged Plate
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Armoured enemies shed plating along with their additional loot when they fall. You strap on a piece, gaining a short-lived shield.
The shield does not stack and fades when the fight ends.
This is a salvage and shield effect.
armour.tag: This is a salvage and shield effect.

arsenal.name: Trophy Arsenal
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Weapons among the additional loot lend their edge to you: your attacks take on a trace of the fallen enemy's damage type for the rest of the fight.
Only the most recent weapon claimed this way lends its edge.
This is a salvage and mastery effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a salvage and mastery effect.

aspect.name: Aspect of the Fallen
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy you helped defeat drops additional loot, you take on a faint aspect of its kind, gaining minor resistance to its damage type.
The aspect lasts a short time, and only the latest aspect is held.
This is a transformation and defensive effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation and defensive effect.

avatar.name: Herald of Plenty
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Allies near you share in your bounty: enemies they defeat while close to you drop additional loot as if you had defeated them.
Holding this aura drains your mana slowly, and it ends while you are stunned.
This is a support and area effect.
avatar.tag: This is a support and area effect.

axe.name: Hewn Spoils
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Your heaviest blows chop pieces from large enemies mid-fight, dropping additional loot before the enemy has fallen.
Each enemy can be hewn this way only once per fight.
This is a harvest and annihilation effect.
axe.tag: This is a harvest and annihilation effect.

balance.name: Weighed Portions
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each time additional loot drops, the most wounded ally in the party recovers a little health, and the healthiest ally takes slightly less damage for a short time.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a healing and support effect.
balance.tag: This is a healing and support effect.

bat.name: Hoardsense
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You hear the clink of rich loot on enemies, even unseen ones. The nearest enemy carrying a rare drop is marked, and allies deal slightly more damage to it.
Only the nearest such enemy is marked at a time, and a new mark waits a short time after the last one falls.
This is a perception and hunting effect.
bat.tag: This is a perception and hunting effect.

battlefield.name: Field Tithe
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
The ground where each enemy falls is marked as a spoil site for the rest of the fight. Allies standing on a spoil site recover stamina slowly.
Spoil sites fade when the fight ends, yielding a little additional loot as they go.
This is an area and harvest effect.
battlefield.tag: This is an area and harvest effect.

bear.name: Bear's Larder
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When you defeat an enemy, you devour part of its additional loot to recover health over a short time.
This can happen once every short while, and loot eaten this way never reaches the party's spoils.
This is a healing and harvest effect.
bear.tag: This is a healing and harvest effect.

bee.name: Honeyed Tithe
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot from defeated enemies is laced with honey. The first ally to pass near each drop recovers a small amount of health.
Each drop heals only once, and the honey dries after a short time.
This is a healing and swarm effect.
bee.tag: This is a healing and swarm effect.

behemoth.name: Titan's Due
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Large and elite enemies yield a heavy share of additional loot. When such an enemy falls, you gain brief resistance to knockback and damage.
This applies only to large or elite enemies.
This is a defensive and harvest effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a defensive and harvest effect.

bird.name: Magpie's Eye
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies carrying rare drops glint to your eyes, and your attacks against a glinting enemy deal slightly more damage.
Only the nearest glinting enemy carries the glint at a time.
This is a perception and hunting effect.
bird.tag: This is a perception and hunting effect.

blight.name: Blighted Harvest
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies that die while suffering your afflictions drop additional loot tainted with blight. The taint bursts when it lands, spreading a weak disease to enemies nearby.
A burst can occur once every few seconds.
This is an affliction and poison effect.
blight.tag: This is an affliction and poison effect.

blood.name: Bloodlet Tithe
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies that die while bleeding drop additional loot, and the blood spilled restores a small amount of your health.
The healing applies only to bleeding enemies and only as each one falls.
This is a healing and affliction effect.
blood.tag: This is a healing and affliction effect.

bone.name: Ossuary Trophies
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Defeated enemies leave a bone trophy among their additional loot. When you are struck hard, you crush a trophy to gain a brief layer of bone armour.
You hold only a limited stock of trophies, and they crumble when the fight ends.
This is a defensive and necromantic effect.
bone.tag: This is a defensive and necromantic effect.

boundary.name: Bounded Claim
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies defeated inside a ward or barrier raised by the party drop additional loot, and each one that falls there briefly reinforces that ward.
Reinforcement can occur once every few seconds.
This is a warding and barrier effect.
boundary.tag: This is a warding and barrier effect.

bounty.name: Overflowing Coffers
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each enemy defeated in a fight raises the share of additional loot from the next, building a growing bounty that pays out when the fight ends.
The bounty is lost if an ally falls before the fight is over.
This is a harvest effect.
bounty.tag: This is a harvest effect.

bow.name: Fletcher's Due
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When you defeat an enemy with a ranged attack, its additional loot falls where it stood, and your next ranged attack deals slightly more damage.
The bonus does not stack and fades after a short time.
This is a hunting and harvest effect.
bow.tag: This is a hunting and harvest effect.

brush.name: Painted Plunder
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You daub a sigil on the enemy you are attacking. If it dies while painted, its additional loot carries a painted charm that grants the nearest ally a brief boon of protection or haste.
Only the latest enemy you paint carries the sigil.
This is a support and conjuration effect.
brush.tag: This is a support and conjuration effect.

cage.name: Caged Spoils
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy dies while held in a restraint, its share of additional loot is richer, and the restraint leaps to the nearest enemy for a short time.
The restraint can leap once per fight.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
cage.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

cat.name: Prowler's Pick
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When you strike an enemy from behind or from stealth, you pilfer a piece of its loot into the party's spoils before it dies.
Each enemy can be pilfered only once.
This is a stealth and evasion effect.
cat.tag: This is a stealth and evasion effect.

cataclysm.name: Ruin's Yield
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When enemies die in quick succession close together, the ruin leaves a cache of additional loot, and the ground there shakes, staggering nearby enemies.
The cache can form once per fight.
This is an annihilation and area effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an annihilation and area effect.

cattle.name: Herdstock
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Beasts that fall yield hides among their additional loot, and each one hardens the party: allies near you take slightly less damage for a short time.
This applies only to beasts, and the effect does not stack.
This is a protection and harvest effect.
cattle.tag: This is a protection and harvest effect.

chain.name: Chainbound Bounty
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy dies, a chain of its additional loot whips out to the nearest living enemy, binding its movement briefly.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
chain.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

chaotic.name: Wild Windfall
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each drop of additional loot is unpredictable: sometimes a rich drop, sometimes a burst that gives a random boon to a nearby ally or a random affliction to a nearby enemy.
A burst can occur once every few seconds at most.
This is a transmutation and affliction effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a transmutation and affliction effect.

charlatan.name: Skimmed Purse
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When you strike an enemy that is confused or attacking someone else, you lift a skimmed share of its loot into the party's spoils and slip briefly from its notice.
Each enemy can be skimmed only once per fight.
This is a stealth and harvest effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a stealth and harvest effect.

chicken.name: Scratched Gleanings
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When you finish an enemy, you peck through its remains, turning up a small extra drop and gaining a brief burst of haste.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a harvest and haste effect.
chicken.tag: This is a harvest and haste effect.

chimera.name: Patchwork Spoils
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot from each kind of enemy grants you a fragment of its nature: a minor bonus to damage of that enemy's strongest type.
Fragments from different kinds can be held together, and each fades after a short time.
This is a transformation effect.
chimera.tag: This is a transformation effect.

claw.name: Rending Claim
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Your claw strikes tear loose scraps of loot as you fight. An enemy you have rended bleeds briefly and drops a little extra loot when it falls.
Each enemy can be rended only once per fight.
This is a harvest and affliction effect.
claw.tag: This is a harvest and affliction effect.

cloth.name: Gleaner's Sash
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot is caught up in fluttering cloth that wraps the nearest ally, absorbing a small amount of damage.
A wrap lasts a short time and does not stack.
This is a protection and shield effect.
cloth.tag: This is a protection and shield effect.

cloud.name: Silver Lining
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls, its additional loot rises as a drifting silver cloud that settles over allies beneath it, softening the next hit they take.
A cloud can form once every short while.
This is a protection and wind effect.
cloud.tag: This is a protection and wind effect.

cold.name: Rimed Spoils
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies slain while chilled or frozen drop additional loot sealed in frost. When the frost cracks, it chills nearby enemies and slows them briefly.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a frost and cold effect.
cold.tag: This is a frost and cold effect.

coral.name: Reefgrown Hoard
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot left on the ground grows a crust of coral over a short time. Allies standing near crusted loot take slightly less damage.
Only the latest drops grow coral, and it crumbles when the fight ends.
This is a growth and protection effect.
coral.tag: This is a growth and protection effect.

corrupt.name: Tainted Plunder
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies that die while cursed drop additional loot that carries the curse onward, leaping it to the nearest enemy for a short time.
The curse can leap once every few seconds and weakens with each leap.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

crocodile.name: Death Roll Spoils
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy dies while held or slowed by you, you tear away a richer share of its additional loot and recover a little stamina.
This applies once to each enemy.
This is a hunting and harvest effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a hunting and harvest effect.

crystal.name: Gemcutter's Find
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot sometimes includes a raw crystal. When it drops, it refracts light into a brief barrier around the nearest ally.
The barrier can form once every short while.
This is a barrier and light effect.
crystal.tag: This is a barrier and light effect.

cycle.name: Seeded Spoils
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each fight's additional loot seeds the next: the first enemy defeated in the following fight drops a richer share, and you recover a little mana as it falls.
If an ally falls during a fight, the seed is lost.
This is a time and harvest effect.
cycle.tag: This is a time and harvest effect.

dance.name: Victor's Twirl
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls near you, you spin through its additional loot, gaining a brief boon of evasion.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is an evasion and movement effect.
dance.tag: This is an evasion and movement effect.

dark.name: Shadow Purse
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies defeated while blinded or wreathed in shadow drop additional loot wrapped in darkness. The darkness clings to you, making you harder to target for a short time.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a shadow and darkness effect.
dark.tag: This is a shadow and darkness effect.

dawn.name: Daybreak Dividend
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
The first enemy defeated in each fight drops additional loot that flares with dawn light, healing allies nearby and searing undead close to it.
This happens once per fight.
This is a light and radiant effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and radiant effect.

death.name: Grave Dividend
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy dies, a wisp of its life force joins its additional loot, and you draw the wisp in to recover a little mana.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a death and restoration effect.
death.tag: This is a death and restoration effect.

deep.name: Sunken Cache
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot from each fight sinks out of sight into a hidden cache that surfaces with a deeper share when the fight ends. While the cache is gathering, you resist being pushed or pulled.
The cache is lost if you fall before the fight ends.
This is a defensive and harvest effect.
deep.tag: This is a defensive and harvest effect.

deer.name: Antler Gleaning
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When you defeat an enemy, its additional loot is shed at your feet and you bound clear of the remains, gaining a brief burst of movement speed.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
deer.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

desolate.name: Barren Harvest
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy dies, its additional loot drains the ground around it, weakening enemies who stand there for a short time.
Drained ground can form once every short while, and allies are not affected by it.
This is an affliction and area effect.
desolate.tag: This is an affliction and area effect.

dimension.name: Folded Spoils
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot slips through a fold in space straight to the party's spoils. As each fold closes, you blink a short distance away from the nearest enemy.
The blink can happen once every short while.
This is a movement and travel effect.
dimension.tag: This is a movement and travel effect.

discord.name: Squabbler's Share
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls, nearby enemies quarrel over its additional loot and briefly turn their attacks on each other.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a sound and command effect.
discord.tag: This is a sound and command effect.

discordant.name: Jarring Windfall
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot lands with a clashing ring that disrupts the casting of enemies nearby for a short time.
The ring can sound once every few seconds.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
discordant.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

dog.name: Loyal Retrieval
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an ally defeats an enemy, you sniff out a scrap of loot they missed, and your next attack against the nearest enemy deals slightly more damage.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a tracking and hunting effect.
dog.tag: This is a tracking and hunting effect.

doom.name: Foretold Plunder
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You mark the enemy most likely to fall next. If it dies while marked, its additional loot is richer and the mark passes to another enemy.
The mark fades after a short time and can be placed once every short while.
This is a curse and precognition effect.
doom.tag: This is a curse and precognition effect.

doppelganger.name: Borrowed Guise
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy you helped defeat drops additional loot, you briefly take on its likeness, and enemies of its kind hesitate before attacking you.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a transformation and stealth effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a transformation and stealth effect.

dragon.name: Wyrm's Hoard
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot gathered in a fight builds into a hoard you guard. As the hoard grows, you gain slight resistance to all damage.
The resistance stops growing at a cap that scales with rank, and the hoard's protection ends with the fight.
This is a defensive and harvest effect.
dragon.tag: This is a defensive and harvest effect.

duck.name: Bobbing Recovery
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot that would be lost to fire, ruin or a collapsing battlefield bobs back up and reaches the party's spoils. Each time this happens, a nearby ally shakes off a slow.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a salvage and restoration effect.
duck.tag: This is a salvage and restoration effect.

dust.name: Dustfall Spoils
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Defeated enemies crumble partly to dust beside their additional loot. The dust hangs in the air briefly, blinding enemies who move through it.
A cloud can form once every few seconds.
This is an affliction and area effect.
dust.tag: This is an affliction and area effect.

earth.name: Buried Riches
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls, its additional loot sinks into the earth and raises a low ridge of stone where it fell, shielding allies behind it for a short time.
A ridge can rise once every short while.
This is a barrier and protection effect.
earth.tag: This is a barrier and protection effect.

echo.name: Echoing Spoils
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls, the sound of its loot echoes on: the next enemy of the same kind defeated soon after drops a matching share.
The echo fades after a short time.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
echo.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

eclipse.name: Eclipsed Reward
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls, a brief eclipse covers its additional loot. Allies near the drop are harder to target, and enemies near it take slightly more light and shadow damage.
This happens once per fight.
This is a light and shadow effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a light and shadow effect.

edifice.name: Spoils Cairn
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot stacks itself into a cairn where an enemy falls. Allies sheltering beside the cairn take less damage from ranged attacks.
Only the latest cairn stands, and it crumbles when the fight ends.
This is a barrier and protection effect.
edifice.tag: This is a barrier and protection effect.

effigy.name: Trophy Effigy
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an elite enemy falls, its additional loot forms a crude effigy of it that draws enemy attacks for a short time.
This happens once per fight, and the effigy breaks when struck hard.
This is a conjuration and protection effect.
effigy.tag: This is a conjuration and protection effect.

elemental.name: Elemental Tithe
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies slain by elemental damage drop additional loot attuned to that element, granting you brief resistance to it.
Only the latest attunement is held.
This is a transmutation and defensive effect.
elemental.tag: This is a transmutation and defensive effect.

elixir.name: Bottled Bounty
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot sometimes includes a minor healing draught, which you pass at once to the most wounded ally nearby.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a healing and alchemy effect.
elixir.tag: This is a healing and alchemy effect.

empower.name: Victor's Spark
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy you helped defeat drops additional loot, the ally who landed the killing blow gains a brief boon of increased damage.
The boon does not stack and can be granted once every few seconds.
This is a support and might effect.
empower.tag: This is a support and might effect.

eye.name: Appraiser's Gaze
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You see what each enemy carries. Your attacks against an enemy bearing rare drops reveal its weaknesses, and the party deals slightly more damage to it for a short time.
This applies once to each enemy.
This is a revelation and perception effect.
eye.tag: This is a revelation and perception effect.

feast.name: Victor's Feast
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Fallen enemies yield edible spoils. Each time an enemy falls, you and allies near you recover a little stamina.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a restoration and harvest effect.
feast.tag: This is a restoration and harvest effect.

feeble.name: Gleaner of the Weak
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
An enemy weakened by your afflictions sheds a little loot each time you strike it, and each such strike saps its strength a little further.
The shedding stops after a short time for each enemy.
This is an affliction and harvest effect.
feeble.tag: This is an affliction and harvest effect.

fertile.name: Fertile Ground
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Where an enemy falls, its additional loot seeds the ground, and a patch of growth springs up that slowly heals allies standing in it.
Only the latest patch grows, and it withers after a short time.
This is a growth and healing effect.
fertile.tag: This is a growth and healing effect.

fey.name: Fey Bargain
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
The first time an enemy falls in each fight, the fey take a tithe of its loot and leave a blessing: a random ally gains brief evasion and haste.
This happens once per fight.
This is an evasion and haste effect.
fey.tag: This is an evasion and haste effect.

fire.name: Smouldering Spoils
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies slain while burning drop additional loot that still smoulders. The embers ignite enemies who step near them.
Embers can form once every few seconds and burn out after a short time.
This is a fire and burn effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire and burn effect.

firebird.name: Ember Rebirth
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an ally falls, the additional loot gathered so far in that fight flares into flame, and the ally rises with a portion of their health restored.
This can happen once per fight, and the burned loot is lost from the party's spoils.
This is a rebirth and fire effect.
firebird.tag: This is a rebirth and fire effect.

fish.name: Shoal of Scraps
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each enemy that falls releases a shoal of glinting scraps that swirls around allies nearby, making enemy attacks against them miss slightly more often.
The shoal lasts a short time and can form once every short while.
This is an evasion and swarm effect.
fish.tag: This is an evasion and swarm effect.

flea.name: Hopping Haul
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls, you leap to the nearest living enemy, and your first attack on it pries loose a little extra loot.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a movement and harvest effect.
flea.tag: This is a movement and harvest effect.

flesh.name: Knitting Spoils
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Living enemies drop raw flesh among their additional loot, and it knits into your wounds, recovering health over a short time.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
flesh.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

foot.name: Unbroken Stride
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You never break stride to gather. Moving across additional loot grants you a brief burst of movement speed and recovers a little stamina.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a movement and travel effect.
foot.tag: This is a movement and travel effect.

force.name: Jarring Toll
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When you knock an enemy back or down, a scrap of its loot is jarred loose. An enemy that dies while knocked down yields a richer share.
Each enemy sheds loot this way only once.
This is a momentum and harvest effect.
force.tag: This is a momentum and harvest effect.

forge.name: Forge-Hot Scrap
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Scrap metal among the additional loot glows forge-hot, and you press it to the nearest ally's weapon, adding slight fire damage to their attacks for a short time.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a fire and support effect.
forge.tag: This is a fire and support effect.

fork.name: Forked Share
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls, its additional loot splits, and a portion strikes out at the nearest other enemy as a forked lash of force.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is an area and harvest effect.
fork.tag: This is an area and harvest effect.

fortress.name: Treasury Keep
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
While you hold your position, additional loot dropped near you walls itself in around you, granting you a growing shield.
The shield caps with rank and breaks when you move.
This is a protection and barrier effect.
fortress.tag: This is a protection and barrier effect.

fox.name: Fox's Cut
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies that fall while taunted by an ally or fooled by an illusion drop a richer share of additional loot, and you slip briefly from the notice of enemies nearby.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a stealth and evasion effect.
fox.tag: This is a stealth and evasion effect.

frog.name: Tongue-Snatched Prize
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You snap up additional loot from a distance with a lashing tongue, and each snatch licks a weak poison onto the nearest enemy.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a poison and harvest effect.
frog.tag: This is a poison and harvest effect.

fungus.name: Mycelial Harvest
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies that fall sprout fungus among their additional loot. Its spores spread a weak rot to enemies nearby and slowly feed you health.
Only the latest bloom spreads spores, and it fades after a short time.
This is a poison and growth effect.
fungus.tag: This is a poison and growth effect.

garuda.name: Serpent-Bane Plunder
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Serpents, reptiles and venomous enemies yield a rich share of additional loot, and each one's death stirs a gust that clears poison from allies nearby.
The gust can rise once every short while.
This is a wind and purification effect.
garuda.tag: This is a wind and purification effect.

gate.name: Gatekeeper's Toll
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies that join a fight as reinforcements or through a portal pay a toll of additional loot when they fall, and the first such enemy each fight is slowed as it crosses in.
The slow happens once per fight.
This is a travel and restraint effect.
gate.tag: This is a travel and restraint effect.

gathering.name: Gatherer's Pull
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot from every enemy the party defeats drifts toward you, and as it gathers you recover a little mana.
The mana recovery can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a harvesting and restoration effect.
gathering.tag: This is a harvesting and restoration effect.

glass.name: Shard Plunder
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot shatters like glass as it lands, spraying shards that cut enemies nearby and leave them bleeding briefly.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is an affliction and area effect.
glass.tag: This is an affliction and area effect.

glimeron.name: Glimmering Trove
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot glimmers with shifting light. Allies near a glimmering drop are veiled for a short time, and ranged attacks against them often go astray.
A veil can form once every short while.
This is a light and evasion effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a light and evasion effect.

goat.name: Chewed Clean
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies that fall while poisoned or diseased still yield clean loot, and you chew through the tainted part, shaking off an affliction of your own.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a purification and harvest effect.
goat.tag: This is a purification and harvest effect.

gorgon.name: Petrified Trophy
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies that die while slowed or stunned by you are partly turned to stone, leaving a statue beside their additional loot that blocks enemy movement.
Only the latest statue stands, and it crumbles after a short time.
This is a restraint and transformation effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a restraint and transformation effect.

griffin.name: Griffin's Claim
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You claim the richest enemy in each fight. You gain movement speed while closing on it, and its additional loot is richer when it falls.
You claim a quarry once per fight.
This is a hunting and tracking effect.
griffin.tag: This is a hunting and tracking effect.

growth.name: Burgeoning Spoils
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each enemy the party defeats makes the next drop grow richer, and the swelling bounty slowly raises your maximum health for the rest of the fight.
The bonus caps with rank and fades when the fight ends.
This is a growth effect.
growth.tag: This is a growth effect.

guardian.name: Warden of Spoils
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an ally near you is struck by an enemy carrying rare drops, you take part of the damage in their place, and that enemy yields additional loot when it falls.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a protection and defensive effect.
guardian.tag: This is a protection and defensive effect.

hair.name: Tangled Spoils
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot is bound up in strands that tangle the feet of enemies nearby, slowing them briefly.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
hair.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

hammer.name: Shattering Toll
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When you defeat an enemy with a heavy blow, it breaks apart into additional loot, and the shock staggers enemies beside it.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is an annihilation and area effect.
hammer.tag: This is an annihilation and area effect.

hand.name: Deft Gleaning
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You pluck additional loot cleanly from every fallen enemy, and each time you do, your next ability costs slightly less.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a mastery and harvest effect.
hand.tag: This is a mastery and harvest effect.

harmonic.name: Resonant Riches
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot rings with a tone tuned to the party. Each drop sounds a chord that briefly raises the healing allies receive.
The chord does not stack and can sound once every few seconds.
This is a resonance and healing effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a resonance and healing effect.

harpy.name: Shrieking Snatch
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls, you lunge in to snatch its additional loot with a shriek that briefly frightens the enemy nearest to it.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a sound and harvest effect.
harpy.tag: This is a sound and harvest effect.

harvest.name: Reaped Bounty
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Every enemy the party defeats yields a fuller harvest, and the more enemies fall in a fight, the more health your attacks recover.
The healing caps with rank and resets each fight.
This is a harvest and healing effect.
harvest.tag: This is a harvest and healing effect.

heidel.name: Hearthbound Share
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot carries a warm glow. Each time an enemy falls, allies near you shrug off cold and fear for a short time.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a support and protection effect.
heidel.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

hook.name: Hooked Plunder
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy you have hooked dies, its additional loot is reeled to you, and the line drags the nearest enemy a short distance toward you.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a binding and harvest effect.
hook.tag: This is a binding and harvest effect.

horse.name: Packhorse Stamina
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You bear the party's spoils with ease. Each enemy defeated grants you movement speed and stamina recovery that build as more fall.
The bonus caps with rank and resets when the fight ends.
This is a travel and movement effect.
horse.tag: This is a travel and movement effect.

hunger.name: Ravenous Share
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each enemy that falls feeds your hunger with a sliver of its additional loot, granting you a brief boon of increased attack speed.
The boon stacks a little with each kill, caps with rank, and fades quickly when kills stop.
This is a harvest and haste effect.
hunger.tag: This is a harvest and haste effect.

hunt.name: Quarry's Toll
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You mark the enemy you are attacking as your quarry. If the quarry falls, its additional loot is richer and you recover a little stamina.
Only the latest quarry carries the mark.
This is a hunting and tracking effect.
hunt.tag: This is a hunting and tracking effect.

hydra.name: Many-Headed Spoils
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies that rise again, split or summon others yield additional loot from every form they take, and each form that falls restores a little of your health.
The healing can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a harvest and restoration effect.
hydra.tag: This is a harvest and restoration effect.

ice.name: Frozen Assets
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot lands encased in ice, and the ice spreads a brief sheet across the ground that slows enemies crossing it.
A sheet can form once every short while.
This is an ice and restraint effect.
ice.tag: This is an ice and restraint effect.

immortal.name: Undying Tithe
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When you would fall, the additional loot you have gathered in that fight is spent to keep you standing with a sliver of health.
This can happen once per fight, and the spent loot is lost from the party's spoils.
This is a rebirth and protection effect.
immortal.tag: This is a rebirth and protection effect.

iron.name: Ironbound Spoils
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each enemy that falls near you lends you a sliver of its armour along with its additional loot, raising your resistance to physical damage for a short time.
The bonus caps with rank and does not refresh while it is active.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
iron.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

juggernaut.name: Trampled Plunder
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
While you are charging or pushing through enemies, any enemy that falls in your path spills its additional loot, and you cannot be slowed for a short time.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a momentum and harvest effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a momentum and harvest effect.

karmic.name: Earned Fortune
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies that fall after harming a downed or helpless ally yield a richer share of additional loot, and their death returns a portion of the harm they did to the ally they wronged as healing.
This can happen once per enemy.
This is a healing and curse effect.
karmic.tag: This is a healing and curse effect.

knife.name: Skinner's Cut
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Your precise cuts carve the best parts from enemies as they fall, turning common drops into finer materials and leaving the nearest enemy bleeding briefly.
The bleed can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a harvest and affliction effect.
knife.tag: This is a harvest and affliction effect.

knowledge.name: Learned Yield
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each time you help defeat an enemy kind you have studied before, its additional loot is richer, and the party deals slightly more damage to that kind for the rest of the fight.
The damage bonus applies to the first kind studied each fight.
This is a revelation and mastery effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a revelation and mastery effect.

kraken.name: Grasping Depths
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls, grasping tendrils rise from beneath its additional loot and seize the nearest enemy, holding it in place briefly.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
kraken.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

leviathan.name: Leviathan's Wake
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Large enemies that fall send out a heavy wave of additional loot that knocks smaller enemies nearby off their feet.
This happens only for large or elite enemies, once every short while.
This is a water and area effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water and area effect.

life.name: Living Dividend
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each time additional loot drops, a pulse of life passes from it to the most wounded ally nearby, healing them slightly.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
life.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

light.name: Radiant Reward
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot shines as it drops, revealing hidden enemies nearby and dealing light damage to undead and shadow creatures close to it.
The light can flare once every few seconds.
This is a light and revelation effect.
light.tag: This is a light and revelation effect.

lightning.name: Arcing Windfall
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot hums with stored charge. When it drops, it arcs lightning to the nearest enemy and jumps once to another close by.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a lightning and storm effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and storm effect.

lizard.name: Shed Scales
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When you take a heavy hit, you shed a layer of scales into the party's spoils and recover health over a short time.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
lizard.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

locust.name: Stripping Swarm
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls, a cloud of locusts strips its remains for additional loot, then descends on the nearest enemy and chews at it for a short time.
The swarm can rise once every short while.
This is a swarm and harvest effect.
locust.tag: This is a swarm and harvest effect.

lotus.name: Lotus Offering
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot blossoms into a lotus where an enemy falls. Allies standing near the lotus recover mana slowly and resist being disrupted while casting.
Only the latest lotus blooms, and it closes after a short time.
This is a restoration and support effect.
lotus.tag: This is a restoration and support effect.

lurker.name: Lurker's Take
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
While you have not attacked for a short time, you wait unseen, and the first enemy you strike after waiting drops a richer share of additional loot when it falls.

This is a stealth and hunting effect.
lurker.tag: This is a stealth and hunting effect.

magic.name: Spellshed Spoils

Enemies slain by spells leave arcane residue among their additional loot. You absorb the residue, recovering a little mana.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a restoration and mastery effect.
magic.tag: This is a restoration and mastery effect.

malign.name: Spiteful Spoils
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls, its additional loot carries a lingering malice that curses the nearest enemy, making it take slightly more damage for a short time.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

manatee.name: Gentle Gleaning
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each time an enemy falls, you drift calmly to its additional loot and steady the allies around it, who take slightly less damage for a short time.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a protection and support effect.
manatee.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

manticore.name: Barbed Tribute
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies that fall while poisoned by you drop barbed spines among their additional loot, which fire at the nearest enemy and poison it in turn.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a poison and hunting effect.
manticore.tag: This is a poison and hunting effect.

master.name: Master's Portion
