The more cleanly the party fights, the richer its spoils: while no ally has fallen in a fight, each enemy defeated yields a growing share of additional loot.
The growth caps with rank and is lost the moment an ally falls.
This is a mastery and harvest effect.
master.tag: This is a mastery and harvest effect.

might.name: Strongarm Haul
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When you defeat an enemy with a melee blow, you heave its remains aside for a richer share of loot and gain a brief surge of strength.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a might and harvest effect.
might.tag: This is a might and harvest effect.

ministration.name: Tended Spoils
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each time additional loot drops, you tend to the ally nearest to it, cleansing a minor affliction and healing them slightly.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a healing and purification effect.
ministration.tag: This is a healing and purification effect.

minotaur.name: Labyrinth Toll
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When you charge an enemy and it falls soon after, it yields a richer share of additional loot, and enemies near it are staggered by your bellow.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a momentum and sound effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a momentum and sound effect.

mirage.name: Phantom Hoard
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls, a false glitter of loot appears beside the real drop and lures enemies nearby toward it for a short time.
The lure can form once every short while.
This is a stealth and command effect.
mirage.tag: This is a stealth and command effect.

mirror.name: Reflected Reward
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an ally defeats an enemy, a reflection of its additional loot reaches you, and you gain a brief copy of any boon that ally holds.
This can trigger once every short while, and the copied boon lasts a short time.
This is a support and transformation effect.
mirror.tag: This is a support and transformation effect.

monkey.name: Nimble Fingers
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You swipe loot from enemies mid-fight. Your quick attacks have a chance to snatch a scrap into the party's spoils and leave the enemy briefly distracted.
Each enemy can be robbed only once.
This is a harvest and evasion effect.
monkey.tag: This is a harvest and evasion effect.

monolith.name: Standing Stone Trove
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
The first elite enemy to fall in a fight leaves a standing stone among its additional loot. Allies near the stone resist knockback and take slightly less damage.
The stone stands once per fight and crumbles after a short time.
This is a protection and defensive effect.
monolith.tag: This is a protection and defensive effect.

moon.name: Moonlit Gleaning
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot is touched with pale moonlight, and allies who stand in the glow regain a little mana and are harder to target for a short time.
The glow can form once every short while.
This is a light and stealth effect.
moon.tag: This is a light and stealth effect.

mouse.name: Crumb Gatherer
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Even the weakest enemies yield a few crumbs of additional loot, and each crumb you gather makes you briefly harder for enemies to notice.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a stealth and harvest effect.
mouse.tag: This is a stealth and harvest effect.

myriad.name: Myriad Spoils
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Swarming and lesser enemies yield their additional loot as a scatter of small pieces. Each piece gathered grants allies nearby a sliver of attack speed.
The bonus caps with rank and fades after a short time.
This is a swarm and haste effect.
myriad.tag: This is a swarm and haste effect.

mystic.name: Mystic Tithe
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot is threaded with mystic power. When it drops, the ability on your longest cooldown recovers slightly.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a mastery and restoration effect.
mystic.tag: This is a mastery and restoration effect.

nebula.name: Stardust Spoils
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot falls wrapped in a haze of stardust that spreads across the area, dazzling enemies inside it so their attacks go astray.
The haze can form once every short while and drifts apart after a short time.
This is an area and light effect.
nebula.tag: This is an area and light effect.

needle.name: Pinpoint Yield
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Your precise strikes find the weak points of enemies carrying rare drops. Critical hits against them pry loose a sliver of loot and pierce their armour briefly.
Each enemy can be pierced this way once every short while.
This is a hunting and precision effect.
needle.tag: This is a hunting and precision effect.

nemesis.name: Rival's Ransom
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You pick out the strongest enemy in a fight as your rival. You deal slightly more damage to your rival, and it yields a rich ransom of additional loot when it falls.
You choose a rival once per fight.
This is a hunting and curse effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a hunting and curse effect.

net.name: Dragnet Spoils
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot is drawn together in a net that settles over the enemy nearest the drop, entangling it for a short time.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
net.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

network.name: Linked Bounty
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Your bounty links the party: whenever any ally defeats an enemy, every ally linked to you recovers a little stamina as its additional loot drops.
The link reaches only allies within a moderate distance and can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a support and restoration effect.
network.tag: This is a support and restoration effect.

oasis.name: Wellspring Spoils
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Where an enemy falls, its additional loot draws up a small spring. Allies standing in it recover health and stamina slowly.
Only the latest spring flows, and it dries after a short time.
This is a water and healing effect.
oasis.tag: This is a water and healing effect.

ocean.name: Tidewrack Bounty
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot washes in on a tide that rolls outward from the fallen enemy, pushing enemies back and clearing burning from allies it reaches.
The tide can roll once every short while.
This is a water and purification effect.
ocean.tag: This is a water and purification effect.

octopus.name: Reaching Arms
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You gather additional loot from every fallen enemy within reach at once, and each piece gathered lets you slip a grip or slow.
Freeing yourself this way can happen once every short while.
This is a harvest and evasion effect.
octopus.tag: This is a harvest and evasion effect.

omen.name: Portent of Plenty
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
At the start of each fight, you read which enemy will yield the richest loot. Allies who strike that enemy first gain a brief boon of increased damage.
The portent is read once per fight.
This is a precognition and revelation effect.
omen.tag: This is a precognition and revelation effect.

onslaught.name: Relentless Plunder
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each enemy you help defeat in quick succession yields a richer share of additional loot and grants you a stacking boon of attack speed.
The chain breaks if you go a short time without a kill, and the boon caps with rank.
This is a momentum and haste effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a momentum and haste effect.

pangolin.name: Armoured Hoard
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When you are struck hard, you curl around the additional loot you carry, gaining heavy damage reduction for a moment while you cannot attack.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

paper.name: Paper Promissory
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot comes wrapped in paper slips that flutter to allies nearby and fold into a thin shield around each.
A slip shield breaks after absorbing a small hit and can form once every short while.
This is a shield and conjuration effect.
paper.tag: This is a shield and conjuration effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Dreamstuff Spoils
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls, its additional loot shimmers into an illusion of treasure that leaves enemies nearby confused for a short time.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is an affliction and transformation effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is an affliction and transformation effect.

phoenix.name: Ashen Renewal
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls, a spark of flame rises from its additional loot and settles on the most wounded ally, healing them and burning enemies beside them.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a fire and healing effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a fire and healing effect.

plant.name: Seedling Spoils
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot falls with a seed that sprouts grasping roots, slowing enemies who walk through them.
Only the latest roots grow, and they wither after a short time.
This is a nature and restraint effect.
plant.tag: This is a nature and restraint effect.

potent.name: Potent Yield
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot from enemies slain by your strongest abilities is of finer quality, and each such kill briefly strengthens your next ability.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a mastery and harvest effect.
potent.tag: This is a mastery and harvest effect.

predatory.name: Predator's Portion
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You hunt down wounded enemies: you move faster toward enemies below a portion of their health, and those you finish yield a richer share of additional loot.
The bonus applies while the enemy is wounded and resets when it falls.
This is a hunting and tracking effect.
predatory.tag: This is a hunting and tracking effect.

prison.name: Jailer's Fee
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies that die while trapped, rooted or held pay a jailer's fee of additional loot, and the hold passes briefly to the nearest enemy.
The hold can pass once every short while.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
prison.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

prosperity.name: Golden Season
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
While the party's health is high, each enemy defeated yields a richer share of additional loot, and allies near you recover a little mana as it drops.
The mana recovery can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a support and harvest effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a support and harvest effect.

pure.name: Purified Spoils
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot is cleansed of taint as it drops, and the cleansing washes over the nearest ally, removing a minor affliction.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a purification effect.
pure.tag: This is a purification effect.

rabbit.name: Rabbit's Luck
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls, you dart to its additional loot and away again, gaining a brief burst of speed and evasion.
This can trigger once every few seconds.

verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot greens the ground around it with fresh growth that slowly heals allies and entangles enemies who linger.
Only the latest patch grows, and it fades after a short time.
This is a growth and healing effect.
verdant.tag: This is a growth and healing effect.

vessel.name: Brimming Vessel
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You hold a portion of each fight's additional loot as stored power. When an ally falls low on health, you pour the vessel out to heal them.
The vessel pours once per fight and refills as more enemies fall.
This is a healing and support effect.
vessel.tag: This is a healing and support effect.

visage.name: Trophy Mask
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an elite enemy falls, you take a mask from its additional loot. While masked, you strike fear into lesser enemies of its kind, making them hesitate.
You wear only the latest mask, and it fades after a short time.
This is a transformation and command effect.
visage.tag: This is a transformation and command effect.

vision.name: Farseer's Claim
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You foresee where loot will fall. Moments before an enemy dies, you call it out, and allies who strike it in those moments gain a brief burst of speed.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a precognition and haste effect.
vision.tag: This is a precognition and haste effect.

void.name: Void Tithe
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
The void takes a cut of each enemy's additional loot and pays it back as a brief hollow around you that swallows enemy projectiles.
The hollow can form once every short while.
This is a darkness and protection effect.
void.tag: This is a darkness and protection effect.

volcano.name: Molten Plunder
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Large enemies that fall erupt with molten additional loot, spattering burning slag across enemies nearby.
This happens only for large or elite enemies, once every short while.
This is a fire and area effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and area effect.

vortex.name: Whirling Spoils
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot spins into a small vortex that drags enemies nearby toward the drop for a short time.
The vortex can form once every short while.
This is a wind and restraint effect.
vortex.tag: This is a wind and restraint effect.

wasp.name: Stinging Tithe
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Enemies that fall to you release a few angry wasps from their additional loot, and the wasps sting the nearest enemy with a weak poison.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a swarm and poison effect.
wasp.tag: This is a swarm and poison effect.

water.name: Tidepool Spoils
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot splashes into a shallow pool that douses burning allies and slowly restores health to any ally standing in it.
Only the latest pool lingers, and it dries after a short time.
This is a water and healing effect.
water.tag: This is a water and healing effect.

weave.name: Woven Fortune
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each enemy defeated adds a strand to a weave of fortune around the party. When the weave is full, the next hit on each ally is softened.
The weave fills once per fight and frays when the fight ends.
This is a protection and binding effect.
weave.tag: This is a protection and binding effect.

wendigo.name: Starving Take
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You devour a portion of each enemy's additional loot, recovering health and chilling enemies nearby with your cold hunger.
This can trigger once every short while, and devoured loot never reaches the party's spoils.
This is a cold and healing effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and healing effect.

whale.name: Leviathan Feast
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When the largest enemy in a fight falls, its additional loot sustains the party for a long while, healing all allies slowly over time.
This happens once per fight.
This is a healing and harvest effect.
whale.tag: This is a healing and harvest effect.

wheel.name: Fortune Wheel
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each enemy defeated turns a wheel of fortune that grants you a rotating boon of damage, defence or speed for a short time.
The wheel turns once every few seconds at most.
This is a momentum and support effect.
wheel.tag: This is a momentum and support effect.

whip.name: Lashed Spoils
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
You crack your whip to snatch additional loot from a distance, and the crack stings the nearest enemy, interrupting its attack.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a restraint and harvest effect.
whip.tag: This is a restraint and harvest effect.

wind.name: Windborne Spoils
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot rides a gust to you, and the gust pushes enemies near the drop back a short distance.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a wind and movement effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and movement effect.

wing.name: Featherfall Spoils
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot drifts down on feathers that settle on allies nearby, letting them dodge the next attack more easily.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is an evasion and protection effect.
wing.tag: This is an evasion and protection effect.

wolf.name: Wolfpack Bounty
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an enemy falls to the combined attacks of you and an ally, it yields a richer share of additional loot and both of you gain a brief boon of attack speed.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a hunting and support effect.
wolf.tag: This is a hunting and support effect.

wood.name: Timber Spoils
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Additional loot falls in a bundle of hardwood that you raise as a brief palisade between allies and the nearest enemy.
The palisade can rise once every short while.
This is a barrier and nature effect.
wood.tag: This is a barrier and nature effect.

wrath.name: Spoils of Fury
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When an ally is struck hard, your fury drives you at their attacker, and if it falls to you soon after, it yields a richer share of additional loot.
You gain this fury once every short while.
This is a hunting and might effect.
wrath.tag: This is a hunting and might effect.

zeal.name: Zealot's Tithe
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
Each enemy you help defeat fuels your zeal, granting a stacking boon of damage that also strengthens the healing you give.
The boon caps with rank and fades when you go a short time without a kill.
This is a holy and support effect.
zeal.tag: This is a holy and support effect.

ziz.name: Skyshadow Bounty
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Bounty]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Bounty].
When the largest enemy in a fight falls, a vast shadow of wings passes over the party, and its additional loot rains down, shielding every ally briefly.
This happens once per fight.
This is a shadow and shield effect.
ziz.tag: This is a shadow and shield effect.

action.name: Ready Upkeep
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
Starting a maintained ability in the middle of a fight costs no upfront mana; its upkeep begins a moment later.
This can happen once every short while, and only for abilities the holder starts while moving or attacking.
This is a haste and mastery effect.
action.tag: This is a haste and mastery effect.

adept.name: Practised Channel
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
The longer the holder keeps a maintained ability running without interruption, the lower its upkeep becomes, down to a floor that scales with rank.
The reduction resets if the ability is dropped or the holder is stunned.
This is a mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Distilled Reserve
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
When an enemy effect drains the holder's mana, a portion of the stolen mana condenses into a reserve that pays the holder's upkeep costs first.
The reserve fades at the end of the fight and holds only a small amount.
This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.

ambush.name: Silent Upkeep
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
While the holder is unseen or has not yet been noticed in a fight, maintained abilities cost no upkeep.
The effect ends the moment the holder attacks or is detected, and returns only after a short time out of sight.
This is a stealth effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth effect.

animate.name: Self-Tending Spells
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
A maintained ability can keep itself going for a short time after the holder is stunned, silenced or knocked down, paying its own upkeep from a small store of mana.
This can happen once per fight for each maintained ability.
This is an animation and mastery effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and mastery effect.

anzu.name: Stormwind Sustain
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
While the holder stands in a storm or wind effect, maintained abilities draw their upkeep partly from the storm, costing slightly less mana.
When an enemy tries to drain the holder's mana, a gust knocks that enemy back; this has a cooldown.
This is a storm and wind effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and wind effect.

ape.name: Stubborn Channel
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
Taking heavy physical hits does not break the holder's maintained abilities; each heavy hit instead adds a small mana charge to their upkeep.
The added charge clears after a short time without being hit.
This is a defensive effect.
ape.tag: This is a defensive effect.

armour.name: Lined Mantle
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
While the holder maintains an ability, their armour is lined with mana that blunts mana drain from melee attacks almost entirely.
Each blunted drain costs the holder a little stamina instead.
This is a defensive and warding effect.
armour.tag: This is a defensive and warding effect.

arsenal.name: Kept Armoury
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
The holder can keep an extra maintained ability running at once, as long as all of their maintained abilities are weapon enchantments or conjured weapons.
The extra ability's upkeep is paid at full cost, without this nature's reduction.
This is a conjuration and mastery effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a conjuration and mastery effect.

aspect.name: Mirrored Upkeep
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
While the holder maintains an ability tied to an aspect or form they have taken, its upkeep is reduced further.
Leaving that form ends the reduction and the form's ability must be paid in full for a short time.
This is a transformation effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation effect.

avatar.name: Exalted Vessel
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
Once per fight, while the holder's health is low, all of their maintained abilities cost no upkeep for a short time.
During that time the holder cannot have their mana drained at all.
This is a transformation and protection effect.
avatar.tag: This is a transformation and protection effect.

axe.name: Severing Edge
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
When an enemy drains the holder's mana, the holder's next axe strike against that enemy cuts the link and returns a portion of the drained mana.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a restoration effect.
axe.tag: This is a restoration effect.

balance.name: Libra's Accord
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
While the holder's health and mana are close to the same fraction of their maximum, maintained abilities cost slightly less upkeep.
When health and mana drift far apart, upkeep returns to its usual cost until they even out.
This is a balance and mastery effect.
balance.tag: This is a balance and mastery effect.

bat.name: Night Wing Channel
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
In darkness, maintained abilities cost less upkeep, and the holder senses any enemy attempting to drain their mana.
In bright light the reduction is lost.
This is a darkness and perception effect.
bat.tag: This is a darkness and perception effect.

battlefield.name: Held Ground Channel
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
Each ally fighting near the holder slightly lowers the upkeep of the holder's maintained auras.
The reduction caps at a level that scales with rank and vanishes if the holder fights alone.
This is a support and area effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a support and area effect.

bear.name: Bruin Endurance
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
While the holder's mana is low, maintained abilities draw part of their upkeep from stamina instead.
If stamina runs out as well, the abilities end as usual.
This is a defensive and restoration effect.
bear.tag: This is a defensive and restoration effect.

bee.name: Hive Tithe
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
Allies near the holder each contribute a tiny trickle of mana toward the holder's maintained abilities.
The trickle stops for any ally whose own mana is low.
This is a swarm and support effect.
bee.tag: This is a swarm and support effect.

behemoth.name: Colossal Reserve
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
The holder's mana pool is unusually hard to drain: each drain effect against them is weakened further for every drain already suffered that fight.
The holder's maintained abilities cost slightly more upkeep while this protection is building.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

bird.name: Skyborne Sustain
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
While the holder keeps moving, maintained abilities cost slightly less upkeep.
Standing still for a short time ends the reduction until the holder moves again.
This is a movement effect.
bird.tag: This is a movement effect.

blight.name: Rot Ward
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
An enemy that drains the holder's mana is afflicted with a creeping blight that withers its own mana regeneration for a short time.
The blight can affect each enemy only once every short while.
This is an affliction and poison effect.
blight.tag: This is an affliction and poison effect.

blood.name: Sanguine Upkeep
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
When mana runs short, the holder can pay a maintained ability's upkeep with health instead of letting it drop.
This only happens while the holder's health is above a safe threshold.
This is a blood and mastery effect.
blood.tag: This is a blood and mastery effect.

bone.name: Marrow Store
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
The holder stores a small reserve of mana in their bones; mana drain empties this reserve before touching their main pool.
The reserve refills slowly while the holder is not being drained.
This is a defensive and necromantic effect.
bone.tag: This is a defensive and necromantic effect.

boundary.name: Sealed Circuit
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
Mana drain cannot reach the holder from outside a short distance; drains from range simply fail.
Drain effects from enemies inside that distance are resisted as usual.
This is a warding and barrier effect.
boundary.tag: This is a warding and barrier effect.

bounty.name: Sated Upkeep
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
When an enemy dies near the holder, the holder's maintained abilities cost no upkeep for a short time.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a harvest effect.
bounty.tag: This is a harvest effect.

bow.name: Drawn Focus
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
While the holder keeps a bow drawn, maintained abilities on their arrows cost slightly less upkeep.
Releasing several shots in quick succession ends the reduction for a short time.
This is a hunting and mastery effect.
bow.tag: This is a hunting and mastery effect.

brush.name: Painted Sigil
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
The holder can paint a lingering sigil under themselves that pays part of their maintained abilities' upkeep while they stand on it.
The sigil fades after a short time and can be painted again after a cooldown.
This is a rune and mastery effect.
brush.tag: This is a rune and mastery effect.

cage.name: Barred Pool
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
An enemy that tries to drain the holder's mana is briefly caught in a cage of the holder's own mana.
This costs the holder a portion of mana and has a cooldown.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
cage.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

cat.name: Idle Grace
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
While the holder is not attacking, maintained abilities cost noticeably less upkeep.
The reduction ends for a short time whenever the holder strikes or casts.
This is a stealth and evasion effect.
cat.tag: This is a stealth and evasion effect.

cataclysm.name: Unbroken Through Ruin
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
Large area attacks cannot break the holder's maintained abilities or drain their mana.
After surviving such an attack, the holder's upkeep is paid at full cost for a short time.
This is a defensive and annihilation effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is a defensive and annihilation effect.

cattle.name: Herd Reserve
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
While allies stand close around the holder, mana drain against the holder is spread thinly across the group and largely shrugged off.
The effect needs allies nearby and does nothing while the holder stands apart.
This is a support and protection effect.
cattle.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

chain.name: Linked Upkeep
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
Maintained abilities the holder keeps running together share their upkeep, each costing slightly less while another is active.
If any linked ability is broken, the others pay full upkeep for a short time.
This is a binding effect.
chain.tag: This is a binding effect.

chaotic.name: Wild Tithe
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
Every so often, a maintained ability's upkeep is waived entirely for a moment; at other times it briefly costs slightly more.
When an enemy drains the holder, the drain sometimes rebounds on the enemy instead.
This is a chaos effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a chaos effect.

charlatan.name: False Reservoir
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
The holder's mana appears empty to enemies, so drain effects against them take only a token amount.
The illusion breaks for a short time after the holder casts a costly ability.
This is a stealth and illusion effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a stealth and illusion effect.

chicken.name: Flustered Ward
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
When an enemy tries to drain the holder's mana, the holder reflexively hops away, breaking the drain before most of it lands.
This has a cooldown and costs a little stamina.
This is an evasion and movement effect.
chicken.tag: This is an evasion and movement effect.

chimera.name: Grafted Upkeep
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
Each different kind of maintained ability the holder keeps running lowers the upkeep of the others slightly.
The holder's mana regeneration slows slightly while this effect is active.
This is a transformation and mastery effect.
chimera.tag: This is a transformation and mastery effect.

claw.name: Clutching Talon
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
The holder's unarmed or claw strikes snag a sliver of mana from the target, which goes straight toward their maintained abilities' upkeep.
This only happens while the holder has a maintained ability active.
This is a harvesting effect.
claw.tag: This is a harvesting effect.

cloth.name: Woven Lining
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
The holder's robes hold a thin weave of mana that absorbs the first mana drain they suffer each fight entirely.
Further drains are resisted as usual, and the weave reforms after resting.
This is a warding and protection effect.
cloth.tag: This is a warding and protection effect.

cloud.name: Drifting Channel
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
Maintained area abilities centred on the holder cost slightly less upkeep while they hang over allies.
Enemies inside a maintained cloud effect find draining the holder harder still.
This is an area and support effect.
cloud.tag: This is an area and support effect.

cold.name: Still Current
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
Mana drained from the holder is chilled, slowing the enemy that took it for a short time.
Maintained frost abilities cost slightly less upkeep.
This is a cold and frost effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and frost effect.

coral.name: Reef Reserve
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
Each time the holder resists a mana drain, a small coral growth of mana forms on them, slightly lowering their upkeep for a short time.
Growths stack only a few times.
This is a growth and defensive effect.
coral.tag: This is a growth and defensive effect.

corrupt.name: Spoiled Wellspring
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
Mana taken from the holder is tainted; the enemy that took it suffers a brief curse that weakens its next ability.
This can happen once every short while for each enemy.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

crocodile.name: Patient Jaws
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
While the holder lies in wait without casting, their maintained abilities cost almost no upkeep.
The holder's first strike after waiting ends the effect and drains a little mana from the target.
This is an ambush and hunting effect.
crocodile.tag: This is an ambush and hunting effect.

crystal.name: Lattice Mind
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
The holder's mana settles into a crystalline lattice that refracts a portion of any drain back into the attacker as a sharp sting.
The lattice cracks for a short time after reflecting.
This is a resonance and protection effect.
crystal.tag: This is a resonance and protection effect.

cycle.name: Turning Upkeep
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Mana Integrity]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Integrity].
When a maintained ability ends naturally, a portion of the mana spent on its upkeep flows back to the holder.
Abilities broken by enemies return nothing.
This is a restoration and time effect.
cycle.tag: This is a restoration and time effect.

dance.name: Measured Step

dog.name: Loyal Reserve

anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder's transcendent damage strikes carry a crack of storm wind that knocks the target back slightly and strips a beneficial effect from it.
Stripping can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a storm and wind effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and wind effect.

ape.name: Brachiate Step
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder's short-range dimension movement can carry it to a spot beside an enemy, and its next melee strike after arriving deals transcendent damage.
The bonus strike applies once per use of the movement ability.
This is a dimension and movement effect.
ape.tag: This is a dimension and movement effect.

armour.name: Starplate Lining
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
While the holder wears armour, dimension and astral attacks against it are reduced by a further portion that scales with rank.
The reduction lapses for a short time after the holder takes a critical hit.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
armour.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

arsenal.name: Rift Armoury
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder reaches into a small dimensional rift to swap weapons mid-fight, and its first strike after a swap deals extra transcendent damage.
Swapping this way has a short cooldown.
This is a dimension and conjuration effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a dimension and conjuration effect.

aspect.name: Celestial Countenance
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
Once per fight, when the holder falls below half health, it takes on a luminous astral aspect for a short time that greatly reduces dimension and astral damage against it.
While the aspect lasts, the holder cannot be healed past half health.
This is a transformation and protection effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation and protection effect.

avatar.name: Starborne Vessel
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
While the holder's mana is high, a faint astral avatar overlaps its body and extends the reach of its transcendent damage strikes.
The avatar drains mana steadily and collapses when mana runs low.
This is an astral and transformation effect.
avatar.tag: This is an astral and transformation effect.

axe.name: Rending Arc
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder's heavy strikes cleave through dimensional barriers and shields, dealing transcendent damage to the enemy behind them.
This has a short cooldown.
This is an annihilation effect.
axe.tag: This is an annihilation effect.

balance.name: Equipoise Field
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When a nearby ally is far more wounded than the holder, a portion of the dimension and astral damage that ally takes is shifted onto the holder.
The sharing works only while the ally stays close.
This is a support and protection effect.
balance.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

bat.name: Riftsong Sense
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder senses enemies hidden by dimensional or astral concealment nearby and reveals them to the party for a short time.
This pulse has a cooldown.
This is a detection and revelation effect.
bat.tag: This is a detection and revelation effect.

battlefield.name: Starfall Ground
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder's dimension abilities leave a short-lived patch of astral ground where allies resist dimension and astral damage.
Only a single patch can exist at a time.
This is an area and warding effect.
battlefield.tag: This is an area and warding effect.

bear.name: Ursine Bulwark
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
While the holder stands its ground, it gains extra dimension and astral resistance that builds over a short time.
Moving any real distance clears the build-up.
This is a defensive effect.
bear.tag: This is a defensive effect.

bee.name: Hive Lattice
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
Each ally the holder aids with a dimension ability shares a portion of its astral resistance for a short time.
The link ends if the ally moves far away.
This is a support and swarm effect.
bee.tag: This is a support and swarm effect.

behemoth.name: Colossal Presence
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder's transcendent damage staggers large enemies, briefly interrupting their attacks.
A given enemy can be staggered this way only every so often.
This is an annihilation and restraint effect.
behemoth.tag: This is an annihilation and restraint effect.

bird.name: Skyward Slip
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When an enemy begins a dimension or astral ability aimed at the holder, the holder sidesteps it with a short teleport.
This can happen only once every few seconds.
This is an evasion and movement effect.
bird.tag: This is an evasion and movement effect.

blight.name: Withering Rift
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
Enemies struck by the holder's transcendent damage briefly lose a portion of their dimension resistance and take slight damage over a short time.
Reapplying the effect refreshes it rather than stacking it.
This is an affliction and poison effect.
blight.tag: This is an affliction and poison effect.

blood.name: Sanguine Transit
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When its mana runs short, the holder can pay for a dimension ability with health instead, and such abilities gain extra effect.
This cannot be used while the holder is badly wounded.
This is a dimension and blood effect.
blood.tag: This is a dimension and blood effect.

bone.name: Ossified Frame
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
Dimension and astral effects that would displace or banish the holder are shortened, and after resisting such an effect its next strike deals transcendent damage.
The bonus strike has a short cooldown.
This is a defensive effect.
bone.tag: This is a defensive effect.

boundary.name: Edge Warden
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder marks an astral boundary around itself, and enemies crossing it from outside take transcendent damage.
The boundary lasts a short time and costs mana to raise.
This is a warding and barrier effect.
boundary.tag: This is a warding and barrier effect.

bounty.name: Starward Bounty
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When the holder defeats an enemy with transcendent damage, it and nearby allies regain a little mana.
This can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a harvest and restoration effect.
bounty.tag: This is a harvest and restoration effect.

bow.name: Folded Arrow
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder's ranged attacks can pass through a small rift and strike from beside the target, dealing transcendent damage.
This costs mana and has a short cooldown.
This is a dimension effect.
bow.tag: This is a dimension effect.

brush.name: Star Script
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder paints a sigil of starlight on the ground, and allies standing on it resist dimension and astral effects.
The sigil lasts a short time, and only a single sigil can exist at once.
This is a warding effect.
brush.tag: This is a warding effect.

cage.name: Astral Cell
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder seals the most dangerous nearby enemy in a dimensional cage for a short time.
The cage breaks early if the enemy takes heavy damage.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
cage.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

cat.name: Nimbleway
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
After the holder evades an attack, its next dimension movement ability costs no mana.
This can happen only once every few seconds.
This is an evasion and movement effect.
cat.tag: This is an evasion and movement effect.

cataclysm.name: Sundering Star
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
Once per fight, when several enemies are clustered, the holder tears open a rift beneath them that deals heavy transcendent damage across the area.
The holder is slowed for a short time afterward.
This is an annihilation and area effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an annihilation and area effect.

cattle.name: Steadfast Herd
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
Allies standing close together near the holder gain extra dimension resistance.
The bonus fades as soon as the group spreads apart.
This is a support and protection effect.
cattle.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

chain.name: Starbound Tether
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When the holder deals transcendent damage, a chain of astral force links the target to the holder for a short time, slowing the target's movement away from it.
Only a single enemy can be tethered at a time.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
chain.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

chaotic.name: Wild Rift
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
Each time the holder uses a dimension ability, it gains an unpredictable bonus for a short time: extra transcendent damage, a burst of speed, or brief astral warding.
The holder cannot gain the same bonus back to back.
This is a dimension and resonance effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a dimension and resonance effect.

charlatan.name: False Horizon
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When an enemy targets the holder with a dimension or astral ability, a decoy image appears where the holder stood and draws the effect.
This can happen once every so often, and the decoy vanishes after a short time.
This is an evasion and illusion effect.
charlatan.tag: This is an evasion and illusion effect.

chicken.name: Flutter Ward
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When the holder is badly hurt by an astral attack, it skips a short distance away through a small rift and gains brief dimension resistance.
This has a long cooldown.
This is an evasion and defensive effect.
chicken.tag: This is an evasion and defensive effect.

chimera.name: Patchwork Star
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
Each time the holder resists a dimension or astral attack, it borrows a sliver of that attack's nature and adds it to its next transcendent damage hit.
Only a single borrowed trait is held at a time.
This is a transformation and mastery effect.
chimera.tag: This is a transformation and mastery effect.

claw.name: Riftrake Talons
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder's quick melee strikes leave thin tears in space that deal slight transcendent damage over a short time.
A given enemy can bear only a few tears at once.
This is a dimension and affliction effect.
claw.tag: This is a dimension and affliction effect.

cloth.name: Starweave Mantle
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
While the holder wears cloth or light armour, its astral resistance extends to allies directly beside it at a reduced portion.
The mantle weakens while the holder is channelling an ability.
This is a protection and support effect.
cloth.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

cloud.name: Nebulous Drift
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When the holder uses a dimension movement ability, it leaves a drifting astral haze that hides allies inside it from ranged attackers.
The haze disperses after a short time.
This is a stealth and dimension effect.
cloud.tag: This is a stealth and dimension effect.

cold.name: Void Chill
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder's transcendent damage carries the cold of empty space, slowing the target's attacks for a short time.
Repeated hits refresh the slow but do not deepen it.
This is a cold and frost effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and frost effect.

coral.name: Reefstar Shell
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
Each dimension or astral attack the holder resists adds a thin layer of starlit coral to its skin that absorbs a portion of the next hit.
The layers crumble shortly after combat ends and stack only a few deep.
This is a defensive and growth effect.
coral.tag: This is a defensive and growth effect.

corrupt.name: Tainted Rift
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder's dimension abilities seep corruption into enemies they touch, reducing the healing those enemies receive for a short time.
Corruption can be applied to a given enemy only every so often.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

crocodile.name: Deathroll Fold
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When the holder grapples or pins an enemy, it can twist space around the target to deal heavy transcendent damage.
This costs stamina and has a cooldown.
This is a restraint and annihilation effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a restraint and annihilation effect.

crystal.name: Prismatic Lattice
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When the holder resists an astral attack, a crystal facet forms beside it and refracts the next hit against a nearby ally back at the attacker.
Only a single facet can stand at a time.
This is a barrier and protection effect.
crystal.tag: This is a barrier and protection effect.

cycle.name: Orbital Return
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When the holder's dimension ability ends, part of its mana cost returns over a short time.
The refund is lost if the holder uses another dimension ability before it completes.
This is a time and restoration effect.
cycle.tag: This is a time and restoration effect.

dance.name: Constellation Step
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
Each time the holder moves between enemies in quick succession, its transcendent damage builds slightly, tracing a constellation behind it.
The build-up fades if the holder stays still for a moment.
This is a momentum and movement effect.
dance.tag: This is a momentum and movement effect.

dark.name: Starless Hollow
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
While the holder stands in darkness, its dimension abilities gain extra effect and its transcendent damage briefly blinds the target.
The blinding can affect a given enemy only every so often.
This is a darkness and shadow effect.
dark.tag: This is a darkness and shadow effect.

dawn.name: First Light Passage
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The first dimension ability the holder uses each fight bathes nearby allies in dawn light, healing them slightly and granting brief astral resistance.
This happens only once per fight.
This is a light and healing effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and healing effect.

death.name: Last Horizon
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder's transcendent damage deals extra damage to enemies that are close to death.
When such a hit finishes an enemy, the holder regains a little mana, but only once every few seconds.
This is a death and necromantic effect.
death.tag: This is a death and necromantic effect.

deep.name: Abyssal Depth
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder's dimension abilities draw on deep astral pressure, pulling nearby enemies slightly toward their centre.
The pull has a cooldown and does not move large enemies.
This is a dimension and binding effect.
deep.tag: This is a dimension and binding effect.

deer.name: Starbound Hart
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When an enemy closes to melee range, the holder bounds away through a short rift and gains a moment of extra speed.
This has a cooldown.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
deer.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

desolate.name: Barren Reach
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
While no ally stands near the holder, its astral resistance and transcendent damage are both increased.
The bonus ends the moment an ally comes close.
This is an annihilation and defensive effect.
desolate.tag: This is an annihilation and defensive effect.

dimension.name: Pocket Sky
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When the holder uses a dimension ability, it opens a small fold of space where a nearby ally's next incoming hit is partly diverted.
The fold lasts a short time and costs extra mana.
This is a dimension and protection effect.
dimension.tag: This is a dimension and protection effect.

discord.name: Jarring Astrum
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder's transcendent damage jars the target's focus, making its next ability cost more.
This can affect a given enemy only every so often.
This is a sound and curse effect.
discord.tag: This is a sound and curse effect.

discordant.name: Dissonant Fold
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When the holder uses a dimension ability near enemies, a clashing astral tone briefly interrupts any channelled abilities they are casting.
This has a cooldown.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
discordant.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

dog.name: Faithful Orbit
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When an ally the holder can see is struck by a dimension or astral attack, the holder rifts to that ally's side.
This has a cooldown and does not trigger while the holder is channelling.
This is a protection and movement effect.
dog.tag: This is a protection and movement effect.

doom.name: Fated Collapse
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder marks an enemy with a slow-building astral doom; when the mark expires, it deals transcendent damage scaled by the damage the party dealt meanwhile.
Only a single mark can exist at a time.
This is a curse and death effect.
doom.tag: This is a curse and death effect.

doppelganger.name: Mirrored Orbit
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder steps out of an astral double that copies its next dimension ability at a reduced effect.
The double fades after a short time.
This is a conjuration and dimension effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a conjuration and dimension effect.

dragon.name: Wyrmstar Scales
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
While the holder is above half health, its astral resistance extends to fire and lightning at a reduced portion.
When a breath or cone attack hits it, the holder's next transcendent damage hit is increased; this has a cooldown.
This is a protection and fire effect.
dragon.tag: This is a protection and fire effect.

duck.name: Slipwater Glide
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
Dimension and astral effects that would slow the holder slide off it, ending early.
After shrugging off a slow, the holder gains a moment of extra speed, but only every few seconds.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
duck.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

dust.name: Stardust Veil
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When the holder uses a dimension ability, glittering stardust settles on nearby enemies, making their attacks against the party slightly less accurate.
The dust settles for a short time and the effect has a cooldown.
This is a dimension and evasion effect.
dust.tag: This is a dimension and evasion effect.

earth.name: Rooted Meridian
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
While the holder stands on bare ground, effects that would teleport, banish or displace it are resisted.
If the holder moves under its own power, the anchoring lapses for a short time.
This is a defensive and binding effect.
earth.tag: This is a defensive and binding effect.

echo.name: Resounding Star
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
A short time after the holder deals transcendent damage, a fainter echo of that hit strikes the same target.
The echo cannot echo itself and has a cooldown.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
echo.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

eclipse.name: Umbral Corona
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder wreathes itself in an eclipsed corona that adds light and shadow damage to its transcendent damage for a short time.
While the corona burns, the holder's healing received is reduced.
This is a light and darkness effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a light and darkness effect.

edifice.name: Astral Keep
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When the holder stays in place for a moment, a faint astral structure rises around it, granting nearby allies dimension resistance.
The structure collapses if the holder moves and takes a short time to rise again.
This is a barrier and warding effect.
edifice.tag: This is a barrier and warding effect.

effigy.name: Star Effigy
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
Once per fight, the holder leaves a starlit effigy of itself that draws enemy dimension and astral abilities for a short time.
The effigy shatters after absorbing a few hits.
This is a conjuration and protection effect.
effigy.tag: This is a conjuration and protection effect.

elemental.name: Elemental Meridian
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When the holder is hit by elemental damage, its astral resistance briefly extends to that element at a reduced portion.
Only the most recent element is covered.
This is a protection and fire effect.
elemental.tag: This is a protection and fire effect.

elixir.name: Starwell Draught
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When the holder drinks a potion, it also gains brief dimension and astral resistance and a little mana.
This bonus applies only every so often.
This is an alchemy and restoration effect.
elixir.tag: This is an alchemy and restoration effect.

empower.name: Amplified Rift
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
When the holder uses a dimension ability on an ally, that ally's next attack also deals transcendent damage.
This has a cooldown.
This is a support and dimension effect.
empower.tag: This is a support and dimension effect.

eye.name: Starseer Gaze
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Affinity].
The holder sees through dimensional concealment and spots enemies preparing astral attacks, warning the party a moment before they land.
Each warning applies only to attacks within the holder's sight.
This is a perception and precognition effect.
eye.tag: This is a perception and precognition effect.

feast.name: Starmaw Repast
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Astral Affinity]. Catalyst: Feast essence.
