The holder ties a thread of light to an ally, and the ally is drawn along with it whenever the holder moves quickly.
Only a few allies can be tied at once, and the thread breaks after a short time.
This is a binding and support effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and support effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderous Arrival
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
When the holder dashes into a fight, it arrives with a clap of thunder that stuns enemies near where it lands.
This has a cooldown.
This is a storm and lightning effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a storm and lightning effect.

time.name: Borrowed Moment
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
Once per fight, the holder can step outside time for a brief moment, acting freely while everything around it stands still.
Afterward the holder is slowed for a short time.
This is a time and haste effect.
time.tag: This is a time and haste effect.

tranquil.name: Unhurried Flow
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
While the holder keeps a steady pace, its dodges and attacks cost less stamina.
The steady pace breaks when the holder is struck or sprints.
This is a restoration and movement effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a restoration and movement effect.

transfiguration.name: Shifting Form
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
The holder can briefly take on a sleeker, lighter form that moves and strikes faster but takes slightly more damage.
This lasts a short time and has a cooldown.
This is a transformation and haste effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a transformation and haste effect.

transgression.name: Stolen Speed
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
When an enemy is hastened near the holder, the holder steals that haste for itself.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a curse and haste effect.
transgression.tag: This is a curse and haste effect.

trap.name: Snap Trap
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
When the holder dashes, it leaves a trap at its starting point that snaps shut on the next enemy to step there.
Only a few traps exist at once.
This is a restraint and trap effect.
trap.tag: This is a restraint and trap effect.

tree.name: Swaying Bough
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
While the holder stands its ground, it sways aside from blows and takes less damage from the first hit after it stops moving.
This works only while the holder is standing still.
This is a nature and defensive effect.
tree.tag: This is a nature and defensive effect.

troll.name: Mending Stride
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
While the holder is moving, its wounds close slowly.
The healing stops for a short time after the holder takes fire damage.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
troll.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

trowel.name: Quick Mortar
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
The holder can throw up a low wall in front of an ally in an instant to block an incoming attack.
This costs stamina and has a cooldown.
This is a protection and conjuration effect.
trowel.tag: This is a protection and conjuration effect.

turtle.name: Shell Dash
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
When the holder dashes, it hardens its body and takes reduced damage until it stops.
This costs stamina and has a cooldown.
This is a defensive and movement effect.
turtle.tag: This is a defensive and movement effect.

twilight.name: Dusk Runner
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
While the holder moves through dim light, its Speed rises and enemies have trouble keeping track of it.
The bonus fades in full light and in deep darkness.
This is a shadow and light effect.
twilight.tag: This is a shadow and light effect.

undeath.name: Hurried Dead
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
Undead allies near the holder share a portion of its Speed, and the holder moves faster near fallen enemies.
The bonus lasts only while the holder is close to them.
This is a necromantic and haste effect.
undeath.tag: This is a necromantic and haste effect.

unity.name: United Stride
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
When the holder and allies near it move together, each of them gains a slight boost to Speed.
The bonus ends when the group scatters.
This is a support and haste effect.
unity.tag: This is a support and haste effect.

vast.name: Ranging Stride
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
The holder's dashes and leaps cover much more ground.
They cost slightly more stamina.
This is a movement and travel effect.
vast.tag: This is a movement and travel effect.

vehicle.name: Carrying Stride
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
The holder can sweep up a downed or rooted ally and carry them out of danger at full Speed.
This costs stamina and has a cooldown.
This is a support and travel effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a support and travel effect.

venom.name: Venom Dash
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
The holder's quick strikes poison enemies, and poisoned enemies are slightly slowed.
The slow does not stack.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

verdant.name: Blooming Path
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
Where the holder runs, small flowers bloom that heal allies who step on them.
Only a few patches bloom at once, and they wilt after a short time.
This is a nature and healing effect.
verdant.tag: This is a nature and healing effect.

vessel.name: Bottled Tailwind
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
The holder stores Speed from each burst it receives, releasing it later as a burst of its own.
Only a limited amount can be stored.
This is a haste effect.
vessel.tag: This is a haste effect.

visage.name: Fleeting Face
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
When the holder dodges, its face blurs, and enemies who lose sight of it forget it for a moment.
This has a cooldown.
This is a stealth and evasion effect.
visage.tag: This is a stealth and evasion effect.

vision.name: Watchful Step
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
The holder sees attacks coming a moment earlier and reacts with a burst of Speed.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a perception and evasion effect.
vision.tag: This is a perception and evasion effect.

void.name: Void Slip
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
The holder can slip into the void and reappear a short distance away, untouched by attacks in between.
This costs mana and has a cooldown.
This is a dimensional and evasion effect.
void.tag: This is a dimensional and evasion effect.

volcano.name: Eruptive Rush
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
When the holder charges, the ground erupts behind it in a line of fire and ash.
This costs stamina and has a cooldown.
This is a fire and earth effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and earth effect.

vortex.name: Whirling Draw
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
When the holder spins through a crowd, it draws enemies nearby inward toward it.
This costs stamina and has a cooldown.
This is a wind and restraint effect.
vortex.tag: This is a wind and restraint effect.

wasp.name: Stinging Dart
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
The holder can dart in, sting an enemy and dart out again before it can react.
This has a cooldown and costs stamina.
This is a poison and evasion effect.
wasp.tag: This is a poison and evasion effect.

water.name: Flowing Stride
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
The holder flows around enemies like water, slipping past them without being blocked.
This works only while the holder is moving.
This is a water and movement effect.
water.tag: This is a water and movement effect.

weave.name: Woven Paths
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
The holder weaves between allies, and each ally it passes gains a brief burst of Speed.
This has a short cooldown on each ally.
This is a support and haste effect.
weave.tag: This is a support and haste effect.

wendigo.name: Ravenous Stride
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
The holder moves faster toward wounded enemies, and its strikes on them freeze the wound.
This works only on enemies that are badly hurt.
This is a cold and hunting effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and hunting effect.

whale.name: Great Wake
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
When the holder charges, allies behind it are carried along in its wake with a portion of its Speed.
This has a cooldown.
This is a water and support effect.
whale.tag: This is a water and support effect.

wheel.name: Spinning Wheel
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
The holder can roll forward in a spinning rush, striking every enemy it passes.
This costs stamina and has a cooldown.
This is a momentum effect.
wheel.tag: This is a momentum effect.

whip.name: Whipcrack Pace
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
The holder's whip lashes come out faster, and a crack of the whip hastens allies near it for a moment.
The haste has a cooldown.
This is a haste and command effect.
whip.tag: This is a haste and command effect.

wind.name: Tailwind
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
A wind follows the holder, pushing it and allies near it forward faster.
The wind dies down while the holder is standing still.
This is a wind and support effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and support effect.

wing.name: Radiant Wingshield
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
When the holder dashes to an ally, it spreads wings of light that shield the ally from the next hit.
This has a cooldown.
This is a light and protection effect.
wing.tag: This is a light and protection effect.

wolf.name: Pack Pursuit
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
When an ally attacks an enemy, the holder moves faster to join the attack on it.
This works only on enemies an ally has struck recently.
This is a hunting and support effect.
wolf.tag: This is a hunting and support effect.

wood.name: Springy Timber
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
The holder bends like green wood, springing back from knockbacks with a burst of Speed.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a nature and momentum effect.
wood.tag: This is a nature and momentum effect.

wrath.name: Furious Pace
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
When an ally near the holder falls, it surges with fury, gaining Speed for a short time.
This happens once per fight.
This is a haste and momentum effect.
wrath.tag: This is a haste and momentum effect.

zeal.name: Zealous Charge
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
The holder charges into battle with holy zeal, gaining Speed and resisting slowing effects for a short time.
This has a cooldown.
This is a holy and haste effect.
zeal.tag: This is a holy and haste effect.

ziz.name: Skyborne Shadow
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Celestine] ability [Celestial Swiftness]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Celestial Swiftness].
When the holder leaps at an enemy, a great winged shadow passes over the battlefield and slows enemies beneath it.
This has a cooldown.
This is a shadow and restraint effect.
ziz.tag: This is a shadow and restraint effect.

action.name: Wyrm Reflex
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
When the holder shrugs off an attempt to control its mind, it immediately makes a melee strike against the nearest enemy with no wind-up.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a momentum and warding effect.
action.tag: This is a momentum and warding effect.

adept.name: Scaled Discipline
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
Each consecutive melee hit the holder lands on the same enemy deals slightly more damage, building on the bonus from its absorbed essences.
The chain resets if the holder switches targets or goes a short time without landing a hit.
This is a mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Drakebile Draught
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].

When the holder drinks a potion, its melee strikes carry a trace of that potion for a short time, applying a weak form of a harmful effect or sharing a sliver of a helpful effect with allies it stands beside.
This can happen once per potion, and the potion's own cooldown applies.
This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.

ambush.name: Lurking Wyrm
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
The holder's first melee strike against an enemy that has not yet noticed it deals bonus damage scaled by the essences it has absorbed.
Each enemy can be caught this way once per fight.
This is a stealth and hunting effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and hunting effect.

animate.name: Scale Golems
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
Once per fight, when the holder is struck hard, shed scales rise as a small animated guardian that fights beside it and shares its resistance to mind control.
The guardian crumbles after a short time or when destroyed.
This is an animation and summoning effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and summoning effect.

anzu.name: Thunderclaw Lineage
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
The holder's melee strikes build a static charge; when full, its next strike discharges as lightning that arcs to an enemy close by.
The charge builds only while the holder is fighting in melee and fades between fights.
This is a lightning and storm effect.
anzu.tag: This is a lightning and storm effect.

ape.name: Brute Lineage
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
The holder's heavy melee attacks hurl smaller enemies back and stagger them briefly.
This costs stamina with each heavy attack and does not affect large foes.
This is a momentum effect.
ape.tag: This is a momentum effect.

armour.name: Hoard Plating
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
Each time the holder resists a mind-affecting effect, its scales harden, reducing incoming melee damage for a short time.
The hardening does not stack and has a short cooldown.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
armour.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

arsenal.name: Talon Armory
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
The melee damage bonus from absorbed essences also applies to the holder's thrown weapons and off-hand strikes.
Thrown strikes gain only a portion of the bonus.
This is a mastery effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a mastery effect.

aspect.name: Dragon Shape
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
Once per fight, when the holder falls below half health, draconic features surface for a short time, lengthening its reach and greatly heightening the essence bonus to its melee damage.
When the features recede, the holder is briefly tired and slower.
This is a transformation effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation effect.

avatar.name: Ancestral Mantle
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
Once per fight, the holder can call up the image of a dragon ancestor around itself for a short time; allies inside its shadow share the holder's resistance to mind control.
The holder moves slowly while the image stands.
This is a warding and support effect.
avatar.tag: This is a warding and support effect.

axe.name: Cleaving Jaw
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
The holder's melee strikes cleave into another enemy standing close beside the target, dealing a portion of the damage.
The cleave carries none of the essence bonus.
This is an area effect.
axe.tag: This is an area effect.

balance.name: Poised Bloodline
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
While the holder's health and mana are both above half, its melee strikes deal slightly more damage.
While either is below half, it instead resists stagger and knockback.
This is a defensive and mastery effect.
balance.tag: This is a defensive and mastery effect.

bat.name: Echo Scales
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
The holder senses enemies hidden or invisible close by and can strike them in melee as if it saw them.
The sense reaches only a short distance and is blocked by loud sound effects.
This is a detection and sound effect.
bat.tag: This is a detection and sound effect.

battlefield.name: Warlord Ancestry
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
While the holder is surrounded by enemies, allies near it resist fear and charm effects as it does.
The aura holds only while the holder stays in melee.
This is a warding and support effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a warding and support effect.

bear.name: Mauling Blood
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
When the holder is hit in melee, its next melee strike deals bonus damage based on the hit it took.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a momentum effect.
bear.tag: This is a momentum effect.

bee.name: Hive Stinger
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
The holder's melee strikes leave a stinging venom that deals a little damage over a short time.
Allies who strike the same target refresh the venom; it does not stack.
This is a poison and support effect.
bee.tag: This is a poison and support effect.

behemoth.name: Colossal Heritage
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
The holder's melee strikes cannot be parried or deflected by enemies smaller than it.
Each heavy strike costs extra stamina while this holds.
This is a momentum effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a momentum effect.

bird.name: Skyborn Talon
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
After the holder leaps or dashes, its next melee strike deals bonus damage.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a movement and haste effect.
bird.tag: This is a movement and haste effect.

blight.name: Rotting Fang
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
The holder's melee strikes spread a creeping rot that slightly reduces the target's healing for a short time.
The rot does not stack and ends early if the target is purified.
This is an affliction and poison effect.
blight.tag: This is an affliction and poison effect.

blood.name: Dragonblood Fury
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
The holder's melee strikes against bleeding enemies restore a sliver of its health.
The healing scales with rank and stops while the holder is at full health.
This is a healing and affliction effect.
blood.tag: This is a healing and affliction effect.

bone.name: Ossified Wyrm
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
When the holder resists a mind-affecting effect, bone spurs break through its scales and its next few melee strikes pierce armour.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a defensive and death effect.
bone.tag: This is a defensive and death effect.

boundary.name: Ancestral Bounds
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
Once per fight, when an ally near the holder falls under mind control, the holder can mark a small ward that breaks the control on any ally inside it.
The ward lasts a short time and costs mana.
This is a warding and purification effect.
boundary.tag: This is a warding and purification effect.

bounty.name: Hoardkeeper's Due
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
When the holder lands the killing blow in melee, it gains a brief surge of melee damage and a small restoration of stamina.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a harvest and restoration effect.
bounty.tag: This is a harvest and restoration effect.

bow.name: Fang and Fletch
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
The essence bonus to melee damage also applies, at a reduced portion, to the holder's ranged attacks against enemies close by.
The bonus fades at longer range.
This is a hunting effect.
bow.tag: This is a hunting effect.

brush.name: Inkscale Stroke
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
The holder's sweeping melee strikes leave a trailing mark on the ground that slows enemies crossing it for a short time.
Only the newest mark stands; older marks fade.
This is a restraint and area effect.
brush.tag: This is a restraint and area effect.

cage.name: Caged Will
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
When an enemy attempts to control the holder's mind and fails, that enemy is briefly rooted in place.
Each enemy can be caught this way once per fight.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
cage.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

cat.name: Prowling Drake
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
The holder's melee strikes from behind or the side of an enemy deal slightly more damage.
This applies only while the target is not focused on the holder.
This is a hunting and stealth effect.
cat.tag: This is a hunting and stealth effect.

cataclysm.name: Ruinous Descent
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
Once per fight, the holder can slam the ground with a melee strike that shakes everything around it, dealing damage that scales with its absorbed essences.
The holder is briefly stunned by the force of the blow.
This is an area and annihilation effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an area and annihilation effect.

cattle.name: Stampede Heart
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Ancestry]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Ancestry].
When the holder charges into melee, it shoves aside enemies in its path and its first strike deals bonus damage.
This costs stamina and has a short cooldown.
This is a momentum and movement effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderclap Haft

tranquil.name: Calming Presence

transfiguration.tag: This is a transformation effect.

trowel.tag: This is a barrier and conjuration effect.

turtle.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

twilight.tag: This is a light and shadow effect.

undeath.tag: This is a necromantic and summoning effect.

unity.name: United Front

void.tag: This is a darkness and binding effect.

trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
When an enemy closes on the holder while it is guarding, its jaws snap shut on the attacker, holding it in place for a moment.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a restraint and trap effect.
trap.tag: This is a restraint and trap effect.

tree.name: Heartwood Scales
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder roots itself and draws strength from the ground, raising its Power and defence while it stands still.
Moving ends the effect, which takes a moment to build again.
This is a nature and defensive effect.
tree.tag: This is a nature and defensive effect.

troll.name: Trollwyrm Regrowth
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder slowly regenerates health in a fight, faster the more Power it has.
Fire or acid damage stops the regeneration for a short time.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
troll.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

trowel.name: Plastered Wyrmhide
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
Each time the holder is struck, it slaps a layer of hardened earth over the wound, raising its defence slightly.
The layers stack a few times and crumble after a short time.
This is a protection and nature effect.
trowel.tag: This is a protection and nature effect.

turtle.name: Tortoise Bastion
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
While the holder guards, its defence is heightened by a portion of its Power and it cannot be knocked back.
The holder moves slowly while it guards this way.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
turtle.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

twilight.name: Dusk Wyrm
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder's heavy blows deal light and darkness damage alike, finding whichever the target is weaker to.
This costs a little mana for each heavy blow.
This is a light and shadow effect.
twilight.tag: This is a light and shadow effect.

undeath.name: Bonewyrm Rising
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
Once per fight, when the holder falls, it rises as a skeletal drake for a short time, fighting with a portion of its Power.
When the form ends, the holder is restored with a sliver of health.
This is a necromantic and rebirth effect.
undeath.tag: This is a necromantic and rebirth effect.

unity.name: Kindred Strength
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
When the holder and an ally strike the same enemy together, both blows land with heightened Power.
This can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a support effect.
unity.tag: This is a support effect.

vast.name: Vast Wingspan
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder's heavy blows cover a wider area, striking enemies around the target.
The wider swings cost more stamina.
This is an area effect.
vast.tag: This is an area effect.

vehicle.name: Bearing Burden
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
When an ally near the holder is knocked down, the holder can haul them clear of danger, pulling them to safety with sheer strength.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a support and movement effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a support and movement effect.

venom.name: Venomblood Fang
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder's heavy blows inject a potent venom that deals damage over time, scaled by its Power.
A target already poisoned by the holder cannot be poisoned again until the venom ends.
This is a poison effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison effect.

verdant.name: Verdant Wyrm
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
Each heavy blow the holder lands sprouts growth beneath it, restoring a little health to allies standing close.
The growth can sprout only once every few seconds.
This is a growth and healing effect.
verdant.tag: This is a growth and healing effect.

vessel.name: Wyrmheart Reservoir
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder stores a portion of the force from blows it absorbs, releasing it in its next heavy blow.
The stored force fades after a short time.
This is a defensive and momentum effect.
vessel.tag: This is a defensive and momentum effect.

visage.name: Dragon Mask
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder's face twists into a fearsome draconic mask when it attacks, frightening weaker enemies for a moment.
A frightened enemy cannot be frightened again for a short time.
This is a transformation and curse effect.
visage.tag: This is a transformation and curse effect.

vision.name: Foresight Strike
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder foresees where an enemy will move, and its heavy blows strike that spot with heightened Power.
This can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a precognition and perception effect.
vision.tag: This is a precognition and perception effect.

void.name: Voidscale Rend
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder's heavy blows drain magical effects from the target, stripping a boon.
This can happen only once every few seconds and costs a little mana.
This is an annihilation and curse effect.
void.tag: This is an annihilation and curse effect.

volcano.name: Molten Wyrmblood
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
When the holder is badly hurt, its blood boils, and its heavy blows burst with fire around the target.
The eruption lasts a short time and can happen once per fight.
This is a fire and burn effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and burn effect.

vortex.name: Vortex Wyrmspin
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder can spin in a whirling attack that pulls enemies around it inward and strikes them with force from its Power.
The spin costs stamina and can be used only once every so often.
This is a wind and area effect.
vortex.tag: This is a wind and area effect.

wasp.name: Waspwyrm Barb
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder's quick attacks carry a stinging barb that lowers the target's defence for a short time.
The sting stacks a few times on the same enemy, then fades.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
wasp.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

water.name: River Strength
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder's heavy blows flow into each other, each costing less stamina than the last.
The flow breaks if the holder stops attacking for a moment.
This is a water and momentum effect.
water.tag: This is a water and momentum effect.

weave.name: Wyrmweave Mesh
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder weaves its Power into a protective mesh around allies close to it, absorbing a portion of the next hit each takes.
The weave can be renewed only once every so often.
This is a barrier and support effect.
weave.tag: This is a barrier and support effect.

wendigo.name: Wendigo Wyrmhunger
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder's heavy blows chill and drain the target, restoring a little stamina to the holder.
This can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a cold and hunting effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and hunting effect.

whale.name: Breaching Bulk
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
Once per fight, the holder throws its full weight onto the ground, sending a shockwave that knocks down enemies around it.
The holder is slow to rise afterwards.
This is an area and annihilation effect.
whale.tag: This is an area and annihilation effect.

wheel.name: Rolling Wyrm
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder curls and rolls through enemies in its path, striking each with force from its Power.
The roll costs stamina and can be used once every few seconds.
This is a movement and momentum effect.
wheel.tag: This is a movement and momentum effect.

whip.name: Whipwyrm Lash
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder can lash its tail at an enemy just beyond its reach, striking with force from its Power and pulling it closer.
The lash costs stamina and can be used once every few seconds.
This is a restraint and momentum effect.
whip.tag: This is a restraint and momentum effect.

wind.name: Galeborne Strike
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder's heavy blows carry a gust that knocks enemies back, scaled by its Power.
The gust can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a wind effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind effect.

wing.name: Buffeting Wings
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder can beat its wings to buffet enemies in front of it, pushing them back with force from its Power.
The buffet costs stamina and can be used once every few seconds.
This is a wind and area effect.
wing.tag: This is a wind and area effect.

wolf.name: Packmate's Fury
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
When the holder attacks an enemy that an ally is also attacking, its blows land with heightened Power.
The bonus applies only while the ally stays close.
This is a hunting and support effect.
wolf.tag: This is a hunting and support effect.

wood.name: Ironwood Scales
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder's scales harden like seasoned wood when it guards, raising its defence by a portion of its Power.
The hardening fades if the holder is burned.
This is a defensive and nature effect.
wood.tag: This is a defensive and nature effect.

wrath.name: Draconic Rage
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
Each time the holder or an ally near it is struck, its rage builds, raising its Power up to a limit.
At full rage, the holder loses some defence until the rage cools after a short time.
This is a transformation and annihilation effect.
wrath.tag: This is a transformation and annihilation effect.

zeal.name: Fervent Blood
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
The holder's devotion to its party fuels its Power while any ally is in danger.
The bonus fades once all allies are safe.
This is a support and protection effect.
zeal.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

ziz.name: Skyshadow Colossus
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Draconic Power]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Draconic Power].
Once per fight, the holder spreads its wings and casts a vast shadow, frightening enemies around it and raising allies' Power for a short time.
The holder cannot attack while its wings are spread.
This is a shadow and support effect.
ziz.tag: This is a shadow and support effect.

action.name: Flinchless Hide
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder takes elemental damage while attacking, the attack is not interrupted and the holder's next strike comes out with no wind-up.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and momentum effect.
action.tag: This is a defensive and momentum effect.

adept.name: Studied Plating
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Each time the holder is struck by an element, its scales learn that element and resist it slightly better for the rest of the fight.
The effect stacks a few times per element and ends when the fight does.
This is a defensive and mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a defensive and mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Reactive Scales
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder drinks a potion, its scales take on a matching hue and it gains extra resistance to the element that last hurt it.
The extra resistance lasts a short time and cannot trigger again until it fades.
This is an alchemy and defensive effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and defensive effect.

ambush.name: Lurking Hide
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder is unseen by enemies, its scales dull and it takes reduced elemental damage from area attacks.
The first attack the holder makes from hiding each fight deals bonus damage of the element it last resisted.
This is a stealth and defensive effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and defensive effect.

animate.name: Risen Scales
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Once per fight, when the holder is badly hurt by elemental damage, a handful of scales shed and rise as a small scale guardian that fights beside it for a short time.
The guardian shares the holder's elemental resistance and crumbles when struck too often.
This is an animation and protection effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and protection effect.

anzu.name: Thunder Hide
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Lightning damage the holder resists builds a charge in its scales, up to a limit that scales with rank.
At full charge, the holder's next attack releases the charge as a bolt that arcs to a nearby enemy. Unused charge fades slowly.
This is a lightning and storm effect.
anzu.tag: This is a lightning and storm effect.

ape.name: Brawler's Hide
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder is in melee range of an enemy, its resistance to elemental damage from that enemy is slightly higher.
Each time it resists an elemental hit this way, its next unarmed or melee strike knocks the target back a short way, once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and momentum effect.
ape.tag: This is a defensive and momentum effect.

armour.name: Layered Scale
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's worn armour gains a portion of its elemental resistance, stacking with the armour's own.
While the holder's armour is damaged or broken, its scales thicken to cover the gap for a short time once per fight.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
armour.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

arsenal.name: Tempered Panoply
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Each time the holder resists an elemental hit, the weapon in its hand takes on that element for a short time.
Only the most recent element is held, and the effect cannot refresh more often than every few seconds.
This is a defensive and transmutation effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a defensive and transmutation effect.

aspect.name: Ancestral Flare
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Once per fight, when the holder falls below half health, it takes on a fuller draconic aspect for a short time, its scales spreading and its elemental resistance rising sharply.
While the aspect holds, nearby enemies are slightly more likely to target the holder.
This is a transformation and defensive effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation and defensive effect.

avatar.name: Wyrmskin Avatar
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Once per fight, the holder can swell into a scaled avatar of its ancestry, growing larger and gaining heavy elemental resistance for a short time.
While in avatar form, the holder's attacks shed sparks of the element it last resisted. It moves slowly while the form lasts.
This is a transformation and mastery effect.
avatar.tag: This is a transformation and mastery effect.

axe.name: Cleaving Scales
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists an elemental hit, its next heavy swing cleaves through the element, dispersing any lingering hazard of that element in its arc.
This can happen once every few seconds and costs a little stamina.
This is a defensive and purification effect.
axe.tag: This is a defensive and purification effect.

balance.name: Equilibrium Hide
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder is struck by opposing elements in quick succession, such as fire and frost, the follow-up hit is heavily reduced.
This works only once in a short time, and the holder's resistance to the first element dips slightly while it waits.
This is a defensive and warding effect.
balance.tag: This is a defensive and warding effect.

bat.name: Sonar Scales
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales hum faintly, letting it sense elemental attacks being charged nearby and brace a moment before they land.
A braced elemental hit deals reduced damage. The bracing works once every few seconds.
This is a sound and perception effect.
bat.tag: This is a sound and perception effect.

battlefield.name: Warfront Plating
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Allies standing near the holder share a portion of its elemental resistance while the holder is in combat.
The shared resistance fades quickly if the holder moves away, and covers only a few allies at a time.
This is a support and protection effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

bear.name: Ursine Hide
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder stands its ground without moving, its elemental resistance builds slowly up to a limit.
Moving or dodging resets the build-up. The bonus lasts only while the fight does.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
bear.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

bee.name: Honeycomb Scales
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists an elemental hit, a small swarm of scale-motes peels away and stings the attacker with that element.
The swarm forms once every few seconds and lasts only a short time.
This is a swarm and defensive effect.
bee.tag: This is a swarm and defensive effect.

behemoth.name: Titan's Mantle
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder cannot be knocked down or pushed back by elemental attacks while above half health.
Below half health, the holder's elemental resistance rises slightly instead, but its movement slows.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

bird.name: Plumed Scales
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder dodges, it gains a brief burst of elemental resistance as feather-edged scales flare along its back.
The burst cannot happen again for a short time after it triggers.
This is an evasion and defensive effect.
bird.tag: This is an evasion and defensive effect.

blight.name: Rot Scales
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales extend their resistance to disease and poison, shrugging off a portion of those afflictions.
When the holder resists a disease or poison this way, the attacker suffers a light affliction of its own, once every few seconds.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
blight.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

blood.name: Blood Scales
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Each time the holder resists an elemental hit, it recovers a small amount of health.
The healing cannot trigger more than once every few seconds, and does nothing against bleeding.
This is a healing and defensive effect.
blood.tag: This is a healing and defensive effect.

bone.name: Ossified Scale
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales harden over bone ridges, reducing physical damage from blunt attacks slightly while its elemental resistance is active.
Once per fight, a hit that would break the holder's guard is turned aside by a cracking scale plate.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
bone.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

boundary.name: Ward Scales
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Elemental hazards on the ground, such as fire, frost, or charged pools, cannot spread into the space where the holder stands.
Allies sheltering beside the holder are also kept clear of the edge of such hazards for a short time after the holder enters them.
This is a warding and barrier effect.
boundary.tag: This is a warding and barrier effect.

bounty.name: Bountiful Scales
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists a heavy elemental hit, a scale falls away as a small glowing token that a nearby ally can collect for a brief resistance boon.
Only a single token can lie on the ground at a time, and it fades after a short time.
This is a support and harvest effect.
bounty.tag: This is a support and harvest effect.

bow.name: Archer's Mail
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Elemental projectiles fired at the holder lose some of their force before striking it.
After the holder resists an elemental projectile, its next ranged attack carries that element, once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and hunting effect.
bow.tag: This is a defensive and hunting effect.

brush.name: Huebright Scales
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales take on the colour of the element that last struck it, raising its resistance to that element slightly for a short time.
Only a single colour can be held at a time, and changing colour has a short cooldown.
This is a defensive and transformation effect.
brush.tag: This is a defensive and transformation effect.

cage.name: Cage Ribs
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Once per fight, when the holder is caught in an elemental area attack, its scales close into a lattice that blocks the rest of that attack.
While the lattice holds, the holder cannot attack or move.
This is a barrier and restraint effect.
cage.tag: This is a barrier and restraint effect.

cat.name: Feline Plating
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder lands from a leap or recovers from a fall, it takes reduced elemental damage for a short moment.
After resisting an elemental hit, the holder's next dodge covers slightly more ground. This works once every few seconds.
This is an evasion and defensive effect.
cat.tag: This is an evasion and defensive effect.

cataclysm.name: Doomsday Hide
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's elemental resistance rises sharply against the largest area attacks, such as eruptions and storms called down by powerful enemies.
After surviving such an attack, the holder unleashes a burst of the same element around itself, once per fight.
This is an annihilation and area effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an annihilation and area effect.

cattle.name: Herdbound Hide
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder is close to several allies, all of them gain a small portion of its elemental resistance.
The bonus is lost if the group scatters, and it cannot stack from multiple sources.
This is a support and protection effect.
cattle.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

chain.name: Chainmail Hide
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales interlock like mail when it is hit by an element, spreading a portion of the damage across its whole hide.
Each linked hit chains the reduction to the next elemental hit within a short time, until the chain breaks.
This is a defensive and binding effect.
chain.tag: This is a defensive and binding effect.

chaotic.name: Wildfire Hide
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Each time the holder is struck by an element, its scales shift to resist a random element strongly for a short time.
When the random element matches the next hit, that hit is shrugged off almost entirely. The shift cannot happen more than once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and transmutation effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a defensive and transmutation effect.

charlatan.name: False Gleam
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales glitter with a false sheen that makes enemies misjudge which element it resists, so they favour the element it resists best.
The misdirection breaks for a short time after the holder takes heavy damage.
This is a defensive and illusion effect.

guardian.name: Warden Scales
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When an ally near the holder is about to take a heavy elemental hit, the holder steps in front and takes the hit instead with its full resistance.
This can happen once every few seconds and costs a little stamina.
This is a protection and support effect.
guardian.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

hair.name: Bristled Scales
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales bristle with fine hairs that catch heat and cold before they reach the skin, raising resistance to fire and frost slightly.
When the holder is chilled or burned, the bristles shed, ending the effect early once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
hair.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

hammer.name: Hammered Plating
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales flatten and harden like beaten metal, letting heavy elemental impacts deal reduced damage.
After resisting a heavy hit, the holder's next swing stuns the target briefly, once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
hammer.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

hand.name: Gripping Scales
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder can catch an incoming elemental projectile in its scaled hand, taking reduced damage and holding the element for a short time.
Its next thrown attack or strike releases the caught element. This works once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and mastery effect.
hand.tag: This is a defensive and mastery effect.

harmonic.name: Tuning Scales
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales ring when struck by an element, tuning themselves to that element and resisting it slightly better for a short time.
Allies near the holder gain a smaller share of the tuned resistance while it lasts.
This is a resonance and support effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a resonance and support effect.

harpy.name: Shrieking Scales
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists a wind or sound attack, its scales let out a piercing shriek that disorients nearby enemies briefly.
The shriek has a short cooldown.
This is a sound and wind effect.
harpy.tag: This is a sound and wind effect.

harvest.name: Reaping Scales
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Each time the holder resists an elemental hit, it reaps a sliver of that energy, building a store that fills over the fight.
When the store is full, the holder releases it as a small heal for itself and the closest ally. The store empties and begins again.
This is a harvest and healing effect.
harvest.tag: This is a harvest and healing effect.

heidel.name: Stampede Hide
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder charges toward an enemy, its elemental resistance rises sharply and it barrels through elemental hazards in its path.
The bonus ends when the charge does, and charging costs stamina.
This is a momentum and defensive effect.
heidel.tag: This is a momentum and defensive effect.

hook.name: Barbed Scales
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When an enemy strikes the holder with an elemental melee attack, the holder's barbed scales catch the weapon and briefly drag the attacker closer.
This works once every few seconds and only against enemies close enough to touch.
This is a binding and defensive effect.
hook.tag: This is a binding and defensive effect.

horse.name: Galloping Hide
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder is running, it takes reduced damage from lingering elemental ground effects and is slowed less by them.
The holder's running stamina drains slightly faster while this is active.
This is a movement and travel effect.
horse.tag: This is a movement and travel effect.

hunger.name: Devouring Scales
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales devour a portion of resisted elemental energy, restoring a little mana with each hit absorbed.
If the holder has not been struck by an element for a while, its scales grow hungry and its resistance drops slightly until it is struck again.
This is a harvest and defensive effect.
hunger.tag: This is a harvest and defensive effect.

hunt.name: Tracker's Hide
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When an enemy strikes the holder with an element, the holder marks that enemy, resisting its attacks slightly better and dealing slightly more damage to it.
Only a single enemy can be marked at a time, and the mark fades after a short time.
This is a hunting and tracking effect.
hunt.tag: This is a hunting and tracking effect.

hydra.name: Regrowing Scales
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When a heavy elemental hit tears scales from the holder, they regrow over a short time, briefly raising its resistance above its normal level as they do.
The regrowth can happen only once in a while, and is halted by fire damage.
This is a restoration and defensive effect.
hydra.tag: This is a restoration and defensive effect.

ice.name: Glacial Scales
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance to ice and frost rises sharply, and frozen ground does not slow it.
When the holder resists a frost attack, a thin shell of ice forms over its scales, absorbing a small amount of damage. The shell reforms once every few seconds.
This is an ice and frost effect.
ice.tag: This is an ice and frost effect.

immortal.name: Undying Plates
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Once per fight, when the holder would fall to elemental damage, its scales hold together and it survives with a sliver of health.
For a short time afterward, the holder's elemental resistance is raised sharply while it recovers.
This is a rebirth and defensive effect.
immortal.tag: This is a rebirth and defensive effect.

iron.name: Iron Scales
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales take on an iron sheen, slightly raising its resistance to physical damage alongside its elemental resistance.
While the iron sheen holds, the holder resists lightning slightly less.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
iron.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

juggernaut.name: Unstoppable Hide
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder moves forward toward an enemy, elemental attacks cannot slow, root, or knock it back.
This effect breaks if the holder takes too much damage in a short time, and cannot return until the holder rests briefly.
This is a momentum and defensive effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a momentum and defensive effect.

karmic.name: Reckoning Scales
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists an elemental hit, a portion of the resisted damage is paid back to the attacker as a jolt of the same element.
This repayment can happen once every few seconds per enemy.
This is a defensive and retribution effect.
karmic.tag: This is a defensive and retribution effect.

knife.name: Bladed Scales
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales grow sharp edges that cut enemies who strike it in melee, leaving a light bleed.
The edges dull for a short time after cutting an enemy.
This is a defensive and affliction effect.
knife.tag: This is a defensive and affliction effect.

knowledge.name: Scholar's Scales
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder recognises the elemental weaknesses and strengths of enemies it fights, resisting the element of the enemy it is facing slightly better.
This works against only a single enemy at a time and switches when the holder changes target.
This is a revelation and perception effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a revelation and perception effect.

kraken.name: Tidal Hide
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales resist water and lightning sharply, and tentacle or grappling attacks have trouble keeping hold on its slick scales.
When the holder breaks free from a grapple, it gains a brief burst of elemental resistance, once every few seconds.
This is a water and binding effect.
kraken.tag: This is a water and binding effect.

leviathan.name: Leviathan Plating
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales grow thick and broad like those of a great sea beast, resisting water and crushing attacks strongly.
The weight of these scales slows the holder slightly on land.
This is a water and defensive effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water and defensive effect.

life.name: Lifebloom Scales
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists an elemental hit, it gains a small amount of healing over a short time.
The healing does not stack with itself and cannot be gained again until it ends.
This is a healing and nature effect.
life.tag: This is a healing and nature effect.

light.name: Gleaming Scales
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales resist radiant and light damage strongly and shine with a soft glow that makes it harder for shadowy enemies to approach unseen.
When the holder resists a shadow attack, the glow flares, briefly blinding nearby shadowy enemies once every few seconds.
This is a light and radiant effect.
light.tag: This is a light and radiant effect.

lightning.name: Storm Scales
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance to lightning rises sharply, and it is not stunned by electrical attacks.
When the holder resists a lightning hit, a spark leaps from its scales to the nearest enemy, once every few seconds.
This is a lightning and storm effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and storm effect.

lizard.name: Moulting Hide
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Once per fight, the holder can shed its outer scales to cast off a lingering elemental effect, such as burning or freezing.
The fresh scales beneath are slightly weaker for a short time.
This is a purification and restoration effect.
lizard.tag: This is a purification and restoration effect.

locust.name: Swarming Plates
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists a heavy elemental hit, a cloud of loose scales lifts from its body and swarms the attacker, nibbling at it briefly.
The swarm cannot form again until a cooldown passes.
This is a swarm and defensive effect.
locust.tag: This is a swarm and defensive effect.

lotus.name: Lotus Scales
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder stands still and is not attacking, its scales open like petals, slowly raising its elemental resistance and cleansing a lingering effect at intervals.
The petals close when the holder moves or attacks.
This is a purification and restoration effect.
lotus.tag: This is a purification and restoration effect.

lurker.name: Shrouded Scale
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder is hidden or has not yet attacked in a fight, its elemental resistance is slightly higher.
The bonus fades the moment the holder strikes, but its first strike from hiding deals extra damage.
This is a stealth and defensive effect.
lurker.tag: This is a stealth and defensive effect.

magic.name: Arcane Scales
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance extends to raw magical damage, shrugging off a portion of pure spell force.
When the holder resists a spell, its own next spell costs slightly less mana, once every few seconds.
This is a mastery and warding effect.
magic.tag: This is a mastery and warding effect.

malign.name: Spiteful Hide
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance extends to curses and malign afflictions, slightly reducing how long they last.
When the holder resists a curse, a portion of it rebounds onto the caster for a short time.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

manatee.name: Gentle Hide
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder is near a wounded ally, a portion of its elemental resistance extends to that ally.
The holder moves slightly slower while sharing its resistance this way.
This is a support and protection effect.
manatee.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

manticore.name: Barbtail Scales
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's tail scales grow venomous barbs. When an enemy strikes the holder with an element, the holder lashes back with its tail, poisoning that enemy.
The lash has a short cooldown.
This is a poison and defensive effect.
manticore.tag: This is a poison and defensive effect.

master.name: Masterwork Scales
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder gains a small, even boost to resistance against every element, and its resistances cannot be lowered by enemy debuffs below their base level.
Enemy attempts to strip the holder's resistances fail entirely once per fight.
This is a mastery and warding effect.
master.tag: This is a mastery and warding effect.

might.name: Mighty Scales
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists an elemental hit, its next melee attack deals slightly increased damage.
The bonus can trigger once every few seconds and does not stack.
This is a defensive and might effect.
might.tag: This is a defensive and might effect.

ministration.name: Nursing Scales
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When an ally near the holder is afflicted with burning, freezing, or shock, the holder's scales draw some of that affliction onto itself, where its resistance blunts it.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a support and healing effect.
ministration.tag: This is a support and healing effect.

minotaur.name: Horned Hide
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder charges through an elemental hazard, it takes reduced damage and its next hit slightly staggers the target.
This works once every few seconds and costs stamina.
This is a momentum and defensive effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a momentum and defensive effect.

mirage.name: Heatshimmer Hide
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists a fire or light attack, a heat shimmer rises from its scales and blurs its outline, making the next ranged attack against it more likely to miss.
The shimmer has a short cooldown.
This is an illusion and evasion effect.
mirage.tag: This is an illusion and evasion effect.

mirror.name: Mirror Scales
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Once every so often, an elemental spell that strikes the holder is partly reflected back at its caster.
The reflection has a long cooldown and reflects only a portion of the spell.
This is a warding and defensive effect.
mirror.tag: This is a warding and defensive effect.

monkey.name: Nimble Scales
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder climbs, vaults, or leaps over an obstacle, it gains a brief burst of elemental resistance.
The burst cannot happen again for a short time after it triggers.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
monkey.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

monolith.name: Monolith Hide
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder stands its ground, its scales stiffen into a stone-like shell, sharply raising elemental resistance.
The holder cannot move while the shell holds, and breaking out of it takes a moment.
This is a defensive and barrier effect.
monolith.tag: This is a defensive and barrier effect.

moon.name: Moonlit Scales
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder fights in dim light or darkness, its scales take on a silver sheen that slightly raises resistance to every element.
The sheen fades in bright light, and returns only a short time after the holder is back in shadow.
This is a light and defensive effect.
moon.tag: This is a light and defensive effect.

mouse.name: Burrow Scales
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder is caught in an elemental area attack, it curls tight behind its scales, taking reduced damage from the rest of the attack.
While curled, the holder cannot attack. This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and evasion effect.
mouse.tag: This is a defensive and evasion effect.

myriad.name: Myriad Plates
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
