Each separate elemental hit that strikes the holder in quick succession deals slightly less damage than the hit before it.
The reduction resets after a short pause between hits.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
myriad.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

mystic.name: Sigil Hide
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Faint mystic sigils glow on the holder's scales, slightly raising its resistance to magical and elemental spells.
When the holder resists a spell, the sigils flare and briefly shield the closest ally from the same element, once every few seconds.
This is a warding and support effect.
mystic.tag: This is a warding and support effect.

nebula.name: Starcloud Hide
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Resisted elemental damage swirls around the holder as a faint cloud of starlit dust, slightly reducing the accuracy of enemies within it.
The cloud thins and disperses after a short time and cannot reform until a cooldown passes.
This is a defensive and area effect.
nebula.tag: This is a defensive and area effect.

needle.name: Quill Scales
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists an elemental hit, a few needle-fine scales shoot from its hide at the attacker.
The volley can fire once every few seconds and only at enemies within a short range.
This is a defensive and retaliation effect.
needle.tag: This is a defensive and retaliation effect.

nemesis.name: Grudge Scales
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The enemy that has dealt the most elemental damage to the holder this fight becomes its nemesis. The holder resists that enemy's attacks strongly.
The holder resists other enemies slightly less while it holds a nemesis.
This is a hunting and defensive effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a hunting and defensive effect.

net.name: Netted Scales
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Elemental projectiles that strike the holder are caught in a mesh of overlapping scales, which spreads their damage over a short time instead of all at once.
Only a single projectile can be caught this way at a time.
This is a binding and defensive effect.
net.tag: This is a binding and defensive effect.

network.name: Linked Hides
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder links its resistance with nearby allies: when any linked ally takes elemental damage, a portion is shared across the group.
The link only holds while the allies stay close, and the holder takes a larger share.
This is a support and binding effect.
network.tag: This is a support and binding effect.

oasis.name: Coolspring Hide
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists a fire or heat attack, it releases a cool spray that soothes nearby allies, reducing their burning damage for a short time.
The spray has a short cooldown.
This is a water and support effect.
oasis.tag: This is a water and support effect.

ocean.name: Sea-Dragon Hide
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance to water, frost, and storm attacks rises sharply, and waves cannot push it.
When struck by water, the holder's scales draw some of the moisture in, restoring a little stamina once every few seconds.
This is a water and storm effect.
ocean.tag: This is a water and storm effect.

octopus.name: Ink Scales
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder takes a heavy elemental hit, its scales release a cloud of ink that hides it from enemies for a short time.
The cloud cannot form again until a cooldown passes.
This is a stealth and evasion effect.
octopus.tag: This is a stealth and evasion effect.

omen.name: Warning Scales
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales prickle before a heavy elemental attack lands nearby, letting it and nearby allies brace slightly.
Braced allies take reduced damage from that attack. The warning has a short cooldown.
This is a precognition and support effect.
omen.tag: This is a precognition and support effect.

onslaught.name: Relentless Hide
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder is attacking without pause, its elemental resistance rises slightly with each hit it lands, up to a limit.
The bonus fades if the holder stops attacking for a short time.
This is a momentum and defensive effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a momentum and defensive effect.

pangolin.name: Rolling Scales
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Once per fight, when the holder is badly hurt, it rolls into a ball of overlapping scales, gaining heavy elemental resistance for a short time.
While rolled, the holder cannot attack.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

paper.name: Parchment Hide
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales grow thin and layered like folded paper, letting them bend under elemental blasts and spread the force.
Fire burns through these layers more easily, slightly lowering fire resistance.
This is a defensive and transformation effect.
paper.tag: This is a defensive and transformation effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Dream Scales
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists an elemental hit, a shimmering phantom of itself appears nearby to distract the attacker briefly.
The phantom vanishes when struck, and cannot appear again for a short time.
This is an illusion and evasion effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is an illusion and evasion effect.

phoenix.name: Phoenix Plumage
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance to fire rises sharply, and resisted fire damage slowly mends its wounds.
Once per fight, when the holder falls, it rises again in a burst of flame with a portion of its health.
This is a fire and rebirth effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a fire and rebirth effect.

plant.name: Mossback Scales
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales take on a bark-like texture that resists earth and water attacks slightly better.
Fire damage that strikes this bark burns a little hotter on the holder.
This is a nature and growth effect.
plant.tag: This is a nature and growth effect.

potent.name: Concentrated Scales
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance to the element it was last struck by is greatly increased for a short time.
Its resistance to other elements drops slightly while this lasts.
This is a mastery and defensive effect.
potent.tag: This is a mastery and defensive effect.

predatory.name: Stalking Hide
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder attacks a wounded enemy, it resists that enemy's elemental attacks slightly better until the enemy falls.
Only a single enemy can be stalked at a time.
This is a hunting and defensive effect.
predatory.tag: This is a hunting and defensive effect.

prison.name: Warden's Shell
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When an enemy repeatedly strikes the holder with the same element, the holder's scales close over that element, trapping some of it inside.
The trapped element can be released as a binding pulse that briefly roots the attacker, once every few seconds.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
prison.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

prosperity.name: Gilded Scales
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales take on a golden sheen. While the party is at high health, everyone in it resists elemental damage slightly better.
The bonus vanishes when any ally drops below half health.
This is a support and protection effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

pure.name: Cleansing Scales
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales cleanse lingering elemental effects over time, ending burns, chills, and shocks faster.
Once per fight, the holder can purge all lingering elemental effects at once.
This is a purification and restoration effect.
pure.tag: This is a purification and restoration effect.

rabbit.name: Startled Hide
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder is struck by a sudden elemental attack, it gains a brief burst of movement speed to escape.
The burst cannot happen again for a short time after it triggers.
This is a haste and evasion effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a haste and evasion effect.

rake.name: Furrowing Scales
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists an elemental ground effect, its scales rake through it, breaking up the hazard around its feet.
This works once every few seconds and only clears a small area.
This is a purification and harvest effect.
rake.tag: This is a purification and harvest effect.

rat.name: Scavenger Hide
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder resists poison and disease damage slightly better, and its scales cannot be corroded by acids.
When the holder resists a poison attack, it gains a little stamina, once every few seconds.
This is a poison and defensive effect.
rat.tag: This is a poison and defensive effect.

reagent.name: Catalytic Scales
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists an elemental hit, it gains a stack of catalysis. Its next ability that matches that element costs slightly less.
Catalysis stacks a few times and fades if unused for a short time.
This is an alchemy and mastery effect.
reagent.tag: This is an alchemy and mastery effect.

refracting.name: Refracting Scales
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Light and radiant attacks that strike the holder bend through its scales, scattering into harmless glints.
When the holder resists such an attack, it gains a brief bonus to evasion, once every few seconds.
This is a light and evasion effect.
refracting.tag: This is a light and evasion effect.

renewal.name: Renewing Scales
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Damaged scales on the holder slowly regrow over the course of a fight, restoring a little health each time a layer finishes regrowing.
Regrowth stops while the holder is burning.
This is a restoration and healing effect.
renewal.tag: This is a restoration and healing effect.

resolute.name: Unyielding Scales
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's elemental resistance holds firm against effects that would lower it, such as curses and debuffs.
While the holder is below half health, its resistance rises slightly instead.
This is a defensive and mastery effect.
resolute.tag: This is a defensive and mastery effect.

resonating.name: Humming Scales
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales hum in tune with nearby allies, sharing a small portion of its elemental resistance with them.
The hum fades if the holder is silenced or stunned.
This is a resonance and support effect.
resonating.tag: This is a resonance and support effect.

roc.name: Skyborne Scales
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance to wind and lightning rises sharply, and strong gusts cannot slow it.
When the holder resists a storm attack, its next leap carries it slightly farther, once every few seconds.
This is a wind and storm effect.
roc.tag: This is a wind and storm effect.

rune.name: Rune-Etched Scales
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Runes etch themselves into the holder's scales, slightly raising resistance to magical and elemental spells.
When the holder resists a spell, the runes glow and briefly ward the holder against the same spell, once every few seconds.
This is a warding and mastery effect.
rune.tag: This is a warding and mastery effect.

sacrifice.name: Offered Scales
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When an ally near the holder is about to take a fatal elemental hit, the holder takes the hit in its place.
This works once per fight and leaves the holder with lowered resistance for a short time afterward.
This is a protection and support effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

sand.name: Sandscour Hide
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder resists earth and wind attacks slightly better, and sandstorms do not blind it.
When the holder resists such an attack, a burst of sand blinds the attacker briefly, once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and affliction effect.
sand.tag: This is a defensive and affliction effect.

sceptre.name: Regal Scales
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales gleam with authority. Allies near the holder gain a small portion of its elemental resistance.
The bonus fades if the holder is staggered, and returns a short time later.
This is a command and support effect.
sceptre.tag: This is a command and support effect.

scribe.name: Inscribed Hide
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Each element that strikes the holder is written into its scales as a glowing script, and the holder resists that element slightly better for the rest of the fight.
Only a few elements can be inscribed at a time; a new inscription replaces the oldest.
This is a mastery and defensive effect.
scribe.tag: This is a mastery and defensive effect.

serene.name: Calm Scales
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder is at full health, its elemental resistance is slightly higher and it shrugs off fear effects.
The bonus fades as soon as the holder takes damage, and returns only after it has healed to full.
This is a defensive and restoration effect.
serene.tag: This is a defensive and restoration effect.

serpent.name: Coiled Scales
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales lie smooth and coiled like a serpent's, letting elemental beams and sprays glance off at an angle for reduced damage.
After a glancing hit, the holder's next strike lashes out quickly, once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and momentum effect.
serpent.tag: This is a defensive and momentum effect.

shark.name: Sharkskin Hide
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales roughen like sharkskin, scraping enemies who strike it in melee and leaving a light bleed.
When the holder smells blood on a nearby enemy, it resists that enemy's elemental attacks slightly better. The scraping has a short cooldown per enemy.
This is a hunting and defensive effect.
shark.tag: This is a hunting and defensive effect.

shield.name: Shieldwall Hide
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder raises a shield or guards, its elemental resistance is shared with allies directly behind it.
Holding this guard drains stamina steadily.
This is a shield and protection effect.
shield.tag: This is a shield and protection effect.

shimmer.name: Blurred Scales
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists an elemental hit, its scales shimmer and blur, raising its evasion for a short time.
The shimmer cannot appear again until a cooldown passes.
This is an evasion and illusion effect.
shimmer.tag: This is an evasion and illusion effect.

ship.name: Hull Plating
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales overlap like a ship's hull, keeping water and storm attacks from breaching its defences.
Allies who stay close behind the holder gain a share of this resistance, but the holder moves slightly slower while they do.
This is a water and protection effect.
ship.tag: This is a water and protection effect.

shovel.name: Earthen Plates
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Once per fight, when the holder is caught in a heavy elemental attack, it digs in and heaps earth over itself, blocking most of the attack.
The holder is briefly stuck in place while it digs itself out.
This is a defensive and barrier effect.
shovel.tag: This is a defensive and barrier effect.

sickle.name: Crescent Scales
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists an elemental hit, its next sweeping strike reaps a portion of the element from all enemies in its arc, weakening their elemental attacks briefly.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a harvest and affliction effect.
sickle.tag: This is a harvest and affliction effect.

simulacrum.name: Shell Double
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Once per fight, the holder sheds its scales into a hollow double of itself that stands nearby for a short time.
The double shares the holder's elemental resistance and draws enemy attacks while it lasts.
This is a conjuration and protection effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a conjuration and protection effect.

sin.name: Defiant Hide
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance extends to holy and radiant damage, and its scales darken when struck by such attacks.
Each time it resists a holy attack, the holder's next attack deals slightly increased damage, once every few seconds.
This is a curse and defensive effect.
sin.tag: This is a curse and defensive effect.

skirmish.name: Skirmisher's Hide
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
After the holder dodges or repositions, it gains a brief burst of elemental resistance.
The burst cannot happen again for a short time after it triggers.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

skunk.name: Musk Scales
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder takes a heavy elemental hit, it releases a foul cloud that makes nearby enemies hesitate briefly.
The cloud has a short cooldown.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
skunk.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

sky.name: Sky Hide
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance to wind, lightning, and weather effects rises sharply.
When the holder resists such an attack, a gust clears lingering clouds and smoke around it, once every few seconds.
This is a wind and storm effect.
sky.tag: This is a wind and storm effect.

sloth.name: Torpid Hide
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder moves slowly or stands still, its elemental resistance rises slightly.
The bonus fades when the holder sprints or dodges.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
sloth.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

smoke.name: Smoke Scales
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists a fire hit, its scales vent smoke that hides it from ranged attacks for a short time.
The smoke has a short cooldown.
This is a fire and stealth effect.
smoke.tag: This is a fire and stealth effect.

snake.name: Shedding Hide
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Once per fight, the holder sheds its outer scales, removing all lingering elemental effects.
The holder resists poison slightly better for the rest of the fight after shedding.
This is a purification and poison effect.
snake.tag: This is a purification and poison effect.

soaring.name: Updraft Scales
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists a wind or storm hit, the updraft carries it a short way in the direction it was moving.
This happens once every few seconds and cannot carry the holder over walls.
This is a wind and movement effect.
soaring.tag: This is a wind and movement effect.

song.name: Singing Scales
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales chime when struck by an element, and the chime briefly raises the resistance of nearby allies to that element.
The chime has a short cooldown.
This is a sound and support effect.
song.tag: This is a sound and support effect.

sovereign.name: Crowned Scales
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales form a regal crest. Allies near the holder resist the element that last struck the holder slightly better.
The bonus fades when the holder is stunned or knocked down.
This is a command and support effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a command and support effect.

spear.name: Spearhead Scales
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder advances in front of the party, it resists elemental attacks slightly better and draws some of them toward itself.
The bonus ends if the holder falls back behind its allies.
This is a protection and command effect.
spear.tag: This is a protection and command effect.

spider.name: Silk Scales
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales are bound with fine silk that catches elemental projectiles and slows their impact, reducing their damage slightly.
Fire burns through the silk, removing this benefit for a short time.
This is a binding and defensive effect.
spider.tag: This is a binding and defensive effect.

spike.name: Thorn Scales
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales grow sharp spikes. Enemies who strike it in melee with an elemental attack take a small amount of damage back.
The spikes need a short time to regrow after they strike.
This is a defensive and retaliation effect.
spike.tag: This is a defensive and retaliation effect.

staff.name: Channelled Scales
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Resisted elemental energy flows through the holder's scales into its staff or focus, slightly increasing its next spell's damage.
This can happen once every few seconds and only while the holder is holding a staff or focus.
This is a mastery and defensive effect.
staff.tag: This is a mastery and defensive effect.

star.name: Star Scales
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales shine with starlight, resisting radiant and cosmic damage slightly better.
When the holder resists such an attack, a small flash of starlight dazzles the attacker briefly, once every few seconds.
This is a radiant and light effect.
star.tag: This is a radiant and light effect.

stellar.name: Celestial Plates
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales catch the light of distant stars, slightly raising resistance to every element while the holder is in open ground.
In cramped spaces, this bonus fades.
This is a radiant and defensive effect.
stellar.tag: This is a radiant and defensive effect.

storm.name: Tempest Mantle
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance to lightning, wind, and rain rises sharply.
When the holder resists a storm attack, a gust buffets nearby enemies back a short way. This happens once every few seconds.
This is a storm and wind effect.
storm.tag: This is a storm and wind effect.

succubus.name: Unswayed Scales
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance extends to charm and compulsion effects, shortening how long they hold it.
When the holder breaks free of a charm, it resists the charmer's elemental attacks slightly better for a short time.
This is a warding and defensive effect.
succubus.tag: This is a warding and defensive effect.

sun.name: Sun Scales
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance to fire and radiant damage rises sharply, and its scales glow with gentle warmth.
Allies near the holder resist frost slightly better while the glow lasts. The glow fades for a short time after the holder takes a heavy frost hit.
This is a fire and radiant effect.
sun.tag: This is a fire and radiant effect.

swarm.name: Hive Scales
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists an elemental hit, small motes of energy break from its scales and buzz around it, absorbing part of the next elemental hit.
The motes disperse after a short time and stack only a few times.
This is a swarm and protection effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and protection effect.

swift.name: Fleet Scales
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
After the holder resists an elemental hit, it gains a brief burst of movement speed.
The burst cannot happen again for a short time after it triggers.
This is a haste and movement effect.
swift.tag: This is a haste and movement effect.

sword.name: Parrying Scales
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder parries an elemental melee attack, it resists that element strongly for a short time.
Its next sword strike deals slightly increased damage. This works once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and mastery effect.
sword.tag: This is a defensive and mastery effect.

talisman.name: Charmed Scales
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
A protective charm forms in the holder's scales, absorbing a portion of the first elemental hit it takes each fight.
The charm reforms after a long cooldown.
This is a warding and protection effect.
talisman.tag: This is a warding and protection effect.

tentacle.name: Grasping Scales
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When an enemy strikes the holder with an elemental attack in melee, the holder's scales briefly grip the attacker, slowing it.
This works once every few seconds per enemy.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

thread.name: Stitched Scales
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales are stitched together with fine thread that tightens when struck by an element, holding them together against heavy hits.
After a heavy hit, the stitches loosen and need a short time to tighten again.
This is a binding and defensive effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and defensive effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderwing Hide
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance to lightning and thunder rises sharply, and it cannot be deafened by thunder.
When the holder resists a lightning attack, a thunderclap rings out, briefly stunning nearby enemies once per fight.
This is a lightning and sound effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a lightning and sound effect.

time.name: Timeworn Scales
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Once per fight, when the holder takes a heavy elemental hit, its scales turn back a moment, undoing a portion of that damage.
Lingering elemental effects on the holder tick more slowly while this is in effect.
This is a time and restoration effect.
time.tag: This is a time and restoration effect.

tranquil.name: Stillwater Scales
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder has not been hit for a short time, its elemental resistance rises slightly and it slowly recovers mana.
The bonus ends the moment the holder is struck.
This is a restoration and defensive effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a restoration and defensive effect.

transfiguration.name: Reshaping Hide
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder is struck by an element it resists poorly, its scales reshape themselves to resist that element better for a short time.
The reshaping has a short cooldown and slightly lowers resistance to other elements while it holds.
This is a transformation and defensive effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a transformation and defensive effect.

transgression.name: Outlaw Hide
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales resist warding and binding magic, letting it push through barriers and wards that would hold it back.
Doing so costs a portion of its health.
This is a defensive and curse effect.
transgression.tag: This is a defensive and curse effect.

trap.name: Snare Scales
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder resists elemental traps and triggered hazards strongly.
When the holder sets off such a trap, it gains a brief burst of resistance against all elements, once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and detection effect.
trap.tag: This is a defensive and detection effect.

tree.name: Bark Hide
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales thicken into a bark-like layer that resists earth and water attacks slightly better.
While rooted in place for a moment, the holder slowly recovers health.
This is a nature and growth effect.
tree.tag: This is a nature and growth effect.

troll.name: Troll Hide
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales knit back together quickly after elemental damage, healing it slowly over time.
Fire and acid damage stop this regeneration for a short time.
This is a restoration and healing effect.
troll.tag: This is a restoration and healing effect.

trowel.name: Masoned Scales
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder's scales crack from a heavy elemental hit, they are mortared back together, restoring the lost resistance over a short time.
This repair has a short cooldown.
This is a restoration and defensive effect.
trowel.tag: This is a restoration and defensive effect.

turtle.name: Shellback Scales
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's back scales harden into a shell that resists elemental attacks from behind strongly.
The holder moves slightly slower while the shell holds.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
turtle.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

twilight.name: Gloaming Scales
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales take on the colours of dusk, resisting both light and shadow damage slightly better.
When the holder resists either, it gains a brief bonus to stealth, once every few seconds.
This is a shadow and light effect.
twilight.tag: This is a shadow and light effect.

undeath.name: Deathless Scales
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance extends to necromantic damage and draining effects, and its scales cannot be withered.
Once per fight, when the holder would fall, it clings on with its scales hardened for a short time before healing can reach it.
This is a necromantic and death effect.
undeath.tag: This is a necromantic and death effect.

unity.name: Kindred Scales
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Allies near the holder share its elemental resistance. The more allies stand near the holder, the stronger the shared resistance becomes, up to a limit.
The bonus fades if the holder is separated from the group.
This is a support and protection effect.
unity.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

vast.name: Vast Hide
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales spread wide, letting its resistance cover a broader area so that allies nearby take reduced damage from elemental area attacks.
The holder moves slightly slower while its scales are spread.
This is an area and protection effect.
vast.tag: This is an area and protection effect.

vehicle.name: Carriage Plates
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder moves at a steady pace, its scales lock into a rigid frame that resists elemental attacks slightly better.
Stopping suddenly or changing direction breaks the frame for a short time.
This is a movement and defensive effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a movement and defensive effect.

venom.name: Venom Scales
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder resists poison strongly, and enemies who strike it in melee are lightly poisoned.
The poison cannot stack, and needs a short time to build up again.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

verdant.name: Greenheart Hide
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales sprout small leaves when it resists an elemental hit, slowly healing it and allies near it for a short time.
This healing cannot stack and has a short cooldown.
This is a nature and healing effect.
verdant.tag: This is a nature and healing effect.

vessel.name: Reservoir Scales
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Resisted elemental damage is stored in the holder's scales as a reservoir, up to a limit that scales with rank.
When the reservoir is full, the holder releases it as a burst of elemental energy around itself, damaging nearby enemies.
This is an area and defensive effect.
vessel.tag: This is an area and defensive effect.

visage.name: Terrible Visage
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists a heavy elemental hit, its scales flare into a fearsome draconic face that frightens the attacker briefly.
This can happen once every few seconds per enemy.
This is a transformation and command effect.
visage.tag: This is a transformation and command effect.

vision.name: Farsight Scales
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder sees elemental attacks coming from far away and braces against them, taking reduced damage from distant spells.
The bracing works once every few seconds.
This is a perception and precognition effect.
vision.tag: This is a perception and precognition effect.

void.name: Hollow Scales
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
Once every so often, an elemental hit that strikes the holder vanishes into the void beneath its scales, dealing no damage.
This has a long cooldown and does not work on attacks the holder cannot see.
This is a dimensional and defensive effect.
void.tag: This is a dimensional and defensive effect.

volcano.name: Magma Scales
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance to fire and earth rises sharply, and molten ground does not harm it.
When the holder resists a fire or earth hit, it erupts in a small burst of magma around itself, once every few seconds.
This is a fire and earth effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and earth effect.

vortex.name: Whirling Scales
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists an elemental projectile, it spins the projectile around itself and sends it back toward the nearest enemy.
This works once every few seconds and only against projectiles.
This is a wind and defensive effect.
vortex.tag: This is a wind and defensive effect.

wasp.name: Stinging Scales
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists an elemental hit, its scales sting the attacker with a small jolt of venom.
The sting needs a short time to recharge.
This is a poison and retaliation effect.
wasp.tag: This is a poison and retaliation effect.

water.name: Tideshell Scales
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance to water rises sharply, and wet ground does not slow it.
When the holder resists a fire hit, its scales release a burst of steam that briefly obscures it from enemies, once every few seconds.
This is a water and defensive effect.
water.tag: This is a water and defensive effect.

weave.name: Interwoven Scales
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales weave a thin web of magic between it and nearby allies, sharing a small portion of its elemental resistance.
The web unravels if the holder is stunned.
This is a binding and support effect.
weave.tag: This is a binding and support effect.

wendigo.name: Ravenous Rime
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance to frost and cold rises sharply, and cold damage it resists feeds it a little health.
While the holder is not being struck by cold, its scales slowly lose this resistance until struck again.
This is a frost and harvest effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a frost and harvest effect.

whale.name: Broadback Hide
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's thick scales resist water and crushing damage strongly and spread the force of elemental blasts across its broad hide.
The holder moves slightly slower while this is in effect.
This is a water and defensive effect.
whale.tag: This is a water and defensive effect.

wheel.name: Turning Scales
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder is struck by an element, its scales rotate to a fresh face, resisting the next hit of that element slightly better.
This rotation can happen once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and momentum effect.
wheel.tag: This is a defensive and momentum effect.

whip.name: Lashing Scales
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder resists an elemental melee hit, its tail lashes out at the attacker, slowing it briefly.
The lash has a short cooldown.
This is a defensive and restraint effect.
whip.tag: This is a defensive and restraint effect.

wind.name: Windswept Scales
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's resistance to wind rises sharply, and gusts cannot push it around.
When the holder resists a wind hit, it gains a brief burst of movement speed, once every few seconds.
This is a wind and haste effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and haste effect.

wing.name: Wingshield Hide
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder can fold its scaled wings around itself to shield against an elemental attack, taking reduced damage from it.
The holder cannot move while shielded, and this has a short cooldown.
This is a shield and protection effect.
wing.tag: This is a shield and protection effect.

wolf.name: Pack Hide
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder fights beside an ally, its elemental resistance is slightly higher.
The bonus fades if the holder is separated from its allies.
This is a support and protection effect.
wolf.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

wood.name: Timber Scales
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales grow a wooden grain that resists lightning and water slightly better.
Fire burns through the grain more easily, lowering fire resistance slightly.
This is a nature and defensive effect.
wood.tag: This is a nature and defensive effect.

wrath.name: Raging Scales
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
When the holder takes heavy elemental damage, it falls into a brief rage, gaining increased damage and resistance to the element that struck it.
The rage ends after a short time and cannot happen again until a cooldown passes.
This is a defensive and fire effect.
wrath.tag: This is a defensive and fire effect.

zeal.name: Zealous Scales
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
While the holder is fighting enemies of opposing faith or dark nature, its scales glow with zeal, raising its resistance to their elemental attacks.
The glow fades when no such enemies remain nearby.
This is a holy and radiant effect.
zeal.tag: This is a holy and radiant effect.

ziz.name: Skyshade Scales
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Scales]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Scales].
The holder's scales spread wide like the wings of a vast bird, sheltering allies near it from elemental attacks from above.
The holder moves slightly slower while its scales are spread this way.
This is a protection and wind effect.
ziz.tag: This is a protection and wind effect.

action.name: Snap Exhale
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
When the holder finishes a dodge or a charge, it can loose its breath at once with no wind-up.
This can happen once every few seconds and costs stamina.
This is a momentum and haste effect.
action.tag: This is a momentum and haste effect.

adept.name: Learned Cone
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Each time the breath strikes the same enemy during a fight, the holder learns its weak points, and later breaths deal slightly more damage to it.
The effect stacks a few times per enemy and fades when the fight ends.
This is a mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Reagent Plume
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
When the holder drinks a potion, its next breath carries the potion's harmful counterpart, afflicting enemies in the cone with a matching ailment.
This works only within a short time of drinking, and only for the next breath.
This is an alchemy and affliction effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and affliction effect.

ambush.name: Hidden Gout
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The holder's breath against an enemy that has not yet noticed it deals bonus damage and briefly stuns.
This can affect each enemy only once per fight.
This is a stealth and hunting effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and hunting effect.

animate.name: Breath Wyrmling
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Once per fight, the breath leaves behind a small serpent made of its own element that coils forward and bites the nearest enemy.
The serpent lasts a short time and fades at once if the holder falls.
This is an animation and conjuration effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and conjuration effect.

anzu.name: Thunderclap Breath
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath crackles with storm, and enemies at the edge of the cone are struck by lightning that arcs to another nearby foe.
The arcing costs extra mana and only happens while the holder's mana is high.
This is a lightning and storm effect.
anzu.tag: This is a lightning and storm effect.

ape.name: Bellowing Roar
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath comes out as a roar as well, knocking lower-rank enemies in the cone back a short distance.
This costs extra stamina, and the same enemy cannot be knocked back again for a short time.
This is a sound and momentum effect.
ape.tag: This is a sound and momentum effect.

armour.name: Scaled Exhale
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
After the holder breathes, its scales harden for a short time, reducing damage taken by an amount scaled to how many enemies the breath struck.
The hardening does not stack and ends early if the holder is knocked down.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
armour.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

arsenal.name: Shard Gale
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath carries a spray of conjured blade shards that leave bleeding wounds on enemies struck.
The bleeding lasts a short time, and the shards cost extra mana.
This is a conjuration and affliction effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a conjuration and affliction effect.

aspect.name: Borrowed Element
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath takes on the element of the last ability that struck the holder, dealing that kind of damage on top of its own.
The borrowed element fades after a short time and cannot be taken from the same enemy again during a fight.
This is a transformation effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation effect.

avatar.name: Looming Wyrm
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Once per fight, when the holder breathes while badly hurt, a towering draconic image rises behind it and the cone widens greatly.
The widened breath costs a large amount of mana and leaves the holder unable to breathe again for a while.
This is a transformation and area effect.
avatar.tag: This is a transformation and area effect.

axe.name: Cleaving Exhale
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath strikes with a cutting edge, dealing extra damage to enemies at the very front of the cone and stripping away a portion of their armour.
The armour returns after a short time, and the cutting edge costs stamina.
This is a sundering and affliction effect.
axe.tag: This is a sundering and affliction effect.

balance.name: Even Measure
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
When the breath strikes a lone enemy, its damage is concentrated on that foe; when it strikes a crowd, the holder recovers a little health for each enemy caught.
The healing is small and can only restore a portion of the holder's health each fight.
This is a healing and mastery effect.
balance.tag: This is a healing and mastery effect.

bat.name: Echoing Breath
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath carries a pulse of sound that reveals hidden enemies within the cone for a short time.
The pulse costs a little extra mana.
This is a sound and detection effect.
bat.tag: This is a sound and detection effect.

battlefield.name: Seared Ground
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath leaves the ground it touched charged with its element, and enemies standing there take damage over time.
The patch lasts a short time, and only the most recent patch remains.
This is an area effect.
battlefield.tag: This is an area effect.

bear.name: Ursine Retort
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
When the holder breathes at an enemy that has just struck it, the breath deals bonus damage and briefly frightens that enemy.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a retaliation and sound effect.
bear.tag: This is a retaliation and sound effect.

bee.name: Stinging Haze
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath leaves a haze of stinging motes that poison enemies who walk through it.
The haze lasts a short time, and only the most recent haze remains.
This is a poison and swarm effect.
bee.tag: This is a poison and swarm effect.

behemoth.name: Titan Exhalation
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath deals extra damage to enemies larger than the holder and staggers them.
This costs heavy stamina, and the same enemy cannot be staggered this way again for a short time.
This is an annihilation effect.
behemoth.tag: This is an annihilation effect.

bird.name: Sweeping Gust
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The holder can breathe while running without slowing, the cone sweeping along its path.
Holding the breath while moving drains stamina steadily.
This is a movement and wind effect.
bird.tag: This is a movement and wind effect.

blight.name: Withering Plume
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Enemies struck by the breath are blighted and receive less healing for a short time.
The blight does not stack and costs extra mana.
This is an affliction and curse effect.
blight.tag: This is an affliction and curse effect.

blood.name: Sanguine Gout
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath draws a portion of the damage it deals back to the holder as health.
The draining only happens while the holder is hurt, and once every few seconds.
This is a blood and healing effect.
blood.tag: This is a blood and healing effect.

bone.name: Ossuary Breath
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Enemies slain by the breath leave bone shards that briefly armour nearby allies.
Each shard lasts a short time, and how many an ally can carry scales with rank.
This is a necromantic and protection effect.
bone.tag: This is a necromantic and protection effect.

boundary.name: Bounded Cone
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath leaves a shimmering line of ward along the edge of the cone, and enemies who cross it take damage.
The line lasts a short time and vanishes when the holder breathes again.
This is a warding and barrier effect.
boundary.tag: This is a warding and barrier effect.

bounty.name: Generous Breath
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Enemies slain by the breath release a small burst of mana that the nearest ally absorbs.
Each enemy releases this only once, and the amount is small.
This is a harvest and support effect.
bounty.tag: This is a harvest and support effect.

bow.name: Lancing Breath
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
When its target stands far away, the holder narrows the breath into a long thin line that reaches much farther and pierces through enemies.
The narrow breath costs extra mana and loses the width of the cone.
This is a hunting effect.
bow.tag: This is a hunting effect.

brush.name: Painted Breath
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath leaves a painted streak on enemies struck, and allies' attacks against a painted enemy deal slightly more damage.
The paint wears away after a short time.
This is a revelation and support effect.
brush.tag: This is a revelation and support effect.

cage.name: Caging Breath
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The edges of the breath harden into bars that briefly hold the enemy at the centre of the cone in place.
This can happen once every few seconds, and stronger enemies break free sooner.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
cage.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

cat.name: Pouncing Breath
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
After the holder leaps or dashes at an enemy, its next breath within a short time deals bonus damage.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a hunting and momentum effect.
cat.tag: This is a hunting and momentum effect.

cataclysm.name: Ruinous Exhalation
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Once per fight, the holder breathes a vast cone that shakes the ground, damaging and knocking down everything in it.
The holder is exhausted afterward and cannot breathe again for a while.
This is an annihilation and area effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an annihilation and area effect.

cattle.name: Stampede Breath
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath shoves enemies along with it, pushing them away from allies standing behind the holder.
This costs stamina and moves only lower-rank enemies.
This is a momentum effect.
cattle.tag: This is a momentum effect.

chain.name: Chained Gout
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
When the breath kills an enemy, a lash of its element leaps from the body to the nearest foe outside the cone.
The lash deals reduced damage and can leap only once per breath.
This is a binding and area effect.
chain.tag: This is a binding and area effect.

chaotic.name: Wild Exhalation
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Each breath takes on a random extra element, adding a matching burn, chill, shock or poison to enemies struck.
The holder cannot choose the element, and the extra effect costs a little mana.
This is a fire, frost, lightning and poison effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a fire, frost, lightning and poison effect.

charlatan.name: False Ember
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
When the holder is about to breathe, enemies in front of it see the breath coming from a slightly different angle and dodge the wrong way.
This works only on enemies that have not yet seen the holder breathe this fight.
This is an illusion and evasion effect.
charlatan.tag: This is an illusion and evasion effect.

chicken.name: Clucking Burst
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
When the holder is hurt badly, it lets out a startled burst of breath that pushes nearby enemies away and gives it a moment to retreat.
This happens once per fight and deals reduced damage.
This is an evasion and movement effect.
chicken.tag: This is an evasion and movement effect.

chimera.name: Chimeric Maw
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath splits into a fire cone, a poison cone and a storm cone, each covering part of the full arc.
Splitting costs extra mana and each part deals a portion of the full damage.
This is a fire, poison and storm effect.
chimera.tag: This is a fire, poison and storm effect.

claw.name: Rending Breath
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
After the holder strikes an enemy with its claws, its next breath at that enemy tears open the wounds, dealing bonus bleeding damage.
The bonus lasts a short time after the claw strike.
This is an affliction and hunting effect.
claw.tag: This is an affliction and hunting effect.

cloth.name: Smothering Veil
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath wraps the enemy nearest the holder in a clinging veil that slows its attacks for a short time.
The veil can hold only lower-rank enemies and costs a little mana.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
cloth.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

cloud.name: Fog Breath
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath leaves a bank of mist behind it, and enemies inside the mist find it harder to hit allies.
The mist lasts a short time, and only the most recent bank remains.
This is a water and evasion effect.
cloud.tag: This is a water and evasion effect.

cold.name: Rime Exhale
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath chills enemies struck, slowing their movement for a short time.
An enemy chilled repeatedly is briefly frozen in place, which cannot happen again to that enemy for a while.
This is a frost and cold effect.
cold.tag: This is a frost and cold effect.

coral.name: Reefborn Spray
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Enemies struck by the breath are crusted with sharp coral that cuts them when they move.
The crust lasts a short time and breaks if the enemy takes a heavy hit.
This is a water and growth effect.
coral.tag: This is a water and growth effect.

corrupt.name: Tainted Breath
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath corrupts the boons of enemies struck, turning a boon into a matching affliction.
Only the newest boon on each enemy is affected, and this costs extra mana.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

crocodile.name: Crocodile Pyre
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
When the holder breathes on an enemy it is grappling or that is knocked down, the breath deals heavy bonus damage.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a hunting and annihilation effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a hunting and annihilation effect.

crystal.name: Prism Breath
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath leaves crystal growths where it lands, and allies who stand near a growth regain mana slowly.
Each growth lasts a short time, and only a few can exist at once.
This is a resonance and support effect.
crystal.tag: This is a resonance and support effect.

cycle.name: Turning Breath
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Each breath shifts its element in a fixed cycle, and completing the cycle within a fight makes the next breath strike with every element at once.
The full cycle resets if the holder goes too long without breathing.
This is a mastery and time effect.
cycle.tag: This is a mastery and time effect.

dance.name: Whirling Breath
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The holder can spin as it breathes, sweeping the breath in a ring around itself.
The ring deals reduced damage and costs stamina.
This is a movement and area effect.
dance.tag: This is a movement and area effect.

dark.name: Shadow Breath
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath carries shadow, blinding enemies struck so they lose track of the holder for a short time.
Blinded enemies cannot be blinded again this way for a while.
This is a shadow and darkness effect.
dark.tag: This is a shadow and darkness effect.

dawn.name: Daybreak Breath
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath glows with first light, burning undead and dark creatures with extra radiant damage and lightly healing allies it passes over.
The healing is small and can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a light and healing effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and healing effect.

death.name: Grave Breath
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath deals extra damage to enemies that are already badly hurt.
Enemies slain this way cannot be raised or revived by their allies for the rest of the fight.
This is a death and necromantic effect.
death.tag: This is a death and necromantic effect.

deep.name: Abyssal Exhale
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath carries crushing pressure, slowing enemies struck and deepening the damage they take from the holder's next attack.
The pressure lasts a short time and costs extra stamina.
This is a water and affliction effect.
deep.tag: This is a water and affliction effect.

deer.name: Fleet Breath
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
After the holder breathes, it gains a burst of speed to bound away from enemies in front of it.
The burst lasts a short time and can happen once every few seconds.
This is a haste and evasion effect.
deer.tag: This is a haste and evasion effect.

desolate.name: Barren Breath
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath strips enemies struck of their regeneration and lingering healing for a short time.
The holder pays a little of its own health each time this triggers.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
desolate.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

dimension.name: Folded Cone
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath can begin from a point a short distance in front of the holder, reaching enemies hiding behind cover.
Folding the breath costs extra mana and can happen once every few seconds.
This is a dimensional effect.
dimension.tag: This is a dimensional effect.

discord.name: Jarring Breath
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath rings with a harsh note that interrupts enemies who are channelling or casting.
Interrupted enemies cannot be interrupted this way again for a short time.
This is a sound and affliction effect.
discord.tag: This is a sound and affliction effect.

discordant.name: Dissonant Roar
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Enemies struck by the breath are confused for a short time and may strike at each other.
Confusion only takes hold on lower-rank enemies and costs extra mana.
This is a sound and curse effect.
discordant.tag: This is a sound and curse effect.

dog.name: Pack Howl
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
When the holder breathes on an enemy an ally is already fighting, that ally gains a brief burst of attack speed.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a support and hunting effect.
dog.tag: This is a support and hunting effect.

doom.name: Doomfire Breath
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath marks enemies struck with doom; when the mark ends, they take a burst of delayed damage scaled to what the breath dealt.
Only the most recent mark on each enemy counts, and the mark costs extra mana.
This is a curse and death effect.
doom.tag: This is a curse and death effect.

doppelganger.name: Mirrored Breath
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Once per fight, a shadowy copy of the holder appears beside it and breathes a weaker cone in the same direction.
The copy fades after its breath.
This is a conjuration and shadow effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a conjuration and shadow effect.

dragon.name: True Wyrmflame
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath gains extra damage for each essence the holder has absorbed beyond its rank's usual measure, and strikes fear into lower-rank enemies.
The fear lasts a short time and the breath's cooldown lengthens slightly.
This is a fire and mastery effect.
dragon.tag: This is a fire and mastery effect.

duck.name: Paddling Spray
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath carries a spray of water that soaks enemies struck, making them slip and lose footing for a short time.
Soaked enemies cannot be tripped again this way for a while.
This is a water effect.
duck.tag: This is a water effect.

dust.name: Choking Dust
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath leaves a cloud of dust that blinds enemies inside it and makes them miss more often.
The cloud lasts a short time, and only the most recent cloud remains.
This is an evasion and area effect.
dust.tag: This is an evasion and area effect.

earth.name: Quarry Breath
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath carries grit and stone, knocking lower-rank enemies off their feet.
Knocked-down enemies cannot be knocked down this way again for a short time, and this costs stamina.
This is an earth effect.
earth.tag: This is an earth effect.

echo.name: Echoing Exhale
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
A short time after the holder breathes, a faint echo of the breath sweeps the same cone again.
The echo deals a portion of the damage and cannot itself echo.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
echo.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

eclipse.name: Eclipsed Breath
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath carries light and shadow together, dealing radiant damage to dark creatures and shadow damage to everything else.
Splitting the element this way costs extra mana.
This is a light and shadow effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a light and shadow effect.

edifice.name: Bulwark Breath
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath leaves a low wall of hardened slag at the far edge of the cone, blocking enemy movement and projectiles.
The wall lasts a short time, and only the most recent wall remains.
This is a barrier and conjuration effect.
edifice.tag: This is a barrier and conjuration effect.

effigy.name: Effigy Flame
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Once per fight, the holder breathes life into a burning effigy of itself that taunts nearby enemies.
The effigy lasts a short time and bursts into a weaker cone of breath when it is destroyed.
This is an animation and fire effect.
effigy.tag: This is an animation and fire effect.

elemental.name: Elemental Torrent
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath deals bonus damage of whichever element the enemy struck is weakest against.
Finding that weakness costs extra mana, and the bonus does not work against enemies with no weakness.
This is a fire, frost and lightning effect.
elemental.tag: This is a fire, frost and lightning effect.

elixir.name: Tonic Mist
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
When allies stand behind the holder as it breathes, a soft mist flows back over them and restores a little health.
The mist heals only lightly and can happen once every few seconds.
This is an alchemy and healing effect.
elixir.tag: This is an alchemy and healing effect.

empower.name: Kindling Breath
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Allies caught in the back draft of the breath gain a brief boon that adds the breath's element to their attacks.
The boon lasts a short time and costs the holder extra mana.
This is a support and fire effect.
empower.tag: This is a support and fire effect.

eye.name: Seeking Breath
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath bends slightly toward the weakest point of each enemy in the cone, dealing extra damage on critical hits.
