This costs a little extra mana and only works on enemies the holder can see clearly.
This is a perception effect.
eye.tag: This is a perception effect.

feast.name: Gorging Breath
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Each enemy slain by the breath restores a little of the holder's health and stamina.
The restoration stacks only a few times per fight.
This is a harvest and restoration effect.
feast.tag: This is a harvest and restoration effect.

feeble.name: Sapping Breath
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Enemies struck by the breath are weakened and deal less damage for a short time.
Weakened enemies cannot be weakened again this way until the effect ends.
This is an affliction and curse effect.
feeble.tag: This is an affliction and curse effect.

fertile.name: Seeding Breath
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath leaves the ground thick with fast-growing vines that slow enemies and slowly heal allies standing in them.
The growth lasts a short time, and only the most recent patch remains.
This is a nature and growth effect.
fertile.tag: This is a nature and growth effect.

fey.name: Glamour Breath
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath glitters with fey light, charming lower-rank enemies struck so they wander aimlessly for a short time.
An enemy that takes damage breaks free, and the charm costs extra mana.
This is a curse and illusion effect.
fey.tag: This is a curse and illusion effect.

fire.name: Furnace Breath
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath sets enemies struck alight, burning them for a short time.
The burn stacks a few times on each enemy, and each stack costs a little extra mana.
This is a fire and burn effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire and burn effect.

firebird.name: Rising Cinder
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Once per fight, when the holder falls, it releases a final burst of flame that damages nearby enemies and heals nearby allies.
The burst does not revive the holder.
This is a fire and rebirth effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire and rebirth effect.

fish.name: Gill Spray
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath becomes a high-pressure jet of water that pushes enemies back and puts out burning allies it passes over.
The jet costs stamina and pushes only lower-rank enemies.
This is a water effect.
fish.tag: This is a water effect.

flea.name: Skipping Breath
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The holder can hop a short distance in any direction just before breathing, adjusting its angle.
The hop costs stamina and can happen once every few seconds.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
flea.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

flesh.name: Searing Viscera
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The holder can pay a portion of its own health to deal extra damage with its breath.
The health cost cannot bring the holder below a low threshold.
This is a blood and transformation effect.
flesh.tag: This is a blood and transformation effect.

foot.name: Stomping Breath
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The holder stamps as it breathes, sending a tremor through the cone that briefly roots enemies.
The stamp costs stamina, and rooted enemies cannot be rooted again this way for a short time.
This is an earth and restraint effect.
foot.tag: This is an earth and restraint effect.

force.name: Ramming Gust
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath strikes with sheer force, knocking enemies back and slamming them into walls for extra damage.
The force costs extra mana and moves only lower-rank enemies.
This is a momentum effect.
force.tag: This is a momentum effect.

forge.name: Smelting Breath
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath heats the weapons of allies it brushes past, adding fire damage to their attacks for a short time.
Each ally can be heated this way once every few seconds.
This is a fire and support effect.
forge.tag: This is a fire and support effect.

fork.name: Forked Flame
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath splits into narrower prongs that reach farther and strike enemies at different angles.
Each prong deals a portion of the full damage, and splitting costs extra mana.
This is a lightning and area effect.
fork.tag: This is a lightning and area effect.

fortress.name: Rampart Breath
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
While the holder stands its ground and breathes, it takes reduced damage from enemies in front of it.
The protection lasts only while the breath is held and costs stamina.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
fortress.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

fox.name: Foxfire Breath
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath leaves wisps of foxfire that drift toward enemies and lure them away from wounded allies.
The wisps last a short time and cost extra mana.
This is a fire and illusion effect.
fox.tag: This is a fire and illusion effect.

frog.name: Bog Breath
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath coats the ground in sticky slime that slows enemies who cross it.
The slime lasts a short time, and only the most recent patch remains.
This is a water and restraint effect.
frog.tag: This is a water and restraint effect.

fungus.name: Sporing Breath
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath seeds enemies with spores that burst into a poison cloud when they die.
The cloud lasts a short time and costs a little extra mana.
This is a poison and growth effect.
fungus.tag: This is a poison and growth effect.

garuda.name: Sky Serpent Breath
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath deals heavy bonus damage to snakes, serpents and other draconic creatures.
Against them, the breath costs extra mana.
This is a hunting and wind effect.
garuda.tag: This is a hunting and wind effect.

gate.name: Gateway Breath
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The holder can breathe into a small portal that opens beside a distant enemy, striking it from an unexpected side.
Opening the portal costs extra mana and can happen once every few seconds.
This is a dimensional effect.
gate.tag: This is a dimensional effect.

gathering.name: Drawn Ember
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The holder slowly gathers loose mana from the air between breaths, and its next breath deals extra damage for each moment spent gathering.
The gathering stops once the holder takes damage.
This is a harvest and mastery effect.
gathering.tag: This is a harvest and mastery effect.

glass.name: Glassing Breath
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath turns the ground to brittle glass, and enemies who cross it are cut by shards.
The glass lasts a short time and shatters if heavily struck.
This is a fire and earth effect.
glass.tag: This is a fire and earth effect.

glimeron.name: Starmote Breath
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath glitters with drifting motes of starlight that reveal hidden enemies and mark them for allies.
The motes last a short time and cost a little extra mana.
This is a light and revelation effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a light and revelation effect.

goat.name: Butting Breath
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
After the holder headbutts an enemy, its next breath on that enemy deals bonus damage and briefly dazes it.
The bonus lasts a short time after the headbutt and costs stamina.
This is a momentum effect.
goat.tag: This is a momentum effect.

gorgon.name: Petrifying Breath
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Enemies struck by the breath slowly turn to stone, growing slower until they are briefly petrified.
Petrification lasts a short time, and the same enemy cannot be petrified again this way for a while.
This is a curse and restraint effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a curse and restraint effect.

griffin.name: Talon Breath
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
After the holder lunges at an enemy, its breath sweeps down from above, dealing bonus damage to that enemy.
The lunge costs stamina and can happen once every few seconds.
This is a hunting and wind effect.
griffin.tag: This is a hunting and wind effect.

growth.name: Swelling Breath
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The cone widens slightly each time the holder breathes during a fight.
The widening stacks a few times and resets if the holder goes too long without breathing.
This is a growth and area effect.
growth.tag: This is a growth and area effect.

guardian.name: Warden Breath
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
When an enemy attacks an ally near the holder, the holder can breathe on that enemy without wind-up and draw its attention.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a protection and support effect.
guardian.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

hair.name: Tangling Breath
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath trails fine strands that cling to enemies struck and slow their movement.
The strands last a short time and burn away if the enemy takes fire damage.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
hair.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

hammer.name: Hammerblow Breath
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath lands as a heavy blow, briefly stunning the enemy nearest the holder.
The stun costs stamina, and the same enemy cannot be stunned this way again for a short time.
This is an impact and momentum effect.
hammer.tag: This is an impact and momentum effect.

hand.name: Guided Breath
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The holder can curve the breath around allies, so the cone never strikes or blocks them.
Curving the breath costs a little extra mana.
This is a mastery and support effect.
hand.tag: This is a mastery and support effect.

harmonic.name: Resonant Breath
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
When the holder breathes right after an ally uses an ability, the breath resonates with it and deals bonus damage.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a resonance and support effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a resonance and support effect.

harpy.name: Shrieking Gale
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath carries a piercing shriek that deafens enemies struck, slowing their casting for a short time.
The shriek costs extra stamina.
This is a sound and wind effect.
harpy.tag: This is a sound and wind effect.

harvest.name: Reaping Breath
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Enemies slain by the breath release a mote of mana that returns to the holder.
Each mote is small, and only a few can be gathered per fight.
This is a harvest and harvesting effect.
harvest.tag: This is a harvest and harvesting effect.

heidel.name: Burrow Breath
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath leaves a faint scent on enemies struck, and the holder can track them even when they hide or turn invisible.
The scent fades after a short time.
This is a tracking and detection effect.
heidel.tag: This is a tracking and detection effect.

hook.name: Hooking Breath
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath snags the enemy farthest away in the cone and drags it toward the holder.
This costs stamina, works only on lower-rank enemies, and can happen once every few seconds.
This is a binding and momentum effect.
hook.tag: This is a binding and momentum effect.

horse.name: Galloping Breath
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
After the holder runs a good distance in a straight line, its next breath deals bonus damage.
The bonus is spent on that breath and costs stamina.
This is a movement and momentum effect.
horse.tag: This is a movement and momentum effect.

hunger.name: Ravenous Breath
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath devours a portion of the mana of enemies struck and feeds it to the holder.
Only a small amount can be devoured from each enemy, and this can happen once every few seconds.
This is a harvest and affliction effect.
hunger.tag: This is a harvest and affliction effect.

hunt.name: Quarry Mark
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The first enemy struck by the breath in a fight becomes the holder's quarry, taking bonus damage from its breath until it dies.
Only the current quarry counts, and a new quarry is chosen after it falls.
This is a hunting and tracking effect.
hunt.tag: This is a hunting and tracking effect.

hydra.name: Many-Headed Breath
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
Each time the holder is badly hurt, its next breath splits into extra cones aimed at different enemies.
Each cone deals a portion of the full damage, and this can happen once every few seconds.
This is a rebirth and area effect.
hydra.tag: This is a rebirth and area effect.

ice.name: Glacier Breath
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Dragon Breath].
The breath coats enemies in ice, freezing lower-rank enemies in place for a short time.
Frozen enemies take extra damage from the next heavy blow, and this costs extra mana.
This is an ice and frost effect.
ice.tag: This is an ice and frost effect.

immortal.name: Undying Breath
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.

The shield lasts a short time and does not stack.

shield.tag: This is a shield and protection effect.

shimmer.name: Shimmering Breath
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.

The breath leaves the holder briefly translucent, so enemies have trouble keeping it targeted.
The shimmer lasts a short time and can happen once every few seconds.
This is a stealth and evasion effect.

ship.name: Bow Wave Breath
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Draconian] ability [Dragon Breath]. Catalyst: Ship essence.

This is a conjuration and illusion effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a conjuration and illusion effect.

skirmish.name: Skirmisher Breath

skirmish.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

skunk.name: Reeking Breath

lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Each time the holder absorbs a kind of magic, its runes learn that element and absorb a slightly larger portion of it for the rest of the fight.
The bonus has a cap that scales with rank and resets when the fight ends.
This is a mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Runic Distillery
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magical poison and alchemical damage are absorbed as well, and a portion of the mana gained this way is distilled into a gentle healing over a short time.
Only a single distillation runs at a time.
This is an alchemy and healing effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and healing effect.

ambush.name: Unseen Current
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
The first magical hit the holder takes from a hidden or unseen attacker is absorbed in full, and the runes flare to reveal that attacker to the party for a short time.
This happens once per fight.
This is a detection and perception effect.
ambush.tag: This is a detection and perception effect.

animate.name: Living Glyphs
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder absorbs a heavy magical hit, a rune peels from its skin and becomes a small animated glyph that fights beside it, striking with the absorbed element.
Only a single glyph exists at a time, and it fades after a short time.
This is an animation and summoning effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and summoning effect.

anzu.name: Stormthief Veins
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder absorbs lightning or wind damage, it also siphons a little mana from the caster, as if stealing the spell back along its path.
This can trigger once every short while against each enemy.
This is a storm and wind effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and wind effect.

ape.name: Knuckle Runes
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic the holder absorbs gathers in the runes of its hands, adding a portion of the absorbed damage to its next melee strike.
Only a single strike can be charged, and the charge fades after a short time.
This is a might and momentum effect.
ape.tag: This is a might and momentum effect.

armour.name: Runeplate Skin
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
While the holder's mana is full, magic that would be absorbed instead hardens its runes into a thin magical armour that blunts the next physical hit.
The armour holds for a short time and cannot stack.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
armour.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

arsenal.name: Armoury of Channels
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Each element the holder absorbs is stored as a charge in its runes, and its weapon attacks spend those charges to add a touch of that element.
Only a few charges are held, and each attack spends a charge.
This is a mastery and conjuration effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a mastery and conjuration effect.

aspect.name: Elemental Guise
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
The first time each fight the holder absorbs a given element, it briefly takes on that element's aspect, resisting it and adding it to its attacks.
The aspect lasts a short time, and each element can grant it only once per fight.
This is a transformation effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation effect.

avatar.name: Conduit Avatar
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].

Once per fight, after the holder has absorbed a great deal of magic, its runes blaze and it becomes a living conduit for a short time, absorbing a larger portion and casting its own spells for less mana.
The form ends early if the holder's mana runs dry.
This is a transformation and mastery effect.
avatar.tag: This is a transformation and mastery effect.

axe.name: Cleaving Current
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Absorbing a magical hit charges the holder's next attack to cleave in a wide arc, spilling the absorbed element onto nearby enemies.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is an area effect.
axe.tag: This is an area effect.

balance.name: Level Channel
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic absorbed while the holder's mana is full flows into its health instead, and magic absorbed while its health is full flows wholly into mana.
Only a small amount can be redirected each short while.
This is a balance and restoration effect.
balance.tag: This is a balance and restoration effect.

bat.name: Echoing Veins
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Absorbing a spell sends a ringing echo back along its path, marking the caster so the holder and nearby allies can sense it for a short time, even through stealth.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a sound and detection effect.
bat.tag: This is a sound and detection effect.

battlefield.name: Warfield Runes
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
While the holder stands inside an enemy's lingering magical area, it absorbs a portion of the ongoing damage and allies standing in the same area take slightly less from it.
The protection for allies applies only while the holder remains inside the area.
This is an area and protection effect.
battlefield.tag: This is an area and protection effect.

bear.name: Denning Reservoir
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder is badly wounded, the magic it absorbs restores a little health as well as mana, and its runes absorb a larger portion for a short time.
This happens once per fight.
This is a defensive and restoration effect.
bear.tag: This is a defensive and restoration effect.

bee.name: Hive Channel
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
A portion of the mana the holder absorbs is passed along to nearby allies who are running low on mana.
The share is small and reaches only allies close to the holder.
This is a support and swarm effect.
bee.tag: This is a support and swarm effect.

behemoth.name: Colossal Channel
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
The heavier a single magical hit, the larger the portion the holder absorbs, up to a cap that scales with rank, and absorbed hits cannot knock it back.
After absorbing a very heavy hit the holder moves slowly for a short time.
This is a defensive effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a defensive effect.

bird.name: Updraft Runes
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Absorbing magical damage lightens the holder's step, granting a short burst of movement speed and evasion.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
bird.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

blight.name: Blighted Channel
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magical disease and rot are absorbed as well, and the holder's next attack after absorbing them inflicts a lingering blight on its target.
The blight cannot stack, and the effect can trigger once every short while.
This is an affliction and poison effect.
blight.tag: This is an affliction and poison effect.

blood.name: Bloodrun Veins
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder absorbs magical damage, the mana surging through its veins also closes a bleed on it.
Blood magic it absorbs leaves a brief bleed on the caster in return. This can trigger once every short while.
This is an affliction and healing effect.
blood.tag: This is an affliction and healing effect.

bone.name: Marrow Runes
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Each magical hit the holder absorbs drives its runes into its bones, reducing the damage of the next physical hit it takes.
The reinforcement does not stack and fades after a short time.
This is a defensive effect.
bone.tag: This is a defensive effect.

boundary.name: Threshold Runes
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Enemy spell projectiles passing close to the holder bend toward it and are absorbed, sparing allies standing nearby.
This works only on projectiles and can trigger once every short while.
This is a warding and protection effect.
boundary.tag: This is a warding and protection effect.

bounty.name: Windfall Channel
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When an enemy that struck the holder with magic during the fight is defeated, the holder recovers a burst of mana.
Each enemy can grant this only once.
This is a harvest effect.
bounty.tag: This is a harvest effect.

bow.name: Fletched Current
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Absorbed mana charges the holder's next ranged attack, letting it carry the absorbed element and fly farther.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a hunting effect.
bow.tag: This is a hunting effect.

brush.name: Painted Wards
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder absorbs an element, it brushes a temporary rune onto the nearest ally, letting that ally absorb a small portion of the same element into mana.
Only a single ally carries a painted rune at a time, and it fades after a short time.
This is a warding and support effect.
brush.tag: This is a warding and support effect.

cage.name: Caging Glyphs
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder absorbs a spell, runes close around the caster like bars, slowing its casting for a short time.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
cage.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

cat.name: Landing Runes
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
The first magical hit the holder takes after dodging is absorbed in full.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is an evasion effect.
cat.tag: This is an evasion effect.

cataclysm.name: Overflow Rupture
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic the holder absorbs while its mana is full builds pressure in its runes, and when the pressure peaks it bursts outward, damaging nearby enemies.
The burst empties the pressure and cannot build again for a short time.
This is an annihilation and area effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an annihilation and area effect.

cattle.name: Herdguard Runes
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Allies standing right beside the holder take slightly less magical damage, because the holder's runes draw a portion of it into itself and absorb it.
This applies only while the holder has room in its mana pool.
This is a protection and support effect.
cattle.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

chain.name: Anchor Link
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When a spell that jumps between targets reaches the holder, the chain ends there and is absorbed, sparing anyone further along it.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a binding and protection effect.
chain.tag: This is a binding and protection effect.

chaotic.name: Wild Channel
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic the holder absorbs sometimes spills back out as a random elemental jolt against the caster.
The jolt is a chance, not a certainty, and cannot happen again for a short time once it does.
This is a storm and affliction effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a storm and affliction effect.

charlatan.name: False Runes
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder absorbs a spell, its runes flicker as if badly hurt, luring that caster to keep targeting the holder instead of its allies for a short time.
The lure ends at once if the holder's mana is full.
This is a deception and warding effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a deception and warding effect.

chicken.name: Startle Runes
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When a magical hit lands while the holder is badly wounded, it absorbs a larger portion and bolts a short distance away from the caster.
This happens once per fight.
This is an evasion and movement effect.
chicken.tag: This is an evasion and movement effect.

chimera.name: Braided Channel
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Each different element the holder absorbs within a short window adds a little power to its next spell.
The bonus is spent by that spell and lapses if the window closes.
This is a mastery and transformation effect.
chimera.tag: This is a mastery and transformation effect.

claw.name: Raking Runes
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
After absorbing magic, the holder's next few melee strikes leave glowing rune-scratches that briefly expose the target to more magical damage.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a hunting and affliction effect.
claw.tag: This is a hunting and affliction effect.

cloth.name: Woven Skin
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
The holder's runes extend into its clothing, so magic that strikes it from behind or the side is absorbed as readily as magic it faces.
Hits absorbed this way grant a little less mana.
This is a protection and warding effect.
cloth.tag: This is a protection and warding effect.

cloud.name: Mist Veins
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder absorbs a heavy spell, a portion of it vents as a soft mist around it that hides it and nearby allies from enemy sight for a short time.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a water and stealth effect.
cloud.tag: This is a water and stealth effect.

cold.name: Rime Channel
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Frost damage is absorbed especially well, and absorbing it leaves the caster briefly chilled and slowed.
The chill cannot be reapplied to the same enemy for a short time.
This is a frost and cold effect.
cold.tag: This is a frost and cold effect.

coral.name: Reef Runes
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic the holder absorbs slowly builds a crust of living rune-coral over its skin, which returns a sliver of mana each time it is struck by an attack.
The crust has a limit that scales with rank and crumbles when the fight ends.
This is a growth and water effect.
coral.tag: This is a growth and water effect.

corrupt.name: Tainted Channel
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Curses and corrupting magic are absorbed as well, and a portion of the corruption is fed back into the holder's next spell as a weakening curse.
Absorbing corruption costs the holder a little health along with the mana it gains.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

crocodile.name: Basking Channel
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
While the holder stands still, it absorbs a larger portion of magical damage, and its next attack after moving again deals extra damage.
The bonus attack can happen once every short while.
This is a defensive and hunting effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a defensive and hunting effect.

crystal.name: Lattice Veins
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Absorbed magic crystallises in the holder's runes as a brittle facet that refracts the next spell it casts into an extra, weaker bolt.
Only a single facet forms at a time.
This is a light and resonance effect.
crystal.tag: This is a light and resonance effect.

cycle.name: Tidal Runes
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
The holder's absorption rises and falls in a slow rhythm through the fight, peaking regularly at a larger portion.
Between peaks it ebbs below its usual level.
This is a time and rhythm effect.
cycle.tag: This is a time and rhythm effect.

dance.name: Whirling Current
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
While the holder keeps moving in combat, magic it absorbs grants a brief burst of evasion as well as mana.
This can trigger once every short while and ends when the holder stops moving.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
dance.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

dark.name: Shaded Channel
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Shadow magic is absorbed especially well, and absorbing it lets the holder slip into darkness, becoming harder for enemies to see for a short time.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a shadow and darkness effect.
dark.tag: This is a shadow and darkness effect.

dawn.name: First-Light Runes
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
The first magical hit the holder absorbs each fight releases a gentle wash of light that heals nearby allies a little.
This happens once per fight.
This is a light and healing effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and healing effect.

death.name: Grave Channel
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Necromantic magic is absorbed as well, and the holder can spend that mana to deny the caster's next attempt to raise or empower the dead nearby.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a death and necromantic effect.
death.tag: This is a death and necromantic effect.

deep.name: Abyssal Reservoir
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic absorbed while the holder's mana is full sinks into a deep reserve beneath its runes, which refills its mana when it next runs low.
The reserve holds only a little and empties when the fight ends.
This is a water and restoration effect.
deep.tag: This is a water and restoration effect.

deer.name: Startled Grace
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder absorbs a spell, it springs a short way out of the spell's area, and its next dodge costs no stamina.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
deer.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

desolate.name: Barren Channel
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder absorbs a spell, the ground around it is drained of magic for a short time, weakening enemy spells cast from inside that patch.
Only a single drained patch exists at a time.
This is an area and warding effect.
desolate.tag: This is an area and warding effect.

dimension.name: Folded Veins
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When a spell would strike an ally beside the holder, the holder's runes can fold the space between them so the spell lands on the holder instead and is absorbed.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a protection and warding effect.
dimension.tag: This is a protection and warding effect.

discord.name: Jarring Runes
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Absorbing a spell sends a jarring note back to the caster, briefly disrupting its next cast.
This can trigger once every short while against each enemy.
This is a sound and affliction effect.
discord.tag: This is a sound and affliction effect.

discordant.name: Dissonant Channel
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic the holder absorbs leaves its runes humming out of tune, and enemies nearby suffer slightly weaker spells while the hum lasts.
The hum fades after a short time and cannot be renewed until it ends.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
discordant.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

dog.name: Loyal Runes
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When an ally near the holder is struck by magic, the holder bounds to their side, and the next spell aimed at that ally is absorbed by the holder instead.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a protection and support effect.
dog.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

doom.name: Doomed Current
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Each spell the holder absorbs from an enemy marks that enemy, and when its marks build high enough the holder's runes condemn it, dealing a burst of damage.
Marks fade at the end of the fight, and each enemy can be condemned only once.
This is a curse and annihilation effect.
doom.tag: This is a curse and annihilation effect.

doppelganger.name: Mimic Runes
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
After absorbing a spell, the holder's runes can mimic it, casting a faint copy back at its caster.
Only spells the holder has absorbed in the last short while can be mimicked, and this has a cooldown.
This is a transformation and mastery effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a transformation and mastery effect.

dragon.name: Wyrmblood Veins
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Fire and elemental breath attacks are absorbed especially well, and the holder can exhale the stored power as a short gout of flame in front of it.
The breath empties the stored power and needs a short time to build again.
This is a fire and flame effect.
dragon.tag: This is a fire and flame effect.

duck.name: Shedding Runes
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Lingering magical effects roll off the holder like water: when it absorbs a spell, it also sheds an elemental burn, chill or soak on itself.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a water and purification effect.
duck.tag: This is a water and purification effect.

dust.name: Dust Veins
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder absorbs a spell, a puff of rune-dust bursts around it, blinding enemies right beside it for a short time.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is an area and affliction effect.
dust.tag: This is an area and affliction effect.

earth.name: Bedrock Absorption
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
While the holder stands on solid ground and has not moved for a moment, it absorbs a larger portion of magical damage and cannot be knocked down by spells.
Moving breaks the stance until it settles again.
This is a defensive and earth effect.
earth.tag: This is a defensive and earth effect.

echo.name: Returning Spell
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
A short time after the holder absorbs a spell, a faint echo of it rings back out at the caster.
The echo is weak and can happen once every short while.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
echo.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

eclipse.name: Umbral Halo
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Light and shadow magic are both absorbed especially well, and absorbing either wraps the holder in a halo that resists the other for a short time.
Only a single halo is active at a time.
This is a light and shadow effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a light and shadow effect.

edifice.name: Keystone Runes
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic the holder absorbs can be poured into a barrier or structure it is standing beside, restoring a portion of that structure's strength.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a barrier and protection effect.
edifice.tag: This is a barrier and protection effect.

effigy.name: Proxy Glyph
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Once per fight, when the holder is struck by a heavy spell, a rune-carved effigy of it appears nearby and takes the next spell aimed at the holder, absorbing it for the holder's mana.
The effigy crumbles after absorbing that spell or after a short time.
This is a conjuration and protection effect.
effigy.tag: This is a conjuration and protection effect.

elemental.name: Elemental Riverbed
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Fire, frost, lightning and earth magic are each absorbed especially well, and absorbing any of them adds a touch of that element to the holder's next attack.
The added element is spent by that attack and can be granted once every short while.
This is a fire and storm effect.
elemental.tag: This is a fire and storm effect.

elixir.name: Tonic Veins
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder drinks a potion, its runes drink too: for a short time afterward, it absorbs a larger portion of magical damage.

storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Lightning and storm magic are absorbed especially well, and absorbing them calls a small bolt down on the caster.
The bolt can fall once every short while.
This is a lightning and storm effect.
storm.tag: This is a lightning and storm effect.

succubus.name: Beguiling Runes
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder absorbs a spell, its runes glow with a beguiling allure that briefly charms the caster into holding its next attack.
This works on each enemy once per fight.
This is a command and affliction effect.
succubus.tag: This is a command and affliction effect.

sun.name: Daybright Veins
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
In daylight or bright light, the holder's runes drink deeply and absorb a larger portion of fire and light magic.
Absorbing these warms nearby allies, healing them a little once every short while.
This is a light and healing effect.
sun.tag: This is a light and healing effect.

swarm.name: Thronging Runes
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When many enemies attack the holder with magic in a short window, each spell beyond the first is absorbed in a slightly larger portion.
The bonus resets once the barrage ends.
This is a swarm and defensive effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and defensive effect.

swift.name: Fleet Current
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic the holder absorbs quickens it, shortening the cooldown of its next movement ability.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a haste and movement effect.
swift.tag: This is a haste and movement effect.

sword.name: Edgerune Channel
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
The holder can catch a spell on its blade, absorbing a larger portion, and its next sword strike carries the absorbed element.
This can happen once every short while against spells it sees coming.
This is a mastery and warding effect.
sword.tag: This is a mastery and warding effect.

talisman.name: Charmstone Veins
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
The holder's strongest rune acts as a talisman, absorbing the first curse or hex that would land on it each fight in full.
This happens once per fight.
This is a warding and curse effect.
talisman.tag: This is a warding and curse effect.

tentacle.name: Grasping Runes
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder absorbs a spell, rune-tendrils reach out and grab an enemy close by, holding it briefly in place.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

thread.name: Threaded Veins
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
A fine thread of runes links the holder to the ally it is closest to, and that ally absorbs a small portion of magical damage into mana for a short time after the holder absorbs a spell.
The thread can be spun once every short while.
This is a binding and support effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and support effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderhide Runes
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Absorbing a heavy spell sets the holder's runes crackling, and the next enemy to strike it in melee is jolted with lightning.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a lightning and storm effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a lightning and storm effect.

time.name: Delayed Channel
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When a heavy spell strikes the holder, its runes can hold the unabsorbed portion back for a short time and let it trickle in slowly instead of all at once.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a time and defensive effect.
time.tag: This is a time and defensive effect.

tranquil.name: Placid Runes
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic the holder absorbs settles its mind, and for a short time afterward its spells cost slightly less mana.
The calm does not stack and can be renewed once every short while.
This is a mastery and serenity effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a mastery and serenity effect.

transfiguration.name: Reshaping Veins
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
The holder's runes can reshape an absorbed element into the element of its own magic, adding that power to its next spell.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a transmutation and transformation effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a transmutation and transformation effect.

transgression.name: Trespass Runes
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic the holder absorbs lets it break through enemy wards and barriers, its next attack ignoring a portion of the target's magical protection.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a curse and annihilation effect.
transgression.tag: This is a curse and annihilation effect.

trap.name: Springing Glyph
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder absorbs a spell, it leaves a hidden rune on the ground that snaps shut on the next enemy to step on it, briefly rooting it.
Only a single rune trap exists at a time.
This is a trap and restraint effect.
trap.tag: This is a trap and restraint effect.

tree.name: Heartwood Runes
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic the holder absorbs settles deep like sap in heartwood, slowly restoring a little health over a short time.
The restoration does not stack and can begin once every short while.
This is a nature and restoration effect.
tree.tag: This is a nature and restoration effect.

troll.name: Rune-Fed Trollflesh
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
While the holder's mana is high, its runes feed its flesh, letting it regenerate health slowly in combat.
Fire and acid damage halt the regeneration for a short time.
This is a healing and regeneration effect.
troll.tag: This is a healing and regeneration effect.

trowel.name: Mortared Runes
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic the holder absorbs can be smoothed over cracks in nearby allied barriers and shields, restoring a little of their strength.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a barrier and shield effect.
trowel.tag: This is a barrier and shield effect.

turtle.name: Shellback Runes
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic striking the holder from behind is absorbed in a much larger portion.
The holder turns more slowly while this protection is active, which lasts for as long as it is in combat.
This is a defensive and shield effect.
turtle.tag: This is a defensive and shield effect.

twilight.name: Dusk Channel
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Absorbing light magic heals the holder a little, and absorbing shadow magic hides it briefly.
Each can happen once every short while.
This is a light and shadow effect.
twilight.tag: This is a light and shadow effect.

undeath.name: Gravebound Veins
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Spells cast by undead are absorbed especially well, and absorbing them weakens the undead caster's hold on its body, slowing it for a short time.
This works on each enemy once every short while.
This is a necromantic and death effect.
undeath.tag: This is a necromantic and death effect.

unity.name: Shared Channel
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
While the holder fights beside allies, each ally near it absorbs a small portion of magical damage into mana as well.
The shared absorption reaches only allies close to the holder.
This is a support and protection effect.
unity.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

vast.name: Boundless Veins
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
The holder's runes stretch wide, so magic that strikes it from a great distance is absorbed in a larger portion.
Spells cast from close by gain no bonus.
This is a warding and area effect.
vast.tag: This is a warding and area effect.

vehicle.name: Conveyance Runes
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Mana the holder absorbs carries it along, granting a short burst of movement speed that it can share with an ally beside it.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a travel and movement effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a travel and movement effect.

venom.name: Venomrun Veins
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Poison magic is absorbed especially well, and absorbing it coats the holder's next attack in venom.
The venom does not stack and can be applied once every short while.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

verdant.name: Greenvein Runes
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic the holder absorbs makes greenery spring up around it, slowly healing allies standing nearby.
The greenery withers after a short time and can grow once every short while.
This is a growth and healing effect.
verdant.tag: This is a growth and healing effect.

vessel.name: Vessel Channel
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
The holder's body holds more of what it absorbs: when its mana is full, further absorbed magic is stored and released to refill its mana when it next casts.
The store holds only a little and empties at the end of the fight.
This is a mastery and restoration effect.
vessel.tag: This is a mastery and restoration effect.

visage.name: Runemask Visage
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder absorbs a spell, the runes on its face flare into a fearsome mask that makes the caster hesitate before casting again.
This works on each enemy once every short while.
This is an affliction and command effect.
visage.tag: This is an affliction and command effect.

vision.name: Farsight Channel
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
The holder's runes foresee spells aimed at its allies, and it calls a warning that lets them brace, taking slightly less from the next spell.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a precognition and support effect.
vision.tag: This is a precognition and support effect.

void.name: Hollowing Runes
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic the holder absorbs while its mana is full is swallowed by a void in its runes rather than wasted, and that void drains a little mana from the caster.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a darkness and annihilation effect.
void.tag: This is a darkness and annihilation effect.

volcano.name: Runic Eruption
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Fire and earth magic build heat in the holder's runes, and when the heat peaks it erupts in a burst of molten rock around the holder.
The eruption empties the heat and needs a short time to build again.
This is a fire and earth effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and earth effect.

vortex.name: Whirlpool Runes
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder absorbs a spell, a brief whirl of magic spins around it, pulling nearby enemy spell projectiles in to be absorbed as well.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a wind and warding effect.
vortex.tag: This is a wind and warding effect.

wasp.name: Stinging Current
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
After absorbing a spell, the holder's next few quick attacks carry a stinging charge that briefly weakens the target.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a poison and haste effect.
wasp.tag: This is a poison and haste effect.

water.name: Riverbed Runes
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic flows through the holder's runes like water through a channel worn smooth, so water magic is absorbed especially well and absorbed mana arrives without delay.
The smooth flow falters for a short time if the holder is stunned.
This is a water effect.
water.tag: This is a water effect.

weave.name: Woven Spellcraft
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Each spell the holder absorbs is woven into its own magic, letting its next spell carry a thread of the absorbed element.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a mastery and binding effect.
weave.tag: This is a mastery and binding effect.

wendigo.name: Starving Runes
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
While the holder is low on mana, its runes feed on cold and hunger, absorbing frost magic in a much larger portion.
The hunger leaves the holder slightly slower while its mana stays low.
This is a cold and harvest effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and harvest effect.

whale.name: Leviathan Lungs
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
The holder's runes take a deep draught of magic, so the first heavy spell each fight is absorbed in a much larger portion, and the holder sounds a deep call that steadies nearby allies.
This happens once per fight.
This is a sound and water effect.
whale.tag: This is a sound and water effect.

wheel.name: Turning Channel
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Mana the holder absorbs turns through its runes and comes out as stamina when its mana is full.
The conversion is slight and can happen once every short while.
This is a momentum and balance effect.
wheel.tag: This is a momentum and balance effect.

whip.name: Lashing Runes
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
After absorbing a spell, the holder's next attack lashes out farther than usual and snaps the target toward it.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a binding and momentum effect.
whip.tag: This is a binding and momentum effect.

wind.name: Gale Veins
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Wind magic is absorbed especially well, and absorbing it wraps the holder in a brief breeze that turns aside the next projectile.
The breeze can rise once every short while.
This is a wind and evasion effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and evasion effect.

wing.name: Mantling Runes
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When an ally beside the holder is targeted by a spell, the holder spreads its rune-marked arms like a mantle over them and absorbs the spell itself.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a protection and shield effect.
wing.tag: This is a protection and shield effect.

wolf.name: Packrun Channel
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
When the holder absorbs a spell aimed at it while allies are nearby, those allies gain a brief burst of attack speed against the caster.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a hunting and support effect.
wolf.tag: This is a hunting and support effect.

wood.name: Grainwood Runes
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic the holder absorbs runs along its runes like grain through wood, toughening its weapon or staff so its next blocked hit costs no stamina.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a nature and defensive effect.
wood.tag: This is a nature and defensive effect.

wrath.name: Wrathful Current
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Each spell the holder absorbs stokes its anger, slightly raising its damage for a short time.
The anger has a cap that scales with rank and cools soon after spells stop landing.
This is a fire and momentum effect.
wrath.tag: This is a fire and momentum effect.

zeal.name: Fervent Veins
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Magic the holder absorbs fuels its zeal, shortening the cooldown of its next ability slightly.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a mastery and haste effect.
zeal.tag: This is a mastery and haste effect.

ziz.name: Skyshroud Runes
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Spellborn]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Spellborn].
Once per fight, when a spell would strike many allies at once, the holder's runes spread a vast shadow over them and absorb a portion of the spell meant for each.
The absorbed portion goes to the holder's mana, and the shroud lasts only for that spell.
This is a protection and warding effect.
ziz.tag: This is a protection and warding effect.

action.name: Brimming Stride
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is near its maximum, its attacks and movement are slightly quicker.
The bonus fades as soon as its mana drops below that threshold, and returns only after a short pause.
This is a haste and momentum effect.
action.tag: This is a haste and momentum effect.

adept.name: Measured Reservoir
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Each different ability the holder uses in a fight slightly raises its maximum mana for the rest of that fight.
The bonus has a cap that scales with rank and resets when the fight ends.
This is a mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Philtre Well
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Mana potions the holder drinks also raise its maximum mana for a short time, and the extra capacity arrives already filled.
This cannot stack with itself and has a cooldown after it ends.
This is an alchemy and restoration effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and restoration effect.

ambush.name: Hoarded Strike
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder is unseen or has not yet attacked in a fight, a portion of its maximum mana is held in reserve and cannot be spent.
Its first ability from hiding releases the reserve into that ability's power, after which the reserve is gone until the next fight.
This is a stealth and ambush effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and ambush effect.

animate.name: Wakened Font
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Once per fight, when the holder's mana is full, the excess it would gain instead wakes a small runic wisp that follows it and fires minor bolts at nearby enemies.
The wisp lasts a short time and fades early if the holder's mana falls below half.
This is an animation and summoning effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and summoning effect.

anzu.name: Stormcrowned Well
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is above half, a crackling crown of wind and lightning strikes the nearest enemy every so often.
Each strike drains a small portion of the holder's mana, and the crown goes quiet below half mana.
This is a lightning and wind effect.
anzu.tag: This is a lightning and wind effect.

ape.name: Heavy Reserve
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's unarmed and weapon strikes deal slightly more damage for every portion of its maximum mana it currently holds.
Each strike that benefits costs a sliver of mana.
This is a might and mastery effect.
ape.tag: This is a might and mastery effect.

armour.name: Mana Plating
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
A portion of the holder's unspent mana hardens into its armour, granting resistance that grows with how full its pool is.
The resistance thins as mana is spent and is gone entirely while the pool is empty.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
armour.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

arsenal.name: Deep Quiver Well
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's extra maximum mana is split into separate reserves, each tied to a different kind of ability it carries, and each refills on its own.
Spending from a reserve never drains its neighbours, but each reserve is smaller than the whole.
This is a mastery and support effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a mastery and support effect.

aspect.name: Mirrored Depths
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is near full, it takes on the aspect of the last ability it used, gaining a minor boon that matches that ability.
The aspect lasts a short time and refreshes only when the holder spends mana on a new ability.
This is a transformation effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation effect.

avatar.name: Overflowing Vessel
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Once per fight, when the holder's mana reaches its maximum, it takes on an avatar form for a short time, gaining greatly raised maximum mana and slightly stronger abilities.
When the form ends, any mana above its usual maximum is lost.
This is a transformation and mastery effect.
avatar.tag: This is a transformation and mastery effect.

axe.name: Cleaving Surplus
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is full, its heavy attacks cleave into enemies beside the target.
Each cleave spends a sliver of mana, so the effect ends as soon as the pool dips below full.
This is a might and area effect.
axe.tag: This is a might and area effect.

balance.name: Level Font
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's mana and health pull gently toward the same fraction of their maxima, trickling from the fuller into the emptier over time.
The transfer is slow and stops entirely during a short window after the holder takes damage.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
balance.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

bat.name: Nightwing Reserve
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is above half, it senses enemies around it through a faint echo, revealing hidden foes nearby.
Each hidden foe revealed this way costs a portion of mana.
This is a perception and detection effect.
bat.tag: This is a perception and detection effect.

battlefield.name: Mustering Well
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder fights near allies, its extra maximum mana extends to them as a small shared reserve they can draw on when their own runs dry.
The reserve is shared by the whole party and refills only slowly.
This is a support and area effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a support and area effect.

bear.name: Hibernal Store
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder takes a heavy blow, a portion of its stored mana is burned to soften it.
This can trigger once every short while and only while the holder's mana is above a small portion of its maximum.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
bear.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

bee.name: Honeyed Store
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is full, its regeneration is passed on as a gentle trickle of mana to allies nearby.
The trickle stops whenever the holder itself spends mana and resumes only once the pool refills.
This is a support and restoration effect.
bee.tag: This is a support and restoration effect.

behemoth.name: Titan Reservoir
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's maximum mana also raises its maximum health by a portion of the same amount.
While its mana is below half, the extra health is suppressed and cannot be healed into.
This is a defensive and might effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a defensive and might effect.

bird.name: Skyborne Font
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is above half, it moves slightly faster and dodges with greater lightness.
The bonus fades for a short time whenever it is struck by a heavy attack.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
bird.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

blight.name: Tainted Well
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Spending a large portion of the holder's mana in a single ability leaves a blighted patch where the ability lands, weakening enemies who stand in it.
Only a single blighted patch can exist at a time, and it fades after a short time.
This is an affliction and poison effect.
blight.tag: This is an affliction and poison effect.

blood.name: Sanguine Reservoir
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana runs dry, it can keep casting by paying with health instead, at a rate set by its maximum mana.
Health spent this way cannot be healed for a short time.
This is a blood and sacrifice effect.
blood.tag: This is a blood and sacrifice effect.

bone.name: Marrow Font
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's extra maximum mana settles into its bones, granting it resistance to being knocked down or staggered while its mana is above half.
The resistance breaks after it prevents a stagger and returns after a short cooldown.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
bone.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

boundary.name: Well's Edge
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is full, a faint runic boundary surrounds it, slowing enemies who cross into melee range.
Each enemy slowed drains a sliver of mana, so the boundary falls once the pool dips.
This is a warding and restraint effect.
boundary.tag: This is a warding and restraint effect.

bounty.name: Bountiful Spring
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When an enemy falls near the holder, it gains a small burst of mana and its maximum mana rises slightly for the rest of the fight.
The bonus has a cap that scales with rank and resets when the fight ends.
This is a harvest and restoration effect.
bounty.tag: This is a harvest and restoration effect.

bow.name: Drawn Reserve
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's ranged attacks can be charged from its mana pool, dealing extra damage that scales with the mana spent.
A charged shot cannot draw more than a modest portion of the pool, and the charge resets if the holder is interrupted.
This is a hunting and mastery effect.
bow.tag: This is a hunting and mastery effect.

brush.name: Inkwell Font
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder spends a large portion of its mana, it paints a brief glowing rune on the ground that grants allies standing on it a slow trickle of mana.
Only a single rune can exist at a time, and it fades after a short time.
This is a support and restoration effect.
brush.tag: This is a support and restoration effect.

cage.name: Caged Torrent
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When an enemy drains, burns or steals the holder's mana, a runic cage seals the pool and the enemy is briefly rooted in place.
