This can trigger once every short while, and the sealed pool cannot be drained for a short time afterward.
This is a binding and warding effect.
cage.tag: This is a binding and warding effect.

cat.name: Feline Reserve
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The first time each fight the holder's mana drops below a small portion of its maximum, it instantly recovers a portion of its mana and darts a short distance away from the nearest enemy.
After this, the holder's maximum mana is slightly reduced until the fight ends.
This is an evasion and restoration effect.
cat.tag: This is an evasion and restoration effect.

cataclysm.name: Ruinous Overflow
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Once per fight, when the holder's mana is full, it can empty the entire pool in a single runic eruption that strikes every enemy around it.
The eruption's damage scales with its maximum mana, and its mana does not regenerate for a short time afterward.
This is an annihilation and area effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an annihilation and area effect.

cattle.name: Patient Herd
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder stands its ground without moving, its mana regenerates slightly faster and allies beside it share a portion of that regeneration.
The bonus ends as soon as the holder moves and returns after a short pause.
This is a support and restoration effect.
cattle.tag: This is a support and restoration effect.

chain.name: Linked Reservoir
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder binds its mana pool to the nearest ally, letting either draw from the other when their own mana runs short.
Mana drawn through the link loses a portion in transfer, and the link breaks if they move far apart.
This is a binding and support effect.
chain.tag: This is a binding and support effect.

chaotic.name: Wild Spring
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Each time the holder's mana fills, its maximum mana shifts unpredictably, sometimes swelling well beyond its usual size and sometimes shrinking slightly.
The shift lasts until the pool next empties, and the holder cannot control its direction.
This is a transmutation effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a transmutation effect.

charlatan.name: Hollow Well
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Enemies who read or target the holder's mana see an empty pool, so mana-draining and mana-burning effects against it are weakened.
The disguise breaks for a short time whenever the holder casts a costly ability.
This is a stealth and warding effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a stealth and warding effect.

chicken.name: Startled Reserve
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder is struck while its mana is low, it flees a short distance and recovers a small burst of mana.
This can trigger once every short while and leaves the holder unable to attack for a moment.
This is an evasion and restoration effect.
chicken.tag: This is an evasion and restoration effect.

chimera.name: Grafted Pools
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's mana pool also stores a portion of its stamina, so either resource can cover a shortfall in the other.
Converting between them wastes a portion of what is converted.
This is a transformation and mastery effect.
chimera.tag: This is a transformation and mastery effect.

claw.name: Taloned Reserve
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Each melee hit the holder lands while its mana is full leaves a bleeding rune that deals damage over a short time.
Each rune costs a sliver of mana, and a single enemy can bear only a single rune at a time.
This is a hunting and affliction effect.
claw.tag: This is a hunting and affliction effect.

cloth.name: Spellcloth Reserve
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's extra maximum mana is woven into its garments, granting a light barrier against spells while its mana is above half.
The barrier unravels after absorbing a spell and reweaves after a short time.
This is a barrier and warding effect.
cloth.tag: This is a barrier and warding effect.

cloud.name: Misted Font
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, excess mana it would gain condenses into a drifting mist that makes it and nearby allies harder to hit.
The mist lasts a short time and only a single cloud can exist at a time.
This is an evasion and area effect.
cloud.tag: This is an evasion and area effect.

cold.name: Rimebound Store
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
A portion of the holder's mana is kept frozen and cannot be drained or burned by enemies.
The frozen portion thaws for use only when the rest of the pool is empty, and refreezes slowly afterward.
This is a cold and warding effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and warding effect.

coral.name: Reef Reservoir
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Over a fight, the holder's maximum mana slowly accretes, rising a little for each stretch of time it remains in combat.
The growth has a cap that scales with rank and is lost if the holder is knocked down.
This is a growth effect.
coral.tag: This is a growth effect.

corrupt.name: Tainted Reserve
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder can spend health to permanently corrupt a portion of its pool for the fight, raising its maximum mana further while its abilities apply a minor affliction.
Corrupted mana cannot be restored by allies' support effects.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

crocodile.name: Basking Pool
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
After the holder stays still for a short time, its mana pool swells slightly beyond its maximum.
The swollen excess is spent first and fuels a single ambushing strike that drags its target toward the holder.
This is a hunting and restraint effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a hunting and restraint effect.

crystal.name: Geode Reservoir
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's mana is stored in a crystalline lattice, so a portion of every mana cost it pays is refunded when the ability strikes its target.
The refund cannot carry its mana above its maximum and is lost if the ability misses.
This is a resonance and mastery effect.
crystal.tag: This is a resonance and mastery effect.

cycle.name: Ebb and Flood
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Each time the holder's mana is fully emptied and then refilled, it gains a short burst of faster regeneration and a slightly raised maximum for the rest of the fight.
The bonus has a cap that scales with rank and resets when the fight ends.
This is a restoration and time effect.
cycle.tag: This is a restoration and time effect.

dance.name: Flowing Step
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Each time the holder dodges an attack, it gains a small burst of mana.
This can trigger once every short while and cannot carry its mana above its maximum.
This is an evasion and momentum effect.
dance.tag: This is an evasion and momentum effect.

dark.name: Lightless Well
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder stands in shadow or darkness, its mana regenerates faster and its shadow abilities cost slightly less.
The bonus ends for a short time when the holder is struck by light or holy magic.
This is a shadow and darkness effect.
dark.tag: This is a shadow and darkness effect.

dawn.name: First Light Font
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
At the start of each fight, the holder's mana pool fills to its maximum and allies near it gain a small burst of mana.
Allies can only benefit from this once per fight, and it does not trigger if the holder enters the fight injured.
This is a light and support effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and support effect.

death.name: Grave Reserve
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When an enemy dies near the holder, a portion of the enemy's remaining magic flows into the holder's mana.
This can trigger once every short while and cannot carry its mana above its maximum.
This is a death and necromantic effect.
death.tag: This is a death and necromantic effect.

deep.name: Sunken Cistern
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Below its usual pool, the holder keeps a hidden reserve of mana that it can only draw on once its normal mana is spent.
The hidden reserve refills only between fights.
This is a mastery effect.
deep.tag: This is a mastery effect.

deer.name: Wary Spring
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is near full, it senses incoming attacks a moment early and steps lightly aside from the first of them each fight.
After this dodge, the holder's mana regenerates slightly slower for a short time.
This is a perception and evasion effect.
deer.tag: This is a perception and evasion effect.

desolate.name: Barren Reservoir
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, enemies near it regenerate mana more slowly as the holder hoards the magic around it.
The effect ends as soon as the holder spends mana and returns once its pool is full again.
This is an affliction and area effect.
desolate.tag: This is an affliction and area effect.

dimension.name: Creased Cistern
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
A portion of the holder's extra maximum mana is folded into a pocket space that enemies cannot drain, burn or steal.
Drawing from the folded portion takes a moment and cannot be done while the holder is stunned.
This is a dimensional and warding effect.
dimension.tag: This is a dimensional and warding effect.

discord.name: Jarring Well
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When an enemy attempts to drain the holder's mana, the stolen mana turns sour and briefly disrupts that enemy's next ability.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a sound and curse effect.
discord.tag: This is a sound and curse effect.

discordant.name: Clashing Reservoir
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Each time the holder spends a large portion of its mana, a jarring pulse rolls out from it, briefly interrupting enemies who are casting nearby.
The pulse has a cooldown and cannot interrupt the same enemy again for a short time.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
discordant.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

dog.name: Faithful Spring
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder stays near the player, its mana regenerates slightly faster and its maximum mana rises a little.
The bonus fades after a short time if the holder strays from the player.
This is a support effect.
dog.tag: This is a support effect.

doom.name: Fated Reserve
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder can mark an enemy with doom, sealing away a large portion of its own mana for the mark's duration.
When the mark expires, the sealed mana is released as damage to that enemy, and only a single mark can exist at a time.
This is a curse and death effect.
doom.tag: This is a curse and death effect.

doppelganger.name: Twin Reservoir
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Once per fight, when the holder's mana is full, a runic double steps from it and fights beside it, drawing on the same pool.
The double fades when the pool empties or after a short time.
This is a conjuration and summoning effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a conjuration and summoning effect.

dragon.name: Dragon Hoard
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The longer the holder goes without spending mana, the larger its maximum mana grows, building a hoard for the next ability it casts.
That ability gains power with the hoard's size, the hoard has a cap that scales with rank, and it resets once spent.
This is a fire and mastery effect.
dragon.tag: This is a fire and mastery effect.

duck.name: Unruffled Spring
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is above half, effects that drain, burn or steal its mana slide off it more easily.
The protection fades for a short time after it shrugs off a drain.
This is a warding and water effect.
duck.tag: This is a warding and water effect.

dust.name: Dustfall Spring
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Mana the holder spends drifts down as fine dust around it, and a small portion of it settles back into its pool over a short time.
Only mana spent while standing within the dust can be recovered this way.
This is a restoration and area effect.
dust.tag: This is a restoration and area effect.

earth.name: Bedrock Well
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder stands its ground, its maximum mana is slightly higher and its casting cannot be interrupted by knockback.
The bonus ends when the holder is moved against its will and returns after a short pause.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
earth.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

echo.name: Resounding Font
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder spends a large portion of its mana on an ability, an echo of that mana returns to its pool a short time later.
The echo restores only a small portion and cannot carry its mana above its maximum.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
echo.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

eclipse.name: Umbral Tide
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana falls below half, its light and shadow abilities trade places in cost, so whichever it has used least becomes cheaper.
The swap lasts until the pool refills past half and has a cooldown afterward.
This is a light and shadow effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a light and shadow effect.

edifice.name: Runic Cistern
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Once per fight, the holder can raise a runic cistern on the ground that stores a portion of its mana for allies to draw from while standing nearby.
The cistern holds only what the holder pours in and crumbles when emptied or after a short time.
This is a conjuration and support effect.
edifice.tag: This is a conjuration and support effect.

effigy.name: Decoy Cistern
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Once per fight, when the holder's mana is drained or burned heavily, a runic effigy takes the loss in its place and draws nearby enemies' attention.
The effigy lasts a short time and shatters when struck repeatedly.
This is a warding and conjuration effect.
effigy.tag: This is a warding and conjuration effect.

elemental.name: Tempered Elements
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's maximum mana rises slightly for each different element it casts during a fight.
The bonus has a cap that scales with rank and resets when the fight ends.
This is a fire, frost and lightning effect.
elemental.tag: This is a fire, frost and lightning effect.

elixir.name: Distilled Spring
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Healing potions the holder drinks also restore a portion of its mana, scaled by its maximum mana.
This shares the potion's own cooldown and cannot carry its mana above its maximum.
This is an alchemy and restoration effect.
elixir.tag: This is an alchemy and restoration effect.

empower.name: Surging Reservoir
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is full, its next ability is empowered by a portion of the pool, dealing extra damage or healing.
The empowerment spends that portion of mana and returns only when the pool is full again.
This is a mastery effect.
empower.tag: This is a mastery effect.

eye.name: Castwatch Font
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is above half, it can see the mana of enemies nearby and favours striking casters who are about to cast.
Each time it interrupts a cast this way, it spends a portion of mana and the effect has a short cooldown.
This is a perception and revelation effect.
eye.tag: This is a perception and revelation effect.

feast.name: Gorged Reservoir
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder defeats an enemy, its maximum mana swells slightly for a short time and the extra space arrives filled.
The swelling cannot stack beyond a cap that scales with rank.
This is a harvest and restoration effect.
feast.tag: This is a harvest and restoration effect.

feeble.name: Sapping Well
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Enemies hit by the holder's abilities while its mana is full are briefly weakened, dealing slightly less damage.
Each weakening costs a sliver of mana, so the effect ends as soon as the pool dips below full.
This is an affliction effect.
feeble.tag: This is an affliction effect.

fertile.name: Fecund Spring
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is full, allies near it regenerate health slowly.
The growth ends whenever the holder spends mana and returns once its pool refills.
This is a growth and healing effect.
fertile.tag: This is a growth and healing effect.

fey.name: Glamoured Font
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The first time each fight an enemy strikes the holder while its mana is above half, the blow lands on a glamoured illusion instead.
The illusion costs a portion of mana to maintain and fades after a short time.
This is an evasion and transformation effect.
fey.tag: This is an evasion and transformation effect.

fire.name: Kindled Reserve
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, excess mana it would gain instead burns as a flame around its weapons, adding fire damage to its attacks.
The flame lasts a short time and only reignites once the pool is full again.
This is a fire and flame effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire and flame effect.

firebird.name: Ashen Refill
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Once per fight, when the holder's mana runs fully dry, it bursts into flame and its pool refills to a portion of its maximum.
The burst burns nearby enemies, and the holder's maximum mana is slightly reduced for the rest of the fight.
This is a fire and rebirth effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire and rebirth effect.

fish.name: Running Current
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder keeps moving, its mana regenerates slightly faster, as though carried on a current.
The bonus ends when the holder stops moving for a moment.
This is a water and movement effect.
fish.tag: This is a water and movement effect.

flea.name: Leaping Reserve
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, it can spend a portion to leap a short distance out of danger.
The leap has a cooldown and can only be used while the holder is in melee range of an enemy.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
flea.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

flesh.name: Fleshbound Font
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder takes damage while its mana is full, a portion of the damage is absorbed by its mana instead.
Mana spent this way regenerates more slowly for a short time.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
flesh.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

foot.name: Grounded Spring
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's mana regenerates slightly faster while it walks rather than stands still or fights.
The bonus pauses for a short time after it attacks or casts.
This is a travel and movement effect.
foot.tag: This is a travel and movement effect.

force.name: Pressure Reserve
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, its next ability knocks enemies back with a burst of raw force.
The burst spends a portion of mana and has a cooldown.
This is a force and area effect.
force.tag: This is a force and area effect.

forge.name: Anvil Well
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder can temper a portion of its maximum mana into its weapon for the fight, giving its attacks extra damage while the tempered mana stays locked away.
Tempering takes a moment and can only be done once per fight.
This is a fire and mastery effect.
forge.tag: This is a fire and mastery effect.

fork.name: Forking Stream
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder spends a large portion of its mana on a single-target ability, a lesser branch of it strikes another nearby enemy.
The branch has a cooldown and deals reduced damage.
This is a lightning and area effect.
fork.tag: This is a lightning and area effect.

fortress.name: Bastion Well
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is above half, it and allies directly beside it take slightly less damage.
Each blow softened this way costs a sliver of mana, and the effect fades below half mana.
This is a protection and defensive effect.
fortress.tag: This is a protection and defensive effect.

fox.name: Cunning Reserve
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's mana pool appears smaller than it is to enemies, so they underestimate its threat and target it less while its mana is full.
The deception fades for a short time after the holder casts a costly ability.
This is a stealth and evasion effect.
fox.tag: This is a stealth and evasion effect.

frog.name: Marsh Well
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder stands in water or mud, its mana regenerates faster and its maximum mana is slightly higher.
The bonus fades a short time after leaving the water.
This is a water and nature effect.
frog.tag: This is a water and nature effect.

fungus.name: Spore Reserve
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder spends a large portion of its mana, it releases spores that slowly poison nearby enemies.
Only a single spore cloud can exist at a time, and it fades after a short time.
This is a poison and growth effect.
fungus.tag: This is a poison and growth effect.

garuda.name: Sunwing Reservoir
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is full, its attacks against serpents and poisoners deal extra radiant damage.
Each such strike spends a sliver of mana.
This is a radiant and hunting effect.
garuda.tag: This is a radiant and hunting effect.

gate.name: Threshold Spring
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Once per fight, when the holder's mana is full, it can open a short-lived runic gate and step through it to an ally's side.
Using the gate empties a large portion of its mana.
This is a travel and dimensional effect.
gate.tag: This is a travel and dimensional effect.

gathering.name: Gathered Waters
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Stray magic from spells cast near the holder, by allies or enemies, slowly gathers into its pool.
This cannot carry its mana above its maximum and stops while the holder is casting.
This is a harvest and harvesting effect.
gathering.tag: This is a harvest and harvesting effect.

glass.name: Clearglass Well
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is full, its spells pierce through a portion of enemy resistances.
The effect shatters when the holder is struck hard and reforms only once the pool is full again.
This is a mastery effect.
glass.tag: This is a mastery effect.

glimeron.name: Gleaming Pool
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is above half, it shimmers with refracted light, making its exact position hard to strike.
The shimmer dims for a short time after it is hit.
This is a light and evasion effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a light and evasion effect.

goat.name: Headstrong Font
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is above half, it resists being knocked back and its charges strike harder.
Each charge spends a portion of mana and has a cooldown.
This is a momentum and might effect.
goat.tag: This is a momentum and might effect.

gorgon.name: Petrified Reserve
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, enemies who meet its gaze while it casts are briefly slowed as if turning to stone.
Each slowing costs a sliver of mana, and a single enemy cannot be slowed again for a short time.
This is a restraint and curse effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a restraint and curse effect.

griffin.name: Proud Spring
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is above half, it dashes to an ally under attack and strikes the attacker.
The dash costs a portion of mana and has a cooldown.
This is a movement and protection effect.
griffin.tag: This is a movement and protection effect.

growth.name: Swelling Reservoir
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's maximum mana grows slightly each time it fills its pool during a fight.
The growth has a cap that scales with rank and resets when the fight ends.
This is a growth effect.
growth.tag: This is a growth effect.

guardian.name: Sentinel Spring
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When an ally near the holder takes a heavy blow, the holder spends a portion of its mana to shield that ally from part of the damage.
This can trigger once every short while and only while the holder's mana is above half.
This is a protection and shield effect.
guardian.tag: This is a protection and shield effect.

hair.name: Threaded Reserve
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Fine threads of mana stream from the holder, sensing nearby enemies and warning it of attacks from behind.
The threads cost a slow trickle of mana to maintain and dissipate while its mana is below half.
This is a perception and detection effect.
hair.tag: This is a perception and detection effect.

hammer.name: Stunning Surplus
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is full, its heavy strikes briefly daze the enemies they hit.
Each daze spends a portion of mana, and a single enemy cannot be dazed again for a short time.
This is a might and restraint effect.
hammer.tag: This is a might and restraint effect.

hand.name: Open Palm Font
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder can lay a hand on an adjacent ally to pass them a portion of its mana.
This has a cooldown and the holder cannot pass more than a modest portion of its pool at a time.
This is a support and restoration effect.
hand.tag: This is a support and restoration effect.

harmonic.name: Attuned Reservoir
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is full, its abilities resonate with allies' abilities that strike the same target soon after, adding a small burst of damage.
Each resonance spends a sliver of mana.
This is a resonance and sound effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a resonance and sound effect.

harpy.name: Shrieking Reserve
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, excess mana it would gain is released as a piercing shriek that briefly disorients enemies nearby.
The shriek has a cooldown and does not disorient the same enemy again for a short time.
This is a sound and wind effect.
harpy.tag: This is a sound and wind effect.

harvest.name: Reaping Font
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Each enemy the holder damages during a fight leaves a small store of mana behind that the holder collects when the enemy falls.
The collected mana cannot carry its pool above its maximum.
This is a harvest and harvesting effect.
harvest.tag: This is a harvest and harvesting effect.

heidel.name: Wanderer's Reservoir
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's mana regenerates faster while it travels between fights, so it enters each fight with its pool full.
If a fight begins before the pool has refilled, the holder gains a brief burst of faster regeneration instead.
This is a travel and restoration effect.
heidel.tag: This is a travel and restoration effect.

hook.name: Grasping Reserve
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, it can spend a portion to hook a fleeing or distant enemy and drag it closer.
The hook has a cooldown and cannot pull large enemies.
This is a restraint and binding effect.
hook.tag: This is a restraint and binding effect.

horse.name: Galloping Spring
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder runs, its mana regenerates faster and it gains a burst of speed when its pool fills.
The burst lasts a short time and has a cooldown.
This is a movement and haste effect.
horse.tag: This is a movement and haste effect.

hunger.name: Ravenous Well
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's attacks drain a sliver of mana from enemies, feeding its own pool.
This drain stops while its mana is full and has a cooldown against each enemy.
This is a harvest and affliction effect.
hunger.tag: This is a harvest and affliction effect.

hunt.name: Stalker's Reserve
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder marks the enemy it is fighting, and its maximum mana rises slightly for as long as that enemy lives.
Only a single enemy can be marked at a time, and the bonus vanishes when the mark is lost.
This is a hunting and tracking effect.
hunt.tag: This is a hunting and tracking effect.

hydra.name: Regrowing Wells
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is drained or burned, a portion of the lost mana grows back over a short time.
The regrowth cannot carry its mana above its maximum and stops if the holder is drained again before it finishes.
This is a growth and restoration effect.
hydra.tag: This is a growth and restoration effect.

ice.name: Glacial Reservoir
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is full, a thin layer of ice forms over it, absorbing a portion of the next hit.
The ice shatters when struck and reforms only once the pool is full again.
This is an ice and barrier effect.
ice.tag: This is an ice and barrier effect.

immortal.name: Undying Spring
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Once per fight, when the holder would fall, it instead burns its remaining mana to survive with a sliver of health.
This only works if its mana is above half, and it leaves the pool empty.
This is a rebirth and protection effect.
immortal.tag: This is a rebirth and protection effect.

iron.name: Ironvein Well
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's extra maximum mana reinforces its body, granting slight resistance to physical damage while its mana is above half.
The resistance fades below half mana.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
iron.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

juggernaut.name: Unstoppable Well
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is full, it cannot be slowed or rooted.
Each slow or root it shrugs off costs a portion of mana, so the effect ends once the pool dips.
This is a momentum and protection effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a momentum and protection effect.

karmic.name: Balanced Ledger
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When an enemy drains or burns the holder's mana, a portion of the lost mana is returned to the holder and the enemy takes damage in kind.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a curse and resonance effect.
karmic.tag: This is a curse and resonance effect.

knife.name: Keen Reserve
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is full, its quick strikes deal slightly more damage and have a chance to cause bleeding.
Each bleeding strike spends a sliver of mana.
This is a hunting and affliction effect.
knife.tag: This is a hunting and affliction effect.

knowledge.name: Scholar's Font
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder learns the weaknesses of enemies it fights, and its spells against those enemies cost slightly less mana.
The discount applies only to enemy types it has already fought in that fight.
This is a revelation and mastery effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a revelation and mastery effect.

kraken.name: Abyssal Grip
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, it can spend a large portion to summon grasping tentacles that hold a nearby enemy in place.
The hold lasts a short time and has a long cooldown.
This is a binding and summoning effect.
kraken.tag: This is a binding and summoning effect.

leviathan.name: Leviathan Depths
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's maximum mana grows larger the longer a fight goes on, as deep waters rise within it.
The growth has a cap that scales with rank and is lost when the fight ends.
This is a water and growth effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water and growth effect.

life.name: Verdant Spring
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is full, its regeneration also heals it slowly.
The healing pauses for a short time whenever it spends mana.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
life.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

light.name: Radiant Font
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is above half, it glows with light that reveals hidden enemies nearby and slightly weakens shadow creatures.
The light dims below half mana.
This is a light and revelation effect.
light.tag: This is a light and revelation effect.

lightning.name: Charged Reservoir
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana fills, a bolt of lightning leaps from it to the nearest enemy.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a lightning and storm effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and storm effect.

lizard.name: Shedding Reserve
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Once per fight, when the holder is badly hurt, it sheds a portion of its mana to regrow health over a short time.
The holder's maximum mana is slightly reduced for the rest of the fight afterward.
This is a healing and regrowth effect.
lizard.tag: This is a healing and regrowth effect.

locust.name: Locust Tithe
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, it can release a swarm of runic locusts that eat away at enemies' mana and feed a portion of it back to the holder.
The swarm lasts a short time and has a cooldown.
This is a swarm and harvest effect.
locust.tag: This is a swarm and harvest effect.

lotus.name: Blooming Reservoir
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder stays calm and unhurt, its maximum mana slowly blooms larger.
The growth is lost when it takes damage, and it has a cap that scales with rank.
This is a growth and serenity effect.
lotus.tag: This is a growth and serenity effect.

lurker.name: Hidden Depths
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder is unseen by enemies, its mana regenerates faster and its maximum mana rises slightly.
The bonus fades a short time after it is revealed.
This is a stealth effect.
lurker.tag: This is a stealth effect.

magic.name: Brimful Sorcery
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's spells deal slightly more damage for every portion of its maximum mana it currently holds.
The bonus shrinks as its pool empties and is gone while its mana is low.
This is a mastery effect.
magic.tag: This is a mastery effect.

malign.name: Spiteful Well
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder spends a large portion of its mana, its target is cursed and takes slightly more damage for a short time.
Only a single enemy can bear the curse at a time.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

manatee.name: Seagrass Tide
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is full, allies near it regenerate mana slightly faster.
The effect pauses whenever the holder spends mana and returns once its pool refills.
This is a support and water effect.
manatee.tag: This is a support and water effect.

manticore.name: Barbed Reserve
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, enemies who strike it in melee are pricked by a venomous rune that poisons them.
Each rune costs a sliver of mana, and a single enemy can only be poisoned this way once every short while.
This is a poison and warding effect.
manticore.tag: This is a poison and warding effect.

master.name: Mastered Flow
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's most used ability in a fight costs slightly less mana each time it is used.
The discount has a cap that scales with rank and resets when the fight ends.
This is a mastery effect.
master.tag: This is a mastery effect.

might.name: Mighty Reserve
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is full, its physical attacks deal slightly more damage.
Each empowered strike spends a sliver of mana.
This is a might effect.
might.tag: This is a might effect.

ministration.name: Tending Spring
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's healing abilities restore extra health that scales with its maximum mana.
This bonus applies only while its mana is above half.
This is a healing and support effect.
ministration.tag: This is a healing and support effect.

minotaur.name: Goring Surplus
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, it can spend a portion to charge through enemies in a straight line, knocking them aside.
The charge has a cooldown and cannot pass through walls.
This is a momentum and might effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a momentum and might effect.

mirage.name: Heatshimmer Well
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, it leaves an illusion of itself behind when it moves, drawing enemy attacks.
The illusion lasts a short time and has a cooldown.
This is an evasion and stealth effect.
mirage.tag: This is an evasion and stealth effect.

mirror.name: Reflected Pool
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When an enemy spell strikes the holder while its mana is full, a portion of the spell's power is reflected back.
Reflecting a spell spends a portion of mana and has a cooldown.
This is a warding and reflection effect.
mirror.tag: This is a warding and reflection effect.

monkey.name: Mischief Spring
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, its attacks have a chance to snatch a small amount of mana from enemies.
This cannot carry its mana above its maximum and has a cooldown against each enemy.
This is a harvest and evasion effect.
monkey.tag: This is a harvest and evasion effect.

monolith.name: Monolith Well
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder stands still, its maximum mana slowly rises and it gains resistance to being moved.
The bonus ends when it moves and returns after a short pause.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
monolith.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

moon.name: Moonpull Reservoir
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's mana ebbs and flows during a fight, its maximum mana rising and falling in a slow tide.
At high tide its abilities are slightly stronger, while at low tide its mana regenerates faster.
This is a time and resonance effect.
moon.tag: This is a time and resonance effect.

mouse.name: Lowwater Scamper
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is low, it slips past enemies more easily and becomes harder to target.
The effect ends once its mana refills past half.
This is an evasion and stealth effect.
mouse.tag: This is an evasion and stealth effect.

myriad.name: Myriad Founts
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's extra maximum mana is split into many tiny reserves, each of which refills on its own.
Spending from a reserve does not slow regeneration in the others, but each is very small.
This is a swarm and restoration effect.
myriad.tag: This is a swarm and restoration effect.

mystic.name: Mystic Depths
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's maximum mana rises slightly for each spell it casts in a fight.
The bonus has a cap that scales with rank and resets when the fight ends.
This is a mastery and resonance effect.
mystic.tag: This is a mastery and resonance effect.

nebula.name: Starcloud Reservoir
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, excess mana it would gain forms a drifting cloud of stars that damages enemies passing through it.
The cloud lasts a short time and only a single cloud can exist at a time.
This is a cosmic and area effect.
nebula.tag: This is a cosmic and area effect.

needle.name: Piercing Font
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
While the holder's mana is full, its precise strikes ignore a portion of enemy armour.
Each strike spends a sliver of mana.
This is a mastery effect.
needle.tag: This is a mastery effect.

nemesis.name: Grudge Reservoir
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder chooses a single enemy as its nemesis each fight, and its maximum mana rises slightly while fighting that enemy.
The bonus vanishes when the nemesis falls, and a new nemesis cannot be chosen until the next fight.
This is a hunting and tracking effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a hunting and tracking effect.

net.name: Snaring Reserve
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, it can spend a portion to cast a net of runes that briefly roots enemies in an area.
The net has a cooldown and breaks when the enemies take heavy damage.
This is a restraint and binding effect.
net.tag: This is a restraint and binding effect.

network.name: Webbed Wells
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's extra maximum mana is linked to every ally in the party, letting any of them draw on it when their own mana runs short.
The shared mana is small and refills slowly.
This is a support and resonance effect.
network.tag: This is a support and resonance effect.

oasis.name: Desert Oasis
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Once per fight, when the holder's mana is full, it can create a small oasis where allies regenerate health and mana.
The oasis lasts a short time and empties a large portion of its mana.
This is a restoration and support effect.
oasis.tag: This is a restoration and support effect.

ocean.name: Breaker Surge
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder's mana regenerates in great waves, refilling a large portion of its pool every so often.
Between waves, its regeneration is slightly slower.
This is a water and restoration effect.
ocean.tag: This is a water and restoration effect.

octopus.name: Grasping Pools
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
The holder can maintain several lesser abilities at once, each drawing from its own portion of its mana pool.
Each maintained ability slightly reduces its regeneration.
This is a mastery effect.
octopus.tag: This is a mastery effect.

omen.name: Portent Spring
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When an enemy is about to use a powerful ability, the holder senses it and gains a brief burst of mana to react.
This can trigger once every short while.
This is a precognition effect.
omen.tag: This is a precognition effect.

onslaught.name: Relentless Reservoir
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
Each consecutive hit the holder lands on an enemy restores a small amount of mana.
The chain resets if it stops attacking for a moment, and this cannot carry its mana above its maximum.
This is a momentum effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a momentum effect.

pangolin.name: Curled Bulwark
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].
When the holder's mana is full, it can curl up to take greatly reduced damage for a short time.
Curling up spends a portion of mana and has a cooldown.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

paper.name: Banked Scroll
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Wellspring].

This is a necromantic and death effect.

vast.name: Vast Reservoir
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Vast essence.

The penalty is lifted for a short time whenever its mana falls below half.
This is a mastery effect.
vast.tag: This is a mastery effect.

vehicle.name: Carriage Well
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.

While the holder's mana is full, allies near it move slightly faster as it carries them along in its current.
The effect pauses whenever the holder spends mana.
This is a travel and movement effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a travel and movement effect.

venom.name: Toxic Spring
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Venom essence.

venom.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

verdant.name: Greenwood Font
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.

While the holder's mana is full, plants spring up around it, slowly healing allies who stand among them.

This is a nature and healing effect.
verdant.tag: This is a nature and healing effect.

vessel.name: Overbrim Flask
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.

vision.name: Farsight Well

void.name: Hollow Abyss

vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Wellspring]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.

wasp.name: Stinging Reserve

whip.name: Lashing Reserve

wind.name: Gusting Spring

crystal.tag: This is a light and revelation effect.

When an adaptation fades, the holder briefly gains a slight resistance to the element that opposes it, such as frost after fire.
This lingering resistance is weak and lasts a short time.
This is a defensive and time effect.
