lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
Allies who stay close behind the holder share a portion of its adaptation, as crew sheltered by a hull.
The shared portion is weaker and ends when they move away.
This is a protection and support effect.
ship.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

shovel.name: Dug-In Ward
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder stops moving, it digs in and its adaptation to earth and ground-zone spells strengthens slightly.
The bonus ends when it moves and has a cap that scales with rank.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
shovel.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

sickle.name: Reaping Ward
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder strikes down an enemy caster, it reaps that caster's spell kind and gains a brief resistance to it.
This works once every short while.
This is a harvesting and death effect.
sickle.tag: This is a harvesting and death effect.

simulacrum.name: Decoy Runes
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder adapts to a kind of spell damage, a faint runic copy of it appears and draws the next spell of that kind before vanishing.
The copy has a cooldown.
This is a conjuration and evasion effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a conjuration and evasion effect.

sin.name: Penance Ward
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder resists a spell, the caster is marked with guilt and takes slightly more damage from the holder's allies for a short time.
This can affect each caster once every short while.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
sin.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

skirmish.name: Darting Attunement
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder is fighting on the move, darting in and out of melee, its adaptations build slightly faster.
The bonus ends when it stands still and has a cooldown after triggering.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

skunk.name: Musk Ward
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder takes a heavy spell, it releases a foul cloud that makes nearby enemies falter and miscast briefly.
The cloud has a cooldown.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
skunk.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

sky.name: Open Sky Runes
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder fights in the open air, its adaptations to wind, storm and lightning spells build faster.
The faster build has a cooldown for each kind.
This is a wind and storm effect.
sky.tag: This is a wind and storm effect.

sloth.name: Languid Hide
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
The holder's adaptations fade very slowly, but build more slowly as well.
The holder can switch between slow and normal adaptation only out of combat.
This is a time and defensive effect.
sloth.tag: This is a time and defensive effect.

smoke.name: Smoke Veil
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder resists a fire spell, the flames become a thin smoke around it that makes it harder to target for a short time.
The smoke has a cooldown.
This is a fire and stealth effect.
smoke.tag: This is a fire and stealth effect.

snake.name: Sloughed Runes
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When an adaptation fades, the holder sheds a lingering poison or curse along with it.
This has a cooldown.
This is a poison and purification effect.
snake.tag: This is a poison and purification effect.

soaring.name: Rising Ward
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder adapts to a kind of spell damage, its next leap or dash carries it farther and grants a brief resistance to knockdown.
This has a cooldown.
This is a movement and momentum effect.
soaring.tag: This is a movement and momentum effect.

song.name: Chanted Runes
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder resists a kind of spell damage, it hums a low chant that grants nearby allies a slight resistance to the same kind.
The chant ends with the adaptation, and allies receive a weaker version.
This is a sound and support effect.
song.tag: This is a sound and support effect.

sovereign.name: Sovereign Sigil
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
Once per fight, the holder decrees its current adaptation to every ally nearby at full strength for a short time.
The decree then leaves the holder's own adaptation weaker until it fades.
This is a command and support effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a command and support effect.

spear.name: Point Ward
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
Narrow beam and bolt spells of a kind the holder is resisting are partly turned aside by its lowered spear.
This turning has a cooldown.
This is a defensive and warding effect.
spear.tag: This is a defensive and warding effect.

spider.name: Webbed Runes
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder resists a spell, a faint web of runes stretches toward the caster and slows its next cast.
This can affect each caster once every short while.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
spider.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

spike.name: Thorned Script
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder resists a kind of spell damage, enemies who strike it in melee are pricked by runic spikes for a small amount of damage.
The spikes have a cooldown for each enemy.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
spike.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

staff.name: Grounding Staff
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder holds a staff, a portion of the spell damage it resists is grounded through the staff and restores a little mana.
The mana gained has a cap per fight.
This is a mastery and restoration effect.
staff.tag: This is a mastery and restoration effect.

star.name: Star Mote Ward
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder adapts to a kind of spell damage, a small star mote orbits it and absorbs a portion of the next such spell.
The mote fades after absorbing and has a cooldown.
This is a light and shield effect.
star.tag: This is a light and shield effect.

stellar.name: Constellation Ward
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
Each different kind of spell the holder adapts to in a fight adds a point of light to a faint constellation around it, slightly reducing all spell damage.
The constellation has a cap that scales with rank and fades when the fight ends.
This is a light and protection effect.
stellar.tag: This is a light and protection effect.

storm.name: Eye of the Storm
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder resists lightning, wind or storm spells, allies standing right beside it are sheltered from those kinds too.
The shelter is weaker for allies and ends with the adaptation.
This is a storm and protection effect.
storm.tag: This is a storm and protection effect.

succubus.name: Unswayed Runes
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
Charm and seduction spells count toward the holder's adaptation, and while it resists them it cannot be turned against its allies.
Only the most recent kind is resisted at a time.
This is a defensive and purification effect.
succubus.tag: This is a defensive and purification effect.

sun.name: Noonday Ward
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder resists fire or radiant spells, its runes blaze and it slowly heals.
The healing ends with the adaptation and cannot stack.
This is a fire and healing effect.
sun.tag: This is a fire and healing effect.

swarm.name: Hive Runes
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When several enemies cast the same kind of spell at the holder, its adaptation to that kind builds faster with each different caster.
The build has a cap that scales with rank.
This is a swarm and defensive effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and defensive effect.

swift.name: Quickened Ward
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
The holder adapts to a new kind of spell damage almost instantly after being struck.
This instant adaptation has a cooldown for each kind.
This is a haste and defensive effect.
swift.tag: This is a haste and defensive effect.

sword.name: Parrying Runes
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder holds a blade, it can parry a bolt spell of a kind it is resisting, taking greatly reduced damage.
The parry has a cooldown and costs stamina.
This is a defensive and mastery effect.
sword.tag: This is a defensive and mastery effect.

talisman.name: Charm Runes
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder adapts to a kind of spell damage, a small runic charm forms on its chest and fully absorbs the next spell of that kind.
The charm shatters after absorbing and has a long cooldown.
This is a warding and shield effect.
talisman.tag: This is a warding and shield effect.

tentacle.name: Clutching Runes
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder resists a spell from a nearby caster, runic tendrils reach out and briefly hold that caster in place.
This has a cooldown for each enemy.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

thread.name: Stitched Ward
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
The holder stitches a thread of its adaptation to the nearest ally, who gains a weaker copy of it for as long as they stay close.
Only a single thread exists at a time.
This is a binding and support effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and support effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderhide
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder resists a lightning spell, it answers with a thunderclap that briefly staggers nearby enemies.
The thunderclap has a cooldown.
This is a lightning and sound effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a lightning and sound effect.

time.name: Lingering Runes
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
The holder's adaptations remember spells from a longer stretch of the recent past before they fade.
Time-bending spells such as slows and hastes on enemies count toward its adaptation as well, with a cooldown for each kind.
This is a time and defensive effect.
time.tag: This is a time and defensive effect.

tranquil.name: Untroubled Runes
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder is not attacking, its adaptations slowly strengthen and soothe a minor lingering effect each short while.
The bonus ends when it attacks and has a cap that scales with rank.
This is a purification and restoration effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a purification and restoration effect.

transfiguration.name: Recast Hide
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
Once per fight, the holder can transmute its current adaptation into resistance against a different kind of spell that an enemy is preparing.
The transmuted resistance fades normally.
This is a transmutation and transformation effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a transmutation and transformation effect.

transgression.name: Defiant Runes
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
Spells that break or strip buffs cannot strip the holder's adaptations.
After resisting such a spell, the holder's next attack against that caster deals slightly more damage, once every short while.
This is a curse and defensive effect.
transgression.tag: This is a curse and defensive effect.

trap.name: Snare Runes
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder adapts to a kind of spell damage, it leaves a hidden rune where it stands that roots the next enemy to step on it.
The rune fades after a short time, and only a single rune exists at a time.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
trap.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

tree.name: Rooted Heartrunes
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder stands rooted in place, its adaptations fade more slowly and it regenerates a little health.
The benefit ends when it moves.
This is a nature and healing effect.
tree.tag: This is a nature and healing effect.

troll.name: Regrowing Hide
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder resists a kind of spell damage, its health regenerates slightly, except against fire and acid.
The regeneration ends with the adaptation and cannot stack.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
troll.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

trowel.name: Plastered Runes
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When an adaptation is about to fade, the holder smooths over its runes and keeps it a little longer.
This patching has a cooldown.
This is a protection and defensive effect.
trowel.tag: This is a protection and defensive effect.

turtle.name: Shell Runes
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder is guarding, its current adaptation is stronger and spells of that kind cannot interrupt it.
The bonus ends when it stops guarding.
This is a shield and defensive effect.
turtle.tag: This is a shield and defensive effect.

twilight.name: Dusk Ward
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
The holder's adaptation to light also slightly guards against shadow, and its adaptation to shadow slightly guards against light.
The crossed guard is weaker than the main adaptation and ends with it.
This is a light and shadow effect.
twilight.tag: This is a light and shadow effect.

undeath.name: Deathless Runes
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder resists necromantic spells, life-draining effects cannot steal its health.
This protection ends with the adaptation.
This is a necromantic and death effect.
undeath.tag: This is a necromantic and death effect.

unity.name: United Ward
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
The holder's adaptation is shared at reduced strength with every ally in the party near it.
Sharing slightly weakens the holder's own adaptation for as long as it lasts.
This is a support and protection effect.
unity.tag: This is a support and protection effect.

vast.name: Vast Runes
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
The holder's adaptation applies across a wider span of related spells, so fire also guards slightly against burning and smoke, and frost against cold and ice.
The related guard is weaker than the main adaptation.
This is an area and defensive effect.
vast.tag: This is an area and defensive effect.

vehicle.name: Carried Ward
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder dashes or charges, it carries its current adaptation with it at full strength, and allies it passes gain a brief weaker copy.
This has a cooldown.
This is a movement and support effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a movement and support effect.

venom.name: Antivenom Runes
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder resists poison spells, poisons on it are slowly turned into a mild healing instead.
Only a single poison is turned at a time.
This is a poison and healing effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and healing effect.

verdant.name: Verdant Hide
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder adapts to a kind of spell damage, leafy runes bloom across it and heal it slightly over a short time.
The bloom has a cooldown.
This is a nature and growth effect.
verdant.tag: This is a nature and growth effect.

vessel.name: Overflow Runes
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
Spell damage the holder resists is partly stored in its runes, and when the store fills, the holder releases it as a small burst that heals nearby allies.
The store empties when the fight ends.
This is a healing and support effect.
vessel.tag: This is a healing and support effect.

visage.name: Graven Countenance
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder resists a spell, its runic face hardens and the caster is briefly shaken, casting slightly slower.
This can affect each caster once every short while.
This is a defensive and command effect.
visage.tag: This is a defensive and command effect.

vision.name: Foreseen Ward
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When an enemy begins casting a heavy spell at any ally, the holder foresees its kind and adapts to it before it lands.
This foresight has a cooldown.
This is a precognition and perception effect.
vision.tag: This is a precognition and perception effect.

void.name: Hollow Runes
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
Once every while, a spell the holder is resisting falls into an empty rune and vanishes without dealing damage.
The empty rune refills only after a long cooldown.
This is a darkness and warding effect.
void.tag: This is a darkness and warding effect.

volcano.name: Magma Hide
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder resists fire or earth spells, its runes smoulder and burn enemies who strike it in melee.
The burn has a cooldown for each enemy.
This is a fire and burn effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and burn effect.

vortex.name: Swirling Ward
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder resists a spell, a small vortex around it pulls lingering zones of that kind away from it.
The vortex has a cooldown.
This is a wind and area effect.
vortex.tag: This is a wind and area effect.

wasp.name: Wasp Sigil Ward
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder resists a spell from a nearby caster, it darts in with a quick sting that inflicts a brief poison.
This has a cooldown and costs stamina.
This is a poison and haste effect.
wasp.tag: This is a poison and haste effect.

water.name: Flowing Runes
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
The holder's adaptation flows from one kind to the next instead of starting over, carrying a portion of its strength into the new kind.
The carried portion fades normally.
This is a water and defensive effect.
water.tag: This is a water and defensive effect.

weave.name: Interlaced Ward
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
The holder weaves its adaptation into the nearest ally's own wards and barriers, making them slightly stronger against that kind of spell.
The weaving lasts a short time and has a cooldown.
This is a barrier and support effect.
weave.tag: This is a barrier and support effect.

wendigo.name: Frostfed Hide
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder resists cold or frost spells, chilling effects feed it instead, restoring a little stamina.
The stamina gained has a cap per fight.
This is a cold and harvest effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and harvest effect.

whale.name: Blubber Runes
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
The holder's adaptations last longer the more health it has, fading slowly while it is hale.
The benefit shrinks as it is wounded.
This is a water and protection effect.
whale.tag: This is a water and protection effect.

wheel.name: Turning Runes
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
The holder's adaptations cycle through the kinds it has met this fight, briefly favouring each in turn while it is not being struck.
The cycling ends as soon as a new spell lands.
This is a time and defensive effect.
wheel.tag: This is a time and defensive effect.

whip.name: Lashing Ward
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder resists a spell, its next reaching strike snaps out farther to hit the caster.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and momentum effect.
whip.tag: This is a defensive and momentum effect.

wind.name: Gale Runes
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder resists a spell projectile, a gust from its runes nudges the next projectile of that kind slightly off course.
The gust has a cooldown.
This is a wind and evasion effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and evasion effect.

wing.name: Runic Pinion Cloak
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
When the holder adapts to a kind of spell damage, it sweeps its runic cloak around the nearest ally and shields them from the next spell of that kind.
This has a cooldown.
This is a protection and shield effect.
wing.tag: This is a protection and shield effect.

wolf.name: Pack Ward
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While allies fight near the holder, its adaptations build faster for each ally beside it.
The bonus has a cap that scales with rank.
This is a support and hunting effect.
wolf.tag: This is a support and hunting effect.

wood.name: Grained Runes
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
The holder's adaptations harden like seasoned wood, resisting effects that would strip or weaken them.
After an adaptation resists such an effect, it fades slightly sooner.
This is a nature and defensive effect.
wood.tag: This is a nature and defensive effect.

wrath.name: Wrathful Runes
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
Spell damage the holder resists stokes its anger, and its next attack deals slightly more damage.
The stoked bonus has a cap and fades quickly if unused.
This is a fire and momentum effect.
wrath.tag: This is a fire and momentum effect.

zeal.name: Fervent Hide
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
While the holder is pressing an attack, its adaptations do not fade.
The pause ends when it disengages, and costs a little stamina while it lasts.
This is a holy and momentum effect.
zeal.tag: This is a holy and momentum effect.

ziz.name: Sky Titan Ward
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Adaptive Resistance]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Adaptive Resistance].
Once per fight, when a massive storm or wind spell would sweep the party, the holder spreads its adaptation over every ally caught in it.
The spread resistance is weaker than the holder's own and lasts a short time.
This is a storm and protection effect.
ziz.tag: This is a storm and protection effect.

action.name: Restless Rune Tick
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While the holder is moving or attacking, its mana regeneration ticks faster.
The bonus fades a moment after the holder stands idle, and it does not apply while channelling.
This is a haste and restoration effect.
action.tag: This is a haste and restoration effect.

adept.name: Measured Intake
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Each spell the holder finishes without being interrupted makes its next mana restoration effect slightly stronger, building up to a cap that scales with rank.
Being stunned or interrupted clears the build-up.
This is a mastery and restoration effect.
adept.tag: This is a mastery and restoration effect.

alchemy.name: Lingering Draught
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder drinks a mana potion, the potion leaves a gentle mana regeneration behind it for a short time.
The lingering effect cannot stack, and a fresh potion replaces it.
This is an alchemy and restoration effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and restoration effect.

ambush.name: Lurking Reservoir
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Until the holder is first targeted in a fight, its mana regeneration quietly fills a hidden surplus.
The holder's first attack against an unaware enemy releases the surplus as a burst of mana. This happens once per fight.
This is a stealth and restoration effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and restoration effect.

animate.name: Kindled Servants
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When a summon or construct the holder controls expires, it returns a portion of its unspent mana to the holder.
Only the holder's own creations return mana, and a servant destroyed by an enemy returns only a trace.
This is an animation and restoration effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and restoration effect.

anzu.name: Thieving Gale
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder strikes an enemy that has just cast a spell, it snatches a portion of that spell's mana as restoration.
This can happen against each enemy once every few seconds.
This is a storm and restoration effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and restoration effect.

ape.name: Knuckled Surge
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder lands a melee hit, its next tick of mana regeneration is strengthened.
This triggers once every few seconds and does not stack with itself.
This is a momentum and restoration effect.
ape.tag: This is a momentum and restoration effect.

armour.name: Mail-Clad Spring
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
A portion of the damage the holder's armour absorbs is turned into mana.
The mana gained this way is capped over any short window, so a flurry of blows yields no more than a steady trickle.
This is a defensive and restoration effect.
armour.tag: This is a defensive and restoration effect.

arsenal.name: Varied Kit
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Each time the holder follows an attack with a spell, or a spell with a special ability, it restores a small amount of mana.
Repeating the same kind of action breaks the chain, and the restoration has a short cooldown.
This is a mastery and restoration effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a mastery and restoration effect.

aspect.name: Mirrored Mien
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When an ally near the holder uses a restoration effect, the holder takes on its aspect and gains a slight mana regeneration for a short time.
The holder can carry only a single borrowed aspect at a time.
This is a support and transformation effect.
aspect.tag: This is a support and transformation effect.

avatar.name: Avatar's Tide
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Once per fight, when the holder's mana runs low, it becomes a living conduit of its own magic and its mana regeneration surges for a short time.
While the surge lasts, the holder's spells deal slightly less damage.
This is a transformation and restoration effect.
avatar.tag: This is a transformation and restoration effect.

axe.name: Felling Harvest
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Each enemy struck by a single sweeping attack from the holder restores a little mana.
The mana gained from any single swing is capped, and only sweeping or cleaving attacks count.
This is a harvest and restoration effect.
axe.tag: This is a harvest and restoration effect.

balance.name: Scales of Mana
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While the holder's mana sits well below its health, its mana regeneration is strengthened.
The bonus applies only while the gap is wide, and it ends the moment the holder's mana catches up.
This is a balance and restoration effect.
balance.tag: This is a balance and restoration effect.

bat.name: Dusk Sipper
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder's hits drain a trickle of mana from enemies that have mana, and a little more while the holder stands in darkness.
Each enemy can be drained only once every few seconds.
This is a shadow and restoration effect.
bat.tag: This is a shadow and restoration effect.

battlefield.name: Fallen Wellspring
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When an enemy falls near the holder, the ground where it fell becomes a mana well for a short time, restoring mana to allies who stand on it.
Only a single well exists at a time, and a new one replaces the old.
This is an area and restoration effect.
battlefield.tag: This is an area and restoration effect.

bear.name: Slumbering Store
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While the holder goes without casting a spell, its mana regeneration grows steadily stronger.
Casting any spell resets the build-up.
This is a restoration effect.
bear.tag: This is a restoration effect.

bee.name: Nectar Sharing
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Each time the holder restores mana, allies close beside it receive a small portion as well.
The shared portion is small and reaches only allies within a short distance.
This is a swarm and support effect.
bee.tag: This is a swarm and support effect.

behemoth.name: Titan's Toll
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When a large enemy strikes the holder, it gains a burst of mana regeneration for a short time.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and restoration effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a defensive and restoration effect.

bird.name: Feathered Lift
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder dodges an attack, its mana regeneration lifts for a short time.
This has a short cooldown and does not trigger from attacks that simply miss.
This is an evasion and restoration effect.
bird.tag: This is an evasion and restoration effect.

blight.name: Blightrot Tithe
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Enemies suffering the holder's damage-over-time effects yield a trickle of mana to the holder as those effects tick.
Only the holder's own afflictions count, and the total yield is capped across all afflicted enemies.
This is an affliction and restoration effect.
blight.tag: This is an affliction and restoration effect.

blood.name: Bloodwell Rite
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder's mana runs low, it can turn a portion of its own health into mana.
Afterwards, its mana restoration effects are stronger for a short time. The rite has a long cooldown and will not take the holder below half health.
This is a blood and restoration effect.
blood.tag: This is a blood and restoration effect.

bone.name: Marrow Cache
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Mana the holder restores past full is stored in its bones as a small reserve, released automatically when its mana runs low.
The reserve holds only a small amount and empties at the end of each fight.
This is a necromantic and restoration effect.
bone.tag: This is a necromantic and restoration effect.

boundary.name: Bounded Spring
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While the holder stands inside a barrier or warding area created by the party, its mana regeneration is strengthened.
Leaving the area ends the bonus after a short time.
This is a warding and restoration effect.
boundary.tag: This is a warding and restoration effect.

bounty.name: Bounty's Tithe
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder defeats an enemy, it restores mana scaled to that enemy's rank.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a harvest and restoration effect.
bounty.tag: This is a harvest and restoration effect.

bow.name: Fletcher's Breath
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While the holder draws a ranged attack, its mana regeneration quickens.
Releasing a fully drawn shot restores a small burst of mana. The burst has a short cooldown.
This is a hunting and restoration effect.
bow.tag: This is a hunting and restoration effect.

brush.name: Brushstroke Spring
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Each time the holder restores mana, it leaves a glowing brushstroke on the ground. An ally who crosses the stroke regains a trace of mana.
Each stroke can be claimed by a single ally and fades after a short time.
This is an area and support effect.
brush.tag: This is an area and support effect.

cage.name: Cagebound Draw
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While an enemy is held by a restraint the holder created, the holder draws a slow stream of mana from it.
Only a single caged enemy feeds the holder at a time.
This is a binding and restoration effect.
cage.tag: This is a binding and restoration effect.

cat.name: Spare Life
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The first time each fight the holder's mana is fully drained, it instantly recovers a portion of its mana.
This happens once per fight.
This is a rebirth and restoration effect.
cat.tag: This is a rebirth and restoration effect.

cataclysm.name: Ruinous Return
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder's costliest ability strikes a crowd of enemies, a portion of the mana spent on it flows back over a short time.
This applies only to that ability and only once per its cooldown.
This is an annihilation and restoration effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an annihilation and restoration effect.

cattle.name: Grazing Herd
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While the holder stands close to several allies, its mana regeneration is strengthened.
The bonus fades when the party spreads out.
This is a support and restoration effect.
cattle.tag: This is a support and restoration effect.

chain.name: Chainspark Rebate
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder's ability jumps from enemy to enemy, each jump restores a small amount of mana.
The mana gained from a single chain is capped, and a jump onto an enemy already struck by that chain yields nothing.
This is a lightning and restoration effect.
chain.tag: This is a lightning and restoration effect.

chaotic.name: Wild Influx
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Each time the holder casts a spell, there is a small chance that the spell's mana cost is refunded in full.
The chance resets to nothing for a short time after it triggers.
This is a chaos and restoration effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a chaos and restoration effect.

charlatan.name: Counterfeit Coffer
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When an enemy dispels or drains the holder, the holder's false reserve absorbs part of the loss and returns it as mana a moment later.
This has a long cooldown and returns only a portion of what was taken.
This is a trickery and restoration effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a trickery and restoration effect.

chicken.name: Fretful Pecking
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While the holder is retreating from an enemy, its mana regeneration quickens.
The bonus lasts only a short time after the holder starts backing away and has a short cooldown.
This is a movement and restoration effect.
chicken.tag: This is a movement and restoration effect.

chimera.name: Grafted Founts
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Each different school of magic the holder casts in a fight grafts a slight boost onto its mana regeneration for the rest of that fight.
The boost from each school applies once, and the total is capped by rank.
This is a transformation and restoration effect.
chimera.tag: This is a transformation and restoration effect.

claw.name: Rending Draw
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder's attack opens a bleeding wound, the wound feeds the holder a trickle of mana while it bleeds.
Only a single bleeding enemy feeds the holder at a time.
This is a hunting and restoration effect.
claw.tag: This is a hunting and restoration effect.

cloth.name: Mana-Soaked Robes
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder's robes soak up stray mana from spells cast near it, storing a small reserve that seeps back as regeneration.
The reserve fills slowly and holds only a small amount.
This is a protection and restoration effect.
cloth.tag: This is a protection and restoration effect.

cloud.name: Raincloud Halo
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder restores its mana from a potion or ability, a soft cloud gathers over it and drizzles mana onto allies beneath it for a short time.
The cloud stays over the holder and has a long cooldown.
This is a water and support effect.
cloud.tag: This is a water and support effect.

cold.name: Still Frost Mind
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder slows or chills an enemy, the stillness steadies its own mind and its mana regeneration strengthens for a short time.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a cold and restoration effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and restoration effect.

coral.name: Reefbuilt Store
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Mana the holder regenerates while at full builds into a slowly growing reef of stored mana.
The reef releases its mana when the holder casts its next spell, and it cannot grow past a small cap.
This is a growth and restoration effect.
coral.tag: This is a growth and restoration effect.

corrupt.name: Tainted Siphon
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder curses an enemy, the curse siphons a portion of that enemy's mana to the holder over its duration.
The holder's mana restoration from other sources is slightly weaker while a siphon is running.
This is a curse and restoration effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a curse and restoration effect.

crocodile.name: Basking Jaws
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder holds still for a moment, its mana regeneration warms and strengthens.
The bonus ends as soon as the holder moves, and its next attack after basking restores a small burst of mana.
This is a hunting and restoration effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a hunting and restoration effect.

crystal.name: Prism Capacitor
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Mana restored to the holder while it is already full is held in a crystal that the holder can spend on its next spell's cost.
The crystal holds only a small amount and shatters if the holder takes a heavy hit.
This is a resonance and restoration effect.
crystal.tag: This is a resonance and restoration effect.

cycle.name: Crestcast Rebate
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder's mana regeneration rises and falls in a slow rhythm, and spells cast at the crest of each cycle refund a portion of their cost.
At the low point of each cycle, the holder's regeneration dips slightly.
This is a time and restoration effect.
cycle.tag: This is a time and restoration effect.

dance.name: Measured Steps
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Each time the holder moves between attacks without stopping, it gains a small stacking boost to mana regeneration.
The stacks are capped and vanish if the holder stands still for a moment.
This is a movement and restoration effect.
dance.tag: This is a movement and restoration effect.

dark.name: Umbral Wellspring
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While the holder stands in shadow or darkness, its mana regeneration is strengthened.
The bonus ends a short time after the holder steps into light.
This is a darkness and restoration effect.
dark.tag: This is a darkness and restoration effect.

dawn.name: First Light Flow
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
At the start of each fight, the holder and nearby allies gain a burst of mana regeneration for a short time.
This happens once per fight and only for allies close to the holder when the fight begins.
This is a light and support effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and support effect.

death.name: Last Breath Toll
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When an enemy dies near the holder, the holder draws in a portion of the mana left in it.
This can trigger once every few seconds, and enemies without mana yield nothing.
This is a death and restoration effect.
death.tag: This is a death and restoration effect.

deep.name: Benthic Mana Reserve
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder's maximum mana gains a deep reserve that only mana restoration effects can fill.
The reserve is spent last, refills slowly, and empties at the end of each fight.
This is a restoration effect.
deep.tag: This is a restoration effect.

deer.name: Hart's Calm
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While no enemy is targeting the holder, its mana regeneration is strengthened.
The bonus ends the moment an enemy turns on the holder and returns only after a short time.
This is an evasion and restoration effect.
deer.tag: This is an evasion and restoration effect.

desolate.name: Barren Thirst
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The emptier the holder's mana pool, the stronger its mana regeneration becomes.
The holder's mana regeneration is slightly weaker while its pool is close to full.
This is a restoration effect.
desolate.tag: This is a restoration effect.

dimension.name: Pocket Overflow
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Mana restored to the holder past full is folded away into a pocket space and returned when its mana falls low.
The pocket holds only a small amount and is cleared at the end of each fight.
This is a dimensional and restoration effect.
dimension.tag: This is a dimensional and restoration effect.

discord.name: Jarring Refund
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder interrupts an enemy's spell, it restores a portion of mana.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a sound and restoration effect.
discord.tag: This is a sound and restoration effect.

discordant.name: Clashing Chords
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When enemies near the holder are confused or disoriented, each one leaks a trickle of mana to the holder.
The total trickle is capped, and only lasts while the disorientation holds.
This is a sound and restoration effect.
discordant.tag: This is a sound and restoration effect.

dog.name: Loyal Fetch
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When an ally near the holder runs low on mana, the holder's own mana regeneration spills over to that ally for a short time.
The spillover has a cooldown and slightly weakens the holder's regeneration while it flows.
This is a support and restoration effect.
dog.tag: This is a support and restoration effect.

doom.name: Fated Toll
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder marks an enemy it attacks. If the marked enemy dies within a short time, the holder recovers a large portion of mana.
Only a single enemy can be marked at a time, and the mark has a cooldown.
This is a curse and restoration effect.
doom.tag: This is a curse and restoration effect.

doppelganger.name: Twinned Font
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When an ally near the holder is restored mana, the holder receives a faint copy of that restoration.
The copy is small and can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a support and transformation effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a support and transformation effect.

dragon.name: Brimming Roar
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder's mana regenerates to full during a fight, it lets out a roar that restores a portion of mana to allies nearby.
The roar has a long cooldown and reaches only allies within a short distance.
This is a sound and support effect.
dragon.tag: This is a sound and support effect.

duck.name: Shedding Rain
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While the holder stands in water or rain, its mana regeneration is strengthened.
The bonus fades a short time after the holder leaves the water.
This is a water and restoration effect.
duck.tag: This is a water and restoration effect.

dust.name: Dustmote Gleaning
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder kicks up a cloud of dust or blinds an enemy, the dust settles into motes of mana that the holder gathers over a short time.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a harvest and restoration effect.
dust.tag: This is a harvest and restoration effect.

earth.name: Rooted Draw
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While the holder stands its ground without being moved, it draws mana up from the earth and its regeneration strengthens.
Being knocked back or moving ends the bonus.
This is a nature and restoration effect.
earth.tag: This is a nature and restoration effect.

echo.name: Returning Echo
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Each time the holder is restored mana, a faint echo of that restoration repeats a moment later.
The echo is only a small portion of the original and cannot itself echo.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
echo.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

eclipse.name: Shadowed Corona
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder casts a light spell followed by a shadow spell, or the reverse, it restores a portion of mana.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a light and darkness effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a light and darkness effect.

edifice.name: Mana Cistern
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Once per fight, when the holder casts a barrier or wall, a mana cistern rises with it and restores mana to allies standing close to it for a short time.
The cistern crumbles when the barrier falls.
This is a barrier and support effect.
edifice.tag: This is a barrier and support effect.

effigy.name: Votive Figure
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Once per fight, when the holder's mana runs low, it sets down a small effigy that pulses mana to the holder and nearby allies for a short time.
Enemies can destroy the effigy to end the effect early.
This is a conjuration and support effect.
effigy.tag: This is a conjuration and support effect.

elemental.name: Attuned Elements
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder strikes an enemy with an element it is weak to, the holder restores a small amount of mana.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is an elemental and restoration effect.
elemental.tag: This is an elemental and restoration effect.

elixir.name: Deep Draught
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Mana potions the holder drinks restore a further portion of mana over a short time after the initial surge.
