lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While the holder stands in sunlight, its mana regeneration is strengthened, and allies near it gain a smaller share.
The bonus fades in shade or at night.
This is a light and support effect.
sun.tag: This is a light and support effect.

swarm.name: Hive Current
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
For each summoned creature the holder controls, its mana regeneration is slightly strengthened.
The bonus is capped and fades when summons are lost.
This is a swarm and restoration effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and restoration effect.

swift.name: Fleeting Spark
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder acts quickly after casting a spell, it regains a small portion of that spell's cost.
This has a short cooldown and only applies if the next action comes almost at once.
This is a haste and restoration effect.
swift.tag: This is a haste and restoration effect.

sword.name: Duellist's Draught
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder parries an attack, it regains a small amount of mana.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and restoration effect.
sword.tag: This is a defensive and restoration effect.

talisman.name: Charmed Token
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder carries a runic token that stores a little of its regenerated mana. When the holder's mana runs low, the token releases what it holds.
The token holds only a small amount and recharges slowly.
This is a warding and restoration effect.
talisman.tag: This is a warding and restoration effect.

tentacle.name: Clinging Draw
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder seizes an enemy, it draws mana from that enemy while it holds on.
Only a single enemy can be held at a time.
This is a binding and restoration effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a binding and restoration effect.

thread.name: Silver Thread
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder ties a thread of mana to an ally, and they share a portion of their mana regeneration.
The thread breaks if the ally moves too far away, and it can be retied after a short time.
This is a binding and support effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and support effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderclap Gift
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder's lightning strikes an enemy, a clap of thunder restores a little mana to allies nearby.
This has a cooldown.
This is a lightning and support effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a lightning and support effect.

time.name: Rewound Reserve
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Once per fight, when the holder's mana runs low, it rewinds a portion of its mana to where it stood a short time ago.
The rewind cannot restore more than a portion of the holder's pool.
This is a time and restoration effect.
time.tag: This is a time and restoration effect.

tranquil.name: Tranquil Aura Spring
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While the holder is not attacking, allies near it regenerate mana slightly faster.
The bonus ends when the holder attacks, and returns a short time after.
This is a support and restoration effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a support and restoration effect.

transfiguration.name: Shifting Font
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder takes on a transformation or changes form, it gains a burst of mana.
This has a cooldown.
This is a transformation and restoration effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a transformation and restoration effect.

transgression.name: Trespass Toll
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When an enemy breaks one of the holder's wards or barriers, the holder takes a portion of that enemy's mana in recompense.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a warding and restoration effect.
transgression.tag: This is a warding and restoration effect.

trap.name: Sprung Cache
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When an enemy triggers one of the holder's traps, the trap releases a cache of mana to the holder.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a restoration effect.
trap.tag: This is a restoration effect.

tree.name: Taproot Draw
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While the holder stays near the same spot, it puts down roots and draws mana from the earth.
The bonus builds slowly and ends when the holder moves far.
This is a nature and restoration effect.
tree.tag: This is a nature and restoration effect.

troll.name: Regrowing Font
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder's mana regeneration is strengthened while its health is regenerating.
The bonus ends when the holder takes fire damage, and returns a short time later.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
troll.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

trowel.name: Mortared Reserve
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder raises a wall or barrier, a small amount of mana is set into its foundation and returns to the holder when the barrier falls.
Only a single barrier can hold mana at a time.
This is a barrier and restoration effect.
trowel.tag: This is a barrier and restoration effect.

turtle.name: Tortoise Mana Stance
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder takes a defensive stance, its mana regeneration is strengthened while the stance holds.
The holder moves slowly while in the stance.
This is a defensive and restoration effect.
turtle.tag: This is a defensive and restoration effect.

twilight.name: Dusk Balance
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While the holder stands at the edge of light and shadow, its mana regeneration is strengthened.
The bonus ends when the holder moves fully into light or fully into shadow.
This is a light and darkness effect.
twilight.tag: This is a light and darkness effect.

undeath.name: Grave Draught
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When an undead ally or summon falls near the holder, the holder draws in a portion of the mana that animated it.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a necromantic and restoration effect.
undeath.tag: This is a necromantic and restoration effect.

unity.name: United Font
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When every ally near the holder is above half mana, the whole group regenerates mana slightly faster.
The bonus ends when any ally falls below half.
This is a support and restoration effect.
unity.tag: This is a support and restoration effect.

vast.name: Vast Overfill
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder's mana restoration effects can overfill its pool slightly, holding the excess for a short time.
The excess fades quickly if it is not spent.
This is a restoration effect.
vast.tag: This is a restoration effect.

vehicle.name: Laden Wagon
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder carries a store of spare mana that it can share with allies who run low.
The store fills slowly and holds only a small amount.
This is a support and restoration effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a support and restoration effect.

venom.name: Toxic Tithe
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder's venom stacks on an enemy, each stack draws a small portion of that enemy's mana to the holder.
The total gained is capped across all enemies.
This is a poison and restoration effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and restoration effect.

verdant.name: Leafy Font
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder casts a nature spell, the ground around it sprouts with growth that restores a little mana to allies nearby.
This has a cooldown.
This is a nature and support effect.
verdant.tag: This is a nature and support effect.

vessel.name: Deepened Vessel
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder's maximum mana is slightly larger, and mana restoration effects fill the larger pool fully.
The extra capacity empties first when the holder casts spells.
This is a restoration effect.
vessel.tag: This is a restoration effect.

visage.name: Masquer's Rebate
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder disguises itself or changes its appearance, it regains a little mana.
This has a cooldown.
This is a transformation and restoration effect.
visage.tag: This is a transformation and restoration effect.

vision.name: Foresight Well
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder senses when an ally is about to run low on mana and pre-emptively passes them a small amount.
This has a cooldown.
This is a precognition and support effect.
vision.tag: This is a precognition and support effect.

void.name: Hollow Draw
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder dispels an enemy's magic, it draws a portion of the dispelled mana into itself.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a darkness and restoration effect.
void.tag: This is a darkness and restoration effect.

volcano.name: Molten Font
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder casts a fire or earth spell, a portion of the mana it spent wells back up over a short time.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a fire and restoration effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and restoration effect.

vortex.name: Spiralling Draw
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder pulls enemies together, it draws a little mana from each enemy pulled.
The total gained from a single pull is capped.
This is a wind and restoration effect.
vortex.tag: This is a wind and restoration effect.

wasp.name: Barbed Sip
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder's stinging attacks draw a small sip of mana from each enemy struck.
This can trigger once every few seconds per enemy.
This is a poison and restoration effect.
wasp.tag: This is a poison and restoration effect.

water.name: Brookshare Spring
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder's mana regeneration flows into allies near it, restoring a little mana to them as well.
The amount shared is small and reaches only allies close by.
This is a water and support effect.
water.tag: This is a water and support effect.

weave.name: Woven Mana
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder weaves stray mana from spells cast near it into a reserve it can draw on.
The reserve fills slowly and holds only a small amount.
This is a mastery and restoration effect.
weave.tag: This is a mastery and restoration effect.

wendigo.name: Wendigo Frostdrain
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder chills an enemy, it draws a portion of that enemy's mana.
The holder's own mana regeneration is slightly slower while the chill lasts.
This is a cold and hunger effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and hunger effect.

whale.name: Great Lungful
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder takes a deep breath once per fight, restoring a large portion of its mana over a short time.
The holder cannot cast spells while drawing the breath.
This is a restoration effect.
whale.tag: This is a restoration effect.

wheel.name: Full Rotation Rebate
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Each time the holder completes a full rotation of its abilities, it regains a portion of mana.
This has a cooldown.
This is a momentum and restoration effect.
wheel.tag: This is a momentum and restoration effect.

whip.name: Lashtip Siphon
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder lashes an enemy at the edge of its reach, it draws a little mana back along the lash.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a restraint and restoration effect.
whip.tag: This is a restraint and restoration effect.

wind.name: Breezeborne Mana
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While the holder moves with haste, its mana regeneration is strengthened.
The bonus ends when the haste ends.
This is a wind and restoration effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and restoration effect.

wing.name: Wingshade Mana Share
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder shields an ally, it shares a portion of its mana regeneration with that ally for a short time.
This has a cooldown.
This is a protection and support effect.
wing.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

wolf.name: Pack Wellspring
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
For each ally fighting the same enemy as the holder, its mana regeneration is slightly strengthened.
The bonus is capped.
This is a hunting and support effect.
wolf.tag: This is a hunting and support effect.

wood.name: Heartwood Reserve
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
The holder stores a small amount of mana in its heartwood, releasing it automatically when its mana runs low.
The reserve refills slowly and holds only a small amount.
This is a nature and restoration effect.
wood.tag: This is a nature and restoration effect.

wrath.name: Fury Fuel
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
When the holder takes damage, a portion of it fuels its mana regeneration for a short time.
The bonus is capped and fades quickly.
This is a restoration effect.
wrath.tag: This is a restoration effect.

zeal.name: Fervent Spark
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
While the holder attacks without pause, each strike restores a trace of mana.
The bonus ends a moment after the holder stops attacking.
This is a momentum and restoration effect.
zeal.tag: This is a momentum and restoration effect.

ziz.name: Sky-Shadow Bounty
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Runic] ability [Mana Beacon]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mana Beacon].
Once per fight, the holder's runes blaze and every ally within a wide radius regenerates mana strongly for a short time.
The holder's own mana regeneration is paused while the blaze lasts.
This is a support and restoration effect.
ziz.tag: This is a support and restoration effect.

action.name: Pounce Reflex
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
When an enemy comes within reach, the holder can lunge at it with a powerful strike that skips its usual wind-up, its damage scaling with Power.
This costs stamina and can happen once every few seconds.
This is a momentum and haste effect.
action.tag: This is a momentum and haste effect.

adept.name: Drilled Might
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
Each time the holder lands a heavy hit with the same weapon, its grip settles and its Power rises slightly for the rest of the fight.
The bonus stacks a few times and resets if the holder changes weapons.
This is a mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Pride Tonic
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
When the holder drinks a potion, it roars and the draught surges into its muscles, raising its Power for a short time.
Allies near the holder when it drinks gain a small share of the bonus. This can happen once per fight for each kind of potion.
This is an alchemy and support effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and support effect.

ambush.name: Tall Grass Strike
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
The holder's first attack against an enemy that has not yet noticed it deals extra damage scaling with Power and knocks the target down.
This works once per enemy each fight.
This is a stealth and hunting effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and hunting effect.

animate.name: Roused Ancestors
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
Once per fight, when the holder is badly wounded, the shade of a Leonid forebear rises beside it and fights for a short time, striking with a share of the holder's Power.
The shade vanishes early if the holder is knocked down.
This is an animation and summoning effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and summoning effect.

anzu.name: Thunderous Roar
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
When the holder lands a heavy hit, a crack of thunder rolls out from the blow, dealing lightning damage scaling with Power to enemies close by.
This can happen once every few seconds and costs a little mana.
This is a lightning and storm effect.
anzu.tag: This is a lightning and storm effect.

ape.name: Mountain Shoulders
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
The holder can seize a staggered enemy and hurl it into its allies, damaging the thrown enemy and those it strikes based on the holder's Power.
This costs stamina and has a cooldown. Very large enemies cannot be thrown.
This is a momentum and restraint effect.
ape.tag: This is a momentum and restraint effect.

armour.name: Mane of Mail
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
The holder's Power adds slightly to its armour while it wears heavy armour.
When a blow is blocked by that armour, the holder's next attack hits harder. This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
armour.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

arsenal.name: Weapon Rack Pride
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
Each different weapon type the holder strikes with during a fight raises its Power slightly for the rest of that fight.
The bonus stacks a few times and is lost when the fight ends.
This is a mastery effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a mastery effect.

aspect.name: Lion Aspect
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
Once per fight, when the holder is badly wounded, it takes on the spectral shape of a great lion, raising its Power and making its attacks cleave nearby enemies for a short time.
While the shape lasts the holder cannot use its spells.
This is a transformation effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation effect.

avatar.name: Ancestral Avatar
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
Once per fight, the holder calls on the strength of its whole line, growing larger and gaining a large boost to Power and resistance to being moved for a short time.
When the effect ends the holder is weakened for a short time.
This is a transformation and mastery effect.
avatar.tag: This is a transformation and mastery effect.

axe.name: Felling Blow
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
The holder's heavy chopping attacks deal extra damage scaling with Power against enemies with armour or shields, and wear that armour down for a short time.
This can happen once every few seconds against the same enemy.
This is an annihilation effect.
axe.tag: This is an annihilation effect.

balance.name: Fulcrum Footing
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
While the holder stands its ground without moving, its Power rises slightly and it resists being knocked down or pushed.
The bonus fades a short time after the holder moves.
This is a defensive and balance effect.
balance.tag: This is a defensive and balance effect.

bat.name: Night Prowler
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
While fighting in darkness or deep shadow, the holder's Power rises slightly and its heavy hits drain a little health back to it.
The drain can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a darkness and perception effect.
bat.tag: This is a darkness and perception effect.

battlefield.name: Field Marshal
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
While the holder fights in the front line closest to the enemy, allies behind it gain a small share of its Power.
The aura ends whenever the holder falls back or is knocked down, and returns after a short time.
This is a support and command effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a support and command effect.

bear.name: Grappling Bulk
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
The holder can wrap a nearby enemy in a crushing hold, pinning it and dealing damage scaling with Power for a short time.
This costs stamina while it lasts and has a cooldown. The holder cannot attack others during the hold.
This is a restraint and binding effect.
bear.tag: This is a restraint and binding effect.

bee.name: Swarming Pride
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
Each ally attacking the same enemy as the holder raises the holder's Power slightly against that enemy.
The bonus lasts while the allies keep attacking and is lost when the target falls.
This is a swarm and support effect.
bee.tag: This is a swarm and support effect.

behemoth.name: Colossal Frame
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
The holder's Power adds slightly to its maximum health, and it cannot be knocked down by enemies smaller than itself.
The holder moves slightly slower while it wields a heavy weapon.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

bird.name: Leaping Pounce
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
The holder can bound across a short distance onto an enemy, landing with a strike whose damage scales with Power.
This costs stamina and has a cooldown.
This is a movement and momentum effect.
bird.tag: This is a movement and momentum effect.

blight.name: Wasting Grip
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
The holder's heavy hits leave a rotting blight that slowly weakens the target's strength and deals damage scaling with Power over a short time.
The blight can affect each enemy only once at a time.
This is an affliction and poison effect.
blight.tag: This is an affliction and poison effect.

blood.name: Lineage Blood
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
While the holder is wounded, its Power rises in step with the health it has lost.
Each heavy hit it lands while wounded makes the target bleed for a short time. The holder takes slightly more damage while the effect is strongest.
This is a blood and affliction effect.
blood.tag: This is a blood and affliction effect.

bone.name: Marrow Might
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
The holder's heavy hits can break an enemy's bones, slowing its attacks and movement for a short time.
This can happen once every few seconds against the same enemy.
This is an affliction and restraint effect.
bone.tag: This is an affliction and restraint effect.

boundary.name: Pride Ground
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
Once per fight, the holder roars and claims the ground around it as pride territory. Allies inside gain a small share of its Power and enemies who cross the edge are slowed.
The territory lasts a short time and ends if the holder leaves it.
This is a warding and area effect.

volcano.tag: This is a fire and burn effect.

wasp.name: Waspsting Jabs
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.

The holder's quick strikes sting, dealing a little extra damage scaling with Power.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a poison effect.

water.name: Crashing Wave
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Strength].
The holder's heavy hits release a wave that knocks enemies close by back.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a water effect.
water.tag: This is a water effect.

This is a binding and support effect.
weave.tag: This is a binding and support effect.

wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.

Each enemy the holder fells feeds its hunger, raising its Power for a short time.

This is a hunger and cold effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a hunger and cold effect.

whip.name: Whiplash Tail
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Whip essence.

This is a momentum effect.
wrath.tag: This is a momentum effect.

zeal.name: Zealous Heart
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.

This is a support effect.
zeal.tag: This is a support effect.

ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Strength]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.

ziz.tag: This is a sound and wind effect.

This is a haste and momentum effect.

This is a haste and mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a haste and mastery effect.

This is an alchemy and haste effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and haste effect.

This is a stealth and hunting effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and hunting effect.

This is an animation and haste effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and haste effect.

This is a storm and lightning effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and lightning effect.

ape.name: Wall-Vault Bound
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Ape essence.

This can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a movement and momentum effect.
ape.tag: This is a movement and momentum effect.

armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Armour essence.

Armour worn by the holder does not reduce its Speed.
Each time the holder is struck while moving, its armour hardens briefly at the cost of some stamina.
This is a defensive and movement effect.
armour.tag: This is a defensive and movement effect.

arsenal.name: Swift Rotation
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].

This can trigger only once every few seconds.
This is a haste and mastery effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a haste and mastery effect.

aspect.name: Great Lion Aspect
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
Once per fight, when its health falls low, the holder takes on the aspect of a great lion for a short time, gaining a large burst of Speed and heavier pounces.
When the aspect ends, the holder is briefly slowed.
This is a transformation and haste effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation and haste effect.

avatar.name: Pride Avatar
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.

Allies near the holder share a portion of its Speed bonus.
The aura lapses for a short time whenever the holder is stunned.
This is a support and haste effect.
avatar.tag: This is a support and haste effect.

axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Axe essence.

This is a momentum and area effect.
axe.tag: This is a momentum and area effect.

balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Balance essence.

This is a defensive and movement effect.
balance.tag: This is a defensive and movement effect.

bat.name: Echo Swerve
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Bat essence.

bat.tag: This is an evasion and perception effect.

battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.

The bonus fades quickly once the enemies thin out.
This is a momentum and perception effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a momentum and perception effect.

bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder charges into an enemy at full Speed, the impact knocks the enemy back.
This costs stamina and can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a momentum effect.
bear.tag: This is a momentum effect.

bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
Each time an ally near the holder strikes the enemy it is attacking, the holder's Speed rises slightly for a short time, stacking a few times.

bee.tag: This is a swarm and haste effect.

lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].

This is a momentum and area effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a momentum and area effect.

It can leap this way only every few seconds.

bird.tag: This is a movement and wind effect.

blight.tag: This is an affliction and movement effect.

blood.tag: This is a blood and haste effect.

cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.

The chain breaks if the holder goes a short time without a kill.

This is an evasion and movement effect.
chicken.tag: This is an evasion and movement effect.

cloth.tag: This is a defensive and movement effect.
