scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder dashes, it writes a script of light along the path, and allies who follow the path move faster for a short time.
The script costs mana and fades after a short time.
This is a support and travel effect.
scribe.tag: This is a support and travel effect.

serene.name: Unhurried Grace
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
While the holder is calm and unhurt, its movements become effortless and its stamina drains more slowly.
The serenity breaks for a short time when the holder takes damage.
This is a restoration and movement effect.
serene.tag: This is a restoration and movement effect.

serpent.name: Viper Snap Lunge
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
After standing still for a moment, the holder strikes with lightning speed, crossing a short distance and poisoning its target.
The strike needs a brief pause before it can be repeated.
This is a poison and hunting effect.
serpent.tag: This is a poison and hunting effect.

shark.name: Shark Bloodscent Rush
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
The holder senses bleeding enemies nearby, and its Speed rises further while it moves toward them.
The bonus fades when no bleeding enemies are near.
This is a hunting and tracking effect.
shark.tag: This is a hunting and tracking effect.

shield.name: Aegis Vanguard Rush
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
While the holder charges, a shimmering shield forms in front of it and blocks the first attack it meets.
The shield costs mana and has a cooldown.
This is a shield and protection effect.
shield.tag: This is a shield and protection effect.

shimmer.name: Glimmering Stride
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
While the holder moves at full Speed, it shimmers in and out of sight, and enemies lose track of it for a moment after each dash.
This costs mana and has a cooldown.
This is a stealth and evasion effect.
shimmer.tag: This is a stealth and evasion effect.

ship.name: Deckhand Footing
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
The holder keeps its footing on unstable, shaking or slippery ground and loses no Speed crossing it.
Allies close behind the holder share this footing, though the effect costs stamina to extend to them.
This is a travel and support effect.
ship.tag: This is a travel and support effect.

shovel.name: Burrowing Lunge
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder dashes, it digs its claws into the ground and flings earth ahead that staggers the enemy it is charging.
The flung earth costs stamina and has a cooldown.
This is an earth and momentum effect.
shovel.tag: This is an earth and momentum effect.

sickle.name: Sickle Hamstring Sweep
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder runs past enemies, it cuts them with a curved sweep that hooks their legs and slows them.
Each enemy can be slowed this way only once in a while.
This is a harvest and restraint effect.
sickle.tag: This is a harvest and restraint effect.

simulacrum.name: Living Likeness
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
Once in a while, when the holder dashes away, a lifelike copy stays behind and fights for a short time with a portion of its strength.
The copy shatters when struck hard, and a new copy replaces any copy still standing.
This is a conjuration and evasion effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a conjuration and evasion effect.

sin.name: Guilty Haste
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder strikes an enemy from behind or while it is helpless, its Speed surges for a short time.
Each surge leaves the holder slightly more vulnerable for a moment afterward.
This is a shadow and haste effect.
sin.tag: This is a shadow and haste effect.

skirmish.name: Skirmisher's Dance
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
After each hit the holder lands, it darts back a short way out of reach, ready to strike again.
The dart back costs stamina and can happen only every few seconds.
This is an evasion and momentum effect.
skirmish.tag: This is an evasion and momentum effect.

skunk.name: Reeking Retreat
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder dashes away from an enemy, it leaves a foul cloud that sickens and slows pursuers.
The cloud fades after a short time and has a cooldown.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
skunk.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

sky.name: Open-Sky Bound
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
Under an open sky, the holder's leaps carry it high and far, and it lands without recovery.
Each high leap costs stamina, and the effect is lost indoors and underground.
This is a wind and movement effect.
sky.tag: This is a wind and movement effect.

sloth.name: Languid Burst
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
While the holder rests unmoving, it stores up energy, and its next movement releases it as a large burst of Speed.
Storing energy needs a short time of stillness, and moving at all releases it.
This is a haste and momentum effect.
sloth.tag: This is a haste and momentum effect.

smoke.name: Smokeveil Dash
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder dashes, it trails a plume of smoke that hides allies inside it from enemy sight.
The smoke costs mana and drifts away after a short time.
This is a stealth and concealment effect.
smoke.tag: This is a stealth and concealment effect.

snake.name: Slithering Path
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
The holder weaves as it runs, and attacks aimed at it while it weaves are harder to land.
Weaving drains stamina while it lasts.
This is an evasion and movement effect.
snake.tag: This is an evasion and movement effect.

soaring.name: Updraught Spring
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder leaps, a rising wind lifts it over enemies and obstacles, and it comes down on the far side with a burst of Speed.
The lifting wind costs mana and has a cooldown.
This is a wind and movement effect.
soaring.tag: This is a wind and movement effect.

song.name: Hunting Chant
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
While the holder runs, it sings an old hunting chant of its people that hastens allies who can hear it.
The chant costs mana to sustain and stops if the holder is silenced or stunned.
This is a sound and support effect.
song.tag: This is a sound and support effect.

sovereign.name: Kingly Stride
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
Enemies of lower rank cannot slow or root the holder, and they hesitate when it charges at them.
The holder's dominion fades for a short time after it is struck by an enemy of higher rank.
This is a command and defensive effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a command and defensive effect.

spear.name: Skewering Pike Run
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder charges with a spear or polearm, its Speed lends the thrust extra reach and it pierces through the first enemy to strike another behind.
The piercing thrust costs stamina and has a cooldown.
This is a momentum and mastery effect.
spear.tag: This is a momentum and mastery effect.

spider.name: Silk Line Leap
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
The holder can cast a strand of silk to a point within a short distance and pull itself there swiftly.
Each strand costs mana and has a cooldown.
This is a movement and binding effect.
spider.tag: This is a movement and binding effect.

spike.name: Barbed Trail
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder dashes, it scatters spikes behind it that wound and slow enemies who step on them.
The spikes fade after a short time and can be scattered only every so often.
This is a restraint and area effect.
spike.tag: This is a restraint and area effect.

staff.name: Polevault Strike
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
The holder can plant a staff and vault over an enemy or obstacle, striking with the staff as it lands.
Each vault costs stamina and has a cooldown.
This is a movement and mastery effect.
staff.tag: This is a movement and mastery effect.

star.name: Falling Star Leap
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder leaps onto an enemy, it comes down in a streak of starlight that burns enemies close to where it lands.
The starlight costs mana and has a cooldown.
This is a light and radiant effect.
star.tag: This is a light and radiant effect.

stellar.name: Orbiting Pace
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
While the holder circles an enemy, motes of starlight orbit with it and strike that enemy at intervals.
The motes cost mana to sustain and scatter when the holder stops circling.
This is a light and movement effect.
stellar.tag: This is a light and movement effect.

storm.name: Tempest Runner
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
While the holder moves at full Speed, wind and lightning gather around it and strike nearby enemies at random.
The storm drains mana while active and dies down when the holder stops.
This is a storm and lightning effect.
storm.tag: This is a storm and lightning effect.

succubus.name: Enthralling Glide
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder darts past an enemy, the enemy is briefly charmed and fails to strike back.
Each enemy can be charmed this way only once in a while, and enemies of higher rank resist.
This is a charm and evasion effect.
succubus.tag: This is a charm and evasion effect.

sun.name: Solar Stride
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
In daylight, the holder's Speed rises further and its strikes after a dash burn with solar fire.
The solar strike can happen only every few seconds, and the bonus is lost in darkness.
This is a fire and light effect.
sun.tag: This is a fire and light effect.

swarm.name: Hunting Swarm
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder charges, a swarm of spectral insects bursts out ahead of it and harries the enemy it is charging.
The swarm costs mana and disperses after a short time.
This is a swarm and summoning effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and summoning effect.

swift.name: Fleetfoot Instinct
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
The holder's Speed rises further for a short time after each dodge, stacking a few times.
The stacks clear whenever the holder is struck.
This is a haste and evasion effect.
swift.tag: This is a haste and evasion effect.

sword.name: Passing Edge Cut
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder dashes past an enemy with a sword drawn, it delivers a swift cut on the way through.
The passing cut costs stamina and has a short cooldown.
This is a mastery and momentum effect.
sword.tag: This is a mastery and momentum effect.

talisman.name: Ancestor Charm
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
The holder carries the blessing of an ancestor, which hastens it and wards it from the first slowing effect each fight.
After the ward breaks, the blessing returns only once the holder has gone a short time unharmed.
This is a warding and haste effect.
talisman.tag: This is a warding and haste effect.

tentacle.name: Phantom Tentacle Snare
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When an enemy flees from the holder, spectral tentacles lash out and slow it.
The tentacles cost mana and have a cooldown.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

thread.name: Tethered Pace
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
The holder can tie a thread of light to an ally, and while the thread holds, both share the faster of their Speeds.
The thread costs mana to sustain and snaps if they move too far apart.
This is a binding and support effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and support effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunder Landing
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
Each time the holder lands from a leap, thunder cracks from the ground and dazes enemies close by.
The thunder costs mana and has a cooldown.
This is a storm and sound effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a storm and sound effect.

time.name: Stolen Moment
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
Once per fight, when the holder is badly wounded, time slows around it for a moment while it moves at full Speed.
When the moment ends, the holder is briefly slowed itself.
This is a time and haste effect.
time.tag: This is a time and haste effect.

tranquil.name: Quiet Steps
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
While the holder moves calmly, enemies close by grow drowsy and their attacks slow.
The calm breaks for a short time whenever the holder attacks or takes damage.
This is a support and affliction effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a support and affliction effect.

transfiguration.name: Running Lion Shape
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
Once per fight, the holder can shift into the lean shape of a running lion for a short time, gaining a large burst of Speed and pouncing attacks.
The holder cannot use its other abilities while transformed.
This is a transformation and haste effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a transformation and haste effect.

transgression.name: Trespasser's Dash
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
The holder can dash through enemy wards and barriers as though they were not there.
Each crossing costs a portion of its health and has a cooldown.
This is a warding and movement effect.
transgression.tag: This is a warding and movement effect.

trap.name: Snare Sprint
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder dashes away from an enemy, it leaves a hidden snare where it stood that roots the next enemy to step there.
A new snare replaces the old, and each fades after a short time.
This is a restraint and trap effect.
trap.tag: This is a restraint and trap effect.

tree.name: Deep-Rooted Spring
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder stands still, it draws strength from the ground, and its next movement carries a burst of Speed and a little healing.
Drawing strength needs a short time of stillness.
This is a nature and healing effect.
tree.tag: This is a nature and healing effect.

troll.name: Regenerating Gait
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
While the holder keeps moving, its wounds close slowly.
The regeneration stops for a short time when the holder takes fire or acid damage.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
troll.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

trowel.name: Mortared Footing
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder stops after a sprint, it smooths the ground beneath it into firm footing that allies can stand on without being knocked down.
The footing lasts a short time and costs stamina to lay.
This is a protection and support effect.
trowel.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

turtle.name: Shell Tuck
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder is about to take a heavy blow, it tucks in and braces, reducing the damage but losing its Speed bonus for a moment.
This has a cooldown.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
turtle.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

twilight.name: Dusklight Lope
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
At dusk, dawn or in dim light, the holder slips between light and shadow, and enemies struggle to target it.
The effect fades in full darkness or bright light.
This is a shadow and stealth effect.
twilight.tag: This is a shadow and stealth effect.

undeath.name: Grave Gallop
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder defeats an enemy, it can raise a spectral hound from the remains that runs alongside it for a short time.
A newly raised hound replaces the last, and raising it costs mana.
This is a necromantic and summoning effect.
undeath.tag: This is a necromantic and summoning effect.

unity.name: Pride Together
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
While allies are close to the holder, the whole party gains a little Speed for each ally present.
The bonus fades when the party scatters.
This is a support and haste effect.
unity.tag: This is a support and haste effect.

vast.name: Endless Plains
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
In wide, open spaces, the holder's Speed rises further and its stamina drains more slowly.
The bonus is lost in narrow halls and tight spaces.
This is a travel and movement effect.
vast.tag: This is a travel and movement effect.

vehicle.name: Running Start
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder has been moving for a short time, allies who run behind it are carried along in its slipstream and share its Speed.
The slipstream breaks if the holder stops or changes direction sharply.
This is a travel and support effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a travel and support effect.

venom.name: Venomous Pounce
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder lands an attack after a dash, it injects venom that slows the enemy for a short time.
This can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

verdant.name: Blooming Trail
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
The holder's path blooms with lush growth that hastens allies and entangles enemies who walk it.
The growth costs mana to sustain and withers after a short time.
This is a growth and nature effect.
verdant.tag: This is a growth and nature effect.

vessel.name: Brimming Vigour
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder's stamina is full, the excess is stored, and it can release the stored vigour as a burst of Speed when it most needs it.
The store holds a limited amount that scales with rank.
This is a restoration and haste effect.
vessel.tag: This is a restoration and haste effect.

visage.name: Snarling Visage
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder charges, its face takes on the snarl of a great lion, and enemies it charges at hesitate for a moment.
This costs mana and has a cooldown.
This is a fear and affliction effect.
visage.tag: This is a fear and affliction effect.

vision.name: Foreseen Path
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
The holder glimpses where enemies will strike, and its movements carry it clear of area attacks before they land.
This costs mana and can happen only every few seconds.
This is a precognition and evasion effect.
vision.tag: This is a precognition and evasion effect.

void.name: Null Step
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
The holder can step into the void for a moment, vanishing and reappearing a short distance away.
Each step costs mana and has a cooldown.
This is a darkness and travel effect.
void.tag: This is a darkness and travel effect.

volcano.name: Magma Charge
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder charges, the ground cracks behind it and spews lava that burns enemies who follow.
The lava cools after a short time and has a cooldown.
This is a fire and earth effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and earth effect.

vortex.name: Whirlwind Pivot
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder spins at the end of a dash, a vortex forms and pulls enemies close by toward it.
The vortex costs mana and has a cooldown.
This is a wind and area effect.
vortex.tag: This is a wind and area effect.

wasp.name: Hornet Dash Stings
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
The holder's attacks right after a dash strike in a quick flurry of stings that poison the enemy.
The flurry costs stamina and has a cooldown.
This is a poison and haste effect.
wasp.tag: This is a poison and haste effect.

water.name: Rivulet Deflection
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
The holder flows around attacks like water, and the first attack against it after a dash slides off for reduced damage.
This can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a water and evasion effect.
water.tag: This is a water and evasion effect.

weave.name: Crisscross Quickening
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder and an ally cross paths in a fight, both gain a brief burst of Speed.
The same pair cannot benefit again for a short time.
This is a support and haste effect.
weave.tag: This is a support and haste effect.

wendigo.name: Frostbitten Chase
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder runs low on stamina, it is driven by a ravenous hunger, gaining Speed and leaving a frost on enemies it strikes that drains their stamina.
The hunger lasts a short time and gnaws at the holder's health while active.
This is a frost and hunting effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a frost and hunting effect.

whale.name: Breaching Surge
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
Once per fight, the holder surges forward with tremendous weight, bowling over every enemy in its path.
After the surge the holder is winded for a moment.
This is a momentum and area effect.
whale.tag: This is a momentum and area effect.

wheel.name: Cartwheel Momentum
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
As long as the holder keeps moving in a fight, its Speed builds steadily, up to a limit that scales with rank.
The build-up drains away quickly whenever the holder stops.
This is a momentum and haste effect.
wheel.tag: This is a momentum and haste effect.

whip.name: Bullwhip Crack
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder dashes, a crack of its whip snaps at the enemy in front of it and briefly slows it.
This costs stamina and has a cooldown.
This is a restraint and momentum effect.
whip.tag: This is a restraint and momentum effect.

wind.name: Windborne Pace
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
A tailwind follows the holder, raising its Speed further and hastening allies who run beside it.
The tailwind costs mana to sustain and dies down if the holder stops.
This is a wind and haste effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and haste effect.

wing.name: Mantling Leap
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder leaps, phantom wings mantle around it, steering the leap and softening its landing.
The phantom wings cost mana and have a cooldown.
This is a movement and protection effect.
wing.tag: This is a movement and protection effect.

wolf.name: Pack Lope
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder and an ally attack the same enemy, both gain a little Speed for a short time.
The bonus cannot be gained again until it ends.
This is a hunting and support effect.
wolf.tag: This is a hunting and support effect.

wood.name: Timberline Spring
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
Trees, logs and wooden structures do not block the holder's path, and it can rebound off them with a burst of Speed.
Each rebound costs stamina.
This is a nature and movement effect.
wood.tag: This is a nature and movement effect.

wrath.name: Furious Onrush
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When an ally near the holder falls, it is consumed by wrath and its Speed and attack speed surge for a short time.
This can happen only once per fight.
This is a haste and momentum effect.
wrath.tag: This is a haste and momentum effect.

zeal.name: Crusader's Onrush
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
When the holder charges at an enemy, its zeal drives it on, and it cannot be slowed or interrupted until it reaches the enemy.
The charge costs stamina and has a cooldown.
This is a holy and momentum effect.
zeal.tag: This is a holy and momentum effect.

ziz.name: Vast Shadow Run
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Ancestral Swiftness]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Ancestral Swiftness].
Once per fight, the holder casts the shadow of a vast bird over the field as it runs, and enemies beneath it are slowed by dread.
The shadow lasts a short time and costs a large amount of mana.
This is a darkness and affliction effect.
ziz.tag: This is a darkness and affliction effect.

action.name: Pouncing Favour
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When the holder receives a buff, it lunges at the nearest enemy at once, and that strike carries the buff's strength.
This can happen once every few seconds and costs a little stamina.
This is a movement and haste effect.
action.tag: This is a movement and haste effect.

adept.name: Pride Drill
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Each time the holder reapplies the same buff to an ally in a fight, that buff lasts slightly longer, up to a limit that scales with rank.
Applying a different buff resets the build-up.
This is a support and mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a support and mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Tonic Mane
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When the holder drinks a potion, any buff it applies within a short time also carries a portion of that potion's benefit to its target.
This applies only to the first buff cast after each potion.
This is a alchemy and support effect.
alchemy.tag: This is a alchemy and support effect.

ambush.name: Hidden Roar
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies while unseen by enemies take effect silently and grant the target a brief burst of speed toward the nearest enemy.
Once the fight is underway, this applies only to the first buff the holder casts on each ally.
This is a stealth and support effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and support effect.

animate.name: Stirring Charge
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies to summoned or animated allies also make those allies act with sudden vigour, quickening their next attack.
This can affect each summoned ally only once per fight.
This is a animation and summoning effect.
animate.tag: This is a animation and summoning effect.

anzu.name: Stormcrown Claim
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When an enemy gains a buff near the holder, the holder can tear it away and wear it for a short time.
This can happen once per fight and costs mana.
This is a storm and binding effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and binding effect.

ape.name: Troop Grooming
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When the holder buffs an ally standing beside it, the ally also recovers a little stamina.
This works only while the holder itself is not under attack.
This is a support and restoration effect.
ape.tag: This is a support and restoration effect.

armour.name: Plated Blessing
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Defensive buffs the holder applies or receives also harden the target's armour for their duration.
The extra armour fades the moment the target is struck by a critical hit.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
armour.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

arsenal.name: Battle Kit Boon
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When the holder switches weapons, its active buffs carry over and gain a short burst of potency.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a mastery and haste effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a mastery and haste effect.

aspect.name: Lion's Aspect
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When the holder takes on a buff, its form flickers with a great lion's shape and nearby enemies hesitate briefly.
This can affect each enemy only once per fight.
This is a transformation and command effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation and command effect.

avatar.name: Banner Incarnate
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Once per fight, when the holder is under several buffs at once, it becomes a radiant rallying figure and every ally nearby gains a copy of its strongest buff.
The copies last only a short time and the holder's own buffs are spent to make them.
This is a radiant and support effect.
avatar.tag: This is a radiant and support effect.

axe.name: Cleaving Fervour
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
While the holder is buffed, its heavy swings cut through to strike the enemy behind the first.
Each such cleave shortens the holder's current buff slightly.
This is a mastery and annihilation effect.
axe.tag: This is a mastery and annihilation effect.

balance.name: Even Mane
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When the holder has more buffs than its allies, it shares a portion of their effect with the least-buffed ally nearby.
This can happen once every few seconds and the shared portion fades quickly.
This is a support and balance effect.
balance.tag: This is a support and balance effect.

bat.name: Night Prowl Gift
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies in darkness also let their targets sense hidden enemies nearby by sound.
The sensing lasts only a short time and ends if the target enters bright light.
This is a sound and perception effect.
bat.tag: This is a sound and perception effect.

battlefield.name: Field Herald
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies spread a faint aura on the ground beneath their target, and allies passing through it gain a weaker copy.
Each aura lasts a short time and the holder can keep only a few at once.
This is a area and support effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a area and support effect.

bear.name: Den Mother's Ward
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When an ally the holder has buffed drops below half health, the buff hardens into a brief shield around them.
This can happen once per ally per fight.
This is a protection and shield effect.
bear.tag: This is a protection and shield effect.

bee.name: Honeyed Boons
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Each buff the holder applies to an ally also leaves a sweet residue that slowly mends their wounds.
The mending stops if the ally takes heavy damage.
This is a healing and swarm effect.
bee.tag: This is a healing and swarm effect.

behemoth.name: Titan Blessing
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies to itself also make it immovable for their duration.
The holder moves slightly slower while this lasts.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

bird.name: Skyborne Favour
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies to ranged allies also lengthen the reach of their attacks.
Each ally can benefit from this only for a short time after the buff lands.
This is a wind and support effect.
bird.tag: This is a wind and support effect.

blight.name: Withering Grace
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When the holder buffs an ally, enemies next to that ally suffer a lingering rot that weakens their attacks.
The rot can be applied only once every few seconds.
This is a affliction and poison effect.
blight.tag: This is a affliction and poison effect.

blood.name: Bloodline Boon
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When the holder spends a small amount of its own health, its next buff carries extra strength and lasts longer.
This can happen once every few seconds and cannot drop the holder below half health.
This is a blood and support effect.
blood.tag: This is a blood and support effect.

bone.name: Marrow Blessing
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Defensive buffs on the holder or its allies also brace their bones against stagger and knockdown.
This protection breaks after the first knockdown it prevents.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
bone.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

boundary.name: Pride Territory
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
The holder can mark a stretch of ground as its territory; allies inside it keep their buffs for slightly longer.
Only a single territory can exist at a time, and it fades when the holder leaves it.
This is a area and warding effect.
boundary.tag: This is a area and warding effect.

bounty.name: Plenty Roar
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When the holder defeats an enemy, every buffed ally nearby gains a little health and mana.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a harvest and restoration effect.
bounty.tag: This is a harvest and restoration effect.

bow.name: Far Blessing
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
The holder can cast its buffs on distant allies by loosing them as arrows of light.
Buffs sent this way last a slightly shorter time.
This is a light and support effect.
bow.tag: This is a light and support effect.

brush.name: Painted Pride
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies leave bright brushstrokes on their target, and enemies attacking a painted ally are slightly less accurate.
The strokes fade when the buff ends.
This is a evasion and support effect.
brush.tag: This is a evasion and support effect.

cage.name: Caged Fury
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When the holder is restrained or stunned, its buffs are paused rather than lost and resume at full strength when it breaks free.
This applies to only a single restraint per fight.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
cage.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

cat.name: Catlike Righting
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs on the holder also let it land on its feet from knockbacks and recover instantly.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a evasion and movement effect.
cat.tag: This is a evasion and movement effect.

cataclysm.name: Ruinous Crescendo
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder can spend all of its active buffs at once to unleash a shockwave that scales with how many buffs were spent.
The holder cannot receive new buffs for a short time afterward.
This is a annihilation and area effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is a annihilation and area effect.

cattle.name: Huddled Herd Boon
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Allies standing close together near the holder each gain slightly more from any buff the holder applies to them.
The bonus ends when the allies scatter.
This is a support and defensive effect.
cattle.tag: This is a support and defensive effect.

chain.name: Chainlinked Boon
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When the holder buffs an ally, a faint chain links them, and while it holds the buff's effect is shared by both.
The chain breaks if they move far apart, and only a single chain can exist at a time.
This is a binding and support effect.
chain.tag: This is a binding and support effect.

chaotic.name: Wild Blessing
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Each buff the holder applies gains a random extra boon, such as speed, armour or a burst of healing.
The extra boon lasts only a short time and cannot be chosen.
This is a support and transformation effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a support and transformation effect.

charlatan.name: Gilded Promise
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
The holder can make a buff look far grander than it is, and enemies avoid attacking the ally who wears it.
The deception ends the moment that ally strikes, and it can be used once every few seconds.
This is a stealth and evasion effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a stealth and evasion effect.

chicken.name: Flustered Flock
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When an ally the holder has buffed is hit, it bursts into a flurry of feathers and darts aside out of harm.
This can happen once per ally per fight.
This is a evasion and movement effect.
chicken.tag: This is a evasion and movement effect.

chimera.name: Beastblend Boon
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies to itself also grant it a fitting beast trait, such as claws, thick hide or a sharper sense of smell.
Only a single trait can be held at a time, and it ends with the buff.
This is a transformation and mastery effect.
chimera.tag: This is a transformation and mastery effect.

claw.name: Rending Fervour
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
While the holder is buffed, its claw strikes open bleeding wounds.
Each wound feeds on the holder's buff, shortening it slightly.
This is a blood and affliction effect.
claw.tag: This is a blood and affliction effect.

cloth.name: Mantle Weave
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies can be woven into an ally's garments, so they resume after the ally is stunned or dispelled.
This restores each buff only once per fight.
This is a protection and binding effect.
cloth.tag: This is a protection and binding effect.

cloud.name: Mist Veil Gift
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies also wrap their target in thin mist, making them harder to hit from afar.
The mist disperses when the target attacks in melee.
This is a evasion and wind effect.
cloud.tag: This is a evasion and wind effect.

cold.name: Rime Blessing
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies to allies make their attacks chill enemies, slowing them slightly.
The chill cannot stack on an enemy that is already slowed.
This is a frost and cold effect.
cold.tag: This is a frost and cold effect.

coral.name: Reef Ward
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Defensive buffs the holder applies grow a crust of living coral that hurts enemies who strike the target.
The crust cracks away after a few blows.
This is a protection and growth effect.
coral.tag: This is a protection and growth effect.

corrupt.name: Tainted Boon
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
The holder can twist a buff into a curse and lay it on an enemy, reversing what it would have granted.
This costs extra mana and can be done once every few seconds.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

crocodile.name: Lurking Croc Patience
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
While the holder waits beside an enemy without attacking, its buffs grow steadily stronger.
The build-up is spent all at once on the holder's next bite or strike.
This is a hunting and mastery effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a hunting and mastery effect.

crystal.name: Prism Favour
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies refract through a crystal light, spreading a weaker copy to an ally standing behind the target.
The copy lasts only a short time.
This is a light and resonance effect.
crystal.tag: This is a light and resonance effect.

cycle.name: Turning Boon
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When a buff the holder applied expires, it returns to the holder in a weaker form.
This can happen to each buff only once.
This is a time and support effect.
cycle.tag: This is a time and support effect.

dance.name: Rhythmic Boon Step
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When the holder moves while buffed, each step it takes in rhythm lengthens its current buffs slightly.
Stopping or being struck breaks the rhythm.
This is a movement and momentum effect.
dance.tag: This is a movement and momentum effect.

dark.name: Shade Blessing
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies in shadow make their target harder for enemies to track.
The effect ends when the target steps into bright light.
This is a shadow and stealth effect.
dark.tag: This is a shadow and stealth effect.

dawn.name: Daybreak Roar
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
The first buff the holder applies in each fight shines with the dawn, healing its target and burning nearby enemies.
This happens only once per fight.
This is a light and healing effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and healing effect.

death.name: Last Pride
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When an ally the holder has buffed falls, their buffs pass to the nearest ally.
The passed buffs last only a short time.
This is a death and support effect.
death.tag: This is a death and support effect.

deep.name: Abyssal Favour
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies settle deep, resisting dispels and purges.
Each buff can resist only a single dispel.
This is a protection and warding effect.
deep.tag: This is a protection and warding effect.

deer.name: Fleet Hart Gift
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies also make the target quicker to dodge out of harm.
The quickness fades after the target dodges once.
This is a evasion and haste effect.
deer.tag: This is a evasion and haste effect.

desolate.name: Lone Pride
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When the holder fights with no ally nearby, its buffs on itself grow much stronger.
The bonus ends the moment an ally comes close.
This is a mastery and defensive effect.
desolate.tag: This is a mastery and defensive effect.

dimension.name: Folded Favour
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
The holder can cast a buff on an ally anywhere in the fight, sending it through a fold in space.
This costs extra mana and can be done once every few seconds.
This is a travel and support effect.
dimension.tag: This is a travel and support effect.

discord.name: Dissonant Boon Roar
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When the holder buffs itself, nearby enemies suffer a jarring cry that briefly disrupts their own buffs.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a sound and curse effect.
discord.tag: This is a sound and curse effect.

discordant.name: Clashing Mane
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When an enemy near the holder gains a buff, the holder's own buffs flare with a burst of strength.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a resonance and mastery effect.
discordant.tag: This is a resonance and mastery effect.

dog.name: Loyal Pride
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When the holder buffs an ally, that ally's attacks draw the holder to their side.
The holder can be pulled this way once every few seconds.
This is a movement and support effect.
dog.tag: This is a movement and support effect.

doom.name: Grim Pride
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Enemies who strike an ally the holder has buffed suffer a creeping doom that saps their strength.
The doom lasts only a short time.
This is a curse and death effect.
doom.tag: This is a curse and death effect.

doppelganger.name: Twinned Favour
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
When the holder buffs itself, a shadow double of it briefly gains the same buff and fights beside it.
The double lasts only a short time and can appear once per fight.
This is a conjuration and summoning effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a conjuration and summoning effect.

dragon.name: Dragonheart Boon
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies to itself also make its roar breathe a short gout of fire.
This costs mana and can be done once every few seconds.
This is a fire and mastery effect.
dragon.tag: This is a fire and mastery effect.

duck.name: Shedding Favour
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Boon Aptitude]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Boon Aptitude].
Buffs the holder applies let their target shrug off the next harmful effect.

bounty.name: Plentiful Wind

brush.name: Painted Stride
