lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder passes through a doorway or into a new area, its stamina refills by a portion.
This can happen only once every short while, and not in the middle of a fight.
This is a travel and dimensional effect.
gate.tag: This is a travel and dimensional effect.

gathering.name: Gathered Wind
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When allies near the holder spend stamina, a small portion of what they spend gathers in the holder as stamina of its own.
The gathered stamina has a limit per fight that scales with rank.
This is a harvest and support effect.
gathering.tag: This is a harvest and support effect.

glass.name: Brittle Surge
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
While the holder's stamina is full, its attacks are slightly faster and sharper.
The first hit it takes while the surge is active shatters it and costs a portion of its stamina.
This is a haste effect.
glass.tag: This is a haste effect.

glimeron.name: Glimmering Wind
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder regains a large amount of stamina, a faint glimmer marks the ground at its feet, and allies who step onto it regain a little stamina.
The mark fades after a short time and only the latest mark remains.
This is a light and support effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a light and support effect.

goat.name: Mountain Goat Lungs
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
Climbing slopes and steps does not drain the holder's stamina.
When it charges downhill or from a ledge, its charge costs slightly less stamina and knocks the target back. The knockback can happen once every few seconds.
This is a movement and momentum effect.
goat.tag: This is a movement and momentum effect.

gorgon.name: Stone-Gaze Endurance
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When an enemy meets the holder's gaze while its stamina is full, the enemy's stamina regeneration is frozen for a short time.
This can affect each enemy only once per fight.
This is a binding and curse effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a binding and curse effect.

griffin.name: Lion-Eagle's Wind
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's pounces and leaping attacks cost slightly less stamina, and each pounce that lands returns a little.
The return can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a hunting and momentum effect.
griffin.tag: This is a hunting and momentum effect.

growth.name: Swelling Reserve
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
Each time the holder spends all of its stamina in a fight, its maximum stamina grows slightly for the rest of that fight.
The growth stacks a few times and resets when the fight ends.
This is a growth effect.
growth.tag: This is a growth effect.

guardian.name: Warden's Endurance
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder blocks or intercepts an attack aimed at an ally, the block costs slightly less stamina and the ally regains a little stamina.
This can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a protection and support effect.
guardian.tag: This is a protection and support effect.

hair.name: Mane of Vigour
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
While the holder's stamina is full, its mane bristles and enemies near it are slightly intimidated, striking it with less force.
The effect ends whenever its stamina drops below a portion of its maximum.
This is a defensive effect.
hair.tag: This is a defensive effect.

hammer.name: Pounding Tempo
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
Each heavy blow the holder lands in a steady rhythm returns a little stamina, as long as it keeps the beat.
Missing a blow or pausing breaks the rhythm for a short time.
This is a momentum and resonance effect.
hammer.tag: This is a momentum and resonance effect.

hand.name: Steadying Grip
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder reaches out to steady a nearby ally who has been staggered or knocked down, the ally regains a little stamina.
This can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a support effect.
hand.tag: This is a support effect.

harmonic.name: Resonant Lungs
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder and a nearby ally spend stamina at nearly the same moment, both regain a little of it.
This can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a resonance and support effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a resonance and support effect.

harpy.name: Shrieking Lungs
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder's stamina is full, it can let out a piercing shriek that drains a little stamina from enemies nearby.
The shriek empties a portion of its own stamina and can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a sound and wind effect.
harpy.tag: This is a sound and wind effect.

harvest.name: Reaper's Wind
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder defeats an enemy, it reaps a portion of that enemy's remaining stamina for itself.
Stamina reaped past the holder's maximum is lost. This can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a harvest and harvesting effect.
harvest.tag: This is a harvest and harvesting effect.

heidel.name: Unnoticed Ease
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
While enemies are unaware of the holder, its stamina does not drain from sprinting or sneaking.
The effect ends the moment the holder is noticed.
This is a stealth and movement effect.
heidel.tag: This is a stealth and movement effect.

hook.name: Barbed Vigour
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder hooks or drags an enemy toward it, the pull returns a little stamina.
The return can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a restraint and harvest effect.
hook.tag: This is a restraint and harvest effect.

horse.name: Long-Road Stamina
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The longer the holder keeps running without stopping, the less stamina each moment of sprinting costs.
The reduction resets when it stops or is struck.
This is a travel and movement effect.
horse.tag: This is a travel and movement effect.

hunger.name: Ravenous Wind
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder's stamina falls low, its attacks devour a little stamina from the enemies they strike.
The hunger lasts until its stamina recovers past a portion of its maximum, and each enemy can be fed on only once every few seconds.
This is a harvest and hunting effect.
hunger.tag: This is a harvest and hunting effect.

hunt.name: Long-Chase Stamina
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
While the holder pursues a fleeing or wounded enemy, its sprinting costs no stamina.
The effect lasts a short time per chase and ends if the quarry escapes its sight.
This is a hunting and tracking effect.
hunt.tag: This is a hunting and tracking effect.

hydra.name: Many-Headed Reserve
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
Each time the holder's stamina runs empty, it regrows a portion of its stamina almost at once.
Each regrowth in the same fight is smaller than the last, and the effect resets when the fight ends.
This is a regeneration and restoration effect.
hydra.tag: This is a regeneration and restoration effect.

ice.name: Rime-Sealed Breath
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder's stamina falls low, a shell of ice forms over its body for a short time, reducing damage and sealing in its remaining stamina so nothing can drain it.
The holder moves slightly slower inside the shell. This can happen once per fight.
This is an ice and barrier effect.
ice.tag: This is an ice and barrier effect.

immortal.name: Enduring Deathstand
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
Once per fight, when the holder would fall, it is held up by its own endurance: its stamina is spent in place of the killing blow's damage.
The holder is left with no stamina and slowed for a short time.
This is a rebirth and protection effect.
immortal.tag: This is a rebirth and protection effect.

iron.name: Iron Lungs
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's stamina cannot be drained or stolen by enemy effects while it is above a portion of its maximum.
Below that portion, drains against it are reduced instead of stopped.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
iron.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

juggernaut.name: Unstoppable Wind
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
While the holder charges, it cannot be stopped by blows, and each enemy it shoulders aside costs it a little stamina instead.
The charge ends when its stamina runs low.
This is a momentum and juggernaut effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a momentum and juggernaut effect.

karmic.name: Owed Breath
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When an enemy drains or wastes the holder's stamina, the debt is marked, and the holder's next hit on that enemy takes back a portion of what was lost.
Each debt lasts a short time and is collected only once.
This is a curse and balance effect.
karmic.tag: This is a curse and balance effect.

knife.name: Quick-Cut Breath
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's light, quick attacks cost slightly less stamina.
Each critical hit it lands with a quick attack returns a little stamina, once every few seconds.
This is a haste and mastery effect.
knife.tag: This is a haste and mastery effect.

knowledge.name: Paced Mind
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder learns the pace of each fight, and after a short time its abilities cost slightly less stamina when used in their best moments.
The benefit begins fresh with every fight.
This is a mastery and perception effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a mastery and perception effect.

kraken.name: Grasping Tide
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
While the holder grapples or holds an enemy, it slowly drains that enemy's stamina into its own.
The drain lasts a short time per hold and ends if the holder is struck hard.
This is a water and binding effect.
kraken.tag: This is a water and binding effect.

leviathan.name: Deep-Sea Reserve
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's maximum stamina rises slightly for each large or powerful enemy in the fight.
The bonus fades a short time after those enemies fall.
This is a water and growth effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water and growth effect.

life.name: Overflowing Vitality
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
While the holder's stamina is full, its excess vitality slowly heals it.
The healing stops whenever it spends stamina and returns a short time after its stamina is full again.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
life.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

light.name: Sunlit Vigour
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
While the holder stands in bright light, its stamina regenerates slightly faster and allies near it share a portion of the bonus.
The effect is suppressed while it stands in darkness.
This is a light and holy effect.
light.tag: This is a light and holy effect.

lightning.name: Crackling Nerves
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder spends stamina on a dash or charge, it moves with a crackle of lightning that jolts enemies it passes through.
The jolt can happen only once every few seconds and costs a little extra stamina.
This is a lightning and haste effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and haste effect.

lizard.name: Basking Recovery
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
While the holder stands in sunlight or near fire, its stamina regenerates faster.
In cold places its regeneration is slightly slower.
This is a fire and restoration effect.
lizard.tag: This is a fire and restoration effect.

locust.name: Devouring Swarm-Breath
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder's stamina falls low, a buzzing cloud of locusts spills from it and nibbles stamina from nearby enemies, returning it to the holder.
The cloud lasts a short time and can form once per fight.
This is a swarm and harvest effect.
locust.tag: This is a swarm and harvest effect.

lotus.name: Still Blossom
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder pauses in a fight without attacking for a moment, its stamina blooms back much faster.
The bloom lasts until it acts again and can return only after a short time.
This is a restoration and serenity effect.
lotus.tag: This is a restoration and serenity effect.

lurker.name: Waiting Strength
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
While the holder waits out of sight, its stamina fills past its maximum by a portion.
The extra is spent on its first attack from hiding and fades a short time after it is seen.
This is a stealth and hunting effect.
lurker.tag: This is a stealth and hunting effect.

magic.name: Mana-Wrought Wind
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder's stamina runs low, a portion of its mana is turned into stamina.
This can happen once every so often, and the holder's mana regeneration slows for a short time afterward.
This is a magic and transmutation effect.
magic.tag: This is a magic and transmutation effect.

malign.name: Spiteful Endurance
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
Each time an enemy harms the holder with an affliction, the holder's stamina regenerates slightly faster for a short time.
The bonus stacks a few times and fades as the afflictions are removed.
This is an affliction and curse effect.
malign.tag: This is an affliction and curse effect.

manatee.name: Unhurried Breath
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's stamina regenerates at a steady pace that enemy effects cannot slow.
While unhurried, its stamina cannot be boosted by allied effects either.
This is a water and defensive effect.
manatee.tag: This is a water and defensive effect.

manticore.name: Barbed-Tail Vigour
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder's stamina is full, its next attack carries a venomous sting that drains the target's stamina for a short time.
The sting costs a portion of the holder's stamina and can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a poison and hunting effect.
manticore.tag: This is a poison and hunting effect.

master.name: Master's Composure
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder learns to spend its stamina with perfect economy, and its highest-cost ability costs slightly less stamina.
That ability's cost reduction is lost for a short time each time the holder is staggered.
This is a mastery effect.
master.tag: This is a mastery effect.

might.name: Mighty Lungs
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's heavy attacks draw on its great reserves and strike slightly harder for each portion of stamina it has above half.
Each heavy attack made this way costs slightly more stamina.
This is a might and momentum effect.
might.tag: This is a might and momentum effect.

ministration.name: Lent Stamina
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When an ally near the holder runs out of stamina, the holder gives a portion of its own to restore them.
This can happen only once every short while and not while the holder's own stamina is low.
This is a support and healing effect.
ministration.tag: This is a support and healing effect.

minotaur.name: Maze-Runner's Horns
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's charges cost slightly less stamina, and a charge that drives an enemy into a wall returns a portion of the stamina spent.
The return can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a momentum and charge effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a momentum and charge effect.

mirage.name: Shimmering Fatigue
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
While the holder's stamina is low, enemies see it as fresh and wary, and they hesitate before pressing the attack.
The illusion lasts a short time and can happen once per fight.
This is an illusion and deception effect.
mirage.tag: This is an illusion and deception effect.

mirror.name: Reflected Breath
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When an enemy tries to drain the holder's stamina, a portion of the drain is reflected back onto that enemy.
This can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a reflection and defensive effect.
mirror.tag: This is a reflection and defensive effect.

monkey.name: Restless Mischief
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's vaults, rolls and climbs cost slightly less stamina, and each that carries it past an enemy returns a little.
The return can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
monkey.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

monolith.name: Standing-Stone Wind
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
While the holder has not moved for a short time, it becomes as steady as standing stone, and blocking costs it no stamina.
Moving or dodging ends the effect, which returns a short time after it plants itself again.
This is a defensive and earth effect.
monolith.tag: This is a defensive and earth effect.

moon.name: Waxing Endurance
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
At night or in dim places, the holder's maximum stamina rises slightly.
In bright daylight its stamina regenerates slightly slower.
This is a moon and shadow effect.
moon.tag: This is a moon and shadow effect.

mouse.name: Small-Breath Stamina
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's quick dodges and small steps cost very little stamina while it keeps out of an enemy's direct reach.
The effect ends for a short time when it is struck.
This is an evasion and stealth effect.
mouse.tag: This is an evasion and stealth effect.

myriad.name: Countless Breaths
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's stamina regenerates in many small pulses rather than a steady stream, and each pulse that comes while it is moving is slightly larger.
The larger pulses happen only while the holder is moving.
This is a movement and restoration effect.
myriad.tag: This is a movement and restoration effect.

mystic.name: Inner Wellspring
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder meditates for a moment between bursts of action, a portion of its stamina returns along with a little mana.
This can happen only once every short while and is interrupted by damage.
This is a magic and restoration effect.
mystic.tag: This is a magic and restoration effect.

nebula.name: Starfield Reserve
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
Stamina the holder would regenerate past its maximum gathers around it as a faint cloud of starlight.
When its stamina falls low, the cloud returns its store. The cloud fades when the fight ends.
This is a star and restoration effect.
nebula.tag: This is a star and restoration effect.

needle.name: Pinpoint Economy
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's precise, aimed strikes cost slightly less stamina.
Each strike that hits a weak spot returns a little stamina, once every few seconds.
This is a mastery and precision effect.
needle.tag: This is a mastery and precision effect.

nemesis.name: Rival's Fire
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
At the start of each fight the holder marks the strongest enemy as its rival, and while it fights that rival its stamina regenerates slightly faster.
The bonus ends when the rival falls or the holder turns away from it for long.
This is a hunting and tracking effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a hunting and tracking effect.

net.name: Netted Struggle
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder snares or slows an enemy, that enemy's struggling feeds a little stamina back to the holder.
The feeding lasts a short time per snare.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
net.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

network.name: Shared Wind
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder links the party's stamina, and when any linked ally runs low, a small portion is drawn from the others to steady them.
The link only spans allies near each other and can pass stamina only once every few seconds.
This is a support and network effect.
network.tag: This is a support and network effect.

oasis.name: Watering Hole
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
Once per fight, when the holder's stamina falls low, a cool spring of water rises at its feet.
The holder and allies who stand in the spring regenerate stamina much faster until it dries up a short time later.
This is a water and restoration effect.
oasis.tag: This is a water and restoration effect.

ocean.name: Ebb-and-Flow Breath
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's stamina ebbs and flows like a tide: when it spends heavily, a wave of regeneration follows a short time later.
The wave cannot come again until the tide has fully turned.
This is a water and time effect.
ocean.tag: This is a water and time effect.

octopus.name: Many-Armed Ease
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder grapples, blocks and strikes in quick succession, each action draws on a different reserve and costs slightly less stamina.
Repeating the same action breaks the effect for a short time.
This is a binding and mastery effect.
octopus.tag: This is a binding and mastery effect.

omen.name: Foreboding Breath
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
A moment before an enemy unleashes a heavy attack at the holder, the holder feels it coming and regains a little stamina to dodge.
This can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a precognition and evasion effect.
omen.tag: This is a precognition and evasion effect.

onslaught.name: Tireless Onslaught Chain
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
While the holder keeps attacking without pause, each hit in the chain costs slightly less stamina.
The chain breaks when the holder stops attacking for a moment or is staggered.
This is a momentum and onslaught effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a momentum and onslaught effect.

pangolin.name: Pangolin Respite
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder's stamina runs empty, it curls behind its guard for a short time, taking reduced damage while its stamina recovers faster.
The holder cannot attack while curled. This can happen once per fight.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

paper.name: Folded Breath
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's stamina costs are written down and folded away, and when its stamina runs empty, a portion of the last costs it paid is refunded at once.
This can happen once every so often.
This is a binding and restoration effect.
paper.tag: This is a binding and restoration effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Dreamlit Endurance
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder's stamina falls low, phantom images of it surge outward, and enemies who strike the phantoms lose a little stamina.
The phantoms last a short time and appear once per fight.

undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder's stamina runs empty, it keeps fighting with a cold, deathless endurance for a short time and spends no stamina.
Healing on the holder is weaker while the effect lasts. This can happen once per fight.
This is a necromantic and death effect.
undeath.tag: This is a necromantic and death effect.

unity.name: Yoked Stamina
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When an ally near the holder spends stamina, the holder pays a small portion of the cost for them.
The holder stops sharing while its own stamina is low.
This is a support and unity effect.
unity.tag: This is a support and unity effect.

vast.name: Vast Reserve
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's maximum stamina is greatly increased, but its stamina regenerates slightly slower.
When its stamina is full, it gains slight resistance to knockback.
This is a growth and defensive effect.
vast.tag: This is a growth and defensive effect.

vehicle.name: Driving Engine
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's sprinting costs less stamina the longer it runs in a straight line.
Turning sharply or stopping resets the effect.
This is a travel and momentum effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a travel and momentum effect.

venom.name: Toxin-Fed Lungs
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
Each enemy poisoned by the holder slowly leaks a little stamina to it while the poison lasts.
The stamina gained this way has a limit per fight that scales with rank.
This is a poison and harvest effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and harvest effect.

verdant.name: Greenwood Breath
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder's stamina refills to its maximum, a ring of fresh growth springs up around it, and allies within regenerate stamina slightly faster.
The growth fades after a short time and can spring up only once every short while.
This is a nature and growth effect.
verdant.tag: This is a nature and growth effect.

vessel.name: Brimful Lungs
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
Stamina the holder regenerates past its maximum is held as an overflow, up to a portion of its maximum.
When an ally near it runs low, the overflow pours into them. The overflow empties when the fight ends.
This is a support and restoration effect.
vessel.tag: This is a support and restoration effect.

visage.name: Unwearied Face
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder never shows its fatigue, and enemies cannot tell how much stamina it has left.
When its stamina is low, the first enemy to approach it hesitates briefly. This can happen once per fight.
This is a deception and defensive effect.
visage.tag: This is a deception and defensive effect.

vision.name: Far-Seeing Pace
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder sees the shape of a fight before it unfolds, and dodges it makes against telegraphed attacks cost slightly less stamina.
A dodge that avoids a telegraphed attack completely returns a little stamina, once every few seconds.
This is a precognition and evasion effect.
vision.tag: This is a precognition and evasion effect.

void.name: Bottomless Lungs
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder's stamina runs empty, it draws on the void and keeps acting for a short time, each action pulling a little stamina from nearby enemies instead.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a void and darkness effect.
void.tag: This is a void and darkness effect.

volcano.name: Molten Heart
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
Stamina the holder cannot spend builds as heat in its chest, and when its stamina is full for a short time, the heat erupts in a burst of fire around it.
The eruption empties a portion of its stamina and can happen only once every short while.
This is a fire and earth effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and earth effect.

vortex.name: Cyclone Siphon
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder spins through a group of enemies, it draws a little stamina from each enemy it passes.
The stamina drawn by a spin has a limit that scales with rank.
This is a wind and area effect.
vortex.tag: This is a wind and area effect.

wasp.name: Stinging Persistence
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's repeated quick strikes on the same enemy cost slightly less stamina with each sting.
The reduction stacks a few times and resets when the holder changes target.
This is a poison and momentum effect.
wasp.tag: This is a poison and momentum effect.

water.name: Flowing Wind
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Water essence.

The holder's stamina flows smoothly between actions, and a portion of the stamina it spends on each dodge returns over a short time.

water.tag: This is a water and restoration effect.

weave.name: Burden-Woven Breath
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.

The holder weaves its stamina with the stamina of allies near it, and when it takes a heavy hit, a portion of the stamina loss is spread among them.

wendigo.name: Starving Endurance

When the holder's stamina falls low, it hungers, and each attack it lands steals a little stamina and spreads a creeping chill to the target.
The hunger lasts until its stamina recovers, and the holder cannot be healed above a portion of its health while it lasts.

wendigo.tag: This is a cold and hunger effect.

whale.name: Deep-Dive Lungs
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Whale essence.

The holder takes a deep breath at the start of each fight, filling its stamina past its maximum by a portion.

whale.tag: This is a water and growth effect.

wheel.name: Wheel of Breath
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.

wheel.tag: This is a momentum and cycle effect.

whip.name: Lashing Tempo
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's long-reaching strikes cost slightly less stamina when they hit an enemy at the edge of its reach.
A strike that disarms or trips an enemy returns a little stamina, once every few seconds.
This is a mastery and restraint effect.
whip.tag: This is a mastery and restraint effect.

wind.name: Windborne Lungs
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
While the holder moves with the wind at its back, its sprinting costs slightly less stamina.

wind.tag: This is a wind and movement effect.

wing.name: Spreading Pinions
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
The holder's leaps carry it slightly further for the same stamina as a phantom spread of wings catches the air.
Landing from a long leap returns a little stamina, once every few seconds.
This is a wind and movement effect.
wing.tag: This is a wind and movement effect.

wolf.name: Pack Stamina

The bonus has a limit that scales with rank.
This is a hunting and support effect.
wolf.tag: This is a hunting and support effect.

wood.name: Seasoned Grain
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Wood essence.

This can happen only once every few seconds.
This is a nature and defensive effect.
wood.tag: This is a nature and defensive effect.

wrath.name: Raging Lungs
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Tireless]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Tireless].
When the holder is struck hard, its anger feeds its endurance and it regains a little stamina.

wrath.tag: This is a wrath and momentum effect.

zeal.name: Fervent Breath

zeal.tag: This is a haste and zeal effect.

ziz.name: Great-Wing Wind

ziz.tag: This is a wind and support effect.

alchemy.tag: This is a movement and alchemy effect.

anzu.name: Stormwing Bound

arsenal.tag: This is a movement and mastery effect.

This is a movement and transformation effect.
aspect.tag: This is a movement and transformation effect.

When the effect ends, the holder's stamina recovers slowly for a short time.

avatar.tag: This is a haste and transformation effect.

When the holder ends a sprint with a melee attack, the attack sweeps in a wide arc and strikes every enemy in front of it.

This is a momentum and area effect.
axe.tag: This is a momentum and area effect.

balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Sprint]. Catalyst: Balance essence.

This is a movement and defensive effect.
balance.tag: This is a movement and defensive effect.

While sprinting, the holder senses enemies hidden or in darkness nearby and its party can see them for a short time.
This sense works only while the holder keeps running.
This is a movement and detection effect.
bat.tag: This is a movement and detection effect.

When an ally falls below half health, the holder sprints to them at a burst of extra speed and shields them briefly on arrival.
This can happen once per fight for each ally.
This is a movement and protection effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a movement and protection effect.

bear.name: Bruin Charge
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Sprint]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Sprint].
When the holder sprints into an enemy, it bowls that enemy over, knocking it down briefly.
This can trigger once every few seconds and costs a portion of stamina.
This is a momentum and restraint effect.
bear.tag: This is a momentum and restraint effect.

bee.name: Hive Courier
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Sprint]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Sprint].
Allies the holder sprints past gain a short burst of speed of their own.
Each ally can only gain the burst once every few seconds.
This is a haste and support effect.
bee.tag: This is a haste and support effect.

behemoth.name: Earthshaker Run
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Sprint]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Sprint].

Larger enemies are unaffected, and the tremors cost the holder extra stamina while they last.
This is a momentum and area effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a momentum and area effect.

bird.name: Swooping Stride
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Sprint]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Sprint].
The holder can leap a short distance at the end of a sprint, clearing gaps and low obstacles.
The leap costs a portion of stamina and has a short cooldown.
This is a movement and travel effect.
bird.tag: This is a movement and travel effect.

blight.name: Withering Trail

blood.name: Racing Heart

lines: Retains all effects of [Sprint].
When the holder's stamina runs out, it can keep sprinting by spending a small portion of health instead.
The holder never spends health this way while below half health.
This is a movement and blood effect.
blood.tag: This is a movement and blood effect.

bone.name: Marrow Spring

lines: Retains all effects of [Sprint].
While sprinting, the holder's bones harden against impact, reducing damage from falls, knockbacks and collisions.
The hardening fades a moment after the sprint ends.
This is a movement and defensive effect.
bone.tag: This is a movement and defensive effect.

boundary.name: Boundary Runner
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Sprint]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Sprint].
While sprinting, the holder can pass through enemy barriers and zones of control without being slowed.

This is a movement and warding effect.
boundary.tag: This is a movement and warding effect.

bounty.name: Victory Lap
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Sprint]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Sprint].
When an enemy dies near the holder, it regains a portion of stamina and its next sprint is briefly faster.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a haste and harvest effect.
bounty.tag: This is a haste and harvest effect.

bow.name: Running Volley
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Sprint]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Sprint].
The holder can fire its bow while sprinting without slowing, though shots fired on the run deal slightly reduced damage.
Each shot fired this way costs a portion of stamina.
This is a movement and hunting effect.
bow.tag: This is a movement and hunting effect.

brush.name: Brushstroke Lane
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Sprint]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Sprint].
The holder's sprint paints a bright streak along the ground, and allies who walk along it move slightly faster.
The streak fades after a short time, and only the most recent streak remains.
This is a haste and support effect.
brush.tag: This is a haste and support effect.

cage.name: Caged Pacing
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Sprint]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Sprint].
When the holder is slowed, rooted or trapped, its next sprint after breaking free is faster and costs no stamina for a short time.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a movement and binding effect.
cage.tag: This is a movement and binding effect.

cat.name: Silent Prowl

lines: Retains all effects of [Sprint].
The holder's sprint makes no sound, and enemies that have not yet noticed it do not hear it coming.
The silence breaks the moment the holder attacks or is struck.
This is a movement and stealth effect.

cataclysm.name: Fleeing Ruin

cataclysm.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

cattle.name: Stampede Lead
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Sprint]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Sprint].
While the holder sprints, allies close behind it share a slight speed bonus and spend slightly less stamina.
The bonus ends when the holder stops sprinting.
This is a haste and support effect.
cattle.tag: This is a haste and support effect.

chain.name: Tethered Rush
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Sprint]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Sprint].
When the holder sprints past an enemy, a spectral chain links them briefly and drags that enemy a short way along the holder's path.
This can trigger once every few seconds and costs a portion of stamina.
This is a movement and binding effect.
chain.tag: This is a movement and binding effect.

chaotic.name: Wild Tangent

chaotic.tag: This is a movement and chaos effect.

charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Sprint]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.

This is a movement and evasion effect.

lines: Retains all effects of [Sprint].
When the holder falls below half health, it bursts into a frantic sprint away from its attackers with no stamina cost for a short time.

This is a movement and evasion effect.
chicken.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

claw.name: Clawing Flyby

claw.tag: This is a momentum and affliction effect.

cloth.name: Streaming Cloak
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Sprint]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.

This is a movement and protection effect.
cloth.tag: This is a movement and protection effect.

cloud.name: Mist Running

While the holder sprints, it trails a thin mist that makes it harder for enemies to hit with ranged attacks.

While the holder sprints, its footsteps leave frost that chills enemies who stand on it, slowing them slightly.

corrupt.name: Tainted Wake

Enemies the holder sprints past are tainted briefly, and their healing is reduced for a short time.

ambush.name: Hidden Snarl

animate.name: Stone Throat
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.

anzu.name: Thunder Mane

The roar crackles with lightning, and the first hit each stunned enemy takes releases a jolt of lightning damage.
The jolt costs mana and happens once per enemy for each roar.

ape.name: Chest-Beat Challenge

The taunt ends early if the holder takes heavy damage, and costs stamina.

ape.tag: This is a command and defensive effect.

armour.name: Iron-Lunged Stand
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Armour essence.

The hardening ends when the last weakness fades.

armour.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

arsenal.name: Rattling Arsenal

The roar rattles weapons in enemy hands, and the holder's next weapon attack against each stunned enemy deals bonus damage.

aspect.name: Mane of the Pride

avatar.name: Pride Incarnate
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.

axe.name: Cleaving Bellow

balance.name: Measured Roar
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Balance essence.

bat.name: Echolocating Howl

battlefield.name: Rallying Thunder

bird.name: Hawk Cry

bone.name: Rattle of Bones

boundary.name: Ring of Thunder

bounty.name: Spoils of Terror

eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar reveals the weak points of enemies it weakens, and the party's critical hits against them land more often.
The effect lasts only while the weakness holds.
This is a perception and revelation effect.
eye.tag: This is a perception and revelation effect.

feast.name: Hungry Roar
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
When the holder lands a hit on an enemy weakened by the roar, it recovers a small amount of health.
The recovery is capped per roar.
This is a healing and harvest effect.
feast.tag: This is a healing and harvest effect.

feeble.name: Sapping Roar
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
Enemies weakened by the roar also deal slightly less damage while the weakness lasts.
The sapping does not stack from repeated roars.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
feeble.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

fertile.name: Blossoming Roar
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
Grass and flowers spring up where the roar passes, slowly healing allies who stand in them.
The growth withers after a short time and costs mana.
This is a growth and healing effect.
fertile.tag: This is a growth and healing effect.

fey.name: Fey Trill
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar carries a strange glamour, and stunned enemies wake from the stun dazed and wandering for a short time.
A dazed enemy snaps out of it when struck.
This is a curse and sound effect.
fey.tag: This is a curse and sound effect.

fire.name: Blazing Roar
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar carries a gust of flame, setting stunned enemies alight.
The burn lasts a short time and costs mana.
This is a fire and burn effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire and burn effect.

firebird.name: Phoenix-Crested Cry
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar sheds burning feathers that settle on allies, healing them a little and searing enemies who strike them.
The feathers burn out after a short time.
This is a fire and healing effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire and healing effect.

fish.name: Gilled Roar
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
When the holder roars while standing in water, the roar's reach and stun duration grow.
The bonus applies only in water.
This is a water and sound effect.
fish.tag: This is a water and sound effect.

flea.name: Leaping Roar
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder can leap a short distance as it roars, landing among enemies before the stun takes hold.
The leap costs stamina and shares the roar's cooldown.
This is a movement and haste effect.
flea.tag: This is a movement and haste effect.

flesh.name: Gut-Shaking Roar
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar shakes enemies to their core, and stunned enemies take extra damage from physical blows while the weakness lasts.
The bonus applies only to physical damage.
This is an affliction and sound effect.
flesh.tag: This is an affliction and sound effect.

foot.name: Stomping Roar
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder stamps as it roars, and the shock knocks stunned enemies off their feet.
Enemies too large to topple are slowed instead, and the stamp costs stamina.
This is a movement and area effect.
foot.tag: This is a movement and area effect.

force.name: Concussive Roar
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar strikes as a wave of force, pushing enemies away from the holder as it stuns them.
The push costs mana and does not move enemies far.
This is a sound and area effect.
force.tag: This is a sound and area effect.

forge.name: Anvil Roar
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar rings like a hammer on an anvil, and enemies it weakens have their weapons and armour weakened for a short time.
The weakening fades with the roar's weakness and does not stack.
This is a resonance and affliction effect.
forge.tag: This is a resonance and affliction effect.

fork.name: Forked Roar
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder can split its roar into narrow paths that strike in different directions.
Each path reaches further but is narrower than a full roar.
This is a sound and area effect.
fork.tag: This is a sound and area effect.

fortress.name: Bastion Roar
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
After roaring, the holder plants itself, taking much less damage but unable to move for a short time.
The holder can end the stance early by attacking.
This is a defensive and protection effect.
fortress.tag: This is a defensive and protection effect.

fox.name: Cunning Roar
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
When the holder roars, it slips sideways out of the enemies' sight, and stunned enemies lose track of it for a short time.
Attacking ends the concealment early.
This is a stealth and evasion effect.
fox.tag: This is a stealth and evasion effect.

frog.name: Croaking Roar
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar swells the holder's throat and carries a slick of toxin, poisoning enemies it stuns.
The poison lasts a short time and costs mana.
This is a poison and sound effect.
frog.tag: This is a poison and sound effect.

fungus.name: Sporecloud Roar
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar blasts out a cloud of spores that keeps stunned enemies coughing, slowing their attacks for a short time.
The spores settle quickly and do not stack.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
fungus.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

garuda.name: Sky-King's Roar
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar strikes serpents, poisoners and venomous creatures harder, stunning them for longer.
Allies within reach are briefly cleansed of poison, and the cleanse costs mana.
This is a purification and wind effect.
garuda.tag: This is a purification and wind effect.

gate.name: Gateway Roar
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar shuts nearby portals and stops summoned enemies from arriving for a short time.
The effect costs mana and covers only portals within the roar's reach.
This is a dimensional and warding effect.
gate.tag: This is a dimensional and warding effect.

gathering.name: Gathering Roar
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar pulls scattered enemies toward the holder before it stuns them.
The pull is short and costs stamina.
This is a command and area effect.
gathering.tag: This is a command and area effect.

glass.name: Shattering Roar
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar cracks enemy shields and barriers, and the next hit on a cracked barrier shatters it.
Cracks fade after a short time.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
glass.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

glimeron.name: Glimmer Roar
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
When a spell strikes the holder, a portion of it is caught in its throat and split across its next roar, dealing magic damage to each enemy the roar stuns.
The caught spell fades after a short time if the holder does not roar.
This is a resonance and warding effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a resonance and warding effect.

goat.name: Butting Bellow
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder's next charge after a roar knocks stunned enemies aside and extends their stun slightly.
The charge costs stamina and must come within a short time of the roar.
This is a momentum and movement effect.
goat.tag: This is a momentum and movement effect.

gorgon.name: Petrifying Roar
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
Enemies stunned by the roar begin to stiffen, slowing further over the stun until they are briefly turned to stone.
Stone enemies take less damage from hits, and the effect costs mana.
This is a transmutation and restraint effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a transmutation and restraint effect.

griffin.name: Griffin's Shriek
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar ends in an eagle's shriek, and the holder dives at the nearest stunned enemy with a swooping strike.
The dive costs stamina and happens once per roar.
This is a hunting and movement effect.
griffin.tag: This is a hunting and movement effect.

growth.name: Overgrowth Roar
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar's reach grows slightly each time it is used in the same fight.
The growth resets after each fight.
This is a growth and sound effect.
growth.tag: This is a growth and sound effect.

guardian.name: Warden's Roar
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
When an ally near the holder is about to take a heavy blow, the holder roars to stun the attacker before it lands.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a protection and sound effect.
guardian.tag: This is a protection and sound effect.

hair.name: Hackled Mane
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder's mane bristles as it roars, and enemies who strike it while it is bristling are stunned briefly.
The bristling lasts a short time after each roar.
This is a defensive and warding effect.
hair.tag: This is a defensive and warding effect.

hammer.name: Hammerfall Roar
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder's heavy blows against stunned enemies extend the stun for a moment.
Each enemy can have its stun extended only once per roar.
This is a mastery and restraint effect.
hammer.tag: This is a mastery and restraint effect.

hand.name: Gripping Roar
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder can seize a stunned enemy within reach and throw it into others, stunning them too.
The throw costs stamina and works only on enemies the holder's size or smaller.
This is a restraint and momentum effect.
hand.tag: This is a restraint and momentum effect.

harmonic.name: Kindred Thrum
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar tunes itself to the enemies it strikes, and its weakness spreads to nearby enemies of the same kind that it did not reach.
The spread weakness is milder and lasts a short time.
This is a resonance and sound effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a resonance and sound effect.

harpy.name: Shrieking Roar
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar rises into a shrill shriek that breaks enemy concentration, interrupting any spell being cast within reach.
Interrupted enemies cannot cast for a moment, and the shriek costs mana.
This is a sound and curse effect.
harpy.tag: This is a sound and curse effect.

harvest.name: Reaping Roar
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
When an enemy weakened by the roar dies, the roar's cooldown shortens slightly.
The cooldown can shorten only a few times per roar.
This is a harvest and harvesting effect.
harvest.tag: This is a harvest and harvesting effect.

heidel.name: Steed's Bellow
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
After roaring, the holder gains a burst of running speed and can trample through stunned enemies without being blocked.
The burst lasts a short time and costs stamina.
This is a movement and momentum effect.
heidel.tag: This is a movement and momentum effect.

hook.name: Hooked Roar
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar hooks the furthest enemy it stuns and drags it to the holder.
Only the furthest enemy is dragged, and the hook costs stamina.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
hook.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

horse.name: Charger's Roar
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder can roar while running without slowing down, and its charge into stunned enemies hits harder.
The bonus applies only to charges within a short time of the roar.
This is a momentum and travel effect.
horse.tag: This is a momentum and travel effect.

hunger.name: Famished Roar
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
Enemies weakened by the roar have a portion of their health drained to the holder each time the holder strikes them.
The drain is capped per roar.
This is a harvest and affliction effect.
hunger.tag: This is a harvest and affliction effect.

hunt.name: Quarry Roar
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar marks the enemy the holder is fighting as its quarry, and the quarry cannot hide or turn invisible while the mark lasts.
Only the holder's current target is marked, and the mark lasts a short time.
This is a hunting and tracking effect.
hunt.tag: This is a hunting and tracking effect.

hydra.name: Many-Throated Roar
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
When an enemy recovers from the roar's stun, a smaller roar bursts from the holder at it, stunning it again briefly.
Each smaller roar is weaker than the last, and the chain stops at the end of the roar's weakness.
This is a sound and restraint effect.
hydra.tag: This is a sound and restraint effect.

ice.name: Glacial Roar
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar coats stunned enemies in a thin shell of ice, and they take extra damage when the shell is broken.
The shell breaks on the first hit or after a short time, and costs mana.
This is an ice and frost effect.
ice.tag: This is an ice and frost effect.

immortal.name: Undying Roar
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
Once per fight, when the holder would fall, it roars instead and clings to life for a short time.
Enemies stunned by this roar cannot attack the holder while the stun lasts.
This is a rebirth and protection effect.
immortal.tag: This is a rebirth and protection effect.

iron.name: Iron Throat
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder cannot be silenced or stopped from roaring by stuns, and its roar cannot be interrupted.
This protection applies only while the holder is roaring.
This is a defensive and sound effect.
iron.tag: This is a defensive and sound effect.

juggernaut.name: Unstoppable Roar
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
After roaring, the holder cannot be slowed, stunned or knocked back while it charges toward weakened enemies.
This lasts a short time and costs stamina.
This is a momentum and defensive effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a momentum and defensive effect.

karmic.name: Karmic Roar
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
Enemies who have harmed the holder's allies during the fight are stunned for longer by the roar.
The bonus scales with the harm each enemy has done, and resets when the fight ends.
This is a curse and sound effect.
karmic.tag: This is a curse and sound effect.

knife.name: Gutting Roar
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder's quick strikes against stunned enemies deal bonus damage from behind or from the side.
The bonus applies only while the stun lasts.
This is a hunting and mastery effect.
knife.tag: This is a hunting and mastery effect.

knowledge.name: Learned Roar
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar reveals the resistances and weaknesses of enemies it weakens to the whole party, and allies' attacks favour those weaknesses.
The revelation lasts only while the roar's weakness holds.
This is a revelation and perception effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a revelation and perception effect.

kraken.name: Kraken's Roar
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
Spectral tentacles burst from the ground where the roar passes and grip stunned enemies, holding them in place after the stun ends.
The grip lasts a short time and costs mana.
This is a binding and water effect.
kraken.tag: This is a binding and water effect.

leviathan.name: Deluge Bellow
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar crashes out like a great wave, pushing enemies back and drenching them.
Drenched enemies take extra lightning and cold damage for a short time, and the wave costs mana.
This is a water and area effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water and area effect.

life.name: Vital Roar
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
Allies within the roar's reach recover a portion of their health for each enemy the roar stuns.
The healing is capped per roar and costs mana.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
life.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

light.name: Radiant Roar
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar bursts with radiant light, blinding stunned enemies for a short time after the stun ends.
Undead and creatures of darkness take radiant damage as well, and the burst costs mana.
This is a light and radiant effect.
light.tag: This is a light and radiant effect.

lightning.name: Thunderclap Roar
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar strikes with a thunderclap, dealing lightning damage to stunned enemies.
The thunderclap costs mana and its damage scales with rank.
This is a lightning and sound effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and sound effect.

lizard.name: Hissing Roar
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
When the holder is badly hurt, its roar comes faster and the holder regrows a portion of its health over a short time.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
lizard.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

locust.name: Plague Roar
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar releases a cloud of biting insects that swarm stunned enemies, dealing slight damage over a short time.
The swarm spreads to nearby enemies when its host dies, but does not stack.
This is a swarm and affliction effect.
locust.tag: This is a swarm and affliction effect.

lotus.name: Lotus Roar
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
After roaring, the holder enters a calm stance, recovering mana and stamina for a short time while weakened enemies remain stunned.
The stance ends early if the holder takes damage.
This is a restoration and mastery effect.
lotus.tag: This is a restoration and mastery effect.

lurker.name: Lurking Roar
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
If the holder has stayed out of sight for a short time before roaring, enemies it stuns are also stricken with terror and flee briefly after the stun ends.
The terror ends if the fleeing enemy is struck.
This is a stealth and darkness effect.
lurker.tag: This is a stealth and darkness effect.

magic.name: Arcane Roar
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
Enemies weakened by the roar take extra damage from spells in particular.
The roar's mana cost rises slightly in exchange.
This is a mastery and sound effect.
magic.tag: This is a mastery and sound effect.

malign.name: Baleful Roar
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
Enemies weakened by the roar suffer a curse that makes each affliction on them last longer.
The curse fades with the weakness and costs mana.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

manatee.name: Lowing Roar
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder can roar softly, stunning enemies for a shorter time while allies within reach are soothed and slowly recover health.
The soothing roar costs mana and shares the roar's cooldown.
This is a healing and support effect.
manatee.tag: This is a healing and support effect.

manticore.name: Stinging Roar
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder's tail lashes out with the roar, firing venom spikes at the nearest stunned enemies.
The spikes poison for a short time and cost stamina.
This is a poison and venom effect.
manticore.tag: This is a poison and venom effect.

master.name: Master's Roar
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder chooses where its roar lands with care, missing allies entirely and striking enemies at the edge of its reach as hard as those at its centre.
This precision costs extra stamina.
This is a mastery and command effect.
master.tag: This is a mastery and command effect.

might.name: Mighty Roar
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder's heavy attacks against weakened enemies deal bonus damage based on its strength.
The bonus applies only while the roar's weakness lasts.
This is a mastery effect.
might.tag: This is a mastery effect.

ministration.name: Ministering Roar
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar shakes allies within reach free of stuns, sleep and fear.
The cleansing costs mana and works only on allies the roar reaches.
This is a purification and support effect.
ministration.tag: This is a purification and support effect.

minotaur.name: Labyrinth Bellow
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder can charge and roar at the end of the charge, stunning enemies in its path and where it stops.
The charge costs stamina and shares the roar's cooldown.
This is a momentum and movement effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a momentum and movement effect.

mirage.name: Phantom Roar
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar conjures illusory lions around the holder, and stunned enemies attack the illusions when they recover.
The illusions vanish when struck or after a short time.
This is a conjuration and stealth effect.
mirage.tag: This is a conjuration and stealth effect.

mirror.name: Mirrored Roar
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
When an enemy stuns the holder, the holder's next roar comes back at the enemy with an extended stun.
This happens once per fight against each enemy.
This is a sound and warding effect.
mirror.tag: This is a sound and warding effect.

monkey.name: Taunting Roar
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].

The roar blazes like the noon sun, burning stunned enemies and warming allies, who recover a little health.
The blaze costs mana and does not stack.
This is a fire and holy effect.
sun.tag: This is a fire and holy effect.

swarm.name: Swarming Roar
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar looses a swarm of insects that harass stunned enemies, dealing slight damage over a short time.
The swarm disperses when its target dies and costs mana.
This is a swarm and summoning effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and summoning effect.

swift.name: Swift Roar
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder's roar has a shorter wind-up and a slightly shorter cooldown.
Stuns from the swift roar are briefer.
This is a haste and sound effect.
swift.tag: This is a haste and sound effect.

sword.name: Blade Roar
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder's sword attacks against stunned enemies deal bonus damage and parry their next attack after the stun.
The parry happens once per enemy per roar.
This is a mastery and defensive effect.
sword.tag: This is a mastery and defensive effect.

talisman.name: Talisman Roar
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar leaves a glowing ward on allies within reach that shrugs off the next affliction placed on them.
The ward lasts a short time and costs mana.
This is a warding and protection effect.
talisman.tag: This is a warding and protection effect.

tentacle.name: Grappling Roar
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
Tentacles of shadow burst from the ground and grip stunned enemies, holding them in place briefly after the stun.
The tentacles fade after a short time.
This is a shadow and binding effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a shadow and binding effect.

thread.name: Threadbound Roar
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar binds stunned enemies together with fine threads of sound, and when any of them moves the others are tugged off balance.
The threads snap after a short time and cost mana.
This is a binding and restraint effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and restraint effect.

thunderbird.name: Stormcrest Cry
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar booms like thunder from a stormcloud, striking stunned enemies with lightning that arcs to others nearby.
The arc costs mana and its damage scales with rank.
This is a lightning and storm effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a lightning and storm effect.

time.name: Timeless Roar
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar slows time around stunned enemies, so their recovery takes longer.
The slowed time lasts only while the stun lasts and costs mana.
This is a time and restraint effect.
time.tag: This is a time and restraint effect.

tranquil.name: Tranquil Roar
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
After roaring, the holder settles into a still calm, recovering mana and stamina while stunned enemies remain stunned.
The calm ends if the holder moves or takes damage.
This is a restoration effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a restoration effect.

transfiguration.name: Shifting Roar
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar twists the bodies of stunned enemies, briefly turning lesser enemies into harmless animals.
The change lasts only while the stun lasts and costs mana.
This is a transformation and transmutation effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a transformation and transmutation effect.

transgression.name: Defiant Roar
