transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar breaks through enemy wards, auras and protective effects within reach for a short time.
Breaking through costs mana and has its own cooldown.
This is a curse and annihilation effect.
transgression.tag: This is a curse and annihilation effect.

trap.name: Snapjaw Roar
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar leaves an invisible snare of sound on the ground, and the next enemy to cross it is stunned.
Only the most recent snare remains, and it fades after a short time.
This is a trap and sound effect.
trap.tag: This is a trap and sound effect.

tree.name: Rooted Oak Roar
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
While the holder stands still after roaring, it takes slightly less damage and allies near it recover a little health.
The effect ends when the holder moves.
This is a nature and protection effect.
tree.tag: This is a nature and protection effect.

troll.name: Troll's Bellow
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
Each time the holder roars, it regenerates a portion of its health over a short time.
The regeneration stops if the holder takes fire damage.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
troll.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

trowel.name: Mason's Roar
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar shapes the ground into a low earthen wall between the holder and the nearest stunned enemy.
The wall crumbles after a short time and costs mana.
This is an earth and barrier effect.
trowel.tag: This is an earth and barrier effect.

turtle.name: Shell Roar
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
After roaring, the holder hardens its hide, taking less damage from enemies the roar has stunned.
The hardening lasts a short time.
This is a defensive and shield effect.
turtle.tag: This is a defensive and shield effect.

twilight.name: Dusk Roar
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar blends light and shadow, hiding the holder from stunned enemies while healing nearby allies slightly.
The effect lasts a short time and costs mana.
This is a shadow and light effect.
twilight.tag: This is a shadow and light effect.

undeath.name: Grave Roar
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
When an enemy dies while stunned by the roar, it rises briefly as a shade that fights for the party.
Only a few shades can stand at a time, and each fades after a short time.
This is a necromantic and summoning effect.
undeath.tag: This is a necromantic and summoning effect.

unity.name: Pride Roar
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
Allies within the roar's reach share its strength, and their attacks briefly stun enemies the roar has weakened.
The shared stun is brief and happens once per ally per roar.
This is a support and command effect.
unity.tag: This is a support and command effect.

vast.name: Vast Roar
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar reaches much further than usual, but enemies at its far edge are stunned more briefly.
The vast roar costs extra stamina.
This is an area and sound effect.
vast.tag: This is an area and sound effect.

vehicle.name: Rumbling Roar
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder can roar while moving at full speed, and stunned enemies in its path are knocked aside.
The rumbling roar costs stamina and shares the roar's cooldown.
This is a movement and momentum effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a movement and momentum effect.

venom.name: Venomous Roar
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
Poisoned enemies are stunned for longer by the roar, and their poison deals extra damage while the weakness lasts.
The bonus does not stack.
This is a poison and venom effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and venom effect.

verdant.name: Verdant Roar
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar spreads living green across its area, healing allies and slowing stunned enemies caught in grasping vines.
The growth lasts a short time and costs mana.
This is a growth and healing effect.
verdant.tag: This is a growth and healing effect.

vessel.name: Vessel Roar
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder stores a portion of the damage it takes and releases it with its next roar, adding damage to the stun.
The stored damage is capped and fades if unused.
This is a resonance and sound effect.
vessel.tag: This is a resonance and sound effect.

visage.name: Dread Countenance
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder's face twists into a terrible mask as it roars, and enemies who look at it are frightened for a short time after the stun ends.
The fright ends if the enemy is struck.
This is a curse and darkness effect.
visage.tag: This is a curse and darkness effect.

vision.name: Farsight Roar
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder sees the movements of stunned enemies a moment before they happen, dodging their first attack after the stun.
The dodge happens once per enemy per roar.
This is a precognition and evasion effect.
vision.tag: This is a precognition and evasion effect.

void.name: Void Roar
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar opens a pocket of emptiness that drains mana from stunned enemies.
The drain is capped per roar and costs mana to start.
This is a darkness and annihilation effect.
void.tag: This is a darkness and annihilation effect.

volcano.name: Eruption Roar
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar splits the ground and vents molten heat beneath stunned enemies, burning them.
The vents cool after a short time and cost mana.
This is a fire and earth effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and earth effect.

vortex.name: Whirlpool Roar
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar spins into a vortex that draws enemies toward its centre before they are stunned.
The vortex lasts a moment and costs mana.
This is a wind and area effect.
vortex.tag: This is a wind and area effect.

wasp.name: Stinging Bellow
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
Stunned enemies are stung repeatedly while the stun lasts, taking slight poison damage.
The stinging ends with the stun.
This is a poison and swarm effect.
wasp.tag: This is a poison and swarm effect.

water.name: Torrent Roar
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar carries a torrent of water that drenches stunned enemies and washes burning effects from allies.
The torrent costs mana and does not stack.
This is a water and purification effect.
water.tag: This is a water and purification effect.

weave.name: Woven Roar
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar weaves a net of sound between allies within reach, and enemies crossing it are briefly stunned.
The net lasts a short time and costs mana.
This is a binding and warding effect.
weave.tag: This is a binding and warding effect.

wendigo.name: Wendigo Howl
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar becomes a freezing, hungry howl, and stunned enemies are chilled while the holder recovers a little health from each.
The recovery is capped per roar.
This is a cold and harvest effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and harvest effect.

whale.name: Whalesong Roar
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar sinks into a deep, rolling song that carries far, stunning enemies at great range more briefly.
The song costs mana and shares the roar's cooldown.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
whale.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

wheel.name: Turning Roar
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
Each roar in a fight shortens the cooldown of the holder's other abilities slightly.
The shortening is capped per roar.
This is a time and momentum effect.
wheel.tag: This is a time and momentum effect.

whip.name: Lashing Roar
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The holder's whip and lash attacks against stunned enemies extend the stun slightly.
Each enemy's stun can be extended only a few times per roar.
This is a restraint and mastery effect.
whip.tag: This is a restraint and mastery effect.

wind.name: Squall Bellow
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar comes with a howling gale that pushes back enemies and projectiles.
The gale lasts a moment and costs stamina.
This is a wind and defensive effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and defensive effect.

wing.name: Wingbeat Roar
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar comes with a great beat of spectral wings, shoving stunned enemies away and letting the holder leap back.
The leap costs stamina and has its own cooldown.
This is a wind and movement effect.
wing.tag: This is a wind and movement effect.

wolf.name: Pack Roar
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar calls the party together, and allies near the holder deal extra damage to stunned enemies.
The bonus lasts a short time and costs stamina.
This is a hunting and support effect.
wolf.tag: This is a hunting and support effect.

wood.name: Timber Roar
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar bends nearby trees and roots, and stunned enemies are struck by falling branches.
The branches fall once per roar and cost stamina.
This is a nature and earth effect.
wood.tag: This is a nature and earth effect.

wrath.name: Seething Roar
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The more damage the holder has taken this fight, the longer the roar stuns and the more damage stunned enemies take.
The wrath resets when the fight ends.
This is a fire and curse effect.
wrath.tag: This is a fire and curse effect.

zeal.name: Zealous Roar
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
After roaring, the holder fights with zealous fervour, attacking faster against stunned enemies.
The fervour lasts a short time and costs stamina.
This is a haste and holy effect.
zeal.tag: This is a haste and holy effect.

ziz.name: Skyshaker Roar
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Leonid] ability [Leonid's Roar]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Leonid's Roar].
The roar shakes the air itself, stunning every enemy within reach and silencing their spells for a moment.
The silence costs mana and has its own cooldown.
This is a wind and sound effect.
ziz.tag: This is a wind and sound effect.

action.name: Restless Practice
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder uses one ability within a moment of using a different one, the second ability gains a little advancement.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a momentum and advancement effect.
action.tag: This is a momentum and advancement effect.

adept.name: Chosen Discipline
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While resting, the holder names a single focus ability; whenever any of its other abilities is used, the focus ability gains a sliver of advancement.
The focus can only be changed while resting.
This is a mastery and advancement effect.
adept.tag: This is a mastery and advancement effect.

alchemy.name: Distilled Drive
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder drinks a potion, the next ability it uses within a short time gains advancement drawn from the potion's potency.
This can happen once every short while.
This is an alchemy and advancement effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and advancement effect.

ambush.name: First-Strike Tutelage
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder opens a fight by striking an enemy that has not noticed it, the ability it used gains a burst of advancement.
This happens once per fight.
This is a stealth and advancement effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and advancement effect.

animate.name: Eager Apprentices
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].

Summons and animated allies under the holder's control gain advancement alongside it: each time one of the holder's abilities gains advancement, its summons grow slightly sturdier for the rest of the fight.
The sturdiness stacks only a few times.
This is an animation and advancement effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and advancement effect.

anzu.name: Stolen Destinies
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder interrupts an enemy's ability, it seizes a sliver of that enemy's purpose, and its own most-used ability gains advancement.
Its next attack after the theft crackles with lightning. The same enemy can be robbed only once per fight.
This is a lightning and advancement effect.
anzu.tag: This is a lightning and advancement effect.

ape.name: Mimic's Study
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When an ally uses an ability near the holder, the holder's ability of the same kind (attack, defence or movement) gains a sliver of advancement.
This has a cooldown for each ally.
This is a mimicry and advancement effect.
ape.tag: This is a mimicry and advancement effect.

armour.name: Battered Plate
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
At the end of each fight in which the holder was struck while wearing heavy armour, its defensive abilities gain advancement for the blows it endured.
Only the first few blows of each fight count.
This is a defensive and advancement effect.
armour.tag: This is a defensive and advancement effect.

arsenal.name: Fresh Grip
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder switches weapons, the first ability it uses afterward gains advancement and costs a little less stamina.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a mastery and advancement effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a mastery and advancement effect.

aspect.name: Rising Aspect
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, the holder briefly takes on an aspect suited to it: an attack ability grants extra damage, a defensive one grants resistance, and any other grants speed.
The aspect lasts a short time.
This is a transformation and advancement effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation and advancement effect.

avatar.name: Exemplar's Ascent
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, nearby allies are inspired, and each of their abilities gains a sliver of advancement.
Allies must be close enough to witness it.
This is a support and advancement effect.
avatar.tag: This is a support and advancement effect.

axe.name: Notched Haft
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each enemy the holder cuts down with a heavy blow carves a notch into its weapon.
At a few notches, the holder's next ability is empowered, and the notches are spent as advancement for that ability.
This is a mastery and impact effect.
axe.tag: This is a mastery and impact effect.

balance.name: Measured Ambition
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Whenever one of the holder's abilities gains advancement, its least-advanced ability gains a sliver as well.
This only works while the two abilities are several ranks apart.
This is a balance and advancement effect.
balance.tag: This is a balance and advancement effect.

bat.name: Night-Ear Study
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder detects a hidden enemy, its next ability against that enemy gains advancement and deals a little extra damage.
This happens once for each hidden enemy.
This is a perception and advancement effect.
bat.tag: This is a perception and advancement effect.

battlefield.name: Veteran of the Line
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each ability the holder uses gains advancement that scales with the number of enemies in the fight.
The bonus is capped and only counts enemies that are still standing.
This is an area and advancement effect.
battlefield.tag: This is an area and advancement effect.

bear.name: Winter Den Growth
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
A portion of the advancement the holder earns during a delve is set aside in a bank.
When the holder rests at a camp, the bank is released into its abilities with a little extra on top.
This is a restoration and advancement effect.
bear.tag: This is a restoration and advancement effect.

bee.name: Hive Diligence
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Every ability the holder uses adds a drop of effort to a store.
When the store fills, its contents are shared out as advancement among all of the holder's abilities, and it empties.
This is a growth and advancement effect.
bee.tag: This is a growth and advancement effect.

behemoth.name: Giant's Lesson
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder helps defeat a huge enemy, every ability it used in that fight gains a large portion of advancement.
Only the largest enemies count.
This is a hunting and advancement effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a hunting and advancement effect.

bird.name: Fledgling's Leap
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, the holder gains a brief burst of movement speed and can leap over low obstacles.
The burst lasts a short time.
This is a wind and advancement effect.
bird.tag: This is a wind and advancement effect.

blight.name: Creeping Proficiency
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each time an affliction the holder applied deals damage, the ability that applied it gains a sliver of advancement.
Only a few afflictions per enemy count at once.
This is an affliction and advancement effect.
blight.tag: This is an affliction and advancement effect.

blood.name: Sweat and Blood
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The holder can pay a sliver of health when it uses an ability to give that ability a burst of advancement.
This cannot be done while the holder is badly wounded.
This is a blood and advancement effect.
blood.tag: This is a blood and advancement effect.

bone.name: Ossified Resolve
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each time one of the holder's abilities ranks up, its frame hardens, granting a little armour for the rest of the delve.
The armour stacks only a few times.
This is a defensive and advancement effect.
bone.tag: This is a defensive and advancement effect.

boundary.name: Edge of Limits
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder uses an ability while its mana is nearly empty, that ability gains a burst of advancement.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a mana and advancement effect.
boundary.tag: This is a mana and advancement effect.

bounty.name: Insight Spoils
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Enemies the holder defeats drop a mote of insight that any party member can collect.
The collector's most recently used ability gains a little advancement.
This is a harvest and support effect.
bounty.tag: This is a harvest and support effect.

bow.name: Distant Mark
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities that hit an enemy at long range gain advancement that scales with the distance of the shot.
The bonus is capped and only counts hits that land.
This is a precision and advancement effect.
bow.tag: This is a precision and advancement effect.

brush.name: Painted Triumph
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
At the end of each fight, the holder's ability that dealt the most damage or healing gains a stroke of advancement.
Ties go to the ability used last.
This is a reflection and advancement effect.
brush.tag: This is a reflection and advancement effect.

cage.name: Straining Captive
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While the holder is rooted or bound, each attempt it makes to break free adds advancement to its movement abilities.
When it breaks loose, it gains a brief burst of speed.
This is a binding and advancement effect.
cage.tag: This is a binding and advancement effect.

cat.name: Curious Pounce
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The first time the holder uses an ability against a type of enemy it has never fought, that ability gains a burst of advancement.
This happens once for each enemy type.
This is a knowledge and hunting effect.
cat.tag: This is a knowledge and hunting effect.

cataclysm.name: Sweeping Ambition
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities strikes several enemies at once, it gains advancement for each enemy struck.
The bonus is capped for each use.
This is an annihilation and advancement effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an annihilation and advancement effect.

cattle.name: Steady Yoke
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each fight the holder finishes without falling adds a stack of steady work.
At several stacks, its lowest-ranked ability gains a large portion of advancement and the stacks reset. Falling clears all stacks.
This is an endurance and advancement effect.
cattle.tag: This is an endurance and advancement effect.

chain.name: Linked Drills
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each ability hit the holder lands within a moment of the last adds a link to a chain.
When the chain breaks, every ability in it gains advancement equal to its length.
This is a momentum and advancement effect.
chain.tag: This is a momentum and advancement effect.

chaotic.name: Fickle Fixation
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
At the start of each fight, one of the holder's abilities is chosen at random as its fixation.
Every ability the holder uses in that fight adds a sliver of advancement to the fixation.
This is a chaos and advancement effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a chaos and advancement effect.

charlatan.name: Inflated Reputation
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The holder carries itself like a seasoned champion, and weak enemies sometimes hesitate before attacking it.
Abilities the holder uses on a hesitating enemy gain a little advancement.
This is an illusion and advancement effect.
charlatan.tag: This is an illusion and advancement effect.

chicken.name: Pecking Order Climb
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder defeats an enemy of a higher level, all abilities it used in that fight gain advancement.
The bonus scales with the gap in level.
This is a rivalry and advancement effect.
chicken.tag: This is a rivalry and advancement effect.

chimera.name: Grafted Lessons
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder uses abilities from two different essences back to back, the second ability gains a sliver of advancement.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a transformation and advancement effect.
chimera.tag: This is a transformation and advancement effect.

claw.name: Clawing Ascent
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, the cooldowns of its other abilities are shortened by a portion.
This happens only during a fight.
This is a haste and advancement effect.
claw.tag: This is a haste and advancement effect.

cloth.name: Mended Seams
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While resting, the holder can mend its gear and reflect on the day; the ability it used most that day gains advancement.
This works once per rest.
This is a crafting and advancement effect.
cloth.tag: This is a crafting and advancement effect.

cloud.name: Silver-Lined Rank
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, it also grants a random boon for the rest of the fight: mana recovery, stamina recovery or a sliver of evasion.
The boon is hidden until the rank is reached.
This is a mystery and advancement effect.
cloud.tag: This is a mystery and advancement effect.

cold.name: Cold Calculation
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder lands on a slowed or frozen enemy gain a little advancement.
The same enemy can only provide this once every short while.
This is a frost and advancement effect.
cold.tag: This is a frost and advancement effect.

coral.name: Accreted Will
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Every fight the holder survives lays down a thin layer of progress on each ability it used.
When an ability ranks up, those layers harden into a brief shell that absorbs part of the next hit.
This is a growth and defensive effect.
coral.tag: This is a growth and defensive effect.

corrupt.name: Tainted Bargain
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The holder can drain the advancement from one of its abilities to greatly empower the next use of another.
The drained advancement is lost.
This is a curse and mastery effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a curse and mastery effect.

crocodile.name: Waiting Jaws
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The longer the holder goes without using an ability in a fight, the larger the advancement its first use gains.
The build-up is capped and resets once the ability is used.
This is a hunting and advancement effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a hunting and advancement effect.

crystal.name: Faceted Milestone
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, a small crystal forms and orbits the holder.
The holder can shatter the crystal to reset that ability's cooldown once. The crystal fades when the fight ends.
This is a crystal and advancement effect.
crystal.tag: This is a crystal and advancement effect.

cycle.name: Ability in Season
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each fight, one of the holder's abilities comes into season, in a fixed rotation.
The ability in season gains advancement each time it is used.
This is a time and advancement effect.
cycle.tag: This is a time and advancement effect.

dance.name: Rehearsed Routine
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The holder's last three abilities form a routine.
When the holder repeats the same routine in order, each ability in it gains advancement.
This is a rhythm and advancement effect.
dance.tag: This is a rhythm and advancement effect.

dark.name: Unseen Practice
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder uses while no ally can see it gain a little advancement.
This only works while the holder is out of every ally's sight.
This is a shadow and advancement effect.
dark.tag: This is a shadow and advancement effect.

dawn.name: Morning Resolve
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The first ability the holder uses each day gains a burst of advancement.
The holder also starts its first fight of the day with full stamina.
This is a light and advancement effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and advancement effect.

death.name: Lessons of the Fallen
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder falls in a fight, every ability it used in that fight gains advancement from the defeat.
This happens once per fight.
This is a death and advancement effect.
death.tag: This is a death and advancement effect.

deep.name: Downward Drive
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder uses gain a little advancement that scales with how deep in the dungeon it is.
The bonus only applies below the first floor.
This is a depth and advancement effect.
deep.tag: This is a depth and advancement effect.

deer.name: Charging Antlers
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, its next movement ability ends in a charge that staggers the first enemy it meets.
The charge must be used before the fight ends.
This is a momentum and advancement effect.
deer.tag: This is a momentum and advancement effect.

desolate.name: Lone Climb
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While no ally stands near the holder, every ability it uses gains a little advancement.
The bonus ends the moment an ally comes close.
This is a solitude and advancement effect.
desolate.tag: This is a solitude and advancement effect.

dimension.name: Portal-Sharpened Mind
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder uses within a moment of teleporting or stepping through a portal gain advancement.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a dimensional and advancement effect.
dimension.tag: This is a dimensional and advancement effect.

discord.name: Broken Cadence Study
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder interrupts an enemy's attack or ability, the interrupting ability gains advancement.
The same enemy can only provide this once every short while.
This is a sound and advancement effect.
discord.tag: This is a sound and advancement effect.

discordant.name: Jealous Refrain
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When an ally lands a heavy hit, the holder's competitive streak flares, and its next ability is slightly empowered.
This has a cooldown.
This is a sound and rivalry effect.
discordant.tag: This is a sound and rivalry effect.

dog.name: Faithful Apprentice
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the party leader's ability ranks up, the holder's matching ability gains a sliver of advancement.
This only works while the holder is near the party leader.
This is a loyalty and advancement effect.
dog.tag: This is a loyalty and advancement effect.

doom.name: Defiant Reckoning
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The holder can mark the most dangerous enemy in a fight as its reckoning.
If the holder is still standing when the marked enemy falls, every ability it used gains a large portion of advancement; if it falls first, the mark is lost.
This is a fate and advancement effect.
doom.tag: This is a fate and advancement effect.

doppelganger.name: Mirror Rival
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Once per fight, a shadow of the holder appears and duels it for a short time.
If the holder defeats its shadow, its most-used ability gains a burst of advancement.
This is an illusion and rivalry effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is an illusion and rivalry effect.

dragon.name: Hoarded Glory
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each rank the holder's abilities reach adds a coin to its hoard of glory.
Each coin grants a little damage, up to a cap.
This is a pride and advancement effect.
dragon.tag: This is a pride and advancement effect.

duck.name: Unruffled Persistence
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities is interrupted, its cooldown resets and it gains a sliver of advancement.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a water and persistence effect.
duck.tag: This is a water and persistence effect.

dust.name: Road Dust Ledger
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each fight leaves a layer of dust on the holder's gear.
While resting, the holder brushes it off, and its least-used ability gains advancement for each layer.
This is a travel and advancement effect.
dust.tag: This is a travel and advancement effect.

earth.name: Bedrock Diligence
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While the holder stands its ground without moving, each ability it uses gains a little advancement.
Moving any real distance ends the effect for a short time.
This is an earth and advancement effect.
earth.tag: This is an earth and advancement effect.

echo.name: Resounding Rank
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, the next use of that ability repeats once at reduced effect.
The echo only happens once per rank.
This is a sound and advancement effect.
echo.tag: This is a sound and advancement effect.

eclipse.name: Shadowed Zenith
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While the holder's health is below half and its mana above half, or the reverse, its abilities gain a little advancement.
The bonus ends when both are on the same side of half.
This is a light, shadow and advancement effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a light, shadow and advancement effect.

edifice.name: Laid Foundations
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each rank the holder's abilities reach during a delve lays a stone.
At several stones, all of the holder's abilities gain a small bonus to effect for the rest of the delve.
This is a construction and advancement effect.
edifice.tag: This is a construction and advancement effect.

effigy.name: Effigy of the Old Self
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, an effigy of the holder rises where it stands and draws enemy attacks for a short time.
The effigy crumbles after a few hits.
This is an effigy and advancement effect.
effigy.tag: This is an effigy and advancement effect.

elemental.name: Weakness Scholar
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder hits an enemy's elemental weakness with an ability, that ability gains advancement.
The same enemy can only provide this once every short while.
This is an elemental and advancement effect.
elemental.tag: This is an elemental and advancement effect.

elixir.name: Brewed Ambition
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder drinks a potion it does not need, such as healing at full health, the potion's power becomes advancement for its most recently used ability.
This can happen once every short while.
This is an alchemy and advancement effect.
elixir.tag: This is an alchemy and advancement effect.

empower.name: Crowning Surge
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, the next use of each of its abilities is slightly empowered.
The empowerment fades at the end of the fight.
This is an empowerment and advancement effect.
empower.tag: This is an empowerment and advancement effect.

eye.name: Studied Opponent
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
After the holder watches an enemy use an ability, its own abilities deal a little extra damage to that enemy and gain advancement when they hit it.
The study lasts until the enemy falls.
This is a perception and advancement effect.
eye.tag: This is a perception and advancement effect.

feast.name: Well-Fed Vigour
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
After the holder eats a meal at rest, its abilities gain a little advancement for the next few fights.
Eating again refreshes the effect but does not stack it.
This is a feast and advancement effect.
feast.tag: This is a feast and advancement effect.

feeble.name: Underdog's Hunger
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While the holder is fighting an enemy of a higher level, its abilities gain advancement when they hit that enemy.
The bonus scales with the gap in level.
This is a rivalry and advancement effect.
feeble.tag: This is a rivalry and advancement effect.

fertile.name: Sown Promise
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, a seed of progress is planted in its least-advanced ability.
The seed grows into advancement over the next few fights.
This is a growth and advancement effect.
fertile.tag: This is a growth and advancement effect.

fey.name: Fey Wager
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While resting, the holder can strike a fey wager: an ability of its choice gains advancement at once.
Abilities cost a little extra mana during the next fight.
This is a bargain and advancement effect.
fey.tag: This is a bargain and advancement effect.

fire.name: Kindled Ambition
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each ability the holder uses in a fight adds heat.
At full heat, the holder's abilities deal fire damage for a short time and each gains a little advancement. The heat then resets.
This is a fire and advancement effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire and advancement effect.

firebird.name: Risen Resolve
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder is revived after falling, its abilities gain advancement and its next ability is empowered.
This happens once per fight.
This is a rebirth and advancement effect.
firebird.tag: This is a rebirth and advancement effect.

fish.name: Against the Current
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder uses while slowed or being pushed gain a little advancement.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a water and advancement effect.
fish.tag: This is a water and advancement effect.

flea.name: Host-Hopper's Drive
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder switches to a new target, its next ability against that target gains a little advancement.
This has a cooldown for each enemy.
This is a hunting and advancement effect.
flea.tag: This is a hunting and advancement effect.

flesh.name: Muscle Memory
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each time the holder repeats an ability in a fight, it gains a stack of memory for that ability.
At several stacks, the ability costs a little less stamina and mana for the rest of the fight.
This is a mastery and endurance effect.
flesh.tag: This is a mastery and endurance effect.

foot.name: Miles in the Legs
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Distance the holder travels on foot adds advancement to its movement abilities.
Only travel outside of combat counts.
This is a travel and advancement effect.
foot.tag: This is a travel and advancement effect.

force.name: Driving Push
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities that knock an enemy back gain advancement that scales with how far the enemy was pushed.
The bonus is capped for each use.
This is a force and advancement effect.
force.tag: This is a force and advancement effect.

forge.name: Anvil-Struck Will
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder uses while its stamina is low gain advancement, hammered into shape by strain.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a forge and advancement effect.
forge.tag: This is a forge and advancement effect.

fork.name: Crossroads Choice
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, the holder chooses one of two boons for that ability for the rest of the day: a lower cost or extra damage.
The choice cannot be changed until the next day.
This is a choice and advancement effect.
fork.tag: This is a choice and advancement effect.

fortress.name: Rampart Pride
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's defensive abilities prevents damage to an ally, that ability gains advancement.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a protection and advancement effect.
fortress.tag: This is a protection and advancement effect.

fox.name: Sly Lessons
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder strikes an enemy from behind or while it targets someone else, the ability it used gains advancement.
This has a cooldown for each enemy.
This is a stealth and advancement effect.
fox.tag: This is a stealth and advancement effect.

frog.name: Bounding Progress
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Sometimes, when one of the holder's abilities gains advancement, it leaps forward by a large amount instead.
This can happen only once every long while.
This is a luck and advancement effect.
frog.tag: This is a luck and advancement effect.

fungus.name: Spore-Borne Insight
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, spores carry a sliver of advancement to the matching ability of every nearby ally.
Allies must be close by when the rank is reached.
This is a growth and support effect.
fungus.tag: This is a growth and support effect.

garuda.name: Serpent-Slayer's Pride
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder uses against serpents, reptiles and venomous enemies gain advancement.
The holder also shakes off poison slightly faster while fighting them.
This is a hunting and advancement effect.
garuda.tag: This is a hunting and advancement effect.

gate.name: Threshold Eagerness
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder enters a new area or floor, its next few abilities gain advancement.
This only happens the first time it enters each area.
This is a travel and advancement effect.
gate.tag: This is a travel and advancement effect.

gathering.name: Gleaned Experience
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder picks up loot or gathers a resource, its most recently used ability gains a sliver of advancement.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a harvest and advancement effect.
gathering.tag: This is a harvest and advancement effect.

glass.name: Glass Ascent
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While the holder has not been struck in a fight, each ability it uses gains a little advancement.
The first hit it takes shatters the effect until the next fight.
This is a glass and advancement effect.
glass.tag: This is a glass and advancement effect.

glimeron.name: Glimmer of the Next Rank
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities is close to ranking up, it glimmers, and its uses deal a little extra damage.
The glimmer fades once the rank is reached.
This is a light and advancement effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a light and advancement effect.

goat.name: Summit Seeker
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder uses while standing above its target on high ground gain advancement.
This only works where the ground truly rises.
This is a terrain and advancement effect.
goat.tag: This is a terrain and advancement effect.

gorgon.name: Stony Fixation
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Enemies struck by the holder's most-used ability are briefly slowed as if turning to stone.
Each slowed enemy adds a sliver of advancement to that ability. This has a cooldown for each enemy.
This is a curse and advancement effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a curse and advancement effect.

griffin.name: Stolen-Glory Talon
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder lands the final blow on an enemy that an ally was fighting, the ability it used gains advancement.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a pride and rivalry effect.
griffin.tag: This is a pride and rivalry effect.

growth.name: Ever-Reaching Grasp
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each rank an area ability reaches widens its area slightly.
The widening is capped.
This is a growth and area effect.
growth.tag: This is a growth and area effect.

guardian.name: Sworn Shield's Reward
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder saves an ally from a blow that would fell them, all of its abilities gain advancement.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a protection and advancement effect.
guardian.tag: This is a protection and advancement effect.

hair.name: Victory Braids
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each time one of the holder's abilities ranks up, it adds a braid to its hair.
Each braid grants a sliver of resistance to harmful effects, up to a cap. The braids are undone when the delve ends.
This is a defensive and advancement effect.
hair.tag: This is a defensive and advancement effect.

hammer.name: Hammered Repetition
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Using the same ability on the same enemy several times in a row builds advancement for that ability.
The last strike in the series staggers the enemy. Changing abilities or targets resets the series.
This is an impact and advancement effect.
hammer.tag: This is an impact and advancement effect.

hand.name: Helping Hand Drill
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder heals or aids an ally, the ability it used gains advancement, and the ally's next ability is slightly empowered.
This has a cooldown for each ally.
This is a support and advancement effect.
hand.tag: This is a support and advancement effect.

harmonic.name: Shared Cadence
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities hits an enemy at the same moment as an ally's ability, both abilities gain a sliver of advancement.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a resonance and support effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a resonance and support effect.

harpy.name: Spurred by Scorn
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When an enemy taunts or strikes the holder, its next ability gains a little advancement out of spite.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a sound and rivalry effect.
harpy.tag: This is a sound and rivalry effect.

harvest.name: Reaping the Season
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
At the end of each fight, the holder reaps a little advancement from each enemy it defeated.
The advancement goes to the abilities that landed the final blows.
This is a harvest and advancement effect.
harvest.tag: This is a harvest and advancement effect.

heidel.name: Quarry Pursuit
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While resting, the holder names a type of enemy as its quarry.
Abilities the holder uses against that quarry gain advancement until it rests again.
This is a hunting and tracking effect.
heidel.tag: This is a hunting and tracking effect.

hook.name: Reeled Prize
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Enemies the holder hits with an ability are hooked for a short time.
When a hooked enemy is defeated, the ability that hooked it has its cooldown shortened.
This is a binding and haste effect.
hook.tag: This is a binding and haste effect.

horse.name: Galloping Debut
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
If the holder's first ability in a fight is used while it is running, that ability is empowered and gains advancement.
This happens once per fight.
This is a momentum and advancement effect.
horse.tag: This is a momentum and advancement effect.

hunger.name: Gnawing Want
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each fight in which none of the holder's abilities ranks up adds a pang of want.
Each pang adds advancement to every ability the holder uses in the next fight, until one ranks up and the pangs clear.
This is a hunger and advancement effect.
hunger.tag: This is a hunger and advancement effect.

hunt.name: Trophy Pursuit
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
At the start of each delve, the holder chooses one strong enemy as its trophy.
Defeating it grants a large portion of advancement and a trophy that grants a little damage for the rest of the delve.
This is a hunting and advancement effect.
hunt.tag: This is a hunting and advancement effect.

hydra.name: Twice-Grown Will
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities is interrupted, its next two abilities are slightly empowered.
This has a cooldown.
This is a resilience and empowerment effect.
hydra.tag: This is a resilience and empowerment effect.

ice.name: Rime-Clear Mind
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, its cooldown is held at zero for a moment.
The holder can use that ability freely until the moment passes.
This is an ice and haste effect.
ice.tag: This is an ice and haste effect.

immortal.name: Long View
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
At the end of each fight, the holder's highest-ranked ability passes a sliver of its experience as advancement to its lowest-ranked ability.
This only happens when the two abilities are several ranks apart.
This is a time and advancement effect.
immortal.tag: This is a time and advancement effect.

iron.name: Ironbound Routine
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each fight in which the holder uses every one of its abilities at least once grants all of them a little advancement.
Abilities that cannot be used in combat do not count.
This is a discipline and advancement effect.
iron.tag: This is a discipline and advancement effect.

juggernaut.name: Unstoppable Rise
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each enemy the holder passes through or knocks aside with a charge adds advancement to that charge ability.
The bonus is capped for each charge.
This is a momentum and advancement effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a momentum and advancement effect.

karmic.name: Repaid Kindness
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each time the holder heals or rescues an ally, the next advancement one of its abilities earns is increased.
This stacks a few times.
This is a karmic and advancement effect.
karmic.tag: This is a karmic and advancement effect.

knife.name: Keen Edge Lessons
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities lands a critical hit, it gains advancement.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a precision and advancement effect.
knife.tag: This is a precision and advancement effect.

knowledge.name: Scholar's Ambition
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Books and lore the holder reads while resting grant advancement to an ability of its choice.
Each book counts only once.
This is a knowledge and advancement effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a knowledge and advancement effect.

kraken.name: Essence-Grasping Arms
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder defeats an enemy, it seizes a portion of that enemy's essence, and its next ability is empowered.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a binding and empowerment effect.
kraken.tag: This is a binding and empowerment effect.

leviathan.name: Deepwater Challenge
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
During a fight against a boss, each phase of the fight the holder survives grants advancement to every ability it used in that phase.
Only bosses with distinct phases count.
This is a challenge and advancement effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a challenge and advancement effect.

life.name: Brimming Mender's Lesson
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Healing from the holder's abilities that goes beyond a target's full health becomes advancement for the ability that cast it.
The bonus is capped for each use.
This is a healing and advancement effect.
life.tag: This is a healing and advancement effect.

light.name: Radiant Milestone
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, the holder flares with light, revealing hidden enemies nearby and dazzling those close to it.
The dazzle lasts a short time.
This is a light and revelation effect.
light.tag: This is a light and revelation effect.

lightning.name: Flash of Insight
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Sometimes, when the holder uses an ability, a flash of insight strikes: the ability gains a burst of advancement and its cooldown resets.
This can happen only once every long while.
This is a lightning and advancement effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and advancement effect.

lizard.name: Shed-Skin Growth
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder shakes off a harmful effect, its most recently used ability gains a sliver of advancement.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a regeneration and advancement effect.
lizard.tag: This is a regeneration and advancement effect.

locust.name: Gleaning Swarm
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When an ally defeats an enemy near the holder, the holder gleans what is left, and its most recently used ability gains a sliver of advancement.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a swarm and advancement effect.
locust.tag: This is a swarm and advancement effect.

lotus.name: Still-Water Contemplation
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder meditates while resting, the first use of each of its abilities in the next fight gains advancement.
Meditation takes the whole rest and cannot be combined with eating.
This is a serenity and advancement effect.
lotus.tag: This is a serenity and advancement effect.

lurker.name: Patient Observer
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While the holder is hidden, each enemy it watches for a moment adds a sliver of advancement to its next ability.
The store is spent on the first ability the holder uses from hiding.
This is a stealth and knowledge effect.
lurker.tag: This is a stealth and knowledge effect.

magic.name: Mana-Hungry Study
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Spells the holder casts gain advancement that scales with their mana cost.
The bonus is capped for each cast.
This is a magic and advancement effect.
magic.tag: This is a magic and advancement effect.

malign.name: Covetous Hex
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Once per fight, the holder can hex an enemy as its rival.
Every ability the holder lands on the rival gains advancement, and the rival's abilities cost it extra while the hex lasts.
This is a curse and rivalry effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and rivalry effect.

manatee.name: Gentle Mentorship
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder rests beside an ally, the least-used ability of each of them gains a little advancement.
This works once per rest.
This is a support and advancement effect.
manatee.tag: This is a support and advancement effect.

manticore.name: Barbed Trophies
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each enemy the holder defeats adds a barb to its collection, up to a few.
The holder can spend all its barbs to empower its next ability with poison, and that ability gains advancement for each barb spent.
This is a poison and advancement effect.
manticore.tag: This is a poison and advancement effect.

master.name: Peak Mastery
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each time one of the holder's abilities ranks up, it gains a mastery stack that lowers its cost for the rest of the delve.
Mastery stacks are capped.
This is a mastery and advancement effect.
master.tag: This is a mastery and advancement effect.

might.name: Proving Strength
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Heavy abilities that knock an enemy down gain advancement.
The same enemy can only provide this once every short while.
This is a might and advancement effect.
might.tag: This is a might and advancement effect.

ministration.name: Close-Call Care
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder heals a badly wounded ally, the healing ability gains advancement that scales with how close the ally was to falling.
This has a cooldown for each ally.
This is a healing and advancement effect.
ministration.tag: This is a healing and advancement effect.

minotaur.name: Cornered Bull
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While the holder is surrounded or backed against a wall, its abilities deal a little extra damage and gain advancement.
The effect ends once it breaks free.
This is a fury and advancement effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a fury and advancement effect.

mirage.name: Promised Horizon
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities is close to ranking up, the holder can glimpse the next rank: for one use, the ability works at that rank.
Afterwards, the ability gains no advancement for a short time.
This is an illusion and advancement effect.
mirage.tag: This is an illusion and advancement effect.

mirror.name: Honest Reflection
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
At the end of each fight, the holder's ability that missed most often gains advancement as it learns from its mistakes.
Abilities that never missed are not chosen.
This is a reflection and advancement effect.
mirror.tag: This is a reflection and advancement effect.

monkey.name: Restless Climber
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder vaults or climbs during a fight, its next ability gains a little advancement and costs less stamina.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a movement and advancement effect.
monkey.tag: This is a movement and advancement effect.

monolith.name: Standing Stone Routine
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each fight that the holder opens with the same ability adds to a routine for that ability.
The longer the routine runs, the more advancement that ability gains when it opens a fight. Opening with a different ability breaks the routine.
This is a discipline and advancement effect.
monolith.tag: This is a discipline and advancement effect.

moon.name: Waxing Aspiration
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The holder's drive waxes and wanes with the moon.
Under a waxing or full moon, its abilities gain a little advancement; under a new moon, it gains a little mana recovery instead.
This is a lunar and advancement effect.
moon.tag: This is a lunar and advancement effect.

mouse.name: Nibbling Persistence
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each small hit the holder lands on an enemy adds a nibble.
At several nibbles on one enemy, the holder's next ability against it gains advancement and ignores a portion of its armour.
This is a persistence and advancement effect.
mouse.tag: This is a persistence and advancement effect.

myriad.name: Thousandfold Attempts
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each different ability the holder uses within a short time adds to a count.
At a high count, the cooldowns of all of the holder's abilities are shortened by a portion and the count resets.
This is a mastery and haste effect.
myriad.tag: This is a mastery and haste effect.

mystic.name: Warded Understanding
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder resists a spell, its magical abilities gain a little advancement.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a magic and advancement effect.
mystic.tag: This is a magic and advancement effect.

nebula.name: Newborn Star
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, a small star forms and orbits the holder.
The holder's next ability consumes the star and is empowered by it.
This is a star and advancement effect.
nebula.tag: This is a star and advancement effect.

needle.name: Pinpoint Aim
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
At the start of each fight, the holder picks a weak point on one enemy.
Striking that weak point with an ability grants that ability a burst of advancement.
This is a precision and advancement effect.
needle.tag: This is a precision and advancement effect.

nemesis.name: Sworn Rivalry
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The holder names a type of enemy as its nemesis.
Each nemesis the holder defeats grants advancement and adds a little damage against that type, up to a cap. The nemesis can only be changed once per delve.
This is a rivalry and advancement effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a rivalry and advancement effect.

net.name: Netted Lessons
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When an ally's ability misses near the holder, the holder learns from the mistake, and its own ability of the same kind gains a sliver of advancement.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a binding and knowledge effect.
net.tag: This is a binding and knowledge effect.

network.name: Shared Ascent
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Whenever any party member's ability ranks up, every ability of every party member gains a sliver of advancement.
The holder must be in the party for this to work.
This is a support and advancement effect.
network.tag: This is a support and advancement effect.

oasis.name: Hard-Won Respite
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
After a long, hard fight, the holder's next rest grants advancement to every ability it used in that fight.
Only fights that left the holder badly wounded count.
This is a restoration and advancement effect.
oasis.tag: This is a restoration and advancement effect.

ocean.name: Rising Swell
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each ability the holder uses adds a wave to a swell.
Every few waves, the holder's next ability crashes with extra force and gains advancement.
This is a water and momentum effect.
ocean.tag: This is a water and momentum effect.

octopus.name: Eight-Armed Industry
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder uses two abilities at nearly the same moment, both gain advancement.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a mastery and advancement effect.
octopus.tag: This is a mastery and advancement effect.

omen.name: Foretold Calling
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
At the start of each delve, an omen names one of the holder's abilities.
That ability gains advancement each time it is used during the delve.
This is a precognition and advancement effect.
omen.tag: This is a precognition and advancement effect.

onslaught.name: Relentless Climb
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While the holder keeps attacking without pause, advancement builds up in a store.
When it stops, the store is divided among the abilities it used.
This is a momentum and advancement effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a momentum and advancement effect.

pangolin.name: Weathered Scales
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder survives being surrounded by several enemies, its defensive abilities gain advancement.
This happens once per fight.
This is a defensive and advancement effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a defensive and advancement effect.

paper.name: Written Resolution
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While resting, the holder writes down a goal, such as using a chosen ability a set number of times.
Meeting the goal before the next rest grants that ability a large portion of advancement.
This is a goal and advancement effect.
paper.tag: This is a goal and advancement effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Dreams of Grandeur
