phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While sleeping at rest, the holder dreams of its abilities at their next rank.
On waking, the first use of each of its abilities in the next fight is empowered.
This is a dream and empowerment effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is a dream and empowerment effect.

phoenix.name: Kindled Ascension
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, the holder heals a little and burns away a harmful effect.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a fire and rebirth effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a fire and rebirth effect.

plant.name: Patient Sprouting
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each day, every one of the holder's abilities gains a little advancement, whether it was used or not.
The growth happens when the holder rests.
This is a growth and nature effect.
plant.tag: This is a growth and nature effect.

potent.name: Measure of Might
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each use of the holder's abilities gains advancement that scales with the damage or healing it deals in that single use.
The bonus is capped for each use.
This is a mastery and advancement effect.
potent.tag: This is a mastery and advancement effect.

predatory.name: Apex Appetite
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder uses against elite or champion enemies gain advancement.
The holder also moves slightly faster toward such enemies.
This is a hunting and advancement effect.
predatory.tag: This is a hunting and advancement effect.

prison.name: Sealed Discipline
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While resting, the holder can seal one of its abilities for the next fight.
While it is sealed, every other ability the holder uses gains advancement.
This is a binding and advancement effect.
prison.tag: This is a binding and advancement effect.

prosperity.name: Coin and Climb
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Gold the holder earns from fights adds a little advancement to the ability it used most in that fight.
The bonus is capped for each fight.
This is a prosperity and advancement effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a prosperity and advancement effect.

pure.name: Cleansing Purpose
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder lands on cursed or corrupted enemies gain advancement.
The same enemy can only provide this once every short while.
This is a purification and advancement effect.
pure.tag: This is a purification and advancement effect.

rabbit.name: Burrow-Quick Start
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The first few uses of each of the holder's abilities in a fight gain a little advancement.
Later uses in the same fight gain none of this bonus.
This is a haste and advancement effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a haste and advancement effect.

rake.name: Raked Effort
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each time one of the holder's abilities misses, the effort is scattered on the ground.
At the end of the fight, the holder rakes it up, and each ability that missed gains a little advancement.
This is a harvest and advancement effect.
rake.tag: This is a harvest and advancement effect.

rat.name: Narrow Escape Wisdom
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each time the holder survives a fight with very little health left, all of its abilities gain advancement.
This happens once per fight.
This is a survival and advancement effect.
rat.tag: This is a survival and advancement effect.

reagent.name: Experimental Pairing
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While resting, the holder can pair two of its abilities for the next fight.
Using the pair back to back adds a small combined effect, and both abilities gain advancement.
This is an alchemy and mastery effect.
reagent.tag: This is an alchemy and mastery effect.

refracting.name: Spectrum of Triumph
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, the moment splits into colours, and each nearby ally gains a different brief boon: speed, resistance or damage.
The boons last a short time.
This is a light and support effect.
refracting.tag: This is a light and support effect.

renewal.name: Restored Purpose
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder recovers from badly wounded to full health during a fight, all of its abilities gain advancement.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a restoration and advancement effect.
renewal.tag: This is a restoration and advancement effect.

resolute.name: Unyielding Resolve
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each time one of the holder's abilities misses or is resisted, it gains a stack of resolve.
At several stacks, its next ability cannot miss and gains advancement.
This is a determination and advancement effect.
resolute.tag: This is a determination and advancement effect.

resonating.name: Sympathetic Ringing
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, its other abilities from the same essence gain a portion of advancement.
This only counts abilities from the same essence.
This is a resonance and advancement effect.
resonating.tag: This is a resonance and advancement effect.

roc.name: Lifted by Triumph
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, a gust lifts the holder, and it can move to a nearby spot over enemies and obstacles.
The lift must be used within a short time.
This is a wind and movement effect.
roc.tag: This is a wind and movement effect.

rune.name: Inscribed Ranks
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each rank the holder's abilities reach during a delve inscribes a rune.
The holder can spend a rune to empower a single ability use.
This is a rune and empowerment effect.
rune.tag: This is a rune and empowerment effect.

sacrifice.name: Vow Over the Fallen
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When an ally falls, the holder's abilities gain advancement, and its next few abilities are slightly empowered.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a sacrifice and resolve effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a sacrifice and resolve effect.

sand.name: Hourglass Effort
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
During a fight, advancement collects like sand in an hourglass.
At fixed intervals the glass turns, and the sand is poured into the ability the holder used most since the last turn.
This is a time and advancement effect.
sand.tag: This is a time and advancement effect.

sceptre.name: Rightful Command
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder gives the party a command, its abilities gain advancement for each ally who follows it.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a command and advancement effect.
sceptre.tag: This is a command and advancement effect.

scribe.name: Annotated Journal
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The holder records every ability it uses in a fight.
While resting, the journal grants advancement to each ability that was used only once that day.
This is a knowledge and advancement effect.
scribe.tag: This is a knowledge and advancement effect.

serene.name: Quiet Cultivation
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder uses outside of combat gain a little advancement.
Each ability can only gain this once every short while.
This is a serenity and advancement effect.
serene.tag: This is a serenity and advancement effect.

serpent.name: Baited Lesson
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The holder can lower its guard on purpose.
Each hit it takes while its guard is lowered adds advancement to its next ability. Raising its guard ends the effect.
This is a cunning and advancement effect.
serpent.tag: This is a cunning and advancement effect.

shark.name: Scent of Progress
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder lands on bleeding enemies gain a little advancement.
This only works while the target is bleeding.
This is a hunting and advancement effect.
shark.tag: This is a hunting and advancement effect.

shield.name: Braced Insight
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder blocks a heavy attack, its next ability is empowered and gains advancement.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a shield and advancement effect.
shield.tag: This is a shield and advancement effect.

shimmer.name: Fleeting Brilliance
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, that ability costs no mana for a short time.
The holder cannot gain this again until the fight ends.
This is an illusion and advancement effect.
shimmer.tag: This is an illusion and advancement effect.

ship.name: Shipshape Crew
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder defeats an enemy, each nearby ally's most recently used ability gains a sliver of advancement.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a support and advancement effect.
ship.tag: This is a support and advancement effect.

shovel.name: Unearthed Talent
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each enemy the holder defeats adds a spadeful of earth to a pile.
When the pile is full, the holder unearths a buried talent, and a random ability of its gains a burst of advancement.
This is an earth and advancement effect.
shovel.tag: This is an earth and advancement effect.

sickle.name: Clean Harvest Stroke
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities finishes a wounded enemy, that ability's cooldown is shortened.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a harvest and haste effect.
sickle.tag: This is a harvest and haste effect.

simulacrum.name: Simulated Sparring
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Once per rest, the holder can spar against a conjured simulacrum of a foe it has fought.
Abilities used in the spar gain advancement, but the holder ends the rest with a little less stamina.
This is a simulacrum and training effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a simulacrum and training effect.

sin.name: Pride's Edge
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
After one of the holder's abilities ranks up in a fight, the holder deals a little extra damage but also takes a little extra damage.
The effect lasts until the fight ends.
This is a pride and advancement effect.
sin.tag: This is a pride and advancement effect.

skirmish.name: Probing Engagements
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder uses just after retreating from an enemy gain a little advancement.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a momentum and advancement effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a momentum and advancement effect.

skunk.name: Pungent Lesson
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder is struck by a harmful effect, its abilities gain a little advancement and it briefly resists that same effect.
This has a cooldown for each kind of effect.
This is a poison and knowledge effect.
skunk.tag: This is a poison and knowledge effect.

sky.name: Open Horizons
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While the holder fights under the open sky, its abilities gain a little advancement.
This only works outdoors.
This is a wind and advancement effect.
sky.tag: This is a wind and advancement effect.

sloth.name: Idle Mastery
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
At the end of each fight, each of the holder's abilities that was not used in that fight gains a little advancement.
Abilities that cannot be used in combat do not count.
This is a rest and advancement effect.
sloth.tag: This is a rest and advancement effect.

smoke.name: Vanishing Flourish
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, the holder vanishes in a puff of smoke and is unseen for a moment.
The effect ends early if the holder attacks.
This is a stealth and advancement effect.
smoke.tag: This is a stealth and advancement effect.

snake.name: Second Strike Hunger
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities misses, its cooldown is shortened so the holder can try again.
This can happen once every short while.
This is a persistence and haste effect.
snake.tag: This is a persistence and haste effect.

soaring.name: Ever-Upward
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each rank-up the holder reaches in a fight adds a stack of lift.
At several stacks, its abilities deal extra damage until the fight ends.
This is a wind and momentum effect.
soaring.tag: This is a wind and momentum effect.

song.name: Ballad of Deeds
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The holder's great deeds become songs: defeating a boss, rescuing an ally or clearing a floor.
While resting, each deed sung grants advancement to all of the holder's abilities.
This is a sound and advancement effect.
song.tag: This is a sound and advancement effect.

sovereign.name: Usurper's Due
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder defeats an enemy leader, its abilities gain advancement and nearby enemies falter for a moment.
This happens once for each leader.
This is a command and advancement effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a command and advancement effect.

spear.name: Forward Thrust Drive
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder uses while advancing toward an enemy gain a little advancement.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a momentum and advancement effect.
spear.tag: This is a momentum and advancement effect.

spider.name: Web of Study
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each enemy the holder slows or binds is caught in its web of study.
The holder's next ability against a caught enemy gains advancement.
This is a binding and knowledge effect.
spider.tag: This is a binding and knowledge effect.

spike.name: Bristling Triumph
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, spikes burst from its body and wound nearby enemies.
The spikes retract after a moment.
This is a defensive and advancement effect.
spike.tag: This is a defensive and advancement effect.

staff.name: Long Channel Practice
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder channels gain advancement for each moment they are channelled.
The bonus is capped for each channel.
This is a magic and advancement effect.
staff.tag: This is a magic and advancement effect.

star.name: Polestar Calling
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The holder's highest-ranked ability becomes its guiding star.
Whenever that ability lands the final blow on an enemy, every other ability the holder used in the fight gains a sliver of advancement.
This is a star and advancement effect.
star.tag: This is a star and advancement effect.

stellar.name: Rising Constellation
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each rank-up the holder reaches during a delve adds a star to its constellation.
Each star grants a little mana recovery until the delve ends.
This is a star and restoration effect.
stellar.tag: This is a star and restoration effect.

storm.name: Gathering Storm
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each ability the holder uses in a fight builds a storm charge.
When the holder lands a final blow, the charge breaks as advancement among the abilities it used and resets.
This is a storm and advancement effect.
storm.tag: This is a storm and advancement effect.

succubus.name: Charmed Tutelage
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder lands on charmed or confused enemies gain advancement.
The same enemy can only provide this once every short while.
This is a charm and advancement effect.
succubus.tag: This is a charm and advancement effect.

sun.name: Sunlit Striving
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder uses in daylight gain a little advancement.
This only works outdoors in daylight.
This is a light and advancement effect.
sun.tag: This is a light and advancement effect.

swarm.name: Crowd-Driven
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each ability the holder uses gains a little advancement for each ally standing near it.
The bonus is capped.
This is a swarm and support effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and support effect.

swift.name: Quickened Mastery
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, that ability has no wind-up for a short time.
This happens once for each rank.
This is a haste and advancement effect.
swift.tag: This is a haste and advancement effect.

sword.name: Duellist's Ladder
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While the holder is fighting a single enemy with no one else involved, its abilities gain advancement.
The bonus ends when another combatant joins.
This is a mastery and rivalry effect.
sword.tag: This is a mastery and rivalry effect.

talisman.name: Lucky Token of Striving
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Once per day, when one of the holder's abilities would miss, a lucky token makes it hit instead.
That ability also gains a little advancement.
This is a luck and advancement effect.
talisman.tag: This is a luck and advancement effect.

tentacle.name: Siphoning Grip
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder grabs or holds an enemy, it draws out a sliver of that enemy's skill, and its next ability gains advancement.
This has a cooldown for each enemy.
This is a binding and knowledge effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a binding and knowledge effect.

thread.name: Unbroken Thread
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each ability the holder uses in consecutive fights builds a thread.
The longer the thread, the more advancement that ability gains when used. Skipping it in a fight breaks the thread.
This is a persistence and advancement effect.
thread.tag: This is a persistence and advancement effect.

thunderbird.name: Heralding Thunder
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, a bolt of lightning strikes the nearest enemy.
The bolt's damage scales with the new rank.
This is a lightning and advancement effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a lightning and advancement effect.

time.name: Patient Investment
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The longer one of the holder's abilities stays at its current rank, the larger the advancement each use gains.
The bonus is capped and resets when the ability ranks up.
This is a time and advancement effect.
time.tag: This is a time and advancement effect.

tranquil.name: Undisturbed Focus
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While no enemy is targeting the holder, its abilities cost a little less mana and gain a little advancement.
The effect ends the moment an enemy targets it.
This is a serenity and advancement effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a serenity and advancement effect.

transfiguration.name: Reshaped Calling
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, the holder may change that ability's element for the rest of the day.
The choice must be made when the rank is reached.
This is a transformation and advancement effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a transformation and advancement effect.

transgression.name: Forbidden Overreach
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The holder can use an ability that is still on cooldown by paying a portion of its health.
An ability used this way gains advancement. This can happen once per fight.
This is a curse and advancement effect.
transgression.tag: This is a curse and advancement effect.

trap.name: Snare-Setter's Craft
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When an enemy triggers one of the holder's traps, the ability that set it gains advancement.
The holder's next trap is also set with no wind-up.
This is a trap and advancement effect.
trap.tag: This is a trap and advancement effect.

tree.name: Ringed Years of Striving
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each day the holder survives adds a ring to its growth.
Each ring grants a little health, up to a cap.
This is a growth and endurance effect.
tree.tag: This is a growth and endurance effect.

troll.name: Mending Drive
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While the holder is regenerating health, each ability it uses gains a little advancement.
This only works while the holder is below full health.
This is a regeneration and advancement effect.
troll.tag: This is a regeneration and advancement effect.

trowel.name: Careful Craftsmanship
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder uses during an enemy's wind-up gain advancement.
This only counts enemies that are winding up an attack.
This is a precision and advancement effect.
trowel.tag: This is a precision and advancement effect.

turtle.name: Slow and Steady
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
At the end of each long fight, every ability the holder used gains advancement that scales with the fight's length.
Short fights grant nothing from this effect.
This is an endurance and advancement effect.
turtle.tag: This is an endurance and advancement effect.

twilight.name: Final Push
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When only one enemy remains standing in a fight, each ability the holder uses against it gains advancement.
This ends when that enemy falls.
This is a shadow and advancement effect.
twilight.tag: This is a shadow and advancement effect.

undeath.name: Last Lesson Held
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Once per fight, when the holder would fall, it clings on until its current ability finishes.
That ability gains a burst of advancement before the holder falls.
This is a necromantic and advancement effect.
undeath.tag: This is a necromantic and advancement effect.

unity.name: Common Cause
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the party defeats a boss with every member still standing, each member's abilities gain advancement.
The holder must be among them for this to work.
This is an unity and advancement effect.
unity.tag: This is an unity and advancement effect.

vast.name: Grand Designs
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder has explored every corner of a floor, all of its abilities gain advancement.
This happens once for each floor.
This is an exploration and advancement effect.
vast.tag: This is an exploration and advancement effect.

vehicle.name: Driven Forward
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Abilities the holder uses while mounted or riding gain a little advancement.
This only works while the holder is mounted.
This is a travel and advancement effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a travel and advancement effect.

venom.name: Envious Venom
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When an ally's ability ranks up, the holder's next ability carries a poison born of envy.
This has a cooldown.
This is a poison and rivalry effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and rivalry effect.

verdant.name: Blooming Accomplishment
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, flowers bloom around it, and allies standing among them heal a little.
The flowers wither after a short time.
This is a growth and healing effect.
verdant.tag: This is a growth and healing effect.

vessel.name: Brimming Vessel of Effort
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Advancement the holder earns beyond what an ability needs to rank up is stored in a vessel.
While resting, the holder can pour the vessel into any of its abilities.
This is a vessel and advancement effect.
vessel.tag: This is a vessel and advancement effect.

visage.name: Determined Countenance
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities ranks up, its face hardens with resolve, and enemies nearby are briefly intimidated.
Intimidated enemies hesitate before attacking.
This is an intimidation and advancement effect.
visage.tag: This is an intimidation and advancement effect.

vision.name: Anticipated Lesson
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder dodges an attack just before it lands, its next ability gains advancement.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a perception and advancement effect.
vision.tag: This is a perception and advancement effect.

void.name: Empty-Handed Drive
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While the holder has no boons active, its abilities gain a little advancement.
Gaining any boon ends the effect until it fades.
This is a void and advancement effect.
void.tag: This is a void and advancement effect.

volcano.name: Erupting Determination
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder's health falls very low, its frustration erupts: its next ability bursts with fire around it and gains advancement.
This happens once per fight.
This is a fire and advancement effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and advancement effect.

vortex.name: Spiralling Momentum
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When one of the holder's abilities hits enemies all around it, its cooldown is shortened for each enemy struck.
The shortening is capped for each use.
This is a wind and haste effect.
vortex.tag: This is a wind and haste effect.

wasp.name: Alarm Sting
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder is struck, its next ability within a moment comes out with no wind-up and gains a little advancement.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a poison and haste effect.
wasp.tag: This is a poison and haste effect.

water.name: Flowing Study
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder uses an ability on wet ground or in water, the ability gains a little advancement.

This is a water and advancement effect.
water.tag: This is a water and advancement effect.

weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.

weave.tag: This is a pattern and advancement effect.

wendigo.name: Insatiable Climb

wendigo.tag: This is a hunger and advancement effect.

whale.name: Deep Breath Study
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
After a long rest, the holder starts the next fight with a store of focus.
Each of its abilities draws from the store as it is used, gaining advancement until the store runs dry.
This is a water and advancement effect.
whale.tag: This is a water and advancement effect.

wheel.name: Wheel of Ascent
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each time one of the holder's abilities ranks up, the wheel turns, and the ability with the longest remaining cooldown is reset.
This happens once for each rank.
This is a time and haste effect.
wheel.tag: This is a time and haste effect.

whip.name: Driving Lash
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
The holder can lash itself onward: its next ability gains advancement and is quickened, but costs a little health.
This has a cooldown.
This is a momentum and advancement effect.
whip.tag: This is a momentum and advancement effect.

wind.name: Tailwind Learning
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While the holder is moving at full speed, each ability it uses gains a little advancement.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a wind and advancement effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and advancement effect.

wing.name: Spread Wings
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each time one of the holder's abilities ranks up, spectral wings unfold behind it and shield it from the next hit.
The wings fold away after the hit or a short time.
This is a wind and protection effect.
wing.tag: This is a wind and protection effect.

wolf.name: Pack Ambition
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder and an ally attack the same enemy, the holder's abilities gain a little advancement against it.
This only works while an ally is attacking the same enemy.
This is a hunting and support effect.
wolf.tag: This is a hunting and support effect.

wood.name: Heartwood Grain
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Each fight adds a grain to the holder's heartwood.
When the grains fill, its defensive abilities gain a large portion of advancement and the grains reset.
This is a nature and advancement effect.
wood.tag: This is a nature and advancement effect.

wrath.name: Thwarted Fury
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
When the holder's attack is blocked or parried, its anger builds.
At full anger, its next ability deals heavy extra damage and gains advancement.
This is a wrath and advancement effect.
wrath.tag: This is a wrath and advancement effect.

zeal.name: Single-Minded Drive
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
While the holder attacks only its chosen target, its abilities gain a little advancement against that target.
Switching targets resets the effect.
This is a zeal and advancement effect.
zeal.tag: This is a zeal and advancement effect.

ziz.name: Sky-Ruler's Ambition
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Human Ambition]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Human Ambition].
Once per fight, when the holder defeats a flying enemy, all of its abilities gain advancement.
A great gust also pushes nearby enemies back.
This is a wind and advancement effect.
ziz.tag: This is a wind and advancement effect.

action.name: Seized Initiative
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
If the holder uses a special attack before any enemy has attacked in a fight, that attack's cooldown ends at once.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a haste and momentum effect.
action.tag: This is a haste and momentum effect.

adept.name: Clean Execution
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
A special attack the holder begins standing still and finishes without being struck refunds a portion of its stamina cost.
After a few clean executions in a row, its next special attack cannot be interrupted.
This is a mastery and restoration effect.
adept.tag: This is a mastery and restoration effect.

alchemy.name: Volatile Residue
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Each special attack that lands leaves an alchemical residue on the target.
A later special attack against a target bearing residue ignites it in a burst that also strikes enemies beside the target, and the residue is spent.
This is an alchemy and area effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and area effect.

ambush.name: Waylayer's Patience
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
While the holder has not attacked for a short time, its next special attack against an enemy engaged with someone else cannot be blocked or dodged.
This has a cooldown.
This is a stealth and hunting effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and hunting effect.

animate.name: Homing Haft
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder can hurl its weapon as part of any melee special attack.
The weapon flies back to the holder's hand on its own, striking any enemy in its return path for a portion of the effect.
This is an animation and movement effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and movement effect.

anzu.name: Pilfered Stormcharge
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When a special attack interrupts an enemy's ability, the holder takes a charge of storm from it.
Its next special attack releases the charge as lightning that strikes the target and the enemy nearest it.
This is a lightning and storm effect.
anzu.tag: This is a lightning and storm effect.

ape.name: Brute's Heave
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder can seize a lower-rank enemy struck by a melee special attack and hurl it into another enemy, knocking both down.
This has a cooldown and costs stamina.
This is a momentum and restraint effect.
ape.tag: This is a momentum and restraint effect.

armour.name: Weighted Plate
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder's special attacks gain bonus effect equal to a portion of its own armour.
While the holder wears heavy armour, its special attacks also push lower-rank enemies a short way back.
This is a defensive and momentum effect.
armour.tag: This is a defensive and momentum effect.

arsenal.name: Quick-Change Form
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When the holder switches weapons, its special attack cooldowns shorten slightly.
The first special attack made with the new weapon carries the damage type of the last weapon.
This is a mastery and haste effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a mastery and haste effect.

aspect.name: Borrowed Beast Aspect
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When a special attack strikes a beast, the holder takes on an aspect of it, and its next special attack carries that beast's way of fighting: a bleeding bite, a throwing horn or a poisonous sting.
Only one aspect is held at a time.
This is a transformation and hunting effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation and hunting effect.

avatar.name: Living Ideal
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder can become an embodiment of its techniques for a short time, and each ordinary attack it makes carries the extra effect of its last special attack.
When the embodiment ends, its special attacks cannot be used for a moment.
This is a transformation and mastery effect.
avatar.tag: This is a transformation and mastery effect.

axe.name: Woodsman's Notch
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Each special attack cuts a notch into the target.
At a few notches, the next special attack fells it, knocking it down with bonus effect and clearing the notches.
This is an affliction and momentum effect.
axe.tag: This is an affliction and momentum effect.

balance.name: Settled Follow-Through
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
After a special attack, the holder cannot be knocked down, pushed or staggered until its next attack.
An enemy that tries to unbalance it in that time is staggered instead.
This is a defensive and momentum effect.
balance.tag: This is a defensive and momentum effect.

bat.name: Night-Wing Strike
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
While the holder cannot see its target, its special attacks still find it.
Enemies that are blinded by any source take bonus effect from the holder's special attacks.
This is a sound and hunting effect.
bat.tag: This is a sound and hunting effect.

battlefield.name: Line Breaker
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When a special attack strikes an enemy standing in a group, the enemies beside it are shoved apart.
An enemy left with no ally beside it takes bonus effect from the holder's next special attack.
This is a momentum and command effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a momentum and command effect.

bear.name: Crushing Embrace
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
A melee special attack at very close range can become a crushing hold that keeps the target in place and squeezes away its stamina for a moment.
The holder cannot attack while it holds, and this has a cooldown.
This is a restraint and binding effect.
bear.tag: This is a restraint and binding effect.

bee.name: Dying Sting
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
While the holder is badly wounded, its next special attack strikes with greatly increased effect and leaves a lasting poison.
Afterward, the holder cannot use special attacks for a short time.
This is a poison and blood effect.
bee.tag: This is a poison and blood effect.

behemoth.name: Unparriable Mass
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder's special attacks cannot be parried or deflected.
An enemy that tries to parry one is knocked down.
This is a momentum and impact effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a momentum and impact effect.

bird.name: Stooping Dive
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
After the holder leaps or falls, its next special attack comes down from above, ignoring shields and knocking the target down.
This has a cooldown.
This is a wind and movement effect.
bird.tag: This is a wind and movement effect.

blight.name: Withering Grip
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Special attacks leave a blight that weakens the target's stamina recovery.
If the blighted target uses a special ability of its own, the blight flares and harms it.
This is an affliction and curse effect.
blight.tag: This is an affliction and curse effect.

blood.name: Blood Reserve
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Special attacks that make the target bleed fill a small reserve of blood within the holder.
When the holder is struck hard, the reserve spends itself to close the wound, and it empties when the fight ends.
This is a blood and healing effect.
blood.tag: This is a blood and healing effect.

bone.name: Splintered Guard
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When one of the holder's special attacks is blocked, it still splinters the blocking weapon or shield.
The blocker's defence is lowered for a short time.
This is an affliction and impact effect.
bone.tag: This is an affliction and impact effect.

boundary.name: Line Not Crossed
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
An enemy struck by the holder's special attack cannot move past the holder toward its allies for a short time.
Only a single enemy can be held back this way at a time.
This is a warding and barrier effect.
boundary.tag: This is a warding and barrier effect.

bounty.name: Spoils of Technique
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Enemies defeated by the holder's special attacks have a chance to drop an additional item.
The chance rises with the defeated enemy's rank.
This is a harvest effect.
bounty.tag: This is a harvest effect.

bow.name: Pinning Shaft
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
A ranged special attack that strikes a target beside a wall or tree pins it in place briefly.
A pinned target takes bonus effect from the holder's next ranged attack.
This is a restraint and hunting effect.
bow.tag: This is a restraint and hunting effect.

brush.name: Brushstroke Sign
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Each special attack the holder uses paints a brushstroke in the air beside it.
When a few strokes are painted in a short time, they complete a sign that grants the holder a brief boon of speed, defence or force, chosen by the order of the attacks.
This is a mastery and conjuration effect.
brush.tag: This is a mastery and conjuration effect.

cage.name: Hemmed In
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Enemies struck by the holder's special attacks cannot move farther from the holder for a short time, though they can move closer.
This has a cooldown for each enemy.
This is a binding effect.
cage.tag: This is a binding effect.

cat.name: Nine-Lives Landing
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When the holder is knocked down or thrown, it lands on its feet and can follow at once with a special attack that has no wind-up.
This can happen a few times per fight.
This is a movement and momentum effect.
cat.tag: This is a movement and momentum effect.

cataclysm.name: Aftershock Burst
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When a special attack defeats an enemy, the body bursts in a shockwave that damages and staggers enemies around it.
A shockwave cannot set off another shockwave.
This is an annihilation and area effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an annihilation and area effect.

cattle.name: Stampede Signal
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When the holder charges into a special attack, allies near it charge with it, gaining a burst of speed toward the same target.
This has a cooldown.
This is a support and movement effect.
cattle.tag: This is a support and movement effect.

chain.name: Linked Sequence
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder can cancel the end of one special attack straight into another, chaining them with no recovery between.
Each link costs extra stamina, and the chain ends when the holder's stamina runs low.
This is a momentum and mastery effect.
chain.tag: This is a momentum and mastery effect.

chaotic.name: Unruly Rhythm
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Each time the holder uses a special attack, its cooldown is set to a random length within a range.
A special attack that comes back quickly gains slight bonus effect on its next use.
This is a chaos and time effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a chaos and time effect.

charlatan.name: Bluffed Technique
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder can pretend to begin a special attack without spending it.
Enemies that guard or dodge against the bluff are left open, and the holder's next ordinary attack against them strikes critically; this has a cooldown.
This is an illusion and mastery effect.
charlatan.tag: This is an illusion and mastery effect.

chicken.name: Pecking Precedence
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder's special attacks gain slight bonus effect against enemies of lower rank.
A lower-rank enemy struck by one hesitates to attack the holder for a moment.
This is a command and curse effect.
chicken.tag: This is a command and curse effect.

chimera.name: Three-Headed Strike
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder's special attacks deal fire, poison and physical damage together.
Whichever of the three the target resists least lingers on it as a short affliction.
This is a fire and poison effect.
chimera.tag: This is a fire and poison effect.

claw.name: Tearing Follow-Up
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
After a special attack lands, the holder's next two ordinary attacks against that target are quick rakes that cannot be blocked.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a hunting and haste effect.
claw.tag: This is a hunting and haste effect.

cloth.name: Sleeve Snare
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder's special attacks can wrap a strip of cloth around the target's weapon arm.
The target's next attack is slow and clumsy and can be easily evaded.
This is a binding effect.
cloth.tag: This is a binding effect.

cloud.name: Gathering Mist
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
After the holder uses a special attack, mist gathers around it, and ranged attacks against it miss more often until its next special attack.
The mist cannot gather while the holder stands in fire.
This is an evasion and water effect.
cloud.tag: This is an evasion and water effect.

cold.name: Shattering Frost
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
A special attack against a chilled or frozen target shatters the frost, dealing a burst of cold damage to the target and to enemies right beside it.
The chill ends when it shatters.
This is a cold and area effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and area effect.

coral.name: Coral-Crusted Edge
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Each special attack that lands grows a layer of coral on the holder's weapon, adding a little damage to its ordinary attacks.
At a few layers, the coral breaks off in a spray of shards that strikes enemies around the target.
This is a growth and area effect.
coral.tag: This is a growth and area effect.

corrupt.name: Festering Combination
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Each special attack the holder lands on a cursed target lengthens every curse already on it.
Each curse can be lengthened this way only a few times.
This is a curse effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a curse effect.

crocodile.name: Lying-Low Lunge
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
While the holder is crouched or prone, its next special attack bursts up from the ground with no wind-up and drags the target off its feet.
This has a cooldown.
This is a hunting and restraint effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a hunting and restraint effect.

crystal.name: Ringing Lattice
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Special attacks grow a crystal lattice on the target that rings when the target is struck.
Each ring shortens the holder's special attack cooldowns slightly, and the lattice breaks after a few rings.
This is a crystal and resonance effect.
crystal.tag: This is a crystal and resonance effect.

cycle.name: Four-Season Form
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder's special attacks cycle through the seasons in order: spring mends the holder slightly, summer burns, autumn weakens and winter slows.
Each season's effect lands on the target struck, or on the holder for spring.
This is a time and nature effect.
cycle.tag: This is a time and nature effect.

dance.name: Spinning Recovery
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
After a special attack, the holder twirls out of its recovery, and the turn strikes enemies behind it for a portion of the effect.
The turn costs a little stamina.
This is a movement and area effect.
dance.tag: This is a movement and area effect.

dark.name: Lightless Edge
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
While the holder stands in darkness, its special attacks make no sound and give off no light.
Enemies struck do not know where the blow came from and turn the wrong way briefly.
This is a darkness and stealth effect.
dark.tag: This is a darkness and stealth effect.

dawn.name: First Light Return
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When the holder recovers from a stun, a knockdown or near death, its next special attack shines with dawnlight.
The dawnlight clears an affliction from each ally near the target.
This is a light and purification effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and purification effect.

death.name: Toll of Passing
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When an enemy dies near the holder, the holder's special attack cooldowns shorten slightly.
This can happen once for each enemy.
This is a death and momentum effect.
death.tag: This is a death and momentum effect.

deep.name: Drowning Weight
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Each special attack lays a weight on the target that slows its attacks.
While the weight is heavy, the target cannot jump, leap or fly.
This is a restraint and darkness effect.
deep.tag: This is a restraint and darkness effect.

deer.name: Startle Kick
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When an enemy approaches the holder from behind, its next special attack is a backward kick that knocks that enemy away.
This has a short cooldown.
This is an evasion and momentum effect.
deer.tag: This is an evasion and momentum effect.

desolate.name: Lone Survivor
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
While no ally is near the holder, its special attacks gain bonus effect and cost less stamina.
The bonus ends the moment an ally comes close.
This is a mastery and survival effect.
desolate.tag: This is a mastery and survival effect.

dimension.name: Folded Pocket
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder can store one used special attack in a fold of space and release it later with no wind-up.
Storing the attack starts its cooldown, and only one attack can be stored.
This is a dimensional and time effect.
dimension.tag: This is a dimensional and time effect.

discord.name: Sour Note
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Special attacks lay a discordant note on the target, and its next ability is fumbled and delayed.
A target can carry only one note at a time.
This is a sound and curse effect.
discord.tag: This is a sound and curse effect.

discordant.name: Off-Beat Strike
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Special attacks used while an enemy is recovering from its own attack gain bonus effect and stagger it.
This can happen once every few seconds against each enemy.
This is a sound and momentum effect.
discordant.tag: This is a sound and momentum effect.

dog.name: Scent-Marked
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
An enemy struck by a special attack carries the holder's scent, and the holder always knows where it is.
The holder moves slightly faster toward a scent-marked enemy that is fleeing.
This is a hunting and tracking effect.
dog.tag: This is a hunting and tracking effect.

doom.name: Hour of Falling
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When a special attack strikes an enemy, the holder learns the hour of its fall.
If that enemy dies within a short time, the holder's special attack cooldowns end at once; this can happen once every short while.
This is a death and curse effect.
doom.tag: This is a death and curse effect.

doppelganger.name: Stolen Technique
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When an enemy uses a special attack on the holder, the holder can copy it and use a version of it once in place of one of its own.
Only one copied technique is held at a time, and it fades when the fight ends.
This is a transformation and mastery effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a transformation and mastery effect.

dragon.name: Hoarded Might
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Each special attack the holder keeps ready without using adds to a hoard of power.
Spending the hoard on one special attack releases it all as bonus effect, up to a limit that scales with rank.
This is a mastery and momentum effect.
dragon.tag: This is a mastery and momentum effect.

duck.name: Paddling Footwork
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder can use special attacks while swimming or wading without penalty.
Special attacks made from water splash enemies near the target, slowing them briefly.
This is a water and movement effect.
duck.tag: This is a water and movement effect.

dust.name: Clinging Dust
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Special attacks shake loose a fine dust that clings to the target.
The dust reveals the target while it is invisible and lowers its evasion for a short time.
This is a revelation and affliction effect.
dust.tag: This is a revelation and affliction effect.

earth.name: Upheaval Ridge
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder's special attacks raise a ridge of earth behind the target for a moment.
An enemy knocked back into the ridge is stunned briefly.
This is an earth and restraint effect.
earth.tag: This is an earth and restraint effect.

echo.name: Rebounding Blow
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When a special attack misses, it rebounds and strikes the nearest other enemy for a portion of its effect.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
echo.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

eclipse.name: Eclipsed Opening
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When the holder steps out from behind an ally to use a special attack, the target does not see it coming and cannot block it.
This has a cooldown.
This is a shadow and stealth effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a shadow and stealth effect.

edifice.name: Cornerstone Stance
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When the holder sets its feet before a special attack, it begins laying a foundation.
Until it moves, each special attack it uses raises its armour slightly, up to a limit that scales with rank.
This is a defensive and earth effect.
edifice.tag: This is a defensive and earth effect.

effigy.name: Pinned Likeness
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When a special attack strikes an enemy, a small likeness of that enemy forms in the holder's hand.
The holder's next special attack can strike the likeness instead, and the blow lands on the enemy wherever it stands; the likeness crumbles after a short time.
This is a curse and binding effect.
effigy.tag: This is a curse and binding effect.

elemental.name: Element Primer
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Special attacks leave an elemental mark on the target, cycling between fire, cold and lightning.
A spell of the matching element from any ally detonates the mark for added damage.
This is an elemental and support effect.
elemental.tag: This is an elemental and support effect.

elixir.name: Draught Reflex
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Drinking a potion does not interrupt the holder's special attacks.
The holder can drink in the middle of a wind-up without losing the attack.
This is an alchemy and haste effect.
elixir.tag: This is an alchemy and haste effect.

empower.name: Overcharged Blow
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder can pour extra stamina into a special attack as it begins, adding bonus effect for as long as it holds the attack.
The bonus has a limit that scales with rank, and the stamina is spent even if the attack misses.
This is a momentum and mastery effect.
empower.tag: This is a momentum and mastery effect.

eye.name: Fixed Gaze
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
While the holder keeps its eyes on one enemy without turning to another, its special attacks against that enemy gain critical chance that grows over time.
Turning to another target resets the gain.
This is a perception and hunting effect.
eye.tag: This is a perception and hunting effect.

feast.name: Well-Fed Technique
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
After the holder eats a proper meal, its special attacks cost less stamina for a long time.
The effect fades early if the holder goes hungry.
This is a restoration effect.
feast.tag: This is a restoration effect.

feeble.name: Weakened but Wicked
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
While the holder is weakened, slowed or under an affliction, its special attacks gain bonus effect.
The bonus does not grow with the number of afflictions.
This is an affliction and momentum effect.
feeble.tag: This is an affliction and momentum effect.

fertile.name: Seeded Repeat
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Each special attack the holder uses has a chance to leave behind a spare charge of itself, letting it be used once more before its cooldown ends.
A special attack can hold only one spare charge.
This is a growth and haste effect.
fertile.tag: This is a growth and haste effect.

fey.name: Faerie Pact Strike
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Once per fight, the holder can strike a bargain, and its next special attack has greatly increased effect.
The few special attacks after it cost health instead of stamina.
This is a curse and mastery effect.
fey.tag: This is a curse and mastery effect.

fire.name: Flare-Up Strike
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
A special attack against a burning target makes the flames flare, dealing the rest of the burn's damage at once.
The burn ends when it flares.
This is a fire effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire effect.

firebird.name: Spark-Bird Rising
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When a special attack defeats an enemy, a bird of sparks rises from it and dives at the nearest other enemy.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a fire and conjuration effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire and conjuration effect.

fish.name: Shoal Flicker
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
While several enemies surround the holder, each hit of its multi-strike special attacks lands on a different enemy among them.
The holder chooses the first target, and the rest are chosen at random.
This is a water and evasion effect.
fish.tag: This is a water and evasion effect.

flea.name: Itching Bite
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Special attacks leave a maddening itch on the target, and its ordinary attacks miss more often for a short time.
The itch cannot stack.
This is an affliction effect.
flea.tag: This is an affliction effect.

flesh.name: Elastic Reach
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder's body stretches during a special attack, lengthening its reach for that attack.
Stretching for an attack costs a little health.
This is a transformation effect.
flesh.tag: This is a transformation effect.

foot.name: Sweeping Heel
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Foot essence.

The holder's special attacks end with a low sweep that trips the target if it is moving.
A tripped target cannot dodge for a moment.
This is a restraint and momentum effect.
foot.tag: This is a restraint and momentum effect.

force.name: Recoil Spring
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Force confluence.

When one of the holder's special attacks is blocked, the force rebounds into it as a burst of speed for its next special attack.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a momentum and haste effect.
force.tag: This is a momentum and haste effect.

forge.name: Quenched Temper
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Forge confluence.

After a special attack, the holder's weapon cannot be broken, disarmed or weakened for a short time.
Each special attack also mends a little damage on the weapon.
This is a mastery and defensive effect.
forge.tag: This is a mastery and defensive effect.

fork.name: Forked Follow-Up
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Fork essence.

This is a mastery and movement effect.
fork.tag: This is a mastery and movement effect.

fortress.name: Gatehouse Stance
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
While the holder stands between an ally and an enemy, its special attacks block attacks aimed at that ally during their wind-up.

This is a protection and barrier effect.
fortress.tag: This is a protection and barrier effect.

fox.name: Stolen Finish
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Fox essence.

When an ally brings an enemy below a quarter of its health, the holder's next special attack against that enemy comes out faster and reaches farther.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a hunting and haste effect.
fox.tag: This is a hunting and haste effect.

frog.name: Toxic Skin
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Frog essence.

After the holder uses a special attack, its skin seeps poison for a short time.

This is a poison and defensive effect.
frog.tag: This is a poison and defensive effect.

fungus.name: Mycelial Thread
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Enemies struck by the holder's special attacks are joined by an unseen thread of fungus.
The next special attack against any one of them spreads a little damage to all the others, and the thread breaks.

fungus.tag: This is a growth and poison effect.

garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.

When the holder uses a special attack after a jump or dash, it streaks forward on a gust of golden wind, striking every enemy along the line.

This is a wind and movement effect.
garuda.tag: This is a wind and movement effect.

gathering.tag: This is a mastery effect.

glass.name: Glass Poise
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Glass essence.

While the holder has taken no damage in a fight, its special attacks strike critically.
The first hit the holder takes shatters the poise for the rest of the fight.
This is a mastery and glass effect.
glass.tag: This is a mastery and glass effect.

glimeron.name: Glimmer-Lit Target
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.

glimeron.tag: This is a light and support effect.

goat.name: High-Ground Footing
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Goat essence.

The holder's special attacks cannot be thrown off by uneven ground or ledges.

goat.tag: This is a movement and mastery effect.

gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.

An enemy that is facing the holder when its special attack lands is held fast for a moment, unable to act.
A target can be held this way only once every short while.

gorgon.tag: This is a binding and curse effect.

griffin.name: Grounding Talon
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.

griffin.tag: This is a wind and restraint effect.

growth.name: Seasoned Technique
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Growth essence.

Each fight in which the holder uses a special attack adds to that attack's seasoning.

growth.tag: This is a growth and mastery effect.

guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
