When an ally near the holder is about to be struck, the holder can use a special attack on the attacker that carries it into the blow's path, stopping the blow.
This has a cooldown and costs stamina.
This is a protection and movement effect.
guardian.tag: This is a protection and movement effect.

hair.name: Hair-Trigger Reflex
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When an enemy within reach begins an attack, the holder's next special attack can be started at once with a quickened wind-up.
This has a short cooldown.
This is a haste and perception effect.
hair.tag: This is a haste and perception effect.

hammer.name: Driving the Nail
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Special attacks against a knocked-down or rooted target drive it into the ground, holding it there a moment past its recovery.
A target can be driven down this way only once every short while.
This is a restraint and impact effect.
hammer.tag: This is a restraint and impact effect.

hand.name: Bare-Handed Arts
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Hand essence.

The holder can use any special attack without a weapon, striking with its bare hands.
Unarmed special attacks briefly disarm the target.
This is a mastery and restraint effect.
hand.tag: This is a mastery and restraint effect.

harmonic.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

harpy.name: Shrieking Descent
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
After the holder leaps, its next special attack lets out a shriek that frightens the target into running for a moment.
This has a cooldown.
This is a sound and curse effect.
harpy.tag: This is a sound and curse effect.

harvest.tag: This is a harvest effect.

heidel.name: Saddle Technique

heidel.tag: This is a movement and area effect.

hook.name: Guard Snag

lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder's special attacks can snag the target's shield or guard and turn it aside.
The next attack against that target from any source ignores its block.
This is a restraint and support effect.
hook.tag: This is a restraint and support effect.

horse.name: Hoofbeat Rhythm
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Each special attack the holder lands while moving grants it a stride of movement speed, stacking a few times.

horse.tag: This is a haste and movement effect.

hunger.name: Starving Edge
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Hunger essence.

While the holder's stamina is low, its special attacks cost health instead of stamina and gain bonus effect.

hunger.tag: This is a hunger and blood effect.

hunt.name: Spoor Reader
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder can see the trail left by any enemy struck by its special attacks for a long time.

hunt.tag: This is a tracking and hunting effect.

hydra.name: Regrowing Arts
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.

When one of the holder's special attacks is interrupted, it does not go on cooldown and can be used again at once.

hydra.tag: This is a regeneration and mastery effect.

ice.name: Slick Rink

ice.tag: This is an ice and restraint effect.

immortal.tag: This is a mastery and defensive effect.

iron.name: Unyielding Grasp

This is a defensive effect.
iron.tag: This is a defensive effect.

juggernaut.name: Wrecking Path
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder's charging special attacks break through conjured walls and barriers in their path.

This is a momentum and annihilation effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a momentum and annihilation effect.

karmic.name: Returned Favour
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.

When an ally heals or shields the holder, the holder's next special attack heals or shields that ally for a portion of what was given.

karmic.tag: This is a karmic and support effect.

knife.name: Opening Throw

This is a hunting and haste effect.
knife.tag: This is a hunting and haste effect.

knowledge.name: Applied Theory
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.

The holder knows which of its special attacks will deal the most damage to its current target.

knowledge.tag: This is a knowledge and perception effect.

kraken.name: Kraken's Wake

lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].

kraken.tag: This is a binding and water effect.

leviathan.name: Coiled Pressure
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Each special attack the holder lands in a fight coils pressure within it, up to a limit.
When the holder next takes heavy damage, the coil releases as a shockwave around it.
This is a water and area effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water and area effect.

life.name: Overflow Vigour
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Life essence.

life.tag: This is a life and healing effect.

light.name: Lantern Edge
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder's weapon glows after each special attack, lighting the area around it for a short time.

light.tag: This is a light and revelation effect.

lightning.name: Bolt-Lunge Opening
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder can turn the start of any special attack into a flash of lightning that carries it a short way toward the target.
Each flash costs mana and has a short cooldown.
This is a lightning and movement effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and movement effect.

lizard.name: Sun-Warmed Blood
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].

lizard.tag: This is a nature and time effect.

locust.name: Gnawing Through
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].

lotus.name: Pure Bloom

lurker.name: Hidden Reserve

The effect ends the moment any enemy sees it.

lurker.tag: This is a stealth and time effect.

When the holder's stamina runs low, it can pay for special attacks with mana instead.
Special attacks paid for with mana deal part of their damage as magic.
This is a magic and mastery effect.
magic.tag: This is a magic and mastery effect.

malign.name: Malignant Seed
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Malign essence.

Special attacks plant a malignant seed in the target that grows over a short time.
When another special attack strikes the target, the seed bursts, dealing damage based on how long it grew.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

manatee.name: Pulled Blow
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder can pull its special attacks to leave lower-rank enemies senseless instead of slain.
A senseless enemy cannot rise again during the fight.
This is a restraint effect.
manatee.tag: This is a restraint effect.

manticore.name: Spine Volley
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder's special attacks fling a spray of spines behind it at enemies attacking its back.
The spines carry a weak poison.
This is a poison and area effect.
manticore.tag: This is a poison and area effect.

master.name: Signature Technique
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The special attack the holder has used most over its life gains slight bonus effect and costs less stamina.
If another attack overtakes it, the bonus moves to that attack.
This is a mastery effect.
master.tag: This is a mastery effect.

might.name: Guard Breaker
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder's special attacks cannot be blocked by enemies of lower rank.
Such an enemy that tries has its guard broken and is staggered.
This is a momentum effect.
might.tag: This is a momentum effect.

ministration.name: Triage Strike
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When the holder's special attack strikes an enemy that is attacking an ally, that ally is cleansed of one affliction.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a healing and purification effect.
ministration.tag: This is a healing and purification effect.

minotaur.name: Corridor Fighter
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
In corridors and narrow passages, the holder's special attacks strike every enemy in the line in front of it.
Each enemy past the first takes a portion of the effect.
This is an area effect.
minotaur.tag: This is an area effect.

mirage.name: Wavering Wind-Up
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.

The holder's form wavers while it winds up a special attack.
Ranged attacks aimed at it during the wind-up strike where it appears to be, a short way off.
This is an illusion and evasion effect.
mirage.tag: This is an illusion and evasion effect.

mirror.name: Mirrored Side
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Each special attack the holder lands is also performed in mirror image on its other side, striking any enemy there for a portion of the effect.
The mirror image costs a little mana.
This is a mirror and area effect.
mirror.tag: This is a mirror and area effect.

monkey.name: Tumbling Technique
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder can begin a special attack in the middle of a roll, vault or climb without stopping.
A special attack begun this way costs a little extra stamina.
This is a movement and haste effect.
monkey.tag: This is a movement and haste effect.

monolith.name: Victory Monument
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When a special attack defeats a powerful enemy, the holder raises a stone monument where it fell.
Allies near the monument resist fear and stagger for the rest of the fight.
This is a command and support effect.
monolith.tag: This is a command and support effect.

moon.name: Tide-Pull Strike
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
At night, the holder's special attacks pull the target a short way toward the holder.
By day, they push the target a short way back.
This is a time and movement effect.
moon.tag: This is a time and movement effect.

mouse.name: Beneath the Giant
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder can use a special attack while slipping between a larger enemy's legs, striking it from beneath where it cannot block.
This has a cooldown.
This is an evasion and hunting effect.
mouse.tag: This is an evasion and hunting effect.

myriad.name: Strength in Numbers
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Myriad essence.

The holder's special attacks gain slight bonus effect for each enemy in the fight, up to a limit that scales with rank.
The bonus shrinks as enemies fall.
This is a swarm and mastery effect.

mystic.name: Inner Flow
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.

When a special attack defeats an enemy, a small star is born where it fell.
Allies standing in the star's light regain mana slowly until it fades.

needle.name: Nerve-Point Strike
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Needle essence.

The holder's special attacks can strike a nerve point, numbing one of the target's limbs.
A numbed arm slows the target's attacks, and a numbed leg slows its movement, for a short time.
This is a precision and affliction effect.
needle.tag: This is a precision and affliction effect.

nemesis.name: Rival's Lesson
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When an enemy defeats or nearly defeats the holder, the holder remembers it.
In any later fight against that enemy, the holder's special attacks against it gain bonus effect.
This is a tracking and curse effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a tracking and curse effect.

net.name: Catching Net
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
When an enemy tries to escape the holder by leaping, flying or dashing, the holder's next special attack throws a net that brings it down.
This has a cooldown.

network.name: Shared Opening
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Network confluence.

When any ally interrupts or staggers an enemy, the holder knows at once.

oasis.name: Respite Spring
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.

ocean.name: Tidal Cadence
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.

omen.name: Ill Omen

pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.

pangolin.tag: This is a movement and defensive effect.

phoenix.tag: This is a fire and rebirth effect.

rabbit.name: Lucky Foot

rabbit.tag: This is a fortune and haste effect.

rat.tag: This is a survival and momentum effect.

roc.name: Vaulting Updraft

sand.name: Grinding Grit

serene.name: Unhurried Hand

shield.name: Shield-First Technique
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Shield essence.

shield.tag: This is a shield and defensive effect.

shimmer.name: Glittering Edge
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.

ship.name: Ramming Prow
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Ship essence.

sin.name: Envious Strike

skunk.name: Lingering Reek

sloth.name: Restful Swing
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Sloth essence.

smoke.name: Smoke Signal
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Smoke essence.

The charge is stopped dead.

spear.tag: This is a defensive and momentum effect.

spider.name: Silk Tether
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Special attacks leave a silk line between the holder and the target.
The holder can pull itself along the line to the target in an instant; the line breaks after a short time.
This is a binding and movement effect.
spider.tag: This is a binding and movement effect.

spike.name: Bristling Recoil
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
For a moment after a special attack, the holder bristles with spikes.
Enemies that strike it in melee during that moment are hurt.
This is a defensive effect.
spike.tag: This is a defensive effect.

staff.name: Spinning Guard
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
While the holder spins its weapon at the end of a special attack, it deflects small projectiles.
The spin costs a little stamina.
This is a defensive and mastery effect.
staff.tag: This is a defensive and mastery effect.

star.name: North-Star Course
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
The holder's ranged special attacks curve toward the nearest enemy if they would miss.
This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a light and hunting effect.
star.tag: This is a light and hunting effect.

stellar.name: Constellation Link
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
Each enemy struck by a special attack in a fight is marked with a point of light.
When several are lit, the holder can link them in a line of starfire that damages all of them at once and clears the points.
This is a light and annihilation effect.
stellar.tag: This is a light and annihilation effect.

storm.name: Rain-Called Strike
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Special Attack Aptitude].
While the holder stands in rain or a storm, each special attack has a chance to call lightning down on its target.

This is a storm and lightning effect.
storm.tag: This is a storm and lightning effect.

succubus.name: Captivating Display
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.

An enemy that watches the holder use a special attack on someone else is entranced.
Its approach is slowed for a short time.
This is a charm and command effect.

sun.name: Stored Sunlight
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Sun essence.

While in direct sunlight, the holder slowly stores light.

This is a light and fire effect.

swarm.name: Many Small Cuts
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.

This is a haste and movement effect.

sword.name: Riposte Form
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Sword essence.

sword.tag: This is a mastery and momentum effect.

talisman.name: Lucky Token
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.

thread.name: Tugging Thread
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Thread essence.

thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Human] ability [Special Attack Aptitude]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.

volcano.tag: This is a fire and area effect.

wendigo.tag: This is a hunger and cold effect.

wheel.name: Rolling Onward

whip.name: Cracking Tip

wind.name: Whistling Edge

As a special attack lands, the holder's weapon cuts a blade of air.

wind.tag: This is a wind effect.

wing.name: Wingbeat Overture

wolf.name: Flanking Call

zeal.name: Fervent Opening

The first special attack the holder uses on each enemy in a fight gains bonus effect.

This is a momentum and hunting effect.
zeal.tag: This is a momentum and hunting effect.

ziz.tag: This is a wind and protection effect.
